zh: &219 对你来说，这就是家常便饭，对吧？

en: &2540 It's my job.
&2541 Sorry. It's not personal.
&2542 I'm used to it.
&2543 My personal timeline changes several times a day.
zh: &2543 我的个人时间线一天要变好几次。

en: &220 Either way. You did a good thing.
zh: &220 不管怎样。你做了一件好事。

en: &221 You created a legacy of music for Liz. A legacy of art for Pie Sycamore.
zh: &221 莉兹的音乐，派·西卡莫尔的画，都因为你才能流传下来。

en: &2544 I didn't intend to do either of those things.
zh: &2544 这两件事都不是我有意做的。

en: &222 So what? It still happened.
zh: &222 那又怎样？事情还是发生了。

en: &223 Heck, by saving Pie's life as a child, you created all of us.
zh: &223 你在派小时候救了她，才有了后来的我们这些人啊。

en: &224 In a way, we're YOUR legacy.
zh: &224 换句话说，我们也是你留给这个世界的。

en: &2545 This is the Inman family legacy, not mine. It has nothing to do with me.
zh: &2545 这些是英曼家族留下的，跟我没关系。

en: &225 That painting with your face on it tells me otherwise.
zh: &225 那幅画着你的脸的画告诉我并非如此。

en: &2546 This could all change tomorrow.
zh: &2546 这一切明天都可能改变。

en: &226 So what? I could get hit by a cargo truck tomorrow.
zh: &226 那又怎样？说不定我明天就被卡车撞死了。

en: &2547 All part of the service, Imani.
zh: &2547 都是服务的一部分，伊曼妮。

en: &227 You keep talking like it's just a job.
zh: &227 你一直说得好像这只是一份工作。

en: &2548 Can't I just enjoy this painting for its own sake?
zh: &2548 我就不能单纯欣赏这幅画本身吗？

en: &2549 I'm happy it exists. I like looking at it. And I'll continue to do so while it's... here.
zh: &2549 我很高兴有这幅画，也喜欢看它。只要它还……在，就继续看。

en: &2550 I'm not supposed to have anything more.
&228 I don't understand.
&3900 Everything else changes. Not me. Never me.
zh: &3900 其他一切都在变。只有我不变。永远不变。

en: &3901 We're supposed to just focus on the job. I see why now.
zh: &3901 我们本该只专注于任务。现在我明白为什么了。

en: &3902 Because anything can be taken from us. Just like that.
zh: &3902 因为什么都可能一下子从我们身边消失。

en: &229 That's everyone on the planet, Fia.
zh: &229 菲娅，地球上每个人都是如此。

en: &3903 It's different for me.
&230 I don't think it is.
&231 There's the proof. Right here on these canvases.
zh: &231 证据就在这里。就在这些画布上。

en: &2558 I know you mean well, but you really don't know what you're saying.
zh: &2558 我知道你是好意，但你真的不知道自己在说什么。

en: &2559 I know you mean well, but you're mistaken.
zh: &2559 我知道你是好意，但你搞错了。

en: &2560 They aren't proof of anything. Not really.
zh: &2560 它们证明不了什么。真的。

en: &232 Oh please. Just let yourself be HAPPY. If it were me, I'd be puffing with pride.
zh: &232 拜托，就让自己开心一回吧。换成我，早得意得不得了了。

en: &233 In fact... I think that's why you come here.
zh: &233 其实……我觉得这就是你来这里的原因。

en: &234 You're PROUD.
&235 That's it, isn't it?
&236 Tell me I'm wrong.
&7078 Blast it.
&4864 You don't recognize me?
&274 I'm afraid I don't.
&275 But we change that, can't we?
zh: &275 那现在认识一下，不就行了？

en: &4865 It depends on your point of view.
&276 I've studied points of views my whole life.
&277 But I'm not sure I follow.
zh: &277 但我不太明白你的意思。

en: &4866 No. We haven't.
&278 And yet you know my name.
&4867 Sorry. It doesn't matter.
&4868 Nothing is definite anyway.
zh: &4868 反正没有什么是确定的。

en: &279 Um. It's not?
&4869 No. Not as far as I'm concerned.
&4870 Who knows what may or may not exist from one minute to the next?
zh: &4870 谁知道下一分钟什么存在，什么不存在？

en: &4871 Er. Sorry. I'm not making any sense.
zh: &4871 呃。抱歉。我有点语无伦次。

en: &280 I work with artists. I'm used to nothing making sense.
zh: &280 我跟艺术家打交道，听不懂话，早习惯了。

en: &4872 Heh. Try working with time travel.
zh: &4872 呵。试试跟时间旅行打交道。

en: &281 Oh! You're with ChronoZen.
&282 Don't tell me. You are from the future!
&4873 I couldn't tell you even if I was.
zh: &4873 就算我是，我也不能告诉你。

en: &283 A woman of mystery, huh?
&4874 I'm from the past, technically.
&284 In the sense that we're all from the past?
zh: &284 是说，过去的事塑造了我们每个人？

en: &4875 You got me.
&4876 I'm just here for... myself.
zh: &4876 我只是为了……我自己而来。

en: &285 Well. I can get behind that.
&286 And here I thought you were here to rescue some precious work of art.
zh: &286 我还以为你是来拯救某件珍贵艺术品的。

en: &4878 I... wasn't able to do that.
&4879 It's nothing. Painting with my face on it. Gone now. No big deal.
zh: &4879 没什么，就是一幅画着我的画，现在没了。没什么大不了的。

en: &289 Your face on canvas. Yeah, I can see that.
zh: &289 你的脸在画布上。是啊，我能想象。

en: &290 I can definitely... see your face.
&291 We... DEFINITELY know each other.
&292 Don't we?
&4880 We know each other now.
&293 That's not what I mean.
&294 It's like...
&4881 Don't worry about it. Please.
&295 Worry? Why would I...
&4882 It really doesn't matter.
&296 Doesn't matter? Of course it...
&297 Wait.
&298 Oh. My. Blasting. God.
&299 Time traveler.
&300 It's you. Isn't it?
&4883 Did you sleep well?
&301 Did I sleep WELL? I slept the entire DAY!
zh: &301 我睡得好吗？我睡了整整一天！

en: &4884 You remember me.
&302 Of course I remember you. You don't forget a night like that.
zh: &302 当然记得，那样一晚上，谁忘得了？

en: &4885 You owe me a coffee.
&303 A coffee. Sure. Drugged or undrugged?
zh: &303 一杯咖啡。行。加料还是不加料？

en: &305 This is a lot to process.
&306 How long has it been? For you, I mean?
zh: &306 从那时到现在，对你来说过了多久？

en: &4886 About an hour. You were sleeping when I left.
zh: &4886 大概一个小时。我走的时候你还在睡。

en: &307 An hour.
&308 It's been sixty years for me.
zh: &308 对我来说已经过了六十年。

en: &7155 I know.
&309 I woke up thinking I was gonna get fired, but then I turned on the news...
zh: &309 我醒来时还以为自己会被炒鱿鱼，但后来我打开了新闻……

en: &310 Do you have any idea how much survivor's guilt I had to work through?
zh: &310 你知道我花了多久，才不再因为自己活下来了而内疚吗？

en: &4887 I'm just glad you're okay.
&311 Oh don't get me wrong. So am I.
&312 It took a decade of therapy to be comfortable with that.
zh: &312 做了十年心理治疗，才慢慢接受。

en: &4888 Maybe I shouldn't have told you?
&313 And spend the rest of my life not knowing? No. This is better.
zh: &313 然后一辈子蒙在鼓里？不，还是知道了好。

en: &4889 I'm sorry you had to go through that, but... I'd do it again.
zh: &4889 我很抱歉你经历了那些，但是……我还会那么做。

en: &314 I get it. It's just hard to know how to feel about this.
zh: &314 我明白。只是很难说清对此该作何感受。

en: &315 I waited for you to call. I waited... a long time.
zh: &315 我等过你的电话。我等了……很久。

en: &316 I thought I'd said something wrong. That I was too eager or not eager enough or that night was just the excitement from being almost murdered or...
zh: &316 我以为是哪里说错了，是我太主动，还是不够主动，或者那晚只是因为差点被杀，太激动了，又或者……

en: &317 I never thought TIME TRAVELER. I mean, why would I?
zh: &317 我从没想过是时间旅行者。我是说，我怎么会想到呢？

en: &318 Is that why you were there? To save my life?
zh: &318 你当时在那里就是为了这个吗？为了救我的命？

en: &4890 No. No I wasn't.
&319 But you did it anyway.
&320 Don't lie to spare my feelings. Not now. Please.
zh: &320 别为了让我好受就说谎，至少现在别。求你了。

en: &7157 Sorry.
&4891 Does it matter? I saved you anyway.
zh: &4891 这重要吗？反正我救了你。

en: &321 It does to me.
&4892 I was there to save someone else, but I couldn't just... leave you.
zh: &4892 我本来是要去救别人，但我不能就那么……丢下你。

en: &7158 Not like that.
&322 I've heard how ChronoZen operates. They don't like this kind of thing, do they?
zh: &322 我听说过 ChronoZen 的运作方式。他们不喜欢这种事，对吧？

en: &4893 Not usually, no.
&323 So you took a big risk.
zh: &323 所以你冒了很大的风险。

en: &4894 Maybe the risk was worth it.
&324 Well. I can't argue with that logic.
zh: &324 嗯。这个逻辑我没法反驳。

en: &326 What now?
&4895 How about a drink?
&327 Really? We just pick up where we left off?
zh: &327 真的？就这么接着当年那一晚？

en: &7159 Why not?
&4896 It's up to you.
&4897 I saved your life. You can do what you want with it.
zh: &4897 我救了你的命。你想怎么过都行。

en: &328 When you saved my life, I believe that's exactly what I did.
zh: &328 你救我的时候，我想我已经那么做了。

en: &4898 I... have no idea.
&329 You and me both.
&330 Well.
&331 This is more than a little bit awkward, isn't it?
&4899 I mean, I wasn't gonna say it, but...
zh: &4899 我是说，我本来不想说的，但……

en: &7160 What?
&7161 Imani?
&4900 Not again.
&6054 He was, um, experimenting with time travel.
&6055 He was, um, stalking your family before your dad disappeared.
zh: &6055 他，呃，在你爸爸失踪前一直在跟踪你们家。

en: &6056 He, um, ran an Otis Knox fan site.
zh: &6056 他，呃，运营着一个奥蒂斯·诺克斯的粉丝网站。

en: &57 What?
&6057 It's true.
&6058 His name came up while Fia was investigating. She looked into him.
zh: &6058 菲娅调查时查到了他的名字，接着就查了查他的情况。

en: &6059 He knew things he shouldn't have known. Knowledge of the future.
zh: &6059 他知道不该知道的事，知道未来。

en: &6060 He had photos of your family. A key to your house.
zh: &6060 他有你们家的照片。还有你家的钥匙。

en: &6061 But we know next-to-nothing about him. So anything you can tell us will be useful.
zh: &6061 但我们对他几乎一无所知。所以你能告诉我们的任何事都会有帮助。

en: &58 This is... this is...
&6062 I know. It's a lot.
zh: &6062 我知道，这事一时很难消化。

en: &59 No. This is RIDICULOUS.
&60 I asked you to find out what happened to my father. Not butt into my mother's private life.
zh: &60 我是让你查我父亲出了什么事。不是让你插手我母亲的私生活。

en: &61 How dare you?
&6064 Look. Mr. Knox...
&6065 Let me explain...
&62 I don't want to hear it.
&6066 This is much bigger than we assumed.
zh: &6066 这事比我们原先想的复杂得多。

en: &63 I don't care.
&6067 Don't you want to know what happened?
zh: &6067 你不想知道发生了什么吗？

en: &64 No. Let sleeping dogs lie.
zh: &64 不想了，过去的事，就让它过去吧。

en: &65 My mother was HAPPY. After everything that happened? She deserved to be happy.
zh: &65 我母亲后来很幸福。吃过那么多苦，她也该过点好日子了。

en: &66 And you want to ruin that? Over my dead body.
zh: &66 而你想毁了这一切？除非我死了。

en: &67 You'll be hearing from my lawyer.
&68 Good bye.
This'll be a GUI at some point. But for now... PROTOTYPING AHOY!
zh: 这以后会是个图形界面。但现在……原型开发中！

en: Learn about master combination list, that shows all combinations for all Rastar locks over 50 years old.
zh: 了解通用密码表：可查询所有使用超过50年的拉斯塔锁的密码。

en: Prompt to enter serial number, which you can find on the back of all Rastar locks.
zh: 提示输入序列号，可在所有拉斯塔锁背面找到。

en: You don't know the serial number! Oh nos!
Nozzo gets combo.
Multiple Joe Anderson's in the database. Please enter Date of Birth:
zh: 数据库中有多个乔·安德森。请输入出生日期：

en: Displays a brief bio of Joe Anderson's life. NYU student. Award winning bio-chemist. Net worth. Option to look at his residential history.
zh: 显示乔·安德森生平的简要介绍。纽约大学学生。获奖生物化学家。净资产。可查看其居住历史。

en: You don't know his DOB. Oh nos!
zh: 你不知道他的出生日期。哦不！

en: Boop! 1 Joe Anderson found.
zh: 哔！找到 1 个乔·安德森。

en: Learn Joe Anderson lived in room 1402 in the Brittany House dorm in the year 2024
zh: 得知乔·安德森在 2024 年住在布列塔尼楼宿舍 1402 室

en: Quick bio of Celia Anderson, Joe's sister. Includes contact information.
zh: 乔的妹妹西莉亚·安德森的简要介绍。包含联系信息。

en: Hologram of Celia appears (which is how phone calls happen in THE FUTURE). Talk to her and speak about Joe. Learn the name of Joe's girlfriend, Lisa Sandman.
zh: 西莉亚的全息影像出现（未来打电话就是这样）。与她交谈，谈论乔。得知乔的女友名叫丽莎·桑德曼。

en: Brief bio of Lisa. Shows she worked at FosterTech, and includes the department and floor she worked in. It also says she died in a lab accident
zh: 丽莎的简要介绍。显示她曾在福斯特科技工作，包括所在部门和楼层。还提到她死于实验室事故

en: Obituary of Rhona Foster. Learn how she ran the business with her brother after her father Oliver Foster died.
zh: 罗娜·福斯特的讣告。得知父亲奥利弗·福斯特去世后，她与兄弟共同经营公司。

en: Brief obituary of Oliver Foster. Picture of him with his favorite microscope, which has "ZEUS" engraved on it.
zh: 奥利弗·福斯特的简要讣告。附有他与最喜爱的显微镜的合影，显微镜上刻着“ZEUS”。

en: &501 Sure. Sounds nice and simple. I could use one of those.
zh: &501 行，听着轻松又简单，我正想接个这样的任务。

en: &218 Okay. I'll prep the client. See you soon, Fia.
zh: &218 好，我去让客户准备好。回头见，菲娅。

en: &502 Yeah. See you soon.
&503 There's nothing else?
&219 Nothing that can be arranged in such short notice.
zh: &219 这么短的时间内安排不了别的。

en: &504 You know what? Never mind.
&6109 Okay.
&221 I'm here all night if you want a shift.
zh: &221 今晚我都在，想接班随时找我。

en: &1066 Nothing. Everything's fine, Duffy.
&1 Yeahhhh you've never been a good liar, Fia.
zh: &1 是啊，你从来都不擅长撒谎，菲娅。

en: &2 After all those years training under me, I'd expect you to have a better poker face.
zh: &2 跟我学了那么多年，还以为你能更沉得住气，不把什么都写脸上呢。

en: &1067 Are we that obvious?
&3 With all due respect? Yes.
&4 I didn't spend all those years training you for nothing. I know when something's up.
zh: &4 训练你这么多年可没白花，一看就知道有事。

en: &1068 Things could be worse, Duffy. I'll say that much.
zh: &1068 至少情况还没坏到头，达菲。我只能这么说。

en: &5 You forgetting all those years I spent training you? With time travel, there's no "could."
zh: &5 忘了我教你那么多年的东西？做时间旅行，可没什么“还没坏到头”。

en: &6 So. Spill it.
&270 The client pulled a Code 32.
zh: &270 客户触发了 32 号代码。

en: &7 Oh. So he...
&1069 Yes he did.
&8 Huh. What a total socket.
&9 In that case, the answer is "both of you."
zh: &9 那样的话，答案是“你们俩”。

en: &271 Answer?
&10 To my question. "Who wants drinks?"
&11 Am I right? I'm usually right.
zh: &11 我说得对吗？我通常都是对的。

en: &1070 Yes. You are definitely right.
&12 Nozzo?
&272 Sounds great, but I need to be up early for a meeting with the brass in the morning.
zh: &272 听起来不错，但我明天一早要和公司高层开会，得早起。

en: &273 High profile client like this? It's gonna be a media circus.
zh: &273 这么有名的客户，媒体肯定要闹翻天。

en: &1071 That's the brass's problem. Not yours.
zh: &1071 那是公司高层的问题，不是你的。

en: &13 She's right. It's not your job to deal with the PR spin.
zh: &13 她说得对。公关那摊子事不该你管。

en: &1072 Please Nozzo? We could both use a break.
zh: &1072 拜托了，诺佐？我们俩都需要歇口气。

en: &14 You heard that? She said PLEASE. You can't argue with please.
zh: &14 听到了吧？她都说“拜托”了，你还能拒绝？

en: &1073 You want to face the brass sober? You're braver than me.
zh: &1073 你想清醒着去见高层？你比我勇敢。

en: &15 She's right. This is a medical necessity.
zh: &15 她说得对，这得算治疗需要。

en: &16 And besides, what are they gonna do?
&17 Fire the only chrono-monitor in all of New York?
zh: &17 把全纽约唯一的时序监控员炒了？

en: &274 Okay. Okay. I surrender.
&275 How bout Jay V's?
&1074 Sounds good to me.
&18 It's settled, then. To Jay V's!
&1114 Perhaps not. I'm the one who arrived fifteen minutes late, after all.
zh: &1114 也许不。毕竟我是迟到了十五分钟的那个人。

en: &58 Heh. Well. I've always kept to a rigid schedule. Hard habit to break.
zh: &58 呵。好吧。我一直都严格按时间表行事。这习惯可不好改。

en: &1115 The clock keeps moving forward, regardless of when we are.
zh: &1115 时钟一直往前走，不管我们身处哪个年代。

en: &59 That's both very profound and also kind of depressing.
zh: &59 这话既深刻又有点让人沮丧。

en: &1116 I hope it means something or I'd be out of a job.
zh: &1116 我希望它有意义，不然我就没饭碗了。

en: &60 Heh. Well, it's good to have meaning in your work.
zh: &60 也是，工作能有点意义，总是好事。

en: &61 Anyway. 1871. You can really take me there?
&1117 That's the idea.
&6063 What's the mission?
&62 Here. Take a look at this old newspaper clipping.
&6064 Is this a boxer?
&63 Yeah. Simon Inman. I want to find him.
zh: &63 对。西蒙·英曼。我想找到他。

en: &6065 For what reason?
&64 I need to ask him something.
&6066 Ask him what, exactly?
&65 It's embarrassing. I'd prefer not to tell you.
zh: &65 挺难为情的。我宁愿不告诉你。

en: &66 You said that was okay, right?
&501 I said it was up to Fia.
&68 Well, like I said, I'd rather not. But if you insist...
zh: &68 嗯，就像我说的，我宁愿不说。但如果你坚持……

en: &6072 Where can we find Simon Inman?
zh: &6072 我们在哪儿能找到西蒙·英曼？

en: &69 Er, that's just it. Um. I have no idea.
zh: &69 呃，问题就是……我也不知道。

en: &525 His residence isn't listed in the archive.
zh: &525 档案里没登记他的住址。

en: &6073 That shouldn't be an issue. We know he was at this championship match, so we can find him then.
zh: &6073 那应该不是问题。我们知道他参加了这场冠军赛，所以可以在那时找到他。

en: &70 No! Not the night of the match. That defeats the point.
zh: &70 不！不能是比赛当晚。那就没意义了。

en: &71 I want to ask about his retirement. Six months later should do the trick.
zh: &71 我想问他退役的事。六个月后应该就行。

en: &6074 Then the trick will be finding him.
&72 Can that be done?
&6075 If it wasn't, you wouldn't be here.
zh: &6075 做不到，你也就不会来这里了。

en: &6076 What do we know about him?
&561 Just that he was a boxer who won the citywide championship in 1871, and died around 20 years later at the age of 39.
zh: &561 只知道他是个拳击手，1871年赢得全市冠军，大约20年后去世，享年39岁。

en: &6077 That's all?
&563 That's all in the public record, anyway.
zh: &563 反正公开记录里就这些。

en: &1855 So. Ms. Sadar. It looks like you are already attired. Shall we be off?
zh: &1855 那么，萨达尔女士。看来你已经穿戴好了。我们出发吧？

en: &73 Call me Chloe, please. And yeah! Let's get going.
zh: &73 请叫我克洛伊。还有，对！我们走吧。

en: &6067 I'm afraid I must insist.
zh: &6067 抱歉，这个你必须告诉我。

en: &323 *Sigh*
&324 Fine.
&6069 Very well, Chloe. If that's what you wish.
zh: &6069 好吧，克洛伊，那就不问了。

en: &572 Wait. Seriously?
&6070 You're surprised?
&573 Yeah, frankly. After what happened with Joe Anderson, I'd assume you'd want as much information as possible.
zh: &573 是的，坦白说。在乔·安德森那件事之后，我以为你会想要尽可能多的信息。

en: &325 Joe Anderson? That doc who died a few weeks ago?
zh: &325 乔·安德森？那个几周前去世的医生？

en: &326 Didn't he have a heart attack or something?
zh: &326 他不是心脏病发作还是什么的吗？

en: &6071 Something like that.
&327 Right. I see.
&328 I just want to ask Simon Inman about his retirement.
zh: &328 我只是想问问西蒙·英曼退役的事。

en: &6068 That's all?
&329 Yes. That's all.
&330 Told you it was embarrassing.
&331 Can we move on?
&2255 Sure. Sorry to push. It's my job to get you what you need.
zh: &2255 好，抱歉追问。我得问清楚，才能帮你办好这件事。

en: &332 I get it. We're good.
&2416 Isn't there a failsafe for this kind of thing?
zh: &2416 这种事难道没有保险机制吗？

en: &584 Yeah. ME!
&585 My literal job is to monitor everything from this point. Including what outfit he engages.
zh: &585 这里的一切本来就该我来监测，包括他切换的是哪套衣服。

en: &586 I should have seen it.
&2417 You can't blame yourself.
&587 Who else, then?
&588 It's my job to make sure agents like you and Duffy are safe.
zh: &588 我的工作就是确保像你和达菲这样的特工安全。

en: &2418 I know you, Nozzo. You did your job. You always do.
zh: &2418 我了解你，诺佐。你尽到了职责。你一向如此。

en: &589 Look at that mess on the floor!
&590 Does that LOOK like I did my job?
zh: &590 这样也能叫我尽了职责？

en: &2419 Could it have been just an accident?
&591 I hoped so. But I don't think so.
zh: &591 我希望是。但我不这么认为。

en: &592 If he was wearing his chrono-suit, I could check if it failed, or was improperly coded.
zh: &592 如果他穿着时空防护服，我就能检查是防护服故障，还是编码有误。

en: &3205 But look at him! Those clothes are pure 1970s. I installed them myself.
zh: &3205 可你看看他！穿的是70年代的衣服，还是我亲手装载的。

en: &594 You wear the chronosuit before jumping! That's protocol number one!
zh: &594 跃迁前必须穿时空防护服，这是最基本的规矩！

en: &595 It's just a button press! Why didn't he change?
zh: &595 只是按个按钮！他为什么不换上？

en: &596 I don't want to believe he did this on purpose, Fia. But...
zh: &596 我不愿相信他是故意的，菲娅。可是……

en: &2420 Was there a client involved?
&597 A client...? Yeah, there was a client.
&6110 She wanted to see the Ramones play at CBGBs in the 1970s.
zh: &6110 她想在1970年代去CBGB看雷蒙斯乐队的演出。

en: &2421 Where is she now?
&599 Gone. She spent an hour there, got a headache, and then asked to come back.
zh: &599 走了。她在那里待了一个小时，头疼，然后要求回来。

en: &3102 Duffy asked if he could stay for the rest of the show. I... let him.
zh: &3102 达菲问能不能留下看剩下的演出。我……同意了。

en: &2422 You couldn't have known this would happen.
zh: &2422 你不可能预见到会发生这种事。

en: &606 No. Small mercies.
zh: &606 没法知道，也算一点安慰。

en: &2423 Nozzo. Are you saying what I think you're saying?
zh: &2423 诺佐。你是在说我想的那个意思吗？

en: &2424 Duffy did this DELIBERATELY?
&607 What else could it be?
&608 He went back to the landing point, like always.
zh: &608 他像往常一样回到跃迁落点。

en: &609 Then said "Ready to jump home, Noz." Just like always.
zh: &609 然后说“准备跃迁回家，诺佐。”跟往常一样。

en: &610 Then... this.
&611 It was just another jump. Like hundreds of others before.
zh: &611 只是又一次跃迁。跟之前几百次一样。

en: &2425 You had no reason to think otherwise.
&612 I KNOW. But why would he do that? Why would he lie?
zh: &612 我知道。可他为什么要那么做？为什么要撒谎？

en: &3293 Is there no way to prevent this?
zh: &3293 没有办法阻止这一切吗？

en: &898 Maybe. The brass will create new protocols, I'm sure.
zh: &898 也许。公司高层肯定会制定新协议。

en: &3294 No. Prevent THIS. Send me back to just before he left.
zh: &3294 不是，我是说救下他。把我送到他离开之前。

en: &3295 I'll make sure he activates the chrono-suit.
zh: &3295 我会确保他激活时空防护服。

en: &3296 Force him if I have to.
&899 If only it was that easy.
&900 He was in the timestream without PROTECTION. His body was flooded with Quansonic waves.
zh: &900 他在时间流里没有防护。身体被量声粒子波淹没了。

en: &901 He's chrono-locked now. There's no changing it.
zh: &901 他现在时空锁定了。没法改变。

en: &7038 So a chrono-shift won't fix this.
zh: &7038 所以时空改写也救不了。

en: &7039 This is permanent. This is forever.
zh: &7039 那就再也改不了了，永远改不了。

en: &6037 Yeah.
&902 And Duffy KNOWS this. More than anyone!
zh: &902 而达菲知道这一点。比谁都清楚！

en: &903 He studied Quansonic waves when they were first discovered. This makes no sense!
zh: &903 量声粒子波刚被发现，他就开始研究了，怎么会这样！

en: &2426 So. What happens now?
&613 I've called an ambulance, for all the good they can do now.
zh: &613 我叫了救护车，虽然现在也帮不上什么忙了。

en: &614 There'll be an inquiry. They'll get some proper failsafes installed. That sort of thing.
zh: &614 会有人来调查，再装些可靠的安全装置，大概就是这些。

en: &615 They may can me. They may not.
zh: &615 他们可能开除我，也可能不会。

en: &616 Then? Business as usual.
&618 Why would Duffy do this, Fia?
zh: &618 达菲为什么要这么做，菲娅？

en: &619 Did he say anything to you?
&620 Give any sign that he was planning this?
zh: &620 有任何迹象表明他计划这么做吗？

en: &621 Anything at all?
&2427 Just last night, we were at the Park Gallery...
zh: &2427 就在昨晚，我们还在帕克画廊……

en: &622 Oh. The painting.
&2428 Yeah. And he said to "enjoy beautiful things while they last."
zh: &2428 是啊。他还说“趁美好事物还在，尽情享受吧。”

en: &2429 Then we went to Jay V's and drank till we couldn't stand.
zh: &2429 然后我们去了杰伊V酒吧，喝到站都站不稳。

en: &623 That didn't strike you as strange?
&2430 Not really. Timeline malaise gets us all, sometimes.
zh: &2430 不觉得。时序倦怠有时会找上我们每个人。

en: &2431 It doesn't lead to... this.
&624 True.
&2432 An alternate self of his died recently.
zh: &2432 另一条时间线里的他，最近去世了。

en: &625 That's not unusual. I read about three dead versions of myself just last week.
zh: &625 这并不稀奇。我上周就读到过三个死去的自己。

en: &2433 He joked about going to the funeral.
zh: &2433 他还开玩笑说要去参加葬礼。

en: &626 Well, we all deal with it in different ways.
zh: &626 嗯，我们应对的方式各不相同。

en: &627 It doesn't lead to this.
&2434 He... he was reading his Personic profiles.
zh: &2434 他……他一直在看自己的Personic档案。

en: &628 Blast it, Duffy. He should know better.
zh: &628 该死，达菲，他明知道不该看。

en: &2435 I mean, I do it too. Sometimes.
zh: &2435 我是说，我也这么干。有时候。

en: &629 Well. You should know better.
&2436 You do it as well. I've seen your browser history.
zh: &2436 你也这么干。我看过你的浏览记录。

en: &630 Fine. We all should know better.
zh: &630 行吧，我们都该知道不该看。

en: &631 We all do it. It doesn't lead to this.
zh: &631 我们都这么干。这不会导致这种事。

en: &2437 We don't know he was planning this. Not for sure.
zh: &2437 我们不知道他是否计划这么做。不能确定。

en: &632 No agent would simply FORGET to engage their chrono-suit.
zh: &632 没有哪个特工会忘记启动时空防护服。

en: &633 Not you. And certainly not Duffy.
&2438 No. We wouldn't. You're right.
&2439 I don't know, Noz. Duffy was just... Duffy.
zh: &2439 我不知道，诺佐。达菲就是……达菲。

en: &2440 He didn't leave a note, or anything?
zh: &2440 他没留下字条或别的什么吗？

en: &634 No. Nothing.
&7040 Blast it.
&7041 This isn't supposed to happen.
&7042 Not to us.
&7043 WE stay the same. Everything ELSE changes.
zh: &7043 我们保持不变。其他一切都在变。

en: &7044 That was the deal. That's why I joined.
zh: &7044 当初说好的。这就是我加入的原因。

en: &6106 I know.
&635 Go home, Fia. I'll deal with the police. And the brass.
zh: &635 回家吧，菲娅。我来应付警察。还有公司高层。

en: &2441 No clients today?
&636 No. I've rescheduled them all.
zh: &636 没有。我把他们都改期了。

en: &2442 Good. Smart.
&637 Yeah, that's me. Good and smart.
zh: &637 是啊，我可真是又好又聪明。

en: &2467 Nice to meet you. I'm Fia Quinn.
zh: &2467 很高兴见到你。我是菲娅·奎因。

en: &100 Ah! You're the one who's gonna fix my life?
zh: &100 啊！你就是那个要修复我人生的人？

en: &2468 Assuming it needs fixing.
&101 It does. Believe me, it does.
&2469 BatesTech. Why does that sound familiar?
zh: &2469 贝茨科技。为什么听起来这么耳熟？

en: &638 You've seen their logo on almost every appliance made in the last decade.
zh: &638 过去十年里几乎每件电器上都有他们的标志。

en: &102 Yeah. Our immeasurable gift to humanity.
zh: &102 是啊，我们对人类那无比伟大的贡献。

en: &103 Making a slightly better coffee maker or touchscreen than the competition.
zh: &103 做出比竞争对手稍微好一点的咖啡机或触摸屏。

en: &104 Be still my heart.
&2470 Pasamon Industries?
&105 Yeaahh. Just listen to the way that sounds. Just rolls off the tongue.
zh: &105 是啊——听听这名字。多顺口。

en: &639 Anyway, Mr. Pasamon has asked us to make one small alteration to his past.
zh: &639 总之，帕萨蒙先生要求我们对他的过去做一个小小的改动。

en: &107 Me and my partner Madison streamed a presentation to a group of investors. We'd given dozens before and nobody bit.
zh: &107 我和搭档麦迪逊给一群投资人做了场直播演示。之前做过几十次，都没人肯投钱。

en: &108 So I had a long lunch that day. I was late getting back.
zh: &108 所以那天我午餐吃了很久。回来晚了。

en: &109 How was I supposed to know that on THAT day, Roy Rockcamp would be watching?
zh: &109 我怎么会知道就在那天，罗伊·罗克坎普会看呢？

en: &2471 Who is Madison?
&110 My former partner. Madison Bates. Hence, BatesTech?
zh: &110 我以前的搭档，麦迪逊·贝茨。贝茨科技，不就是她的姓？

en: &111 Urg. Makes me sick thinking about it.
zh: &111 呃。一想到这个我就恶心。

en: &2472 Roy Rockcamp? Who is that?
&112 Is she serious?
&640 We don't all keep up with financial news.
zh: &640 我们不是每个人都关注财经新闻。

en: &113 Fine. TLDR version: Rockcamp is THE name in venture capital. You catch his eye, you're on the gravy train. You follow?
zh: &113 那就长话短说，罗克坎普是风投界的头号人物。他看上你，钱就滚滚来了。懂了吧？

en: &7048 Sure.
&2473 What presentation?
&114 Some logistics system that Madison cooked up to secure funding. Assembles and delivers salads on demand.
zh: &114 麦迪逊为了拉投资想了个物流系统，客人下单，就自动配好沙拉送过去。

en: &2474 Salads?
&115 Yeah. Salads. I know. No originality. Just a better version of someone else's idea.
zh: &115 对。沙拉。我知道。毫无新意。只是别人点子的改良版。

en: &116 Anyway, Rockcamp liked our setup. He gave us enough money to franchise our products worldwide!
zh: &116 罗克坎普喜欢我们的方案，给的钱足够把产品推广到全世界，做连锁生意！

en: &2475 And that was... bad?
&117 It was TERRIBLE.
&118 Since Madison gave the presentation, Rockcamp assumed she was in charge!
zh: &118 因为演示是麦迪逊做的，罗克坎普就以为她才是负责人！

en: &119 So he made her head of everything! The finances, the staffing, what products to make, all of it!
zh: &119 所以他让她掌管一切！财务、人事、做什么产品，所有事！

en: &120 It... should have been me.
zh: &120 那个位置……本来该是我的。

en: &2476 Are you sure you want to risk changing this?
zh: &2476 你确定要冒险改变这件事吗？

en: &2477 BatesTech is a hugely successful company. That could potentially all go away.
zh: &2477 贝茨科技是一家非常成功的公司。那一切可能都会消失。

en: &121 Big deal. So the world has slightly slower dishwashers.
zh: &121 有什么大不了的。世界上的洗碗机稍微慢一点而已。

en: &122 Madison just wanted to earn money. I wanted to change the WORLD.
zh: &122 麦迪逊只想赚钱。我想改变世界。

en: &123 With me in charge, I can finally do that.
zh: &123 由我掌权，我终于可以做到了。

en: &2478 So you want me to go to Roy Rockcamp and change his mind?
zh: &2478 所以你想让我去找罗伊·罗克坎普，改变他的想法？

en: &641 No. Rockcamp's temporal ranking is too high to approach him directly.
zh: &641 不行。罗克坎普的时间线评级太高，无法直接接近他。

en: &642 History says Rockcamp gave an initial investment to the salad company. We won't change that.
zh: &642 历史记载罗克坎普给沙拉公司提供了初始投资。我们不会改变这一点。

en: &643 We're just changing who is in charge of the new company when he does.
zh: &643 我们只是在他投资时，改变新公司的负责人。

en: &124 Yeah. ME.
&2479 You feel you would do a better job running BatesTech than your partner?
zh: &2479 你觉得自己比搭档更适合经营贝茨科技？

en: &125 Former partner. And if you do your job right, it won't be BatesTech anymore.
zh: &125 是前合伙人。如果你把事办好，它就不再叫贝茨科技了。

en: &126 But to answer your question? Yes. Without question.
zh: &126 至于你问的，当然，我毫不怀疑。

en: &2480 Right. So this all seems quite clear.
zh: &2480 好。那这一切就很清楚了。

en: &2481 You want me to make sure you are present for the, er, presentation?
zh: &2481 你想让我保证，那场……演示由你出场？

en: &127 Yes! And make sure Madison is NOT.
zh: &127 对！还要确保麦迪逊不会出席。

en: &128 She took my legacy from me. I need you to take it back.
zh: &128 她抢走了本该属于我的成就，我要你替我夺回来。

en: &2482 Legacy, eh?
&2483 You want to make your mark on the world?
zh: &2483 你想在世上留下自己的印记？

en: &2484 Leave proof of your existence?
&129 That's it. That's exactly it!
&2485 Very well, Mr. Pasamon.
&2486 Let us begin.
&2487 He didn't even ask about his partner.
zh: &2487 他甚至没问起他的合伙人。

en: &644 He's not the first client to rush out like that.
zh: &644 他不是第一个这样匆匆离开的客户。

en: &645 He's excited. He'll learn what happened to her soon enough.
zh: &645 他很兴奋。他很快就会知道她出了什么事。

en: &2488 He has his legacy, I suppose. His so-called "mark on the world."
zh: &2488 这下他有自己的成就了，算是吧。他所谓的“在世界上留下的印记”。

en: &646 His what?
&7068 Never mind.
&2489 I'm fine, Noz. As much as I can be.
zh: &2489 我没事，诺佐。能好到哪儿算哪儿吧。

en: &2490 Any word on Duffy's replacement?
zh: &2490 有接替达菲的人的消息吗？

en: &647 The brass are still looking for a suitable candidate, but it's slow going.
zh: &647 公司高层还在找合适的人选，但进展很慢。

en: &2491 Yeah, I remember what the interview process was like.
zh: &2491 是啊，我记得面试流程是什么样的。

en: &648 Well, we're all done here for the night.
zh: &648 好了，今晚的事都办完了。

en: &649 You want to join me for dinner?
zh: &649 你想和我一起吃晚饭吗？

en: &650 I promise it won't be salad.
&2492 Thanks Noz, but I've got plans. Rain check?
zh: &2492 谢了诺佐，但我有安排了。改天吧？

en: &651 Sure, Fia. Until tomorrow?
&2493 Until tomorrow.
&656 This is, um, Madison Bates. Head of marketing for Pasamon Industries.
zh: &656 这位是，呃，麦迪逊·贝茨。帕萨蒙工业的市场部主管。

en: &119 Ugh. That NAME. I see money burning every time I hear it.
zh: &119 这名字！每次听见，都觉得在白白烧钱。

en: &120 The name "BatesTech" has everything, wouldn't you say?
zh: &120 “贝茨科技”这名字，多有卖相，是不是？

en: &121 THAT'S what it should've been. And now, with your help, it will be!
zh: &121 那才是它本该有的名字。现在，有你的帮助，它就会是了！

en: &122 Right?
&2521 Er, nice to meet you. I'm Fia Quinn.
zh: &2521 呃，很高兴见到你。我是菲娅·奎因。

en: &123 Fia Quinn, Fia Quinn...
&124 Have we met before?
&2522 Nope. No. I don't believe so.
&2523 You work for Pasamon Industries?
&125 You've heard of it?
&2524 I am... familiar, yes.
&126 Well, you'd be the only one.
&2525 You mentioned BatesTech?
&128 Perfect isn't it? Short. Punchy. Just rolls off the tongue.
zh: &128 很完美，对吧？简短。有力。朗朗上口。

en: &129 It SIZZLES! Am I right?
&2526 I wouldn't know.
&657 Anyway, Ms. Bates here wants us to make a slight adjustment to her past.
zh: &657 总之，这位贝茨女士想让我们对她的过去做一点小小的调整。

en: &131 My partner Benji and I were streaming pitch presentations to groups of investors every day.
zh: &131 我和搭档本吉每天都在向投资团体直播推介演示。

en: &132 I missed one. Just ONE! Out of several dozen.
zh: &132 我错过了一场。就一场！几十场里就一场。

en: &133 And naturally, that was the one Roy Rockcamp was attending.
zh: &133 偏偏，罗伊·罗克坎普就看了那一场。

en: &134 Rockcamp assumed my partner was in charge, so he was installed as CEO.
zh: &134 罗克坎普以为我的搭档是负责人，于是他被任命为CEO。

en: &135 And do you know what our brilliant leader decided to make?
zh: &135 你知道我们这位杰出的领袖决定做什么吗？

en: &136 WEAPONS. If it didn't go bang, zap, or boom, he didn't want to build it.
zh: &136 武器。只要不是砰、滋滋、轰的东西，他就不想造。

en: &137 Such a complete and utter WASTE.
&2527 A waste?
&138 We could have been a household name. Our logo emblazoned in every office, home and shop!
zh: &138 我们本可以家喻户晓。我们的标志闪耀在每间办公室、每个家庭和每家商店！

en: &139 Instead we're just... this.
&2528 And that's bad?
&2529 You'd do it differently?
&140 For twenty years, he had me selling our products to warlords and dictators.
zh: &140 二十年来，他让我把产品卖给军阀和独裁者。

en: &141 I could shower the rest of my life and I'd never feel clean.
zh: &141 我下半辈子再怎么洗也洗不干净。

en: &2530 So the answer is yes.
&2531 You want to be in charge instead?
&142 Benji had no business running a company like that in the first place.
zh: &142 本吉从一开始就没资格经营那样的公司。

en: &143 It should be me. It should always have been me.
zh: &143 应该是我。一直都应该是我。

en: &2532 Yes. Quite.
&144 Do you know how many governments our products have destabilized? How many people they killed?
zh: &144 你知道我们的产品颠覆了多少政府吗？害死了多少人？

en: &145 Yes, I know if WE didn't sell those weapons, someone else would have.
zh: &145 是的，我知道就算我们不卖那些武器，别人也会卖。

en: &146 But it WAS us. And I was a part of it.
zh: &146 但卖的人就是我们。而我是其中一员。

en: &147 I can't let that be my legacy. I just can't.
zh: &147 我不能让别人最后只记得我干过这种事，不能。

en: &148 I need to give that presentation. I need to be in charge.
zh: &148 我必须去做那场演示，必须由我掌权。

en: &149 Or at the very least, have equal authority so I have veto power over his dumb decisions.
zh: &149 或者至少拥有同等权力，这样我就能否决他的愚蠢决定。

en: &150 So can you do this for me, or what?
&2533 Nozzo, is this allowed?
&658 There is precedent. There's nothing in the rule book that says we can't.
zh: &658 有先例。规则手册里没写我们不能这么做。

en: &2534 And the brass is aware we are doing this?
zh: &2534 而且高层知道我们在做这件事吗？

en: &659 Yes. I made sure to cover our asses. It's all above board.
zh: &659 知道，我已经确认过了，有批准，我们不用担责任。

en: &151 Well?
&2535 Well, Ms. Bates. Let's get started, shall we?
zh: &2535 好了，贝茨女士。我们开始吧，好吗？

en: &3491 I'm fine.
&198 If you say so.
&3492 I'm the only agent working in the city right now.
zh: &3492 我是目前唯一在这座城市工作的特工。

en: &3493 So unless you'd like to come back in a few months when we've hired someone else...
zh: &3493 所以除非你想等几个月，等我们雇了别人再来……

en: &199 No. No. You'll do. I guess.
zh: &199 不用不用，就你吧，应该行。

en: &3494 The time jump will wake me. It's like a triple shot of espresso.
zh: &3494 时空跃迁会让我清醒。就像三倍浓缩咖啡。

en: &200 Huh. Really.
&3495 You'll see for yourself, soon enough.
zh: &3495 你很快就会亲眼看到了。

en: &201 Anyway, like I was telling your colleague here. Every cop's got their white whale. The one case they could never solve.
zh: &201 跟你同事刚才说的一样，每个警察都有自己的“白鲸”，一桩怎么也破不了的案子。

en: &202 Sixty years ago, my best friend Yvonne was murdered. I discovered the body myself.
zh: &202 六十年前，我最好的朋友伊冯娜被杀了，尸体还是我亲自发现的。

en: &203 Nobody found the guy who did it. Nobody even tried. Until now.
zh: &203 没人找到凶手。甚至没人去查。直到现在。

en: &3496 Nobody tried to solve it? Why?
&205 Because something happened five hours after I found the body.
zh: &205 因为我发现尸体五小时后发生了一件事。

en: &206 A little something called "two planes hitting the World Trade Center."
zh: &206 一件叫做“两架飞机撞上世贸中心”的小事。

en: &207 The NYPD was a bit... preoccupied, for a while. Procedure went out the window. No evidence was logged. No leads were followed.
zh: &207 纽约警局当时有点……忙不过来，好一阵子。程序全乱套了。没有记录任何证据。没有追查任何线索。

en: &208 But by the time things settled down, the trail was cold.
zh: &208 但等一切平息下来，线索已经断了。

en: &209 Just one more sad story in a day full of countless more.
zh: &209 那天的悲剧太多，这也只是其中一桩。

en: &3497 I'm sorry about your friend.
zh: &3497 我为你的朋友感到难过。

en: &210 Yeah, well. Thanks. But it won't matter soon.
zh: &210 是啊，嗯。谢谢。不过很快就不重要了。

en: &211 Because we're gonna fix it.
&3498 So you want to solve your friend's murder?
zh: &3498 你想查清杀害朋友的凶手？

en: &212 Solve it? No. That's already been done.
&213 I don't need to solve it. I want to STOP it.
zh: &213 我不需要破案。我要阻止它。

en: &3499 The murder's been solved?
&3500 I thought you said there wasn't an investigation?
&214 There wasn't. The scumbag was arrested five years ago. He wrote a tell-all book from prison.
zh: &214 是没有。那个混蛋五年前被捕了。他在监狱里写了一本自曝其罪的书。

en: &215 "Fifty Years Behind the Trigger: The Memoirs of Nick Chord."
zh: &215 《扣动扳机五十年：尼克·科德回忆录》。

en: &216 The blasting socket CONFESSED. Yvonne was one of his very first kills.
zh: &216 那个该死的混蛋认罪了。伊冯娜是他最早的受害者之一。

en: &3501 Well. It's clear what needs to be done.
&3502 We stop this Nick Chord from killing your friend Yvonne.
zh: &3502 我们阻止这个尼克·科德杀害你的朋友伊冯娜。

en: &217 Like we said back in my day: "Duh".
zh: &217 就像我们那年代说的：“废话”。

en: &959 Just one thing to be aware of? His Impact Ranking is "Medium".
zh: &959 有一点得注意，他的时间线影响评级是“中等”。

en: &960 So your goal is to stop him. Not kill him.
zh: &960 所以你的目标是阻止他。不是杀了他。

en: &218 Yeah yeah. I know. I don't like it, but I know.
zh: &218 好好好。我知道。我不喜欢，但我知道。

en: &7097 Right.
&3503 So shall we be off?
&4098 I needed this too.
&1095 Well. Feel free to drink the place dry.
zh: &1095 好吧。尽管把这里喝个底朝天。

en: &1096 Unless I do it first.
&4099 We should do this more often. Why don't we?
zh: &4099 我们应该多这样聚聚。为什么不呢？

en: &1097 I've wondered the same thing.
&4100 You look like you could use a few more.
zh: &4100 看来你还挺需要再喝几杯。

en: &1098 More than a few.
&4101 I get it. Too many ERP rewinds can do your head in.
zh: &4101 我懂，ERP回溯太多次，能把人折腾坏。

en: &4102 Take it from me. The best thing is to blotto up.
zh: &4102 听我的。最好的办法就是喝个烂醉。

en: &4103 Speaking of...
&1099 It's not the rewinds. Well, not JUST the rewinds.
zh: &1099 不是回溯的问题。好吧，不只是回溯。

en: &1100 I should never have agreed to a Chrovergence mission. Let alone TWO.
zh: &1100 我当初就不该同意参加时空汇聚任务。更别说两次了。

en: &1101 I'm slipping. I'm normally so careful.
zh: &1101 我没以前谨慎了，平时可不会这样。

en: &1102 Oh well. In for a penny...
&4104 I'm the one who pushed for it.
&1103 I know. That's why I agreed at first. I figured we needed it.
zh: &1103 我知道。所以我一开始才同意。我觉得我们需要它。

en: &4105 It turned out alright in the end, right?
&1104 It was still risky. But I figured we needed it.
zh: &1104 但还是有风险。不过我觉得我们需要它。

en: &4106 Why did you agree, then?
&1105 Because I figured we needed it.
zh: &1105 因为我觉得我们需要它。

en: &4107 Because of Duffy?
&1106 Because of Duffy.
&4108 Misery loves company.
&1110 I'm not MISERABLE, Fia. I'm...
zh: &1110 我不是因为痛苦，菲娅，我是……

en: &4109 Maybe you shouldn't drink tonight.
&1111 Yeah. Probably a bad idea.
zh: &1111 是啊。可能不是个好主意。

en: &1112 You know I had a cluster once, right? Back in the early days.
zh: &1112 你知道我以前有过伴侣组吧？早年间。

en: &4110 I do. You've mentioned them. Sabu and Sarah, right?
zh: &4110 我知道。你提过他们。萨布和莎拉，对吧？

en: &1113 That was them. You've never asked me about them. Not in ten years. Neither did Duffy.
zh: &1113 就是他们。你从来没问过我他们的事。十年了。达菲也没有。

en: &4111 Well, we didn't want to pry. Personal timelines. Kind of a private thing?
zh: &4111 我们不想多问，毕竟自己的时间线，多少算隐私吧？

en: &1114 You have no idea how kind you both were.
zh: &1114 你不知道你们俩有多体贴。

en: &1115 It wasn't just a cluster. It was a whole family.
zh: &1115 那不只是伴侣组。那是一个完整的家庭。

en: &1116 Little Rayla. She'd just turned five.
&4112 And something happened?
&1117 Yeah. Something happened.
&4113 You were a father, too?
&1118 I was. Or never was. Depending how you look at it.
zh: &1118 当过。或者说从没当过。取决于你怎么看。

en: &1119 Anyway...
&1797 Right. Well.
&1121 You know how our PFE only protects our physical existence, but not our whole timeline?
zh: &1121 你也知道，PFE只保证我们的身体还存在，保不住整条时间线吧？

en: &18 Yeah.
&1122 Well, we didn't know it back then.
&1123 They got chrono-shifted away. Gone. Haven't seen them since.
zh: &1123 他们被时空改写掉了。消失了。从那以后就再没见过。

en: &4114 I'm sorry. That must have been terrible.
&1124 Timelines under the bridge. Several thousand, in fact.
zh: &1124 都是过去好几条时间线的事了。其实，好几千条。

en: &4115 Any idea where they are now? In this timeline?
zh: &4115 知道他们现在在哪儿吗？在这条时间线里？

en: &1125 No idea. I used to check their Personic profiles.
zh: &1125 不知道。我以前查过他们的 Personic 资料。

en: &1126 Never a single hit. Not once.
zh: &1126 一次也没查到，从来没有。

en: &4116 How long ago did this happen?
&1127 Fifteen years, relative time? Gosh. Rayla would be in university by now.
zh: &1127 相对时间十五年前？天哪。蕾拉现在该上大学了。

en: &1128 Assuming she stopped doodling cats on her homework. Drove her teachers nuts.
zh: &1128 假设她不再在作业上乱画猫的话。那快把她的老师逼疯了。

en: &4117 I heard this kind of thing happened a lot, back then.
zh: &4117 我听说这种事在当时经常发生。

en: &1129 It was the Wild West in those days. Sometimes literally.
zh: &1129 那时候跟狂野西部一样乱，有时连去的地方都真是西部。

en: &1130 Everyone jumping back in time and poking things. No regulation. Total chaos.
zh: &1130 谁都能跳回过去，随意改动。没有监管，乱成一团。

en: &1131 It's why ChronoZen was founded. To keep the chaos under control.
zh: &1131 这就是 ChronoZen 成立的原因。为了控制混乱。

en: &1132 But for some of us? It was too late.
zh: &1132 但对我们中的一些人来说？已经太迟了。

en: &4118 Did you ever try to bring them back?
zh: &4118 你试过把他们带回来吗？

en: &1133 Of course I tried. But we didn't have the records we have now. I didn't know where to begin.
zh: &1133 我当然试过。但我们当时没有现在这些记录。我不知道从哪儿开始。

en: &1134 So I fell back on the mantra.
zh: &1134 于是，我就靠那句老话撑着。

en: &4119 "Focus on the job."
&1135 Words we all try to live by.
zh: &1135 我们都努力照着这句话生活。

en: &1136 Easier for you than for me, maybe, but still.
zh: &1136 也许对你来说比我容易，但总归如此。

en: &4120 Sorry. Easier for me?
&1137 Yeah. You. Duffy. Any ChronoZen employee hired in the last fifteen years.
zh: &1137 是啊。你。达菲。过去十五年里雇的任何 ChronoZen 员工。

en: &1138 You have to go through that whole thing these days. The... whaddayacallit.
zh: &1138 你们现在都得经过那一整套流程。那个……叫什么来着。

en: &6035 Suitability Analysis Review.
&1139 Determines your ability to shrug off changes to the timeline.
zh: &1139 看你能不能对时间线的变化不往心里去。

en: &1140 Your marks were quite high, if I remember.
zh: &1140 如果我没记错，你的分数相当高。

en: &4121 What made me so "suitable", anyway?
zh: &4121 到底是什么让我这么“适配”呢？

en: &4122 Is it a secret?
&1141 No, but... why do you want to know?
zh: &1141 不是，但……你为什么想知道？

en: &4123 Duffy and I were talking about it last month. Trying to suss out why we were picked.
zh: &4123 达菲和我上个月聊过这事。想弄清楚我们为什么被选中。

en: &1142 Oh. Well, there's a list of rankings the size of my arm that factor in, but most important?
zh: &1142 评分项目一长串，跟我胳膊一样长，可最重要的是什么？

en: &1143 Your ability to resist distractions.
zh: &1143 你能不能不被别的事分心。

en: &4124 Distractions.
&1144 Yeah. Changes to family. Friends. Close personal ties. Your own timeline.
zh: &1144 对，家人、朋友、亲密关系，还有你自己的时间线，全都可能改变。

en: &6036 We moved you away from your home country for a reason.
zh: &6036 我们把你调离你的祖国是有原因的。

en: &4126 So you're saying we... what? Don't care about anything?
zh: &4126 所以你是说我们……怎么？什么都不在乎？

en: &1145 Of course not. But you deal with timeline changes better than any agent I've known.
zh: &1145 当然不是。但你应对时间线变化的能力比我认识的任何特工都强。

en: &1146 Ten years you've worked here and your accent hasn't even changed. You're a rock. Always have been.
zh: &1146 你在这儿工作十年了，口音居然一点没变。你稳如磐石。一直都是。

en: &4127 Until Duffy, you mean.
&1147 Until... Duffy, yeah.
&1148 And that painting didn't help either.
zh: &1148 还有那幅画，也让你更难熬。

en: &4128 Er. What painting?
&1149 Do I really need to answer that?
&4129 You, ah, know about that?
&1150 It wasn't hard to figure out.
&1151 You don't have to say anything. I know all about it.
zh: &1151 你什么都不用说。我全都知道。

en: &1152 I was monitoring your vitals when you first saw it, remember? It was all too familiar.
zh: &1152 第一次看到画的时候，我就在监测你的生命体征，记得吧？那种反应我太熟了。

en: &4130 It doesn't matter, anyway. The painting is gone. They all are. Chrono-shifted. Never existed.
zh: &4130 反正也无所谓了。那幅画没了。它们全都没了。被时空改写了。从未存在过。

en: &1153 I'm sorry.
&4131 Imani's gone, too. No archive record at all.
zh: &4131 伊曼妮也没了。档案里完全没有记录。

en: &4132 So don't worry. Neither will be a "distraction" any more.
zh: &4132 放心，这下都不会再让我“分心”了。

en: &1154 That's not what I'm saying.
&4133 No. I understand perfectly.
&4134 A few paintings hardly compare to losing your whole family.
zh: &4134 几幅画跟失去整个家庭比起来，根本不算什么。

en: &4135 That's why you're telling me this, isn't it? To give me perspective.
zh: &4135 所以你才跟我说这些，是吧？让我知道什么才算真正的损失。

en: &1155 This is about DUFFY. It's been hard on me, too.
zh: &1155 这事跟达菲有关。对我来说也很难熬。

en: &1156 I could've used a night out like this weeks ago, but you were always... you know.
zh: &1156 几周前我就想跟你这样出来喝一杯了，可你总在……你懂的。

en: &4136 ...at the gallery.
&4137 I've... been a real socket.
&4138 I guess the suitability analysis was right. I don't care after all.
zh: &4138 我想适配性分析是对的。我终究还是不在乎。

en: &1338 Of course it's right. But not about that.
zh: &1338 分析当然没错，可不是说你不在乎人。

en: &1157 You were grieving too.
&4139 You should have said something.
&1158 Said what? That you were grieving the wrong way?
zh: &1158 说什么？说你悼念的方式不对？

en: &4140 Still. I didn't think to see if YOU were hurting. Made it all about myself.
zh: &4140 可我只想着自己，都没问问你是不是也难过。

en: &1159 Fia, you could have left me in that ERP loop forever. You didn't.
zh: &1159 菲娅，你明明可以让我永远困在那个ERP循环里，可你没有。

en: &1160 You were there when it mattered.
&1161 That's the thing about this job. When WE are the only constants in our world, all we have is each other.
zh: &1161 干这行就是这样，整个世界只有我们还没变，能依靠的就只有彼此。

en: &1162 So when something like Duffy happens, it creates...
zh: &1162 所以当达菲那样的事发生时，就会造成……

en: &6038 Yeah.
&4141 Speaking of, another round?
&6039 Please.
&4142 Mx. Mix! Two distractions, please!
zh: &4142 米克斯！来两杯，好让我们分分心！

en: &7 Coming right up!
&4164 I'm sorry. Who?
&4165 Otis Knox... is he famous?
zh: &4165 奥蒂斯·诺克斯……他很有名吗？

en: &4166 I don't know who that is. Sorry.
&1 Um... okay that's different.
&2 Otis Knox? The horror writer?
zh: &2 奥蒂斯·诺克斯？那个恐怖小说作家？

en: &3 Wrote over thirty best-selling books and then disappeared without a trace 70 years ago?
zh: &3 写了三十多本畅销书，然后七十年前人间蒸发，毫无踪迹？

en: &4 You don't know anything about that?
&5 I thought you said she knew her stuff?
&1339 Alternate timelines. I explained this.
zh: &1339 平行时间线。我解释过了。

en: &6 Yeah but... my dad had, what did you call it? A high timeline ranking?
zh: &6 是啊，但是……我爸爸有，你管那叫什么来着？很高的时间线评级？

en: &1340 Exactly. Which is why you have to stay behind.
&1341 We can't risk any changes to his history.
zh: &1341 我们不能冒险改变他的历史。

en: &7 Okay. Okay. I get it. It's fine.
zh: &7 好吧。好吧。我明白了。没关系。

en: &8 I mean, not FINE, but...
zh: &8 我是说，不是没关系，但是……

en: &9 *Sigh*
&10 I just want to know. More than anything else, I just want to know.
zh: &10 我就想知道真相，没有什么比这更重要。

en: &11 If you can do that for me? Nothing else matters.
zh: &11 你能帮我查清楚，别的就都无所谓。

en: &4167 Your father disappeared?
&12 You seriously never heard about this?
&13 It happened on the Fourth of July. 1993.
&14 According to mom, he went for a walk during the fireworks and... never came back.
zh: &14 据妈妈说，他在烟花表演时出去散步，然后……就再也没回来。

en: &15 It was the top story for months.
zh: &15 那是连续几个月的头条新闻。

en: &16 "Mystery on the Fourth: Celebrated Horror Author Vanishes Without a Trace."
zh: &16 “独立日谜案：著名恐怖小说作家凭空消失。”

en: &17 Everyone thought it was some kind of publicity stunt for his next book. I did too. But...
zh: &17 所有人都以为那是他下一本书的炒作。我也这么想。但是……

en: &18 Well, it wasn't.
&4168 Your father has a high timeline ranking?
zh: &4168 你父亲的时间线评级很高？

en: &19 So I've been told.
&20 His books weren't even that good.
&1342 Even so. His books were... influential, to put it mildly. Tremendously influential.
zh: &1342 好不好是另一回事，说他的书影响深远，都算轻的了。影响实在太大。

en: &1343 They inspired more adaptations than we can calculate.
zh: &1343 改编作品多得数都数不过来。

en: &21 None of those are any good either. I'm telling you. That ranking is a mistake.
zh: &21 那些改编作品也都不怎么样。我告诉你，那个评级是个错误。

en: &1344 I've explained this. It's not up to me.
zh: &1344 我解释过了。这不由我决定。

en: &1345 His ranking is what it is. So we can't change his history.
zh: &1345 他的评级就是那样。所以我们不能改变他的历史。

en: &22 I know. I KNOW. Just don't ask me to like it.
zh: &22 我知道。我知道。只是别指望我喜欢这样。

en: &4169 What, exactly, do you want to know?
&23 I want to know what happened to my father that day.
zh: &23 我想知道我父亲那天出了什么事。

en: &24 Was he killed? Did he hit his head and lose his memory?
zh: &24 他是被杀了？还是撞到头失忆了？

en: &25 Or did he just... run away and leave us?
zh: &25 或者他只是……跑掉，离开了我们？

en: &26 It's been seventy years. I need to know.
zh: &26 已经七十年了。我需要知道。

en: &27 If I can't save him, then maybe knowing is good enough.
zh: &27 如果我不能救他，那么知道真相也许就够了。

en: &4170 I assume there was an investigation?
&28 Major celebrity like that? Of course there was.
&29 But they found nothing. Everyone gave up.
zh: &29 但他们什么也没找到。所有人都放弃了。

en: &30 Even my mother remarried in less than a year.
zh: &30 连我母亲都在不到一年里再婚了。

en: &31 Adam was a nice enough guy, but...
&1346 He wasn't your father.
&4171 So. I assume I'm going to have to tread lightly?
zh: &4171 所以，我猜我得小心行事？

en: &1347 Yes. Observation only.
&1348 He was last seen at a book signing on the Coney Island boardwalk around 8pm. You should have plenty of time to make your way there.
zh: &1348 他最后一次露面是晚上8点左右在康尼岛木板道的一场签售会上。你应该有足够时间赶过去。

en: &1349 Try to find Knox. DON'T interact with him.
zh: &1349 找到诺克斯，但别跟他接触。

en: &1350 Keep your distance. See what happens. Report back. You know the drill.
zh: &1350 保持距离。看会发生什么。回来报告。你懂规矩的。

en: &4172 All right. I believe I'm up to speed.
zh: &4172 好。我想我已经了解情况了。

en: &4173 I'm ready when you are.
&1351 Mr. Knox, if you could step into our waiting area? I'll keep you updated.
zh: &1351 诺克斯先生，请您到等候区稍候？我会随时向您通报进展。

en: &33 Okay. Thank you. This is... well, thank you.
zh: &33 好的。谢谢你。这真是……嗯，谢谢你。

en: &34 Whatever happens. Whatever you find out. Thank you.
zh: &34 无论发生什么。无论你查到什么。谢谢你。

en: &4181 Cassie?
&89 Er. Yeah? Have we met?
&4182 This is about Leaves again, isn't it?
zh: &4182 又是为了“叶子”的事，对吧？

en: &90 Oh. You heard of us? You'd be the first.
zh: &90 哦。你听说过我们？你可是第一个。

en: &4183 Let me guess. June 23rd, 2042.
&91 Er... that's right. How'd you know that?
&1358 She was briefed before she came.
zh: &1358 她来之前已经听过简报。

en: &1359 Isn't that right?
&92 Good. Efficiency. That's what I like to see.
zh: &92 很好，办事有效率，我就喜欢这样。

en: &93 And with your help, maybe I can finally see some.
zh: &93 有你的帮助，也许我终于能看到点效率了。

en: &94 Without Bates and Pasamon messing it up for everyone.
zh: &94 不用再让贝茨和帕萨蒙把大家的事都搞砸。

en: &4184 You're after efficiency?
&95 You want to do a job right, you do it yourself!
zh: &95 想把事情做好，就得自己来！

en: &4185 By "Bates" I assume you mean Madison Bates?
zh: &4185 你说的“贝茨”，我猜是指麦迪逊·贝茨？

en: &96 You know of her? Of course you do. She had to be the face of everything we did, whether it was appropriate or not.
zh: &96 你知道她？你当然知道。不管合不合适，她都得当我们所有事的门面。

en: &97 Not that Mr. Wannabe Genius was much better.
zh: &97 那个自封的天才先生也好不到哪儿去。

en: &4186 By "Pasamon" I assume you mean Benji Pasamon?
zh: &4186 你说的“帕萨蒙”，我猜是指本吉·帕萨蒙？

en: &98 I'm surprised you heard of him. He barely left his workshop except to sulk.
zh: &98 你居然听说过他，他几乎不出工作室，出来也是生闷气。

en: &99 Not that Ms. Prima Donna was much better.
zh: &99 那位大小姐也好不到哪儿去。

en: &100 Twenty years I worked for those two. Twenty years of brokering every argument, putting out every fire, placating every client they pissed off, rehiring every employee who quit.
zh: &100 我给他们干了二十年。吵架要我调解，出事要我收拾，客户被得罪了要我安抚，员工辞职了还得我一个个请回来。

en: &101 I wasn't their office manager. I was their BABYSITTER.
zh: &101 我不是他们的办公室经理。我是他们的保姆。

en: &102 Leaves could have been so much more. With me in charge? It can be.
zh: &102 “叶子”本可以做得更好。由我掌舵？它就能做到。

en: &4187 So you want them out of the company?
zh: &4187 所以你想让他们离开公司？

en: &103 Oh I WISH that was possible, but no.
zh: &103 哦，我倒是希望那有可能，可惜不行。

en: &4188 So you want to have been in charge instead?
zh: &4188 所以你是想当初由你来掌舵？

en: &104 Not a matter of want. I NEED to have been in charge.
zh: &104 不只是想，那个位置必须是我的。

en: &4189 You think you could've done better?
&105 Who else but me?
&106 Twenty years of hindsight is a powerful thing.
zh: &106 有了二十年的经验，回头再看，就清楚多了。

en: &107 Benji Pasamon's ideas were brilliant. Madison Bates's marketing knowhow was second to none.
zh: &107 本吉·帕萨蒙的想法很出色。麦迪逊·贝茨的营销能力无人能及。

en: &108 In theory they should've been a winning combination, but in reality? They were like a sackful of cats. Neither one would give the other an inch.
zh: &108 按理说，他们应该是天作之合，实际上却跟关在一袋子里的猫一样，谁也不让谁。

en: &109 They created an environment so toxic that everyone quit within a year. We spent more money on training than R&D. Would've quit myself, if I didn't have a minority share.
zh: &109 他们营造的环境太恶劣，一年内所有人都辞职了。我们花在培训上的钱比研发还多。要不是我有一点股份，我也早辞职了。

en: &110 But now I can't help but wonder. What if someone else was put in charge? To guide them? Channel them?
zh: &110 现在想想，要是换个人掌权，管住他们，让他们的本事用在正地方呢？

en: &111 If I'm brutally honest? Nobody did that better than me.
zh: &111 说实话，没人比我更擅长这个。

en: &1360 Well, we'd love to help you, but...
zh: &1360 嗯，我们很乐意帮你，但是……

en: &4190 Yes. We'd love to help you. You'll be running Leaves in no time.
zh: &4190 是的。我们很乐意帮助你。你很快就能掌管“叶子”了。

en: &112 Really?
&4191 Yes. Nothing is set in stone. Why not get what you need?
zh: &4191 是的。没有什么是板上钉钉的。为什么不争取你需要的呢？

en: &4192 That's what we're here for. Right, Nozzo?
zh: &4192 我们就是为此而来的。对吧，诺佐？

en: &4193 I can do this, Noz. I need to do this.
zh: &4193 我能做到，诺佐。我必须这么做。

en: &113 Thank you so much!
&4194 So let's get started, shall we?
&4901 I have a... favor to ask.
&4902 I have a... job for ChronoZen.
&4903 I'd like to change something. In the past.
&1473 I had a feeling this would come up. The answer is no.
zh: &1473 我料到会这样。答案是不行。

en: &4904 You don't know what I was going to say.
&1474 Imani Nash.
&1475 Imani Finley.
&1476 Imani Quentin.
&1477 I know the signs, Fia. I've been where you are.
zh: &1477 菲娅，你这样子我看得懂，我也经历过。

en: &4777 Please, Nozzo.
&1478 It's not up to me.
&1479 And you know exactly why.
&4905 This isn't the same thing.
&4906 I know where she'll be. I know exactly how to save her.
zh: &4906 我知道她会在哪里。我确切知道怎么救她。

en: &1480 So you know why you can't do it.
zh: &1480 所以你知道为什么你不能这么做。

en: &4907 Is it the cost? I have oodles saved up.
zh: &4907 是费用问题吗？我存了很多钱。

en: &4908 It's not like I spend it on much anyway.
zh: &4908 反正我也没什么地方花钱。

en: &1481 That's not why. And you know it.
zh: &1481 根本不是这个原因，你心里清楚。

en: &4909 Come on.
&4910 I saved her once already. Why can't I do it again?
zh: &4910 我已经救过她一次了。为什么不能再救一次？

en: &1482 Saving her was an accidental side-effect of completing your main objective.
zh: &1482 你完成主要任务的时候，顺带救了她，是个意外。

en: &1483 Which is how I marked it down on the report.
zh: &1483 报告里，我就是这样写的。

en: &1484 Unless... there's another reason why she survived that day?
zh: &1484 除非……她那天能活下来另有原因？

en: &1485 Please don't answer. I need the deniability.
zh: &1485 别回答，真有人问起来，我还得说自己不知情。

en: &4911 I appreciate that, Nozzo. Really.
&4912 But I need to do it again.
&4913 It won't take long. I promise you.
zh: &4913 不会花太久的。我向你保证。

en: &4914 Do we have any other jobs taking us to that time period?
zh: &4914 我们还有别的任务会去那个年代吗？

en: &4915 I could save her then. As another accidental side-effect.
zh: &4915 我可以在任务期间救她，又一次顺带救下她的意外。

en: &4916 All I have to do is stop a storage room fire. Should be easy.
zh: &4916 我只需要阻止一场储藏室火灾。应该不难。

en: &1486 You... don't know, do you?
&1487 No. You don't. Or we wouldn't be having this conversation.
zh: &1487 不。你不知道。否则我们也不会有这场对话。

en: &7163 Know what?
&1488 The storage room where she died.
&1489 It was located in a building owned by NYU.
zh: &1489 它位于纽约大学所有的一栋楼里。

en: &1490 Specifically the NYU School of Chemistry.
zh: &1490 具体是纽约大学化学学院。

en: &1491 The fire was caused by a lab explosion on the floor above.
zh: &1491 火灾是由楼上实验室爆炸引起的。

en: &4917 Oh no. Not...
&1492 I'm afraid so. It's the same explosion that Joe Anderson tried to circumvent.
zh: &1492 恐怕正是你想的那样，就是乔·安德森想避开的那场爆炸。

en: &1493 I'm sure you remember what happened to him.
zh: &1493 我相信你还记得他出了什么事。

en: &4918 All too well.
&7164 Blast it.
&6041 Yeah.
&1494 You need to let it go.
&4919 I'm not sure I can.
zh: &4919 我不知道自己做不做得到。

en: &1495 You need to try.
&4920 I'll... try, Noz.
&1496 Please do more than try.
&4921 You're right. I'm sorry.
&1497 Thank you, Fia. Really.
&1498 The brass takes a very hard line on agents going rogue.
zh: &1498 上头对擅自行动的特工，绝不手软。

en: &1499 And... I can't lose you, too.
zh: &1499 而且……我也不能再失去你。

en: &4922 You're not going to lose me, Noz.
&4923 It was a passing fancy. It'll pass.
zh: &4923 那只是一时冲动。会过去的。

en: &1500 Promise?
&4924 I... can't promise that. But I can promise to focus on the job. Fight the malaise. Like always.
zh: &4924 我……没法保证。但我可以保证专注于任务。对抗时序倦怠。一如既往。

en: &1501 *phew* Okay.
&1502 Look. I get it.
&1503 You're presented with all these possibilities. It's only natural to want some of them for yourself.
zh: &1503 你面对着所有这些可能性。想为自己争取一些也很自然。

en: &7167 Speaking from experience?
&1504 Yes. God yes.
&4925 I'm not doing it for me.
&1505 We both know that's not true.
zh: &1505 我们都知道那不是真的。

en: &4926 You're right. Of course. You're right.
zh: &4926 你说得对。当然。你说得对。

en: &1506 I know I'm right. But being right doesn't make it easy.
zh: &1506 我知道道理在我这边，可有道理，不代表做起来容易。

en: &1507 You think I didn't want to break time itself to get back what I lost?
zh: &1507 你以为我不想为了夺回失去的东西而撕裂时间本身吗？

en: &1508 But we have to be better than that. We need to be better than that.
zh: &1508 可我们得克制住自己，必须克制住。

en: &4927 "Control the chaos." I know. I know.
&1509 Good.
&1510 Speaking of chaos, I could use something a little more chaotic than club soda right now.
zh: &1510 说到混乱，我现在正需要比苏打水更带劲的东西。

en: &4928 Music to my blasting ears.
&4929 Mx. Mix? Some chaos over here, please?
zh: &4929 米克斯？这边来点“混乱”，好吗？

en: &1268 Simon Inman?
&15 Do I know you?
&124 No, but we know you. We're fans! Well, I'm a fan.
zh: &124 不认识，但我们认识你。我们是你的粉丝！好吧，我是粉丝。

en: &16 Fans. Great. Sorry. I'm retired.
zh: &16 粉丝。好极了。抱歉，我退役了。

en: &176 So am I. That's why I-
&32 Quiet! You wanna talk, do it far away from here.
zh: &32 安静！想聊就离这儿远点。

en: &1269 Clara? Don't provoke him. Please.
&33 Nobody tells me what to do in my own damn bar.
zh: &33 在我自己的酒吧里，没人能对我指手画脚。

en: &34 Least of all HIM.
&1270 Can you do this later?
&1271 Preferably when we're gone?
&17 This can't wait.
&35 Oh look at you. The big man.
&1272 Chloe? If you want to ask Simon a question, do it now.
zh: &1272 克洛伊？如果你想问西蒙问题，现在就问。

en: &177 Right now? It feels, uh, like a bad moment.
zh: &177 现在？感觉，呃，时机不太好。

en: &36 Quiet! You wanna chat, do it out of my bar.
zh: &36 安静！想聊就滚出我的酒吧。

en: &6144 I... would love that.
&2 You got some beans, walking through that door, Inman.
zh: &2 英曼，你敢走进那扇门，算你有种。

en: &3 Not by choice.
&4 I'm here on business.
&3 You're kidding. He sent YOU?
zh: &3 你在开玩笑。他派了你来？

en: &5 Like I said. Not by choice.
&4 You tell him to send somebody else.
&19 Don't make this difficult, Clara.
&1273 Yes Clara, please don't.
&5 Oh, I ain't BEGUN to make this difficult.
zh: &5 呵，我这还没开始为难你呢。

en: &38 This is my bar.
&1274 Clara. Don't do it.
&39 My bar. My rules.
&1275 What about a round of drinks? On me?
zh: &1275 来一轮酒怎么样？我请客？

en: &1276 We can talk this out over a beer.
zh: &1276 我们可以边喝啤酒边谈。

en: &40 I'm not serving. Not as long as this chisler's ruining the ambiance.
zh: &40 我不伺候。只要这个无赖还在这儿煞风景，我就不伺候。

en: &41 So how 'bout you vamoose and let me get back to work?
zh: &41 所以你不如赶紧滚蛋，让我回去干活？

en: &7 You wouldn't dare.
&1277 Don't kill her, Simon!
&20 Kill her?
&21 You really think I'd kill this woman in self-defense?
zh: &21 你真觉得我会出于自卫杀了这女人？

en: &22 Huh. Well, guess you're right.
&1279 Pull the trigger! What are you waiting for?
zh: &1279 扣扳机啊！你还在等什么？

en: &23 Come on, Clara. What's the hold up?
zh: &23 来吧，克拉拉。还磨蹭什么？

en: &43 Fine! You called my bluff.
zh: &43 行！就当你看出我是在吓唬你了。

en: &44 We both know if I shoot you, I won't outlive the day.
zh: &44 你我都清楚，我要是开枪打你，我活不过今天。

en: &24 The day? Try the minute.
&1280 She's bluffing, Simon.
&25 Course she's bluffing.
&45 The hell I am! I'll shoot if you take one more step!
zh: &45 我才没有！你再往前一步我就开枪！

en: &26 That right?
&27 Thought so.
&1281 Round of drinks! Please! Let's just take a second...
zh: &1281 来一轮酒！拜托！我们都冷静一下……

en: &28 Time's up.
&29 Urrg.
&47 And Inman's out for the count!
&48 You were an oaf in the ring, and you're an oaf right here and now.
zh: &48 你在拳台上是个蠢货，此时此刻也还是个蠢货。

en: &30 Quiet!
&1282 Stop winding him up!
&1283 And put that blasted rifle away!
zh: &1283 还有把那该死的步枪收起来！

en: &49 Fine. Fine.
&1284 There. All threats neutralized.
zh: &1284 好了。所有威胁都解除了。

en: &6145 Now can we all please talk like adults?
zh: &6145 现在我们可以像成年人一样好好谈谈了吗？

en: &178 Hey. You need help, Mr. Inman?
zh: &178 嘿。你需要帮忙吗，英曼先生？

en: &31 I don't need nobody's HELP. Get away from me.
zh: &31 我不需要任何人的帮助。离我远点。

en: &32 You have until Wednesday, Clara!
&33 No later.
&50 Fine. As long as someone else comes to collect.
&34 Wednesday!
&179 Hey wait!
&1285 Chloe!
&6146 Blast it.
&2223 Why do they always run off?
&38 Jesus!
&9 Sorry you had to see that, ladies.
zh: &9 抱歉让你们看到这一幕，女士们。

en: &10 Because I can't leave any witnesses.
zh: &10 因为我不能留下任何目击者。

en: &2224 And here we go again.
&2225 Just get it over with.
&6147 Bang.
&6148 Just make it quick.
&1051 We're looking for a boxer named Simon Inman. Do you know him?
zh: &1051 我们在找一个叫西蒙·英曼的拳击手。你认识他吗？

en: &8 No. Can't you see I'm busy, lady?
zh: &8 不认识。没看见我正忙着吗，女士？

en: &9 Ida's in charge. Talk to her.
zh: &9 艾达是负责人。去跟她说。

en: &1052 About Simon Inman...
&10 I already told you. Talk to Ida.
zh: &10 我已经告诉过你了。去跟艾达说。

en: &1053 I couldn't help but notice your... reaction earlier.
zh: &1053 刚才你的……反应，我看到了。

en: &11 Reaction?
&1054 To our conversation about Simon Inman winning the championship belt.
zh: &1054 我们提到西蒙·英曼拿了冠军腰带的时候，你的反应。

en: &12 *hmph*
&1055 There it is again. Care to explain?
&1056 You obviously know Simon Inman.
&1057 Anything you can tell me could be useful.
zh: &1057 你能告诉我的任何事都可能有用。

en: &14 You know, my dear Daddy Mason, God rest his soul, had a saying.
zh: &14 我那亲爱的梅森老爹，愿他安息，生前有句话常挂嘴边。

en: &15 "If you don't wanna eat flies, keep your mouth shut."
&1058 Quite the poet.
&16 I don't wanna eat flies, is all I'm saying.
zh: &16 我只是说，我不想吃苍蝇。

en: &1059 "Daddy" Mason?
&17 My dear departed daddy. Who'd you think?
zh: &17 我亲爱的已故父亲。你以为是谁？

en: &1060 Right. Of course.
&1061 So you're a boxer?
&18 What gave it away? The gloves?
zh: &18 怎么看出来的，我戴着拳套？

en: &49 Hah. Anyone can wear gloves, but you've definitely got something special.
zh: &49 哈。谁都能戴手套，但你确实有特别之处。

en: &19 Thanks, lady.
&50 Your form's excellent. And that follow-through...
zh: &50 你的拳架很漂亮，出拳后顺势发力也很到位……

en: &20 Well I have been working on that. Ida says I gotta stay on my toes, but I'm a brawler, you know?
zh: &20 我一直在练。艾达说我的脚步要轻快点，可我习惯的是硬碰硬。

en: &6168 Could we...
&51 Sure, sure.
&1062 Can you tell me anything else about yourself?
zh: &1062 你还能告诉我关于你自己的其他事吗？

en: &603 What a strange thing to ask.
&1063 Simon's a thug?
&22 Did I say thug?
&52 Yeah. You did.
&23 Well, forget it. I said nothing. I'm not eating flies.
zh: &23 好吧，当我没说。我什么都没说。我可不想吃苍蝇。

en: &1064 Can you tell us about the fight?
zh: &1064 能跟我们说说那场比赛吗？

en: &25 I lost.
&53 So THAT'S why you're training so hard. Planning on a comeback?
zh: &53 所以这就是你拼命训练的原因。打算东山再起？

en: &26 From him? Naw. Ain't worth it.
&6172 Do you know anything about Paula? Simon Inman's sister?
zh: &6172 你了解葆拉吗？西蒙·英曼的妹妹？

en: &27 Why? She pretty?
&6173 She's twelve. And she's dead.
zh: &6173 她十二岁。而且已经死了。

en: &28 Oh! Uh. No. Sorry. I know nothing about that.
zh: &28 哦！呃。不。抱歉。我什么都不知道。

en: &6174 Have you ever heard of a gang called "The Breakdown Boys?"
zh: &6174 你听说过一个叫“破坏男孩”的帮派吗？

en: &29 I don't work with gangs. If anyone told you that, they're a damn liar.
zh: &29 我不跟帮派打交道。要是有人跟你这么说，那他就是个该死的骗子。

en: &6175 No. No. Not at all. I am just curious about them. That's all.
zh: &6175 不。不。完全不是。我只是对他们有点好奇。仅此而已。

en: &30 They're a bunch of murderers and thugs. That's all you gotta know.
zh: &30 他们是一群杀人犯和恶棍。你只需要知道这些。

en: &6176 The Breakdown Boys specifically, or...?
&31 Any gang. A gang's a gang.
zh: &31 任何帮派。帮派就是帮派。

en: &32 Like Ida would say, that's the bottom fact.
zh: &32 按艾达的说法，就是这么回事。

en: &6124 Do you know where Simon Inman lives, by any chance?
zh: &6124 你碰巧知道西蒙·英曼住在哪儿吗？

en: &4416 All right, then.
&1065 I'll leave you to it.
&33 Yeah.
&1017 The Barking Dog?
&2 It's a bar downtown a ways. Real bucket of blood. Boxers love it!
zh: &2 是市中心那边的一家酒吧。地地道道的打架窝子。拳击手们可喜欢了！

en: &40 We're... familiar with it. You're saying Simon's a regular?
zh: &40 我们……对那儿很熟。你是说西蒙是常客？

en: &3 He was. I doubt they want anything to do with him. Nobody does.
zh: &3 他以前是。我怀疑他们现在都不想跟他有任何瓜葛。没人想。

en: &1018 We're looking for someone you may know. Simon Inman.
zh: &1018 我们在找一个人，你可能认识。西蒙·英曼。

en: &4 Simon?
&5 You just missed him by about ten seconds. Sorry.
&1019 Ah. Was he the man you were... saying hello to?
zh: &1019 啊，刚才你在跟那个人……打招呼，他就是西蒙？

en: &6 Yeah. Saying hello. That's... what we were doing.
zh: &6 是啊。打招呼。我们……刚才就是在打招呼。

en: &1020 Do you know where Simon might have gone?
zh: &1020 你知道西蒙可能去哪儿了吗？

en: &7 What a question. Are you looking for trouble? Because that's what you'll find.
zh: &7 还问他去哪儿，你是想找麻烦？那可算找对人了。

en: &41 We just want to ask him a question.
zh: &41 我们只是想问他一个问题。

en: &8 Hah. Well good luck getting an answer. He's tougher to crack than a split-shell clam.
zh: &8 哈。那祝你好运能问出答案。他比裂壳蛤蜊还难撬开。

en: &42 Do you know where he is or not?
zh: &42 你到底知不知道他在哪儿？

en: &9 I'm not that boy's keeper. He's made that very clear.
zh: &9 我又不是那孩子的保姆。他自己说得很清楚。

en: &1021 What were you and Simon, er, saying hello about?
zh: &1021 你和西蒙，呃，刚才在聊什么？

en: &10 Oh nothing important
&43 Are you in trouble? You can talk to us.
zh: &43 你遇到麻烦了吗？可以跟我们说说。

en: &11 I'm in no trouble. And I'd like to stay that way.
zh: &11 我没麻烦，也不想惹上麻烦。

en: &44 We only want to-
&12 Listen. I say this with all the love in my heart.
zh: &12 听着，我可是真心为你们好。

en: &13 How bout you just mind your onions?
zh: &13 你能不能管好自己的洋葱？

en: &1022 Don't you mean oysters?
&1023 Right. Sorry.
&1024 We heard that Simon used to work for you?
zh: &1024 我们听说西蒙以前为你工作过？

en: &15 That's right. But only for a while.
&16 He... never really took to it.
&1025 So you fired him.
&17 I didn't really want to.
&18 I felt bad for him, but things change.
zh: &18 我为他感到难过，但事情会变。

en: &1026 So tell me about these oysters.
zh: &1026 那跟我说说这些牡蛎吧。

en: &19 They're fresh from the bed, plump, sweet and beautifully briny.
zh: &19 刚从养殖床捞上来的，肥美、鲜甜，还带着恰到好处的海咸味。

en: &20 Penny a piece. Three for two.
zh: &20 一便士一个，两便士三个。

en: &1027 Maybe later.
&1028 How did things "change", exactly?
&21 I don't... he's a nice enough boy, I just... it didn't work out.
zh: &21 我不……他这小伙子人是不错，就是……没法接着干了。

en: &46 You're not the first to say that.
zh: &46 你不是第一个这么说的人。

en: &22 Well, it fits.
&47 THAT was not a nice boy. Please, be honest with us.
zh: &47 刚才那个人可不像什么好小伙子，请跟我们说实话。

en: &23 All right. He got MEAN, is all. Really mean. And empty.
zh: &23 好吧，他就是变凶了，特别凶，而且像整个人都空了。

en: &24 The kid just got empty.
&1029 You said you felt bad for Simon?
zh: &1029 你说你为西蒙感到难过？

en: &25 It was just sad, wasn't it? He... he could have been so much more.
zh: &25 想想真让人难过，对吧？他……他原本可以有更好的前程。

en: &6120 Why do you say that?
&26 *Sigh*
&27 I shouldn't say any more.
&28 What's done is done.
&1030 But Simon is dead now. He can't harm you.
zh: &1030 但西蒙现在已经死了。他伤害不了你了。

en: &30 It's not just about Simon.
&1031 It's not?
&31 Look. I'm just trying to run a business here. I can't afford any trouble.
zh: &31 听着。我只是想在这儿做点生意。我经不起任何麻烦。

en: &32 I just want to get through today. Understand?
zh: &32 我只想熬过今天。明白吗？

en: &1032 What do you mean by Simon being "empty?"
zh: &1032 整个人都“空了”，是什么意思？

en: &33 That there's nothing inside him. Like the light went out of his soul.
zh: &33 他内心空无一物。就像灵魂里的光熄灭了。

en: &34 Nobody wants to be around someone like that, and who can blame 'em?
zh: &34 谁也不愿意跟这样的人待在一起，能怪他们吗？

en: &35 Not even his buddies at the Barking Dog want anything to do with him.
zh: &35 就连他在“吠犬”酒吧的哥们儿都不想跟他有任何瓜葛。

en: &1033 Simon Inman is dead.
&36 When?
&1034 Only a few hours ago.
&37 I thought this might happen.
&38 Someone killed him, didn't they?
&39 It was just a matter of time, wasn't it?
&40 The road he was on, there's only a few places it can lead to. Old age was never gonna be one of them.
zh: &40 他走的那条路，只有几个可能的结局。安享晚年从来不在其中。

en: &1035 We had a conversation about six months ago. Remember?
zh: &1035 我们大约六个月前谈过一次。记得吗？

en: &41 Sorry, sweetheart. I can't remember everyone!
zh: &41 抱歉，亲爱的。我哪能记得每个人！

en: &1036 We spoke about Simon. You had nothing but good things to say about him.
zh: &1036 我们聊过西蒙。你对他赞不绝口。

en: &42 I did?
&1037 Yes. You used words like "charming," "keen", and "easy to like."
zh: &1037 是的。你用了“迷人”“敏锐”“讨人喜欢”这些词。

en: &43 Well, a lot can change in six months.
&1038 Of course, but today you told me he didn't take to the job.
zh: &1038 当然，但今天你告诉我他不适应那份工作。

en: &1039 Do you see the contradiction here?
zh: &1039 你看出这里面的矛盾了吗？

en: &44 People are full of contradictions, dear. They change. And not always for the better.
zh: &44 人本来就充满矛盾，亲爱的。他们会变。而且不总是往好的方向变。

en: &45 And Simon... you might try to help them, but sometimes you have to make a choice.
zh: &45 至于西蒙……你也许想帮他们，但有时候你必须做出选择。

en: &46 It wasn't my fault.
&1040 Why would it be your fault?
&1041 Again. Why would it be your fault?
zh: &1041 可到底为什么会是你的错？

en: &47 I always want to help. That's just how I'm built.
zh: &47 我总想帮忙。我天生就是这样。

en: &48 Those who come from nothing. Or those who lose everything.
zh: &48 那些一无所有的人。或者失去一切的人。

en: &49 You do the best you can, but in the end... you have to put your own family first.
zh: &49 你尽了最大努力，但到头来……你必须把自己的家庭放在第一位。

en: &50 No matter how much you wish things were different.
zh: &50 无论你多么希望事情不是这样。

en: &1043 Why would we think you were heartless?
zh: &1043 我们为什么会觉得你铁石心肠？

en: &51 I'm NOT. That's the whole point!
zh: &51 我不是铁石心肠！我就是想说这个！

en: &1044 You obviously feel guilty about something.
zh: &1044 你显然对某件事感到内疚。

en: &52 I'm a mother. Guilt comes with the job.
zh: &52 我是个母亲。内疚是这份工作的一部分。

en: &48 I can see this is weighing on you, Minna. You don't have to carry this on your own.
zh: &48 我看得出这件事让你压力很大，明娜。你不必独自承受。

en: &53 You have to understand, I never wanted to do it.
zh: &53 你得理解，我从来不想那么做。

en: &6121 Do what?
&54 Fire him.
&55 After what happened to his family? God forgive me, it's the cruelest thing I've ever done.
zh: &55 在他家遭遇那种事之后？上帝原谅我，那是我做过最残忍的事。

en: &1047 Why DID you fire him, then?
&56 When the Breakdown Boys tell you to do something, you do it.
zh: &56 当“破坏男孩”让你做什么，你就得照做。

en: &57 They told me to fire Simon, so I fired Simon.
zh: &57 他们让我解雇西蒙，我就解雇了西蒙。

en: &58 Had to tell myself that he deserved it. Just to look at myself in the mirror.
zh: &58 我只能告诉自己，他活该。这样才敢面对镜子里的自己。

en: &59 Course with the way he turned out, it wasn't exactly hard. At least when he was around.
zh: &59 当然，看他后来那副德性，这么想也不难。至少他在的时候是这样。

en: &60 The rest of the time...
&61 Let's just say I hug my girls extra tight and tell myself it was worth it.
zh: &61 这么说吧，我把女儿们抱得特别紧，告诉自己这一切都值得。

en: &1048 The Breakdown Boys?
&62 Consider yourself lucky if you don't know who they are.
zh: &62 你要是不知道他们是谁，算你走运。

en: &63 They've got their fingers in everything that goes in and out of the seaport.
zh: &63 海港进进出出的东西，每样都有他们插手。

en: &64 And they got into Simon too. He ended up working for 'em.
zh: &64 他们也把西蒙拉下了水。他最后替他们卖命。

en: &1049 So the Breakdown Boys. They forced you to fire Simon, and then they hired him themselves?
zh: &1049 所以“破坏男孩”逼你开除西蒙，然后又自己雇了他？

en: &65 That's the long and short of it.
&66 No idea why. Simon and I weren't exactly... chummy by that point.
zh: &66 不知道他们图什么。那时候我和西蒙已经不算……亲近了。

en: &6122 Did you know Paula? Simon's sister?
zh: &6122 你认识葆拉吗？西蒙的妹妹？

en: &67 I... did. Yes.
&68 Terrible thing that happened. Just terrible.
zh: &68 那件事太可怕了。真的太可怕了。

en: &6123 Do you know what happened to her?
zh: &6123 你知道她出了什么事吗？

en: &69 I heard she died in the woods? That's all I know.
zh: &69 我听说她死在树林里？我就知道这些。

en: &70 I couldn't bear to find out more. I already felt bad enough.
zh: &70 我不敢再打听。我已经够难受了。

en: &71 I'm afraid not. I know he lived uptown some time ago, but he had to move.
zh: &71 恐怕没有。我知道他以前住在上城区，但后来不得不搬走。

en: &72 No idea where he is now.
&1050 Good bye.
&73 I'm here if you want anything.
&1209 Do you know a man named Simon Inman?
zh: &1209 你认识一个叫西蒙·英曼的人吗？

en: &2 What would you say, Brian?
&3 Do we know Simon Inman?
&34 Can't say that we do, Miss Ida.
&4 There's your answer.
&1210 Are you sure you don't know Simon Inman?
zh: &1210 你确定你不认识西蒙·英曼？

en: &5 I am SURE I answered this question already.
zh: &5 我确定这个问题我已经回答过了。

en: &114 He was in this arena six months ago.
zh: &114 他六个月前还在这座竞技场。

en: &6 Was he now.
&115 It was in the newspaper!
&116 Show her, Fia.
&117 See? He won the championship belt!
zh: &117 瞧见没？他赢了冠军腰带！

en: &8 Shush, Brian.
&9 Fine. Fine. Yes, I KNEW him. But I don't know him anymore.
zh: &9 行。行。没错，我认识他。但现在已经不认识了。

en: &10 And that's the bottom fact.
&11 And speaking of bottoms, you're blocking my view of Brian's. We done here?
zh: &11 还有，你挡着我看布赖恩的屁股了。问完没？

en: &12 I've said all I'm going to. I can help you look for any other boxer, but not him.
zh: &12 我能说的都说了。我可以帮你找别的拳手，但他不行。

en: &13 Like Brian over there, for instance. He's well worth looking at.
zh: &13 比如那边的布赖恩。他绝对值得一看。

en: &14 I do it all the time.
&1211 Can you tell me anything about this place?
zh: &1211 你能告诉我关于这个地方的事吗？

en: &15 What's to tell? If you want to watch two people beat each other unconscious, this is the place.
zh: &15 有什么好说的？想看两个人把彼此打昏，来这儿就对了。

en: &16 But I'm guessing you're a bit tight-laced for such things, aren't you?
zh: &16 不过我猜你对这种事有点拘谨，对吧？

en: &1212 "Tight-laced"?
&17 You heard me. Your friend, on the other hand...
zh: &17 说的就是你。你那位朋友倒是……

en: &18 I'm guessing SHE does more than just watch. You a fighter too?
zh: &18 我猜她可不只是看看。你也是拳手吗？

en: &118 Was. I'm retired.
&19 I knew it. I'd love to see you go a few rounds against my Brian. You interested?
zh: &19 我就知道。我很想看你跟我的布赖恩打几个回合。你有兴趣吗？

en: &119 I said I'm retired.
&20 Hm. Too bad.
&1213 You'd really let Brian and Chloe fight?
zh: &1213 你真的会让布赖恩和克洛伊打？

en: &1214 Is that even allowed?
&21 Stop living in the dark ages, lady.
&120 Yeah. The crowd LOVES it when women and men fight in the ring.
zh: &120 是啊。观众喜欢看男女在擂台上对打。

en: &22 They spend more, too.
&23 You sure you're out of the game?
&121 Yeah. Completely sure.
&1215 Who's the pugilist on the bags?
zh: &1215 打沙袋的那位拳击家是谁？

en: &24 Pugilist? Heh, I love Canadians.
zh: &24 “拳击家”？呵，加拿大人说话就是有意思。

en: &25 That's Brian.
&26 Heaviest hands this side of the Hudson.
zh: &26 哈德逊河这边，就数他拳头最狠。

en: &122 So he's a pro?
&27 One of the best!
&28 Or he will be if he MIXES UP HIS COMBINATIONS.
zh: &28 或者他会成为最棒的，只要他多变换组合拳。

en: &35 Yes, Miss Ida.
&1216 Can you tell me about Simon? The one you knew?
zh: &1216 你能告诉我关于西蒙的事吗？你认识的那个？

en: &29 Keen kid. Orphaned not long ago. Trying to find a way to get by.
zh: &29 机灵的孩子。不久前成了孤儿。在想办法谋生。

en: &30 He was slaving away at a dead end job when he first showed up here.
zh: &30 他第一次来这里时，正在一份没前途的工作上累死累活。

en: &31 Never thought he'd make it five minutes, let alone to the championship.
zh: &31 从没想过他能坚持五分钟，更别说夺冠了。

en: &32 He surprised us all.
zh: &32 他让我们所有人都吃惊了。

en: &1217 Brian referred to Simon as a thug. Do you share that view?
zh: &1217 布赖恩说西蒙是个恶棍。你也这么看吗？

en: &33 *Sigh* Damn it, Brian.
&34 I'd say he should know better, but I don't keep him around for his brains.
zh: &34 他该知道什么话不能说。不过我留他，可不是图他聪明。

en: &123 Answer the question.
&35 Tell me one thing first. Why do you care so much?
zh: &35 先告诉我一件事。你为什么这么在意？

en: &175 I'm a fan.
&36 A fan. Of Simon Inman.
&125 Yes. He inspired me to get into the game. I want to meet him.
zh: &125 对，是他的故事让我开始打拳的，我想见他。

en: &126 And to ask him... something.
&37 What kind of something?
&127 That's my business. I already answered your question. Now answer mine.
zh: &127 那是我的事。我已经回答了你的问题。现在回答我的。

en: &38 Fine. A deal's a deal.
&39 Yes. Simon's a thug. To the bone.
zh: &39 是的。西蒙是个恶棍。骨子里就是。

en: &40 Didn't start that way, but that's how he ended up.
zh: &40 起初不是那样，但他最后变成了那样。

en: &41 The kid should've stayed at the oyster stand. Maybe he would've been happier.
zh: &41 那孩子本该留在牡蛎摊的。也许他会更快乐。

en: &1218 You mentioned an oyster stand?
&42 Minna's Oysters. On Essex by the market. Nice woman. Always gives me extra butter.
zh: &42 明娜牡蛎摊。在市场旁边的埃塞克斯街上。人很好。总是多给我黄油。

en: &1219 And they knew Simon?
&43 Simon used to work there. Before she fired him. She had to, after all.
zh: &43 西蒙以前给她干活，后来她把他辞了，也是没办法。

en: &1220 Had to?
&44 Well, yes. Business is business.
New location:[Essex Market[
&1221 About this oyster stand where Simon worked...
zh: &1221 关于西蒙工作过的那个牡蛎摊……

en: &45 I told you. It's over on Essex.
zh: &45 我告诉过你了。在埃塞克斯街上。

en: &46 And that's all you're getting out of me.
zh: &46 我能告诉你的就这些了。

en: &1222 How did Simon end up that way?
&47 *Sigh*
&48 Now look what you've done.
&49 You got an old lady reminiscing. Ida, you old windbag.
zh: &49 害我这老太太又聊起以前来了。艾达，你这老话痨。

en: &128 Please. I... need to know.
&50 I ain't saying a word about Simon, but I'll tell you this.
zh: &50 关于西蒙我一个字也不会说，但我要告诉你这个。

en: &51 Some boxers? They let winning go to their heads.
zh: &51 有些拳击手？他们让胜利冲昏了头脑。

en: &52 Most end up ok. But some... get real mean.
zh: &52 大多数人最后还好，可有些人……就变得特别凶狠。

en: &1223 So you're saying Simon got mean?
&53 I never said I was talking about Simon.
zh: &53 我从没说过我在说西蒙。

en: &54 You'd best remember that.
&1224 Ida? Can you tell me anything about this?
zh: &1224 艾达？你能告诉我这是怎么回事吗？

en: &55 What am I looking at here?
&1225 Some transactions from six months ago. Quite large ones. Made out to you.
zh: &1225 六个月前的几笔转账，金额很大，收款人是你。

en: &1226 The payments are from Eddie Inman.
zh: &1226 这些付款来自埃迪·英曼。

en: &57 I do business with a lot of people.
&1227 You are aware that Eddie Inman is the head of a gang called the Breakdown Boys?
zh: &1227 你知道埃迪·英曼是一个叫“破坏男孩”的帮派头目吗？

en: &36 What?
&58 You concentrate on your blocking, Brian. Let me handle this.
zh: &58 你专心防守，布赖恩。让我来处理。

en: &37 I thought I was taking the fall for YOU.
zh: &37 我还以为我是替你故意输的。

en: &59 Brian!
&6163 Do you know what happened to Paula? Simon's sister?
zh: &6163 你知道葆拉怎么样了吗？西蒙的妹妹？

en: &60 Look. I get it. Losing a loved one is like losing an arm. And you can't fight without an arm.
zh: &60 听着。我明白。失去所爱的人就像失去一条胳膊。没有胳膊你就没法打拳。

en: &61 I work with fighters. You can't fight, I can't use you. That's the bottom fact.
zh: &61 我这里要的是拳手，打不了拳，就用不上你，就是这么回事。

en: &6164 Are you familiar with "The Breakdown Boys?"
&62 Never heard of them. And if you value your health, neither have you.
zh: &62 没听说过。你要是还想活得好好的，也没听说过。

en: &6165 So, you do know of them?
zh: &6165 这么说，你确实知道他们？

en: &63 I don't see how I could be more clear.
zh: &63 我想我已经说得够清楚了。

en: &6166 Did you ever learn where Simon Inman lived?
zh: &6166 你知不知道西蒙·英曼住在哪儿？

en: &64 Wasn't any of my business. Why're you making it yours?
zh: &64 那不关我的事。你为什么要打听？

en: &6167 I'm just asking.
&65 Makes no difference to me.
&1228 Well, thanks for the assistance. I suppose.
zh: &1228 好吧，还是谢谢你帮忙……算是帮忙吧。

en: &66 Good luck out there.
&1229 Thanks. We'll be leaving now.
&3383 I will leave you to it.
&67 Mm hmm.
&1254 We're looking for Simon Inman. Do you know him?
zh: &1254 我们在找西蒙·英曼。你认识他吗？

en: &14 That guy? I ain't saying nothing.
zh: &14 那家伙？我什么都不会说。

en: &171 You and everybody else.
&172 What's his deal? Why does everyone hate him so much?
zh: &172 他怎么回事？为什么大家都这么恨他？

en: &15 Ain't my place to say. I just don't want trouble.
zh: &15 不该由我来说。我只是不想惹麻烦。

en: &1255 What can you tell me about Simon Inman?
zh: &1255 关于西蒙·英曼，你能告诉我什么？

en: &1256 We don't have a lot of time here.
&16 What?
&1257 Anything you tell me could be useful. Please.
zh: &1257 你告诉我的任何事都可能有用。拜托了。

en: &17 You're not making a whole lotta sense.
zh: &17 你说的话让人摸不着头脑。

en: &1258 Why do you hate Simon Inman so much?
zh: &1258 你为什么这么恨西蒙·英曼？

en: &18 Where did you hear that name?
zh: &18 你从哪儿听到这个名字的？

en: &1259 Answer the question. We have very little time.
zh: &1259 回答问题。我们时间非常少。

en: &19 Time? Time for what?
&1260 So I hear this place is popular with boxers?
zh: &1260 我听说这地方很受拳击手欢迎？

en: &20 The gym's only a few streets over, so yeah. We get a lot of them.
zh: &20 健身房离这儿只有几条街，所以是的。我们这儿有很多拳手。

en: &21 You a fan?
&173 You could say that.
&22 Well just to warn you. They come here for PRIVACY.
zh: &22 只是提醒你一下。他们来这儿是为了清静。

en: &23 You start bugging them, you need to leave. You catch on?
zh: &23 你要是开始烦他们，就得离开。明白了吗？

en: &107 More than you know.
&24 Right then.
&1261 Clara, I know you keep a rifle under the counter.
zh: &1261 克拉拉，我知道你在柜台下面放了把步枪。

en: &25 What's it to you?
&1262 You need to leave it alone. Whatever happens next, don't touch it.
zh: &1262 你别去碰它。接下来不管发生什么，都别碰。

en: &26 A lady's got a right to defend her business.
zh: &26 女士有权保护自己的生意。

en: &1263 You don't understand. He's-
&1264 Listen to me. Simon Inman is about to walk in that door.
zh: &1264 听我说。西蒙·英曼马上就要从那个门进来。

en: &27 Pff. I'd like to see him try.
zh: &27 切。我倒想看看他敢不敢。

en: &1265 He will. You need to keep calm. Don't do anything stupid.
zh: &1265 他会的。你必须保持冷静。别做傻事。

en: &28 Stupid? If he comes in here, HE'S the stupid one.
zh: &28 傻事？他要是敢进来，傻的是他。

en: &29 Stupid gets what stupid deserves.
zh: &29 傻子活该有傻子的下场。

en: &6141 I fear you may be right.
&1266 You are about to die. If you don't keep calm, you will die. And so will we.
zh: &1266 你快要死了。如果你不冷静，你会死。我们也会。

en: &174 Calm down, Fia. What are you talking about?
zh: &174 冷静点，菲娅。你在说什么？

en: &30 Yeah. No drinks for you, lady. You've had enough.
zh: &30 是啊。不给你酒了，女士。你喝得够多了。

en: &31 See you.
&1267 You know what? Never mind. We'll try this again soon.
zh: &1267 你知道吗？算了。我们很快会再试一次。

en: &1286 So what was that all about?
&51 My monthly payment was due. He came to collect.
zh: &51 该交这个月的钱了，他来收钱。

en: &1287 You didn't want to pay?
&52 No problem with paying. I know how the world works.
zh: &52 付钱没问题。我知道这世界的规矩。

en: &53 But I told 'em. Simon Inman doesn't darken my door. Ever.
zh: &53 但我跟他们说了。西蒙·英曼别想踏进我的门。永远。

en: &1288 Tell me about Simon Inman.
&1289 I get the impression that something happened to him.
zh: &1289 我总觉得他出了什么事。

en: &54 It's not exactly a secret. His whole family died.
zh: &54 这也不是什么秘密。他全家都死了。

en: &1290 So he's all alone. That explains a lot.
zh: &1290 所以他孤身一人。这就说得通了。

en: &55 No, it doesn't.
&56 Lots of people are alone. It doesn't turn them into THAT.
zh: &56 孤独的人多了。不会变成他那样。

en: &1291 Who is this monthly payment to?
&57 You're not from this neighborhood, are you?
&58 Then you're better off not knowing. Trust me.
zh: &58 那你最好别知道。相信我。

en: &1292 How did his family die?
&59 I wasn't exactly CLOSE, was I? A road accident, from what I heard.
zh: &59 我又不是他什么人，对吧？听说是车祸。

en: &60 I knew his daddy, though. Everybody did. He was a good man.
zh: &60 不过我认识他爸。大家都认识。他是个好人。

en: &61 Would break his heart to see what his boy's turned into.
