zh: &61 要是看到自己儿子变成这样，他心都会碎。

en: &1293 You knew Simon's father?
&62 Course. Everyone knew Patrick Inman. Especially in wintertime.
zh: &62 当然。大家都认识帕特里克·英曼。尤其是冬天。

en: &63 Best furrier in the northeast.
&1294 Simon's father was a furrier. Really.
zh: &1294 西蒙的父亲是皮货商。真的。

en: &64 Yeah. Patrick made a fortune back in the day. Course the market's not what it was.
zh: &64 是啊。帕特里克当年发了大财。当然现在行情不如从前了。

en: &65 But we've all got our problems.
zh: &65 但我们都有各自的难处。

en: &1247 Do you know where Simon lives?
zh: &1247 你知道西蒙住在哪儿吗？

en: &66 No idea. Don't care to.
&6157 Do you know Paula? Simon Inman's sister?
zh: &6157 你认识葆拉吗？西蒙·英曼的妹妹？

en: &67 Inman has a sister?
&6158 Had. She's dead.
&68 Oh. Did Simon get her killed? I bet he did.
zh: &68 哦。是西蒙害死她的吗？我打赌是他。

en: &6159 Your sympathy is palpable.
zh: &6159 你的同情心真是溢于言表。

en: &69 Sympathy is for people without a business to run.
zh: &69 同情心是留给那些不用打理生意的人的。

en: &6160 Are you familiar with a gang called "The Breakdown Boys?"
zh: &6160 你熟悉一个叫“破坏男孩”的帮派吗？

en: &70 Me and everyone else who does business around here.
zh: &70 我和这附近所有做生意的人都熟悉。

en: &6161 Are they the ones you give monthly payments to?
zh: &6161 你每月付钱的就是他们吗？

en: &71 You trying to get me into trouble?
&72 Go ask your questions somewhere else.
&1295 Well, we'd best be going.
&6162 I'd best be going.
&73 See you soon. Hope it'll be less eventful next time.
zh: &73 回头见。希望下次别这么惊心动魄。

en: &1230 I suppose so. Enjoy yourself.
&129 Hot Yuma. You're the best.
&1231 It's... not recommended.
&130 Fine. I get it.
&131 I don't agree, but I get it.
&1232 Maybe later? After we find your man.
zh: &1232 也许晚点？等我们找到你要找的人之后。

en: &132 I may need a drink before I talk to him. Liquid courage and all?
zh: &132 跟他谈之前我可能需要喝一杯。壮壮胆什么的？

en: &1233 Just... try not to get sick.
&1234 If you vomit in the past, we keep your security deposit.
zh: &1234 你要是在过去吐了，押金我们可不退。

en: &133 I can handle myself.
&134 Wow. Will you LOOK at this place?
&135 It's got sawdust on the floor and everything!
zh: &135 连地上的锯末都有，真够地道的！

en: &1235 Do you have any... residual memories? Of an alternate timeline?
zh: &1235 你有没有……残留记忆？来自另一条时间线的？

en: &136 Not that I'm aware of.
&1236 Nothing like, say, getting shot? Simon Inman walking in?
zh: &1236 比如中枪？西蒙·英曼走进来？

en: &137 Did that happen?
&1237 Sort of. We-
&1238 Simon Inman is about to walk in.
zh: &1238 西蒙·英曼马上要进来了。

en: &138 He is? Great! I can't wait to finally meet him.
zh: &138 是吗？太好了，总算能见到他了，真等不及！

en: &139 Wow, I'm actually sweating. Do I look nervous? How's my hair?
zh: &139 哇，我都出汗了。我看起来紧张吗？我头发怎么样？

en: &1241 We need to leave. Right now.
&140 Huh? But we'll miss Simon if we leave now.
zh: &140 啊？但现在走的话我们会错过西蒙的。

en: &1242 Just trust me.
&141 Can you at least tell me why.
zh: &141 你至少能告诉我为什么吧。

en: &1243 Fine. He's-
&1244 Hide. Now.
&142 Jeez, Fia. What's going on with you?
zh: &142 天哪，菲娅。你这是怎么了？

en: &6142 Just keep your head down.
&143 You're making no sense.
&6143 Listen. We-
&1245 What exactly did you imagine?
zh: &1245 那你原先想的是什么样？

en: &144 I... don't know. All I ever knew about him were facts and stats.
zh: &144 我……不知道。我对他了解的全是事实和数据。

en: &145 And it seems like even THEY were wrong.
zh: &145 而且现在看来连那些都是错的。

en: &1246 You want to leave? We can abort, if you want to.
zh: &1246 你想离开吗？如果你想，我们可以中止任务。

en: &146 I'm not a quitter.
&147 No. Fate brought me here to ask Simon Inman a question. I'm gonna ask it.
zh: &147 不。命运把我带到这里，就是要问西蒙·英曼一个问题。我会问的。

en: &148 Even if I don't like the answer.
&5268 We need to learn where Simon Inman lived.
zh: &5268 我们需要查明西蒙·英曼住在哪里。

en: &5244 Is there anything else you know about him? Anything that can give us a clue?
zh: &5244 你还知道关于他的其他事吗？任何能给我们线索的？

en: &150 Course it couldn't be too easy.
&151 Rule number one of being a celebrity. Never let 'em dox you.
zh: &151 当名人的第一条规矩。永远别让人查到你的住址。

en: &152 Course it turns out that Simon wasn't much of a celebrity, was he?
zh: &152 当然，事实证明西蒙算不上什么名人，对吧？

en: &75 *Sigh*
&1249 Are you all right?
&153 Damn it, I dunno.
&154 They always say you shouldn't meet your heroes. I should've listened.
zh: &154 都说别去见自己的偶像，我早该听的。

en: &155 Lord knows I've disappointed... a lot of people.
zh: &155 天知道我让……很多人失望过。

en: &156 But I've never been on this end of it before. It... sucks.
zh: &156 可我还从没尝过被偶像辜负的滋味。真是……难受。

en: &1250 And how are you physically?
zh: &1250 那你身体上感觉怎么样？

en: &157 Fine. Why?
&1251 No strange headaches or anything?
zh: &1251 没有奇怪的头痛之类的？

en: &158 I know I got my head hit for a living, but I pay top dollar for Anderson brain rejuvenation  treatments at least once a decade.
zh: &158 我知道我靠挨打谋生，但我至少每十年花大价钱做一次安德森大脑再生治疗。

en: &1252 Of course. Forget it.
&1253 Shall we carry on?
&159 Yeah. Let's go.
&6197 It's... a complicated calculation that ChronoZen does. Very high tech, I can't really talk about the details. Proprietary...
zh: &6197 是……ChronoZen做的一种复杂计算。技术很先进，细节我不能讲，公司专有……

en: &160 Uh huh.
&161 Look I get it. Trade secret. You don't have to pretend.
zh: &161 听着，我明白。商业机密。你不用装。

en: &6198 In a nutshell, I relived the same time period over and over until I got the desired result.
zh: &6198 简单说，我把同一段时间反复经历了好多次，直到得到想要的结果。

en: &162 Huh. Handy tech. Could've used that in a couple of fights.
zh: &162 好方便的技术啊，我有几场比赛要能用上就好了。

en: &163 But why was it necessary to make him do that in the first place?
zh: &163 但为什么一开始有必要让他那么做？

en: &1716 Because he would've killed us if I hadn't. The bartender as well.
zh: &1716 因为如果我不那样做，他会杀了我们。还有酒保。

en: &164 And you know this for sure?
&165 Well, I guess I shouldn't be surprised.
&166 Why *wouldn't* my hero be a cold-blooded killer?
zh: &166 我的英雄为什么*不会*是个冷血杀手呢？

en: &2706 I'd probably characterize him as more... hot-blooded.
zh: &2706 我倒觉得，他可能更……容易热血上头。

en: &167 Maybe. But...
&168 Dammit.
&169 This is not how I imagined this playing out.
zh: &169 这可不是我想象中的发展。

en: &170 This a time travel thing? I don't get it.
zh: &170 跟时间旅行有关？我不明白。

en: &1188 We weren't really falling. Not technically.
zh: &1188 我们并不是真的在坠落。严格来说不是。

en: &1189 We weren't going either up or down.
zh: &1189 我们既没有向上也没有向下。

en: &1190 We weren't moving in the traditional way we think of it.
zh: &1190 我们并不是以传统意义上的方式在移动。

en: &1191 It's something else.
zh: &1191 跟平常的移动不是一回事。

en: &74 Heh. It certainly is.
&76 You must think I'm so silly.
&77 Using time travel for... this?
&1192 It's important to you. That's all that matters.
zh: &1192 这对你很重要。这才是关键。

en: &78 That's just it. I don't know if it's important or not.
zh: &78 就是这样。我不知道这重不重要。

en: &79 But now I'm here. I'm seeing this through.
zh: &79 但现在我来了。我要把这件事做完。

en: &1193 Between you and me? Your reasons are less silly than most.
zh: &1193 私下跟你说，你的理由，比大多数人的靠谱。

en: &80 Thanks. That's a sweet lie.
zh: &80 谢谢。这是个善意的谎言。

en: &81 Either way, I'm here. I'll see it through.
zh: &81 不管怎样，我来了。我会坚持到底。

en: &1194 Silly or not, we're here.
zh: &1194 傻不傻的，我们都已经来了。

en: &82 Good. I'm not changing my mind. Not now.
zh: &82 好。我不会改变主意。现在不会。

en: &83 You don't win three world championship belts by quitting.
zh: &83 能赢三条世界冠军金腰带的人可不会半途而废。

en: &84 We're gonna find Simon Inman, and I'm gonna ask him... what I need to ask him.
zh: &84 我们要找到西蒙·英曼，然后我要问他……我需要问的事。

en: &85 Speaking of...
&86 Let's do this.
&1195 Can I see that newspaper article? The one you showed Ida?
zh: &1195 那份剪报能给我看看吗？给艾达看的那份。

en: &87 Sure.
&88 Go ahead and keep it. It's just a copy, anyway.
zh: &88 你留着吧。反正只是份复印件。

en: &89 I have the original framed on my wall at home.
zh: &89 原件我裱起来挂在家里的墙上了。

en: &1196 So, you're a boxer?
&90 Was. I retired.
&91 You really never heard of me? I'm a three-time world champion.
zh: &91 你真的没听说过我？我是三届世界冠军。

en: &1197 No. Sorry. Shifting timelines make it hard to follow sport. Sports.
zh: &1197 没有。抱歉。时间线不断变动，很难关注体育。体育运动。

en: &92 That must be weird.
&6081 Perils of the job.
&93 Well, at least this way I know you're not some fangirl!
zh: &93 嗯，至少这样我就知道你不是什么狂热粉丝了！

en: &1198 So this Simon Inman. What can you tell me about him?
zh: &1198 那么这位西蒙·英曼。你能告诉我些什么？

en: &1199 Anything that's not in the historical record?
&94 Not much. Just that he was a sickly kid who grew up to win the championship.
zh: &94 不多。只知道他小时候体弱多病，长大后赢得了冠军。

en: &95 Like me.
&1200 Your biography says he inspired you to become a boxer, is that why you want to meet him now?
zh: &1200 你的传记说他激励你成为拳击手，这就是你现在想见他的原因吗？

en: &96 Yeah. His story gave me direction way back then.
zh: &96 对。他的故事在很久以前就给我指明了方向。

en: &97 I'm hoping he can do the same again for me now.
zh: &97 我希望他现在能再次为我指明方向。

en: &1201 Why did you retire, anyway?
&98 I didn't want to do it anymore.
&1202 And that was that?
&99 That was that.
&100 Boxing is a young person's game. I'm almost 65. The Anderson treatments can only take me so far.
zh: &100 拳击是年轻人的运动。我快65岁了。安德森疗法也只能帮我到这一步。

en: &101 Time to hang up the gloves.
&1203 You really think talking to Simon can help you?
zh: &1203 你真的认为和西蒙谈谈能帮到你？

en: &102 I dunno. It's worth a shot.
&103 Not like anybody else has any decent advice.
zh: &103 反正别人也没什么好建议。

en: &1204 Chloe, we've hit a small snag...
zh: &1204 克洛伊，我们遇到了一点小麻烦……

en: &6082 Would you mind... giving me a boost over the fence?
&1205 Then I can open it from the other side.
zh: &1205 然后我可以从另一边打开。

en: &104 I've got a better idea.
&1207 That... works too.
&105 I thought it might.
&106 Let's go!
&6083 This is really important to you, isn't it?
zh: &6083 这对你真的很重要，是吗？

en: &601 More than you know.
&6084 May I ask why?
&108 Because this time, maybe I can change things. Maybe I can save him.
zh: &108 因为这一次，也许我能改变一切。也许我能救他。

en: &109 Maybe that'll make up for... everything.
&6085 Understood. Well, not understood. But understood. Let's do this.
zh: &6085 懂了。虽然没完全听明白，不过我懂你的意思。走吧。

en: &2219 Chloe. Are you okay?
&110 Why does everyone around me keep dying?
zh: &110 为什么我身边的人一个接一个地死去？

en: &2220 This wasn't your fault.
&111 I am sick of hearing that! Maybe it *should* have been my fault.
zh: &111 我听腻了！也许*应该*是我的错。

en: &2221 What do you mean?
&112 Don't worry about it. Sorry. Let's just go.
&1208 Let's get back to it, shall we?
&113 You're in charge.
&1296 We just have one question for you.
zh: &1296 我们只有一个问题要问你。

en: &1297 That's all. Answer it, and we'll leave.
zh: &1297 就这些。回答完，我们就走。

en: &35 A question.
&36 Seems all anyone does is ask me to do things.
zh: &36 好像所有人都在要求我做事。

en: &1298 What happened here?
&37 84th Street, they said. Got a number and everything.
zh: &37 他们说，84街。有门牌号什么的。

en: &38 All put in motion sixty years ago.
zh: &38 都是六十年前就安排好的。

en: &39 Nothing I could do about it.
&1299 Is this where you live?
&40 Does this look like a place someone lives?
zh: &40 这看起来像有人住的地方吗？

en: &1300 You said you were "going home."
&41 Just because I call it home, doesn't mean I live here.
zh: &41 我把它叫做家，不代表我住在这里。

en: &42 But that's me, isn't it? Never in control. Never my choice.
zh: &42 但那就是我，不是吗？永远无法掌控。永远不是我的选择。

en: &43 Ever since that damn fight I've been living a life that someone laid out for me.
zh: &43 自从那场该死的比赛之后，我就一直过着别人为我安排的生活。

en: &44 Can't even LOSE on my own terms.
zh: &44 连输都不能按我自己的方式来。

en: &45 *Sigh*
&46 You said you had a question? Ask it.
&1301 Go on.
&180 Right.
&181 *Ahem*
&47 Spit it out.
&183 You won the championship.
&48 Yeah. I did.
&184 And then you just... stopped.
&49 Yeah. Stopped. That's it.
&185 I'm... kind of the same.
&50 The same. Right.
&186 And now that it's over... now that I can't go back, I have no idea what to do.
zh: &186 而现在一切都结束了……现在我没法回去了，我不知道该做什么。

en: &51 Is that your question?
&187 You were champion! And you gave it up! Just like me.
zh: &187 你曾是冠军！而你放弃了！就像我一样。

en: &52 Lady, we are *not* the same.
&188 We are. More than you know. I used to have a purpose, you know? A fate.
zh: &188 我们一样，比你想的还像。我以前也有个目标，你知道吗？一个命中注定的方向。

en: &189 Now I just have decades of empty time stretching ahead of me, and I have no idea how to forgive... I mean, what to fill it with.
zh: &189 现在，眼前只剩下几十年空荡荡的日子，我不知道该怎么原谅……我是说，该拿什么填满它。

en: &53 Still not hearing a question.
&54 You want me to tell you how to live your life? Is that it?
zh: &54 你想让我告诉你该怎么生活？是这样吗？

en: &190 *Sigh* No. Yes. Maybe?
&191 I wanted to learn how you lived YOURS, and thought that maybe... it would help me figure out mine? Somehow.
zh: &191 我想听听你是怎么过日子的，也许……能帮我想清楚以后该怎么办？总能有点帮助吧。

en: &192 But then I met you, and you're, well, you, and we have more in common but...
zh: &192 可见到你之后，你，嗯，是这个样子。我们倒是更像了，可是……

en: &193 This is silly, isn't it?
&55 You said it. Not me.
&194 Yeah. You're just as lost as I am.
&56 Lost? You think I'm lost?
&57 I know exactly where I am.
&58 I'm home.
&59 And I ain't ever leaving it again.
zh: &59 而且我再也不会离开了。

en: &1302 Nozzo! ERP! Quick!
&314 I can't, Fia. I'm sorry.
&315 That only works when YOU die. Not anyone else.
zh: &315 那只有你死的时候才管用。别人死可不行。

en: &1303 I'm sorry, Chloe.
&195 This isn't right.
&196 This isn't RIGHT!
&197 He was supposed to live until he was 39.
&198 He had twenty more years. At least!
zh: &198 他至少还有二十年可活！

en: &199 His bio said so!
zh: &199 他的生平档案是这么写的！

en: &1304 Biographies can be a bit unreliable. Especially from this period.
zh: &1304 生平档案未必可靠，尤其是这个年代的。

en: &6186 It doesn't necessarily mean anything went wrong, just the records weren't right.
zh: &6186 这不一定意味着出了什么差错，只是记录不准确而已。

en: &200 So he was supposed to die here? Right now?
zh: &200 所以他本该死在这里？就在现在？

en: &2226 There's no such thing as "supposed to", but perhaps. Yes.
zh: &2226 没有什么“本该”，但也许吧。是的。

en: &201 Well... can you check? See if his bio changed? Please?
zh: &201 那……你能查一下吗？看看他的档案有没有变，求你了。

en: Chloe stares at you impassively; waiting for your answer. Only a slight twitch of her fingers betrays her impatience.
zh: 克洛伊面无表情地盯着你，等待你的回答。只有手指的轻微抽动暴露了她的不耐烦。

en: &1305 It... didn't change.
&202 Jesus. You're a terrible liar.
zh: &202 天哪。你撒谎真不怎么样。

en: &1307 It did change. I'm sorry.
&203 Des Moines.
&204 This is because of us, isn't it?
&205 What happened at the bar. He was already on the edge. That... pushed him over it.
zh: &205 酒吧里那件事。他本来就快崩溃了，那件事……让他彻底撑不住了。

en: &206 This is all my fault.
&1308 If anyone is to blame, blame me.
&1309 I made him slip on that billiard ball.
zh: &1309 是我让他踩到那颗台球滑倒的。

en: &207 No. You were just doing your job.
zh: &207 不。你只是在做你的工作。

en: &208 You only had to do that because I brought us here.
zh: &208 你不得不那么做，是因为我把我们带到了这里。

en: &1310 These things happen sometimes.
&209 People die before they are supposed to?
&1311 Occasionally. Or live longer than they are supposed to.
zh: &1311 偶尔会，也有人比原本活得更久。

en: &1312 Like that barmaid, Clara. Simon would have killed her today.
zh: &1312 就像那个酒吧女招待，克拉拉。西蒙今天本来会杀了她。

en: &210 So Simon's loss is Clara's gain?
zh: &210 所以西蒙没了，克拉拉倒得救了？

en: &6187 You could look at it that way.
&211 So what happens now?
&1313 We'll submit a refund request, naturally.
zh: &1313 我们自然会提交退款申请。

en: &212 A what?
&2227 The brass cares about keeping our customers happy, and although technically we fulfilled our end of the bargain, we aren't unsympathetic.
zh: &2227 公司高层在乎让客户满意，虽然严格来说我们履行了协议，但我们并非不近人情。

en: &6188 I feel pretty confident that... this... wasn't what you wanted out of your visit.
zh: &6188 我很确定……这个结果……不是你来这一趟想要的。

en: &213 I don't want a REFUND.
&2228 You don't?
&214 No. I want to go back and FIX this.
zh: &214 不。我要回去修正这一切。

en: &215 Grab his gun. Knock him out. Something.
zh: &215 夺下他的枪。打晕他。随便什么。

en: &1314 No. We can't. It's too risky.
&216 Why not? Didn't we already change things. What's a few more?
zh: &216 为什么不行？不是已经改过了吗？再多改一点又怎么样？

en: &1315 Chloe.
&217 Is it the money? I've got banks full of it. I'll pay whatever you want.
zh: &217 是钱的问题吗？我银行里多的是。你要多少我都付。

en: &1316 It's not that. We were present when he died.
zh: &1316 不是钱的问题。他死的时候我们就在场。

en: &1317 To stop him, we would have to go back and interact with our past selves. Our PFEs can handle many things, but not that.
zh: &1317 要阻止他，我们就得回去接触过去的自己。我们的PFE能应付很多情况，可应付不了这个。

en: &218 Why? What's the worst that could happen?
zh: &218 为什么？最坏能坏到哪去？

en: &1318 Our current and past selves would melt.
zh: &1318 现在和过去的我们会融化。

en: &1319 You really don't want to know.
&1320 We die. Both our current and past selves. Slowly and painfully.
zh: &1320 我们会死。现在的和过去的自己都会。缓慢而痛苦地死去。

en: &1321 Believe me. It's not pretty.
zh: &1321 相信我。那场面可不好看。

en: &219 There has to be something.
&1322 I'm sorry, Chloe. But there's not.
zh: &1322 抱歉，克洛伊。但真的没有。

en: &316 Actually, there may be a way. Assuming Ms. Sadar is willing to pay for it.
zh: &316 其实，也许有个办法。前提是萨达尔女士愿意付钱。

en: &220 I am. What were you thinking?
&317 According to everyone you've spoken to over then, something happened to Simon the night of the championship fight in April.
zh: &317 你们在那边问过的人都说，四月的冠军赛那晚，西蒙出了点事。

en: &318 Something that set him on the path to... this.
zh: &318 那件事让他走上了……这条路。

en: &319 Find out what that was, change it, you could save his life. All without interacting with your previous selves.
zh: &319 查清楚那件事，改变它，就有可能救他的命，而且不用接触过去的你们。

en: &1323 Any thoughts on where to begin?
&320 Not at the moment. Information from that when is very scarce.
zh: &320 目前还没有。那个年代的信息非常稀少。

en: &321 But we already know where he worked, where he lived, and where he drank.
zh: &321 但我们已经知道他工作的地方、住的地方，还有喝酒的地方。

en: &322 Those are good leads.
&1324 You've met Simon now, Chloe. He's not what you imagined.
zh: &1324 你现在见过西蒙了，克洛伊。他不是你想象的那样。

en: &1325 Are you absolutely sure he's worth it?
zh: &1325 你确定他值得你这么做吗？

en: &221 I don't know. He deserves a second chance to turn things around.
zh: &221 我不知道，可他该有个重新开始的机会。

en: &222 Hell, so do I.
&1326 Nozzo, can you check if Duffy's available?
zh: &1326 诺佐，你能查查达菲有没有空吗？

en: &223 Duffy?
&6190 He's three grades higher than me and niche cases like this are far more his thing.
zh: &6190 他比我高三级，这种特殊情况他更擅长。

en: &224 I don't care about level grades. You know the situation, and you know me.
zh: &224 我不在乎级别。你了解情况，也了解我。

en: &323 That's just as well. Duffy is currently... very busy working on the Mx Mix case. For hours, in fact.
zh: &323 那正好。达菲目前……正忙着处理米克斯的案子。事实上，已经忙了好几个小时了。

en: &1327 Right. Understood. Tell him I'll help him later.
zh: &1327 好吧。明白了。告诉他我晚点去帮他。

en: &6191 Time to see how well he taught me.
zh: &6191 是时候看看他把我教得怎么样了。

en: &1328 All right, Chloe.
&1329 Let's go save Simon Inman.
&892 I just need confirmation to access your bank serial.
zh: &892 我只需要确认一下，就能访问你的银行序列号。

en: &225 Right. Ahem.
&226 Chloe Sadar authorizing payment for: new timefall from ChronoZen.
zh: &226 克洛伊·萨达尔授权支付：ChronoZen 的新一次时间坠落。

en: &893 Processing...
&894 Just a little longer...
&895 Just need a security check. Memorable phrase?
zh: &895 还要做个安全验证。你的验证短句是？

en: &227 "I get up in the morning looking for adventure."
zh: &227 “我早上起床就为了找点刺激。”

en: &228 Um. George Foreman. I chose it a long time ago.
zh: &228 呃。乔治·福尔曼。我很久以前选的。

en: &896 Okay. All set. ChronoZen thanks you for your custom.
zh: &896 好的。都办妥了。ChronoZen 感谢您的惠顾。

en: &229 Thank you. I mean it.
&324 Head back to the landing point. I'll have the new coordinates set by the time you get there.
zh: &324 回到跃迁落点去。等你到那儿的时候，我会把新坐标设好。

en: Chloe has transformed her face into a mask of determination.
zh: 克洛伊收起了别的表情，脸上只剩坚定。

en: &1405 We'll be quick, Promise.
&1406 It will just take a moment.
&1407 It's very important.
&1 *grunt*
&6202 Please?
&2 *grumble*
&237 Is... that a yes?
&3 It's a free country.
&1408 So. Who are you?
&4 You first.
&1409 I'm Fia. This is Chloe.
&201 *grunt*
&1410 And you are?
&202 Busy.
&1411 Right. So you said.
&1412 What is this place?
&6 Fish market.
&1413 And what do you do here?
&7 Sell fish.
&239 And that's all? Nothing else happens here?
zh: &239 就这些？这里没别的事发生？

en: &203 *grumble*
&1414 Do you know Simon Inman?
&204 *grumble*
&240 Inman. Simon Inman.
&241 Won the city heavyweight championship six months ago.
zh: &241 六个月前拿了城市重量级冠军。

en: &205 *grunt*
&1415 Right. Nevermind.
&1416 Is your name "Eddie?"
&206 *grunt*
&605 Is... that a yes?
&207 *grumble*
&1417 So. Are you familiar with the Breakdown Boys?
zh: &1417 那么，你了解“破坏男孩”吗？

en: &208 *grunt*
&1418 I hear they operate out of this area?
zh: &1418 我听说他们在这片区域活动？

en: &209 *grumble*
&110 Did you really think that would work?
zh: &110 你真的以为那能行得通？

en: &1419 Do you know Minna? Runs an oyster stall up on Essex.
zh: &1419 你认识明娜吗？在埃塞克斯街摆牡蛎摊的那个。

en: &1420 Do you do business with her?
&210 *grumble*
&1421 Naturally.
&1422 On second thought, telling him that I was sneaking upstairs uninvited is not the wisest of decisions.
zh: &1422 转念一想，告诉他我不请自来溜上楼，可不是什么明智的决定。

en: &1423 Your name is Inman, isn't it? Eddie Inman?
zh: &1423 你姓英曼，对吧？埃迪·英曼？

en: &8 Hrm?
&9 Do I know you?
&1424 Not exactly. But I know your niblings.
zh: &1424 不算认识。但我认识你的侄甥们。

en: &10 My what?
&1425 Simon and Paula.
&12 What about 'em?
&1426 Simon and Paula live upstairs, don't they?
zh: &1426 西蒙和葆拉住在楼上，对吧？

en: &1427 Or did at some point?
&13 Simon does, yeah.
&14 But Paula...
&242 This guy is hard work.
&1428 I... have some bad news.
&15 You don't have to say nothing. I already know about Paula.
zh: &15 你什么都不用说。葆拉的事我已经知道了。

en: &1429 I have some questions about them, if you don't mind.
zh: &1429 如果你不介意，我想问几个关于他们的问题。

en: &16 I do mind. I don't talk about Paula.
&243 Paula? Did something happen to her?
&17 Like I keep telling Simon, it's ancient history.
zh: &17 就像我一直跟西蒙说的，那都是陈年旧事了。

en: &18 Gotta move on.
&1432 No, you misunderstand. Simon...
&244 Simon's dead.
&211 What?
&20 Who killed him? I'll make them pay.
zh: &20 谁杀了他？我要让他们偿命。

en: &21 A hundred times over. I'll make them pay.
zh: &21 我要他们百倍偿还，付出代价。

en: &1434 No. Please. There is no need for that.
zh: &1434 不，别这样。没必要那么做。

en: &1435 He... took his own life.
&22 I don't understand.
&245 He... shot himself in the head.
zh: &245 他……朝自己脑袋开了一枪。

en: &24 Where is he?
&25 Spit it out. Tell me where my nephew is.
zh: &25 快说。告诉我我侄子在哪儿。

en: &1436 I have some questions first.
&26 You want a cleaver through the head?
&27 Tell me. Now.
&1437 He's by the remains of his old house.
zh: &1437 他在他老房子的废墟那儿。

en: &28 Damn it, Simon.
&29 Of course he'd go there.
&30 Kid can barely shave and he's already stuck in the past.
zh: &30 这小子连胡子都还没长齐，就已经困在过去里了。

en: &1438 Why did he do it?
&31 That's family business.
&32 Tell me where he is. Now.
Chloe's body seems relaxed, but her eyes dart around the area.
zh: 克洛伊的身体看似放松，但她的眼睛在四处扫视。

en: Eddie
&1439 Well, we must be going.
&1440 Thanks for the... chat.
&1441 We're sorry for your loss.
zh: &1441 你侄子过世，我们很遗憾。

en: &33 I'm not.
&6216 Are you all right?
&34 Just disappointed.
&1443 I didn't know him well, but he seemed like a good kid.
zh: &1443 我跟他不太熟，但他看起来是个好孩子。

en: &35 Good? Who cares about that?
&36 He was a coward. Born a coward. Died one, too.
zh: &36 他是个懦夫。生来就是懦夫。死的时候也是。

en: &1444 That's hardly fair.
&37 Fair? Who said anything had to be fair?
&1445 He was obviously troubled.
&38 No. He was WEAK.
&1446 What happened to him?
&1447 I get the impression he used to be... different.
zh: &1447 我感觉他以前……不是这样的。

en: &39 Different? Yeah. He was different.
zh: &39 不是这样？是啊。他以前不一样。

en: &40 I was teaching him the business. He was gonna take over for me when I retired.
zh: &40 我一直在教他这行的门道，等我退休了，他就接我的班。

en: &41 But he had too much of his father in him.
zh: &41 但他骨子里太像他父亲了。

en: &42 Weak. Always weak.
&1448 Why do you say Simon was weak?
&43 You're looking at the evidence.
&44 He always needed someone to hold his hand.
&45 First his momma. Then his sister.
zh: &45 先是他的妈妈。然后是他妹妹。

en: &46 Could never move on when they both died.
zh: &46 她们俩死后，他一直走不出来。

en: &1449 Simon won the city championship.
&1450 That doesn't sound like something a weak man could do.
zh: &1450 那听起来不像是一个软弱的人能做到的事。

en: &47 Yeah. Exactly.
&246 What does that mean?
&48 None of your business.
&1451 Paula died?
&49 Yeah. Over there. In the woods.
&50 Or, you know. Where the woods used to be.
zh: &50 就是……以前那片树林在的地方。

en: &51 They really tore this place apart, didn't they?
zh: &51 他们真把这里拆了个底朝天，对吧？

en: &1452 Paula died in the woods? How?
zh: &1452 葆拉死在树林里？怎么死的？

en: &52 No idea.
&247 Simon wasn't around to help her?
&53 Nah. He was busy wiping the floor with Brian Mason.
zh: &53 没。他正忙着把布赖恩·梅森打得满地找牙。

en: &248 Wait. So she died the night of the fight?
zh: &248 等等，她是在比赛那晚死的？

en: &54 No, during the birth of Christ. Who CARES?
zh: &54 不，是耶稣诞生那会儿。谁在乎啊？

en: &55 It's ancient history. I've moved on. You gotta move on.
zh: &55 都是陈年旧事了。我已经翻篇了。你也得翻篇。

en: &56 Simon couldn't move on, and look what happened to him.
zh: &56 西蒙翻不了篇，看看他落得什么下场。

en: &57 Just get outta here, already. Before there are more dead bodies to deal with.
zh: &57 赶紧离开这儿吧。趁还没多出几具尸体要处理。

en: &249 Eddie-
&58 GO AWAY.
&59 Yeah.
&1457 You really don't remember me?
&46 Maybe. I see so many people these days.
zh: &46 也许吧。这些天我见的人太多了。

en: &47 This city is so crowded. Everyone kind of blurs together.
zh: &47 城里的人太多了，谁是谁都快分不清了。

en: &1458 I only saved your life.
&48 You did?
&1459 The night of your brother's championship win?
&49 I don't remember anything about that night.
zh: &49 那晚的事我什么都不记得了。

en: &1460 Well. Maybe it's best if you don't.
zh: &1460 好吧。也许不记得对你更好。

en: &1461 A friend and I visited your home around six months ago.
zh: &1461 大约六个月前，我和一个朋友去过你家。

en: &1462 You said to me, and I quote, "get the hell off my land."
zh: &1462 你当时对我说，原话是，“滚出我的地盘。”

en: &50 Heh. I got that mad, huh?
&1463 My ears are still ringing.
zh: &1463 我的耳朵到现在还嗡嗡响。

en: &51 Well it makes no difference now.
&52 Couldn't own land in the city even if I wanted to. Not real land, anyway.
zh: &52 就算我想，也没法在城里拥有土地了。反正不是真正的土地。

en: &1464 Could we chat a moment?
&53 Sure. Don't have anywhere to be.
zh: &53 当然。反正我也没地方可去。

en: &1465 I am sorry again about your house.
zh: &1465 你房子的事，我还是很抱歉。

en: &54 "The house is gone, kid. You gotta move on."
&55 Nothing. Just something my Uncle Eddie says. A lot.
zh: &55 没什么，埃迪叔叔总这么说，一遍又一遍。

en: &56 He wants me to forget about our house. But why?
zh: &56 他想让我忘掉我们的房子。可为什么？

en: &57 Just because everyone else is forgetting, it doesn't mean I have to.
zh: &57 别人都忘了，也不代表我就得忘。

en: &1467 Do you like living here?
&59 It's noisy. It's crowded. And I'm gonna smell like fish for the rest of my LIFE.
zh: &59 又吵又挤。而且我这辈子身上都会是一股鱼腥味。

en: &60 Simon swore up and down I'd get used to it, but he's a liar.
zh: &60 西蒙信誓旦旦地说我会习惯的，根本就是骗人。

en: &1468 What is it like living with your uncle?
zh: &1468 跟你叔叔住在一起是什么感觉？

en: &61 *grunt*
&62 *grumble*
&63 *mumble*
&64 Get it?
&1469 That impression is dead on.
&65 Thank you.
&66 When I do that for anybody else, they get real quiet.
zh: &66 我模仿给别人看，他们就都不吭声了。

en: &1470 Has your brother been... all right?
&67 Simon? He's fine.
&1471 Just fine?
&68 He's always working. I never see him.
zh: &68 他总是在工作。我几乎见不到他。

en: &69 I know he's trying to save money to get us a real place somewhere, but...
zh: &69 我知道他想攒钱，好让我们在别处有个真正的住处，可是……

en: &1472 But what?
&70 But nothing. He's fine. Everything's fine.
zh: &70 没什么可是。他很好。一切都好。

en: &1473 No. I can still fix this. I won't upset her if I don't need to.
zh: &1473 不。我还能补救。不到万不得已，我不会让她难过。

en: &1474 If this mission proves to be impossible, I'll tell her then. But not before.
zh: &1474 要是这个任务实在完成不了，到时候我再告诉她，现在还不行。

en: &1475 Does your uncle keep a ledger?
&71 A what?
&1476 A book filled with numbers. Transactions.
zh: &1476 一本写满数字的本子。交易记录。

en: &1477 It is probably hidden in some secret place?
zh: &1477 它可能藏在什么隐秘的地方？

en: &72 A secret place...
&73 You know, there IS a thing like that.
zh: &73 你知道吗，还真有这么一个东西。

en: &1478 There is?
&74 Sure. Upstairs! Wanna see?
&1479 Yes, please.
&76 Come on!
&1480 How did you find this compartment?
zh: &1480 你是怎么发现这个暗格的？

en: &77 You mean you couldn't tell it was there?
zh: &77 你是说你没看出来它在那儿？

en: &78 City people.
&79 I used to track animals through the woods.
zh: &79 我以前常在树林里追踪动物。

en: &80 A crack in the floor isn't exactly hard to spot.
zh: &80 地板上的一条裂缝可不算难发现。

en: &1481 You showed this to me awfully quickly, Paula.
zh: &1481 葆拉，你这么轻易就把这个给我看了？

en: &1482 Do you often share your secrets with strangers?
zh: &1482 你经常跟陌生人分享秘密吗？

en: &82 I don't think you're a stranger. Not really.
zh: &82 我觉得你不算陌生人。不算。

en: &1483 What do you mean by that?
&83 I dunno. Nothing.
&1484 There's no ledger in here.
&84 You asked about a secret place. This is a secret place!
zh: &84 你问的是藏东西的地方，这里就是啊！

en: &85 Maybe Uncle Eddie kept stuff here before we moved in?
zh: &85 也许埃迪叔叔在我们搬进来之前把东西放在这里了？

en: &1485 Perhaps he did.
&1486 Thank you, Paula. You've been a big help.
zh: &1486 谢谢你，葆拉。你帮了大忙。

en: &86 Oh good. Guess we're even now.
zh: &86 哦，太好了。那我们现在扯平了。

en: &1487 Even?
&42 Huh?
&1488 You said we were even now.
zh: &1488 你刚才说我们现在扯平了。

en: &87 No I didn't. Are you hearing things?
&1489 I suppose I must be.
&3141 Take care, Paula.
&88 Hm hmm.
&3217 Do you remember Chloe?
&89 Who?
&3218 Chloe Sadar. Red dress. Dark skin. Very fit. She watched you like a mother hen.
zh: &3218 克洛伊·萨达尔。穿红裙子，皮肤很深，身体很健壮。她像护着小鸡的母鸡似的，一直看着你。

en: &90 I... no. I don't think I know anyone like that. Sorry.
zh: &90 我……不。我不认识那样的人。抱歉。

en: &1395 Bye, Paula.
&91 Sure. Bye, whoever you are.
&1490 You took a fall?
&38 Ida told me to.
&1491 You didn't know about this?
&39 I took the payoff. Sure. Ida told me to.
zh: &39 我拿了钱。没错。艾达让我这么做的。

en: &1492 Tell me what happened.
&40 Ida told me to let Simon Inman win the championship fight.
zh: &40 艾达让我在冠军赛上故意输给西蒙·英曼。

en: &68 I also told you to keep your mouth shut about it!
zh: &68 我还告诉过你这件事要守口如瓶！

en: &41 You said nobody would find out! That you'd make it all ok!
zh: &41 你说过没人会发现的！你说过你会摆平一切的！

en: &69 And I HAVE, haven't I Brian?
zh: &69 我已经摆平了，不是吗，布赖恩？

en: &70 Haven't I always taken good care of you?
zh: &70 我不是一直把你照顾得很好吗？

en: &42 You have. That's why I did it.
&43 But you didn't tell me I was taking a fall for the BREAKDOWN BOYS!
zh: &43 但你没告诉我，我是为“破坏男孩”打假拳！

en: &44 You know my daddy was killed by the Dead Rabbits gang.
zh: &44 你知道我爸爸是被“死兔帮”害死的。

en: &71 That was a different gang.
&45 A gang's a gang!
&72 Brian. I couldn't say no. Not if we both wanted to keep breathing.
zh: &72 布赖恩。我没法拒绝。除非我们俩都不想活了。

en: &73 He would've killed us both if Simon lost.
zh: &73 如果西蒙输了，他会把我们俩都杀了。

en: &74 You know how these things work.
&46 You should've told me. We could've done something.
zh: &46 你当时就该告诉我。我们明明能想想办法。

en: &75 Like what?
&47 I don't know. You're the brains. I'm just the dumb muscle.
zh: &47 不知道。动脑子的事靠你，我就是个只会出力的傻大个。

en: &76 You're not-
&48 Quiet. I need to punch this out before I explode.
zh: &48 别说了，我得先打几拳出出气，不然就要炸了。

en: &77 Brian-
&49 SHH!
&1590 Don't go in there!
&256 Didn't we just go over this?
zh: &256 我们不是刚说过这个吗？

en: &257 If Simon's in there, that's where we need to be.
zh: &257 如果西蒙在里面，我们就得去那里。

en: &258 See you inside.
&1591 I'm fine. But you won't be if you go in there.
zh: &1591 我没事，可你要是进去就有事了。

en: &259 I TOLD you. I can handle my booze.
zh: &259 我告诉过你。我酒量没问题。

en: &1592 This is a mistake, Chloe. We can't go in there.
zh: &1592 这是个错误，克洛伊。我们不能进去。

en: &260 Why? Is Simon somewhere else?
zh: &260 为什么？西蒙在别的地方吗？

en: &6150 Not as such, no, but...
&261 Well then!
&1593 We're in a time loop, Chloe.
zh: &1593 我们被困在时间循环里了，克洛伊。

en: &1594 Every time we go in there, we die.
&262 We don't find Simon?
&1595 Well, we DO, technically, but-
zh: &1595 嗯，严格来说我们找到了，但是——

en: &263 Then what are we waiting for?
&1596 Simon Inman is going to kill us if we go in there!
zh: &1596 如果我们进去，西蒙·英曼会杀了我们！

en: &264 You mean he's inside?
&1597 No, but he's on his way.
&265 Great! Let's have a drink while we wait.
zh: &265 太好了！我们边等边喝一杯吧。

en: &6151 Wait! You don't understand.
&1598 You need to listen to me!
&266 You need to Portland out, Fia.
&267 Maybe by having a drink with me?
&268 What in Yuma are you doing?
zh: &268 尤马啊，你到底在干什么？

en: &2247 ...calibrating my weapon. Just in case.
&269 Aim it somewhere else next time. I'll see you inside.
zh: &269 下次瞄准别的地方。我们里面见。

en: &338 Using your weapon on a client, Fia?
&1600 It was on stun.
&6155 And I don't recall the brass objecting when I shot Joe Anderson.
zh: &6155 我开枪打乔·安德森的时候，也没见高层有意见。

en: &339 That was different. There was a top-level override for him.
zh: &339 那不一样。对他有最高级别的豁免令。

en: &1601 So we can't get another?
&340 No. That was an emergency. This isn't.
zh: &340 不行。那是紧急情况。现在不是。

en: &1602 I keep getting shot in the head! Doesn't that qualify?
zh: &1602 我老是被人爆头！这还不算吗？

en: &341 I don't write the protocols, Fia.
&1603 Fine. I'll just keep dying, shall I?
zh: &1603 行。那我就继续死，行了吧？

en: &342 That's the spirit.
&6152 Chloe, it's too dangerous. Let's go somewhere else.
zh: &6152 克洛伊，太危险了。我们去别处吧。

en: &270 Come on. You only live once!
&6153 Hah. Funny.
&271 I don't get it.
&272 Eh. Whatever. Tell me inside.
&1604 I'm fine. Everything's just... fine.
&273 Okay then. I'll see you inside.
&6177 Simon. What are you doing?
&247 What does it look like?
&6231 Simon. Put that down. Please.
zh: &6231 西蒙。把那个放下。求你了。

en: &248 I would if I could.
&6179 Don't do this!
&249 I don't want to. But I gotta.
zh: &249 我也不想。但我必须这么做。

en: &250 What I've become? What I've turned into?
zh: &250 我变成了什么？我变成了什么样的人？

en: &251 I'm a monster. A god damned monster.
zh: &251 我是个怪物。一个该死的怪物。

en: &6180 Just wait. Wait one second.
&333 Fia? I got this.
&6181 Are you...?
&334 I've been where he is. Let me handle this.
zh: &334 我经历过他的处境。让我来。

en: &6182 All right.
Breaking my rule and thank you Sally.
zh: 打破我的规矩，谢谢你，莎莉。

en: &336 Your boxing career means EVERYTHING, Simon.
zh: &336 你的拳击生涯意味着一切，西蒙。

en: &252 It means nothing. Not anymore.
zh: &252 什么都不是。再也不是了。

en: &337 Do you know what your career meant to people? To the whole sport?
zh: &337 你知道你的拳击生涯对多少人、对整个拳坛意味着什么吗？

en: &253 I won a championship fight, and it ruined my life. If that's the sport? Let it die too.
zh: &253 我赢了一场冠军赛，却把一辈子都毁了。拳击要是这样，那就让它一起完蛋吧。

en: &338 Commission?
&1065 The Commissioners' Plan of 1811.
&1066 It was the long-term plan for New York's grid system of streets. Lots of homes were destroyed in the process.
zh: &1066 就是纽约棋盘式街道布局的长期规划。为了实施规划，拆了很多房子。

en: &6183 Is this really the time for a history lesson?
zh: &6183 现在真的是上历史课的时候吗？

en: &6002 Sorry.
&254 Inmans built this place. Three generations of us born and raised here.
zh: &254 英曼家建了这地方。我们三代人在这里出生长大。

en: &255 Now it's just 84th Street. That's all anybody will know.
zh: &255 现在这里只是第84街，以后谁也不会知道别的了。

en: &256 But they can't take it away. Not where I'm going.
zh: &256 但他们夺不走它。至少在我去的地方夺不走。

en: &339 Power. That's what it's all about, isn't it?
zh: &339 权力。说到底不就是为了这个吗？

en: &340 Who has it. Who doesn't. Who gets caught in the middle.
zh: &340 谁手里有权，谁没有，又是谁夹在中间受罪。

en: &341 It's not fair.
&257 Life ain't fair. I know that.
zh: &257 生活本来就不公平。我知道。

en: &258 All I have left is this one choice.
zh: &258 我剩下的只有这一个选择。

en: &342 So... so there was this study!
zh: &342 所以……所以有这么一项研究！

en: &203 A what?
&343 A study. Of people who jumped off the Golden Gate Bridge. The ones who survived, I mean.
zh: &343 一项研究。关于从金门大桥跳下去的人。我是说，那些活下来的。

en: &344 And you know what? Almost all of them realized afterward that they didn't want to die.
zh: &344 你知道吗？事后他们几乎都意识到，自己其实不想死。

en: &345 They were grateful for that second chance.
zh: &345 他们感激那次重来的机会。

en: &259 What the hell's a golden gate?
&346 I'm saying don't do it. There's always a way. Please.
zh: &346 我是说别这么做。总会有办法的。求你了。

en: &260 There's only one way out. I've thought this through.
zh: &260 只有一条出路。我已经想清楚了。

en: &347 Do it for me!
&261 Huh? Lady I don't know you.
&348 No, but I know you. And... this is going to sound crazy, but...
zh: &348 你不认识我，可我认识你。而且……你可能觉得这话很荒唐，但是……

en: &349 You're the reason I'm the person I am! I traveled so far to meet you, you have no idea.
zh: &349 没有你，就没有今天的我！我走了多远才见到你，你根本想象不到。

en: &262 Sorry to disappoint you.
&350 No. That's what I'm trying to tell you. You WILL matter to people. I promise you.
zh: &350 不。这正是我想告诉你的。你将来会对别人很重要。我向你保证。

en: &263 I. Don't. Care.
&351 Simon. I... I've killed someone, too.
&6185 Chloe?
&352 In the ring. They ruled it an accident, but...
zh: &352 在拳台上。判定是意外，可是……

en: &264 You can't forgive yourself?
&353 No. I don't think I ever will.
zh: &353 不。我觉得我永远也原谅不了。

en: &265 Now you know how I feel.
zh: &265 现在你明白我的感受了。

en: &354 That's what I'm saying! I need to believe there's a way back. I have to.
zh: &354 我就是这个意思！我需要相信还有回头路。我必须相信。

en: &266 There's no coming back from what I've done.
zh: &266 我做过那些事，已经回不了头了。

en: &355 Punishing yourself isn't going to make anything better.
zh: &355 惩罚自己不会让事情变好。

en: &267 There's no GETTING BETTER.
&268 I just need it to STOP.
&356 As long as you're alive, there's hope.
&269 Tell that to the bodies I put in Trinity Cemetery.
zh: &269 去跟那些被我埋进三一公墓的人说吧。

en: &270 In fact? Never mind.
&271 I'll... I'll tell them myself.
zh: &271 我会……我会自己去告诉他们。

en: &358 Damn it. Why?
&360 You're not a monster, Simon.
&272 You don't know me. I kill. I torture. I scare people.
zh: &272 你根本不了解我。我杀人，折磨人，还恐吓人。

en: &273 I never wanted this. But this is what I am.
zh: &273 我从来没想要这样。但我就是这样的人。

en: &274 He told me it was better to be feared. But I can't look in the mirror anymore.
zh: &274 他说，让人怕我才好。可我已经不敢看镜子里的自己了。

en: &361 "He"? Who is "he"?
&275 No. Let him find out on his own.
&276 All I have is THIS. The power to end it. He can't get me then.
zh: &276 我只剩这个了，还能自己结束一切。那样他就再也奈何不了我。

en: &362 Do you... have a home? A real one?
&363 Why don't we take you there. We can talk this out properly.
zh: &363 我们带你去那里吧。我们可以好好谈谈。

en: &277 I told you. I AM home.
&278 I'm never leaving. And nobody can take it away.
zh: &278 我永远不会离开。没人能夺走它。

en: &279 Not the damn commission. Not nobody.
zh: &279 该死的委员会不行。谁都不行。

en: &364 I heard about your family. I'm sorry.
zh: &364 我听说了你家人的事。我很遗憾。

en: &365 But they wouldn't want this.
zh: &365 但他们不会希望你这样。

en: &280 I did it for them, you know?
zh: &280 我做那些是为了他们，你知道吗？

en: &281 The boxing. It was for them.
&282 But it all meant nothing.
&366 You know I was a sick kid, too? I read that about you.
zh: &366 你知道我小时候也体弱多病吗？我读到过你的事。

en: &283 Yeah. Grew into a sick adult.
zh: &283 是啊。长大成了个病态的大人。

en: &367 I know how hard that must have been. I genuinely know.
zh: &367 我知道那有多难。我真的知道。

en: &284 It was nothing compared to losing... everything.
zh: &284 跟失去……一切相比，那不算什么。

en: &368 You fought your way through hell. And you were only little.
zh: &368 你从地狱里杀出一条路。而且你当时还那么小。

en: &369 Think what you could do now.
&285 I'm tired of fighting. There's only one thing I can do to change what I've become.
zh: &285 我不想再斗下去了。想摆脱现在这个自己，只剩下这一条路。

en: &370 That's not true.
&371 I know that's how it feels. Like the world is judging you. But...
zh: &371 我知道那种感觉。就像整个世界都在审判你。但是……

en: &286 The world is past judging me. They've already passed sentence.
zh: &286 世界早就审判完了，连刑都判好了。

en: &287 And the world is right. It's better off without me.
zh: &287 而且世界是对的。没有我它会更好。

en: &372 You haven't thought this through! Not really.
zh: &372 你还没想清楚！根本没想清楚！

en: &373 Maybe... maybe that's why I'm here?
zh: &373 也许……也许这就是我在这里的原因？

en: &374 Because I know you don't die today.
zh: &374 因为我知道你今天不会死。

en: &288 You don't know what you're talking about.
zh: &288 你不知道自己在说什么。

en: &1513 I couldn't do that even if I wanted to.
&1514 I wish I could. But I couldn't even if I wanted to.
zh: &1514 我希望我能。但就算我想，我也做不到。

en: &1515 There WAS a payoff Brian. I can't say otherwise.
zh: &1515 确实有好处费，布赖恩。我不能说没有。

en: &2693 You've got to be kidding.
&83 Do I look like I'm kidding?
zh: &83 我看起来像在开玩笑吗？

en: &1522 You'd really pick a fight with a woman?
zh: &1522 你真的要跟一个女人打架？

en: &84 I didn't pick this fight. You did.
&1523 I don't want any trouble, Brian.
&85 It's too late for that!
&1524 Very well, then.
Brian punches first time
&2231 Looks like we're doing this.
&1525 I have my ways.
&86 Yeah, I believe it. You're not someone to mess with, I can tell.
zh: &86 是啊，我相信。我看得出你不是好惹的。

en: &1526 I'm from the future.
&87 Look, I was just asking. You don't need to be like that.
zh: &87 听着，我只是问问。你不用这样。

en: &1527 It wasn't easy.
&88 Looked pretty easy from here.
&89 Does anybody else know? Besides you?
zh: &89 还有别人知道吗？除了你？

en: &1528 No. Nobody else knows.
&90 Ah, screw it. Clara already knows. It's already too late.
zh: &90 啊，算了。克拉拉已经知道了。已经太迟了。

en: &80 Since when does my opinion really mean that much to you?
zh: &80 从什么时候起我的意见对你这么重要了？

en: &91 You really need to ask that? After what I just did merely on your say-so?
zh: &91 你还用问吗？我刚才做那件事，可全凭你一句话！

en: &81 Wait, are you sayin...
&92 I mean, I didn't want it to come out like this but...
zh: &92 我是说，我本来不想在这种时候说的，可是……

en: &82 Oh my god. Oh thank the lord! Finally! I've been waiting for you to admit this since we were teenagers. I'm sweet on you too, you absolute fool.
zh: &82 天哪，谢天谢地！终于说了！从十几岁起，我就一直在等你承认。我也喜欢你，你这个大傻瓜。

en: &93 But... but... I took a bribe. How on earth could you like me now?
zh: &93 但是……但是……我收了贿赂。你怎么可能现在还喜欢我？

en: &83 Because I know you, you big lug. You're the sweetest guy in this goddamn town.
zh: &83 因为我了解你啊，傻大个。你可是这破镇上最温柔的人。

en: &84 You wouldn't do anything bad unless you had a really good reason.
zh: &84 除非有非常好的理由，否则你不会做坏事。

en: &94 Ida told me I had to. And there was no other choice.
zh: &94 艾达告诉我必须这么做。而且没有别的选择。

en: &85 Well, how's this for a choice. I close this place up early and you come over here behind the counter, huh?
zh: &85 那我给你个选择怎么样？我今天早点关门，你到柜台后面来，嗯？

en: &95 Oh. Uhhh.
&96 Okay!
&97 Whatever you say!
&2232 Um. Before the... er, that.
&2233 Isn't there a fight you need to get to?
zh: &2233 你不是还有场比赛要去吗？

en: &2234 One that doesn't involve me?
&98 Oh. Right.
&99 But first I need to give Ida that money back. Tell her I'm not taking a dive.
zh: &99 但首先我得把钱还给艾达。告诉她我不打假拳。

en: &100 It'll be a fair fight. That Inman kid won't know what hit him.
zh: &100 我们要公平地打一场。英曼家那小子连怎么挨的打都不知道。

en: &86 Yeah! Do that!
&2235 No! Don't do that!
&102 I'm confused. What was all this about, then?
zh: &102 我糊涂了。那这一切是怎么回事？

en: &1530 You need to confess to Simon.
&1531 Whatever happens, the decision needs to be his.
zh: &1531 不管发生什么，决定必须由他来做。

en: &103 Simon?
&104 Yeah. I suppose he deserves to know.
&105 If I was in his shoes, I'd want to know.
zh: &105 如果我是他，我会想知道。

en: &1532 He's at the arena now. Where you should be, incidentally.
zh: &1532 他现在在竞技场。顺便说一句，你也该在那儿。

en: &106 Right. The arena.
&107 Thank you. Fia, was it?
&108 I'd better get going.
&109 And, um, see you soon Clara?
zh: &109 还有，呃，待会儿见，克拉拉？

en: &87 You'd better.
&88 Sooo about those things I said.
zh: &88 那个……关于我说的那些话。

en: &2236 Forget it. Water under the bridge, as they say.
zh: &2236 算了，就当是桥下的流水，过去就过去了。

en: &89 Forget water. How about a whiskey. On the house?
zh: &89 水就算了，来杯威士忌怎么样？我请客。

en: &2237 Maybe later.
&3219 We can talk about de-escalation.
zh: &3219 我们可以谈谈怎么缓和局面。

en: &2238 Yes. I was just leaving.
&110 No you're not.
&2239 Nowhere. Nowhere at all.
zh: &2239 哪儿也不去。我哪儿也不去。

en: &111 That's where you're wrong.
&112 Should have thought of that before you opened your mouth!
zh: &112 你开口之前就该想到这个！

en: &113 Ahhh!
&2240 Not this again.
&114 You make a habit of this?
&2241 You could say that.
&115 Well you're not walking away from this.
&2242 I know what comes next. Come on.
zh: &2242 我知道接下来会怎样。来吧。

en: &116 Er, huh?
&2243 We "marching back in there" or what?
zh: &2243 我们是要“再冲进去”还是怎样？

en: &117 Yeah!
&118 We're gonna march back into that bar and tell Clara there is no payoff.
zh: &118 我们要冲回酒吧，告诉克拉拉根本没有什么好处费。

en: &2244 I thought as much.
&119 Yeah! You better not say anything. It'll just be another lie.
zh: &119 对！你最好什么都别说。那只会是另一个谎言。

en: &2245 I can't do that.
&2246 Brian. Listen.
&120 I said move!
&3221 I intended to, but I suspect you're about to stop me.
zh: &3221 我本来打算去，但我猜你会拦住我。

en: &121 I- yeah! Yeah I am!
&3240 Just taking in the night air.
&122 Like hell you are. You're fleeing the scene.
zh: &122 鬼才信。你这是在逃离现场。

en: &3241 No. I'm going to march back into the bar and tell Clara that there is no payoff.
zh: &3241 不。我要冲回酒吧，告诉克拉拉根本没有什么好处费。

en: &123 Like hell you are! You- wait.
&3242 Let's go.
&2693 You have got to be kidding.
&102 Does it look like I'm kidding? Knock her block off, Brian!
zh: &102 我像在开玩笑吗？布赖恩，给她脑袋来一拳！

en: &103 Brian didn't pick this fight. You did.
zh: &103 布赖恩没想打这场架。是你挑起来的。

en: &127 Yeah... yeah!
&104 Don't stand for it, Brian! Hit her!
&105 Of course she does! She's begging for trouble.
zh: &105 她当然想挨揍！她就是在自找麻烦。

en: &106 Give the lady what she wants!
&2694 This is ridiculous!
&107 The only ridiculous thing is what's coming outta your mouth.
zh: &107 你说的那些话才叫荒唐。

en: &108 Go on, Brian. Shut it for her.
&2695 Maybe you should stop listening to what other people tell you?
zh: &2695 也许你不该再听别人指使了？

en: &2696 Try being your own man, for once!
&109 Now she's saying you're not a man, Brian!
zh: &109 她现在说你算不上男人，布赖恩！

en: &110 You gonna take that?
&128 What the...
&129 She's RIGHT.
&130 You can't get away with sayin' stuff like that!
zh: &130 敢说那种话，就别想轻易脱身！

en: Brian punches fia first time
zh: 布赖恩第一次挥拳打菲娅

en: &3331 Queensbury rules, is it?
&3332 Gotta love a fair fight.
&908 You're using time travel. He isn't.
zh: &908 你在用时间旅行。他没用。

en: &3333 Exactly.
&3334 From the top?
&2698 Blast it. He bolted the door. I'll never make it in time.
zh: &2698 该死。他把门闩上了。我肯定来不及了。

en: &112 No escape, lady.
&113 Don't matter who you are. You run your mouth here in the Five Points, you get what you deserve.
zh: &113 不管你是谁。在五点区乱说话，就得付出代价。

en: &114 Right, Brian?
&3335 Fine. There's was no payoff.
&131 Come ON. Like you MEAN IT.
&3336 I can't mean it if it isn't true.
zh: &3336 本来就是假的，我怎么说得像真话？

en: &3337 I told you. I'm a rubbish liar.
zh: &3337 我告诉过你。我撒谎很烂。

en: &3338 Just come clean. The truth is easier. Trust me.
zh: &3338 干脆坦白吧。说实话轻松多了，相信我。

en: &115 You gonna let this windbag go on like that, Brian?
zh: &115 你就让这个话痨这么一直说下去，布赖恩？

en: &116 Shut her up! Pop her one!
&132 Er. What?
&3339 Clara. There was a payoff, but Brian meant well.
zh: &3339 克拉拉。确实有好处费，但布赖恩是好意。

en: &117 Brian?
&133 There's no payoff!
&118 Why are you doing this?
&3340 Because there *was* a payoff. And Brian knows it.
zh: &3340 因为*确实有*好处费。布赖恩心里清楚。

en: &134 I don't know it. Clara, don't listen to her.
zh: &134 我不清楚。克拉拉，别听她的。

en: &3341 You're going to admit to it eventually, so let's skip all the pointless punching.
zh: &3341 反正你迟早会承认，咱们就省了这顿没意义的拳头吧。

en: &135 Are you saying I can't throw a punch?
&136 You think I'm a bad boxer?
zh: &136 你觉得我是个差劲的拳手？

en: &119 Ha! Show her a real boxer, Brian!
zh: &119 哈！让她看看真正的拳手，布赖恩！

en: &120 Well? Say something.
&3342 There's no point. This always plays out the same.
zh: &3342 没意义。每次结果都一样。

en: &121 Huh? You one of them fraud psychics?
&3343 No, no it's nothing like-
&122 That's it! She's claiming her psychic powers showed her a payoff that didn't exist!
zh: &122 我明白了！她说自己有灵能力，看到了根本不存在的好处费！

en: &137 Yeah. That's gotta be it!
&3344 Psychics. Really.
&138 Don't look at me like that!
&3345 Like what?
&139 Like I'm an idiot. I am not an idiot!
zh: &139 好像我是个白痴。我不是白痴！

en: &3346 I'm sorry. I am just frustrated, and it's giving me a headache!
zh: &3346 抱歉，我就是烦得不行，头都疼了！

en: &123 She's giving *me* a headache, Brian! Finish her!
zh: &123 她搞得*我*头疼，布赖恩！解决她！

en: &124 You gonna let her talk to you like that?
zh: &124 你就让她那样跟你说话？

en: &140 No. No of course not!
&125 That's what I'm talking about!
&3347 There's no point. Just skip to the part where you try and hit me.
zh: &3347 没用的，直接动手打我吧。

en: &126 Yeah! Hit her!
&141 Uh. I'd rather not?
&127 Come on. Do it!
&128 Give her what for, Brian!
zh: &128 给她点颜色看看，布赖恩！

en: &1330 We are looking for you, actually.
&60 Oh. I see.
&61 Ida warned me this might happen.
zh: &61 艾达警告过我可能会发生这种事。

en: &62 You know. Girls following me around.
zh: &62 就是那些跟在我后面的女孩啊。

en: &63 I'm flattered and all, but-
&2 Don't be such a lunkhead, Simon. They aren't here for THAT.
zh: &2 别犯傻了，西蒙。她们不是为了那个来的。

en: &64 They aren't?
&1332 Yes. We are lost. Could you tell us where we are?
zh: &1332 是的。我们迷路了。你能告诉我们这是哪儿吗？

en: &65 About halfway between the Hudson and Bloomington. Where're you headed?
zh: &65 大约在哈德逊和布卢明顿中间。你们要去哪儿？

en: &231 Nouveau Broadway? I mean Broad Street. Anywhere on the Money Mile...
zh: &231 新百老汇？我是说宽街。金融大道上哪儿都行……

en: &6201 Not for a hundred and seventy years we're not.
zh: &6201 再过一百七十年才是呢。

en: &3 You're such a lunkhead, Simon. She's obviously lying.
zh: &3 你真是个呆子，西蒙。她明显在撒谎。

en: &66 She is?
&1334 We are just... out for a walk.
&67 A walk? You're pretty far from anywhere.
zh: &67 散步？这附近可没什么地方能去。

en: &68 You can't be sure about that. Walking is good for you.
zh: &68 这可说不准。走路对身体好。

en: &4 They're from the Commissioner's office. Gotta be.
zh: &4 肯定是委员会办公室派来的。

en: &5 Come to pester us about moving again.
&6 Nobody else has a reason to come here. Not these days.
zh: &6 如今除了他们，谁会特地跑来这里？

en: &69 Hm. Could be.
&70 So. Is my sister right? You two from the Commissioner's office?
zh: &70 我妹妹说得对吗？你们俩是委员会办公室的？

en: &1335 You're moving?
&1336 This is your sister?
&1337 What does the Commissioner's office want with you?
zh: &1337 委员会办公室找你们做什么？

en: &71 See? They don't know a thing about us.
zh: &71 看吧？她们根本不了解我们的事。

en: &72 And besides, they wouldn't send two women all this way by themselves.
zh: &72 再说了，他们不会让两个女人自己跑这么远。

en: &73 That's low even for them.
zh: &73 那也太下作了，连他们都做不出来。

en: &7 Nothing's too low for them.
zh: &7 对他们来说，没什么是太下作的。

en: &74 Hm. It doesn't matter anyway.
&75 Whatever you two want, make it quick.
zh: &75 不管你们想干什么，快点说。

en: &76 I'm heading out soon.
&1338 You said you were moving?
&8 We're not moving.
&77 Ignore her.
&78 Course we're moving. We don't exactly have a choice.
zh: &78 我们当然要搬。我们没得选。

en: &79 There's no stopping the Gridiron project. No matter how much we wish otherwise.
zh: &79 棋盘街网规划停不下来。不管我们多不情愿。

en: &1339 The Gridiron project. That's... the Commissioners' Plan of 1811?
zh: &1339 棋盘街网规划。那是……1811年的委员会计划？

en: &80 Seems about right.
&81 The city's gotta have their criss-crossy streets. Homes like ours just get in the way.
zh: &81 市政府要修横七竖八的街道。我们这样的房子只会碍事。

en: &82 Took sixty years for them to get to us, but it's our turn on the chopping block now.
zh: &82 他们花了六十年才拆到这里，这下轮到我们倒霉了。

en: &9 Only because you won't fight it.
&83 They use DYNAMITE, Paula.
&84 You wanna fight dynamite?
&10 Yes!
&1340 Where are you going to go?
&85 I got us a place. We'll be fine.
zh: &85 我找了个地方。我们会没事的。

en: &11 It's a rat-hole.
&86 Paula!
&12 There's not a single tree on that block.
zh: &12 那个街区一棵树都没有。

en: &13 And it stinks of rotten fish.
&87 Eh. You get used to it.
&1341 This child is your sister?
&14 Who're you calling a child? I'm almost twelve.
zh: &14 你叫谁孩子？我都快十二岁了。

en: &88 Twelve going on thirty.
zh: &88 才十二岁，倒像个三十岁的。

en: &15 Better than nineteen going on seven, like you.
zh: &15 总比你十九岁还像个七岁的强。

en: &89 Maybe YOU should fight Brian Mason tonight.
zh: &89 也许今晚你该去跟布赖恩·梅森打。

en: &16 Maybe you should fight for our house.
zh: &16 那你倒是争一争，把咱们的房子保住啊。

en: &600 *Sigh*
&1342 Can anything be done to save your house?
zh: &1342 有什么办法能保住你们的房子吗？

en: &90 Even if there was, too late now.
&91 Our parents accepted the city's money, and that money's long gone.
zh: &91 我们的父母收了市里的钱，那笔钱早就没了。

en: &92 Gone to pay a list of debts as long as my arm.
zh: &92 全拿去还债了，债单长得跟我胳膊一样。

en: &93 So thanks for that, Dad.
&1343 Looking forward to the big fight tonight?
&94 So you ARE fans. I'm ready. More than ready.
zh: &94 这么说，你们还真是拳迷。我早就准备好了。

en: &95 I have to be.
&1344 I've come to warn you.
&96 Warn me? What about?
&1345 Where are you moving to?
&97 I don't see how that's any of your business.
zh: &97 我看不出这跟你有什么关系。

en: &98 And it's just temporary anyway. After tonight, everything gets better.
zh: &98 反正只是暂时的。过了今晚，一切都会好起来。

en: &1346 Are you familiar with the Breakdown Boys?
&99 Are they that temperance band? Songs so bad, they drive you to drink.
zh: &99 是那个禁酒乐队吗？歌烂得让人只想喝酒。

en: &1347 They're a gang of criminals. They operate near the seaport.
zh: &1347 他们是一伙罪犯。在海港附近活动。

en: &100 I go to the seaport for work almost every day.
zh: &100 我几乎每天都要去海港上班。

en: &101 And I'm telling you that I don't know what you're talking about.
zh: &101 我告诉你，我不知道你在说什么。

en: &1348 You claim you don't know who the Breakdown Boys are.
zh: &1348 你声称不知道“破坏男孩”是谁。

en: &1349 But they certainly seem to know you.
&102 What do you mean?
&1350 There is a photo of your family hanging inside the home of their alleged leader.
zh: &1350 据说他们头目家里挂着一张你们家的照片。

en: &103 Their home? Where?
&1351 A flat above Badger's Fish Market.
zh: &1351 獾鱼市楼上的一间公寓。

en: &104 Hold on. You're talking about Uncle Eddie's place?
zh: &104 等等。你说的是埃迪叔叔家？

en: &106 You hearing this, Paula? They think Uncle Eddie's a gang leader.
zh: &106 你听到了吗，葆拉？他们以为埃迪叔叔是帮派头目。

en: &1352 Your uncle IS a gang leader. Only nobody can prove it. Yet.
zh: &1352 你叔叔就是帮派头目。只是没人能证明。暂时还不能。

en: &107 But you can?
&1353 No. Not in a manner you would believe.
zh: &1353 不能。没法用你会相信的方式证明。

en: &1354 Your uncle tried to kill me.
&108 He did? How?
zh: &108 他真动手了？怎么下手的？

en: &1355 He threw a cleaver at my head!
zh: &1355 他朝我脑袋扔了把切肉刀！

en: &109 If he missed, that means he likes you.
zh: &109 他要是没扔中，说明他喜欢你。

en: &1356 The feeling's mutual.
&1357 Just how well do you know your uncle?
zh: &1357 你对你叔叔到底了解多少？

en: &110 Enough to know he's not a gang leader. That's nutty talk.
zh: &110 至少我知道他不是帮派头目。那简直是胡说八道。

en: &111 Look. I know my uncle can be a bit... intimidating. He's had a rough life.
zh: &111 听着。我知道我叔叔有时候有点……吓人。他这辈子过得很苦。

en: &112 But he's my family. I know him. He wouldn't hurt a fly.
zh: &112 但他是我家人。我了解他。他连只苍蝇都不会伤害。

en: &17 That's because no fly'll come near him. He stinks of fish guts.
zh: &17 那是因为没有苍蝇敢靠近他。他浑身都是鱼内脏的臭味。

en: &113 Be nice, Paula. We'd be homeless without him.
zh: &113 葆拉，别这样。没有他我们就无家可归了。

en: &1358 Homeless?
&114 He's letting us stay with him until we get back on our feet.
zh: &114 他让我们住在他那儿，直到我们重新站稳脚跟。

en: &115 Would a gang leader do that? Go out of his way to help Paula and me?
zh: &115 帮派头目会这么做？特地帮我和葆拉？

en: &1359 Gangs are notorious for looking after their families, and brutalizing everyone else.
zh: &1359 帮派的人出了名地护着自家人，却对外人下狠手。

en: &116 Oh yeah? Like how?
&1360 I won't disagree, but the fact remains.
zh: &1360 我不否认，但事实就是事实。

en: &117 What exactly are you trying to tell me?
&1361 He has an ulterior motive.
&118 Like what?
&1362 I believe your uncle wants to bring you into the fold.
zh: &1362 我相信你叔叔想拉你入伙。

en: &119 To run the fish market? That's fine.
&120 If I lose the match tonight, I could use the work.
zh: &120 我要是今晚输了，正好需要这份活计。

en: &121 The oyster stall is okay, but it's not exactly "buy a new home" money.
zh: &121 牡蛎摊还行，但那点钱可不够“买新房”。

en: &1363 No. He plans on turning you into a criminal. Like him.
zh: &1363 不。他打算把你变成罪犯。像他一样。

en: &122 That's a load of beans and you know it.
zh: &122 那是一派胡言，你自己心里清楚。

en: &123 Uncle Eddie's always been good to us.
zh: &123 埃迪叔叔一直对我们很好。

en: &124 He built a treehouse for Paula and me when we were kids.
zh: &124 我们小时候，他给我和葆拉盖了个树屋。

en: &18 The treehouse? I forgot about the treehouse!
zh: &18 树屋？我都忘了那个树屋！

en: &19 Is that gonna get blown up too?
&125 Damn it. Now you've gone and upset Paula.
zh: &125 该死。现在你把葆拉惹不高兴了。

en: &126 I can't deal with this. I need to FOCUS. Tonight's too important.
zh: &126 我没法应付这些。我得集中精神。今晚太重要了。

en: &127 I want you to leave. Now.
&1364 We'll be going now.
&128 Mm hmm.
&1365 You shouldn't fight tonight.
&129 Hah. Like that's gonna happen.
&1366 You don't understand. Something is going to happen.
zh: &1366 你不明白。会有事情发生。

en: &1367 I am not sure what. But whatever it is, it will change you.
zh: &1367 我不确定是什么。但不管是什么，它都会改变你。

en: &1368 You need to make sure that it doesn't.
&130 You're not making a whole lot of sense, but I can't skip the fight. No way.
zh: &130 你说的我不太明白，可我不能不去比赛，绝对不行。

en: &131 I need that prize money. It's the only way to turn things around.
zh: &131 我需要那笔奖金。这是扭转局面的唯一办法。

en: &1369 Do you have anyone you can talk to?
&132 About what?
&1370 About... depression? Anxiety. Stress. That kind of thing.
zh: &1370 倾诉……抑郁？焦虑。压力。那类事情。

en: &133 Don't see why I need to do that.
zh: &133 我不明白为什么需要那样做。

en: &134 Sure, we've got a lot going on, but we're handling it.
zh: &134 当然，我们有很多事要处理，但我们应付得来。

en: &135 We're fine. Me and Paula. We're gonna be fine.
zh: &135 我们没事。我和葆拉。我们会没事的。

en: &1371 I am afraid you are not going to be fine.
zh: &1371 恐怕事情没你想的那么好。

en: &1372 The pressure will get to you. You need to get ahead of it.
zh: &1372 压力会压垮你的。你得提前应对。

en: &136 I said, I can handle it.
&137 Whatever happens, we'll make do.
zh: &137 不管发生什么，我们都能凑合过去。

en: &1373 Whatever happens... don't turn to crime. Please.
zh: &1373 不管发生什么……别走上犯罪的路。求你了。

en: &138 Um. Wasn't planning on it, but thanks for the warning?
zh: &138 呃。本来没这个打算，不过谢谢你的警告？

en: &232 You need to take this seriously. That is a path that will lead nowhere good. Not for you. Not for Paula.
zh: &232 这事你得当真。走上那条路，不管是你还是葆拉，都不会有好下场。

en: &139 OK. You made your point.
&1375 Never mind. Forget it.
&140 Okay then.
&1376 Simon. Please. You need to listen.
zh: &1376 西蒙。求你了。你得听我说。

en: &20 You're the one who's not listening!
zh: &20 你才是那个不听人说话的人！

en: &1377 You're going to die, Simon.
&233 She's right. In six months, you are going to stand right there and shoot yourself in the head.
zh: &233 她说得对。六个月后，你会站在那里，朝自己脑袋开一枪。

en: &141 WHAT?
&21 Okay. Enough!
&1379 Paula? Can you help him see reason?
zh: &1379 葆拉，你能帮忙劝劝他吗？

en: &1380 Please?
&22 There's only one person here who's acting unreasonable, and it's not someone named Inman.
zh: &22 这里只有一个人在无理取闹，而且那个人不姓英曼。

en: &23 My brother asked you nicely to leave. I'm not as nice as he is.
zh: &23 我哥哥客客气气地请你们离开。我可没他那么好说话。

en: &24 The city may be blowing this place to blazes next week, but until then it's still our property.
zh: &24 市政府下周也许会把这里炸成废墟，可在那之前，这还是我们的地盘。

en: &25 So with all due respect, get the hell off it.
zh: &25 所以恕我直言，赶紧滚出去。

en: &142 You heard the lady.
&1382 Very well.
&1383 And... I'm sorry.
&235 You're just... giving up?
&1384 Changing tack. Let's go.
&1385 You're a smart kid.
&27 Between Simon and me, there's only one kid. And it's not me.
zh: &27 我和西蒙里头只有一个孩子，反正不是我。

en: &1386 Your brother doesn't think it's strange.
zh: &1386 你哥哥不觉得这很奇怪。

en: &28 My brother doesn't think at all if he can help it.
zh: &28 我哥哥能不动脑子就不动脑子。

en: &1387 What do YOU think?
&29 I think my brother's an idiot for not throwing you off our land.
zh: &29 我觉得我哥是个白痴，居然没把你从我们的地盘上赶走。

en: &30 Don't take advantage of him. I'm watching you.
zh: &30 别想占他便宜。我盯着你呢。

en: &1388 You don't think much of your brother.
&31 You watch your mouth.
&32 He's a muttonhead, but I'm all he's got.
zh: &32 他是个蠢货，但我是他唯一的依靠。

en: &33 If I don't stick up for him, nobody will.
zh: &33 如果我不护着他，就没人会了。

en: &1389 You looking forward to seeing your brother fight tonight?
zh: &1389 你期待今晚看你哥比赛吗？

en: &34 I look forward to hearing about it.
&1390 You're not going?
&35 I don't like the city.
&36 Too noisy. Too crowded. Smells terrible.
zh: &36 太吵了。太挤了。味道难闻。

en: &37 I'm fine here.
&1391 You don't want to move, I take it?
&38 No. My parents lived here. My grandparents lived here.
zh: &38 不想。我父母住过这里。我祖父母也住过这里。

en: &39 They all knew this was coming, but none of them had to be alive to see it happen.
zh: &39 他们都知道早晚会有这一天，却谁也不必活着看它真的发生。

en: &40 It's not fair.
&1392 I'm sorry to hear about your house.
zh: &1392 听说你家的事，我很遗憾。

en: &41 Can you do anything about it?
&1393 No. The Gridiron project is ranked too highly to change.
zh: &1393 不能。棋盘街网规划的评级太高，无法改变。

en: &1394 It's... out of my hands.
&43 You sound like my brother.
&44 You two should get married and have a bunch of spineless kids.
zh: &44 你俩应该结婚，生一堆没骨气的孩子。

en: &1396 I'm trying to find Simon Inman.
&1397 I understand he works for you.
&74 Simon? Yeah. Customers love him. Keen worker.
zh: &74 西蒙？是啊。顾客都喜欢他。干活勤快。

en: &75 Why're you so interested? You sweet on him?
zh: &75 你怎么对他这么感兴趣？你看上他了？

en: &1398 Oh. Nothing like that. No.
&76 Hm. Shame.
&77 He's been through a lot. He deserves a nice girl.
zh: &77 他吃了那么多苦，身边该有个好姑娘。

en: &1399 What's he been through?
&78 Oh listen to me running my mouth.
&79 That's... that's his business. I'm just glad I was able to help him out.
zh: &79 那……那是他的私事。我只是很高兴能帮上他。

en: &1400 So you'd say that Simon is a good worker.
&80 Very good. I hope you aren't trying to poach him from me!
zh: &80 非常好。我希望你不是想从我这儿挖走他！

en: &236 Absolutely not.
&81 I'd understand why if you did.
zh: &81 如果你挖他，我也能理解。

en: &82 He's pretty easy to like, isn't he? Charming as hell.
zh: &82 他很容易让人喜欢，不是吗？迷人得要命。

en: &1401 Charming?
&83 Never met anyone more eager to please. Sometimes a little too eager.
zh: &83 没见过比他更想让别人满意的，有时候都过头了。

en: &1402 Simon Inman... eager to please? Simon the boxer?
zh: &1402 西蒙·英曼……这么想让别人满意？你说的是拳击手西蒙？

en: &84 That's him! He'd give away half of these oysters if I let him!
zh: &84 就是他！要是我允许，他能把这些牡蛎送掉一半！

en: &85 But he's such a doll, even the chiselers down at the seaport always give him a deal.
zh: &85 可他就是招人喜欢，连海港的奸商都肯给他便宜点。

en: &86 I don't know how he does it.
zh: &86 我不知道他是怎么做到的。

en: &87 Not that I complain. Simon saves me a bundle.
zh: &87 我可没抱怨，西蒙帮我省了不少钱呢。

en: &1403 Are you attending the fight tonight? To cheer Simon on?
zh: &1403 你今晚会去看比赛吗？为西蒙加油？

en: &88 I wish I could. But without Simon to sell the oysters, I have to mind the stand. But I'll be holding him in my heart.
zh: &88 我倒是想去。但西蒙不在，我得照看摊子。不过我会在心里支持他。

en: &89 Speaking of, you want any?
&1404 Good bye. Thanks for the chat.
&90 You take care!
&1493 Should you really be drinking?
&50 I don't see why not.
&250 You're in a match tonight! For the citywide championship!
zh: &250 你今晚有比赛！全市冠军赛！

en: &1494 Aren't you in a match tonight? For the citywide championship?
zh: &1494 你今晚不是有比赛吗？全市冠军赛？

en: &51 Yep! That's why I'm here. Gotta loosen up.
zh: &51 没错！所以我才来这儿。得放松一下。

en: &251 Brian. That's not how it works.
&1495 Is that how it works?
&52 It's how it works for me. Especially tonight.
zh: &52 对我来说就是这样。尤其是今晚。

en: &53 I don't think I'll be able to get in the ring without it.
zh: &53 不喝点我恐怕上不了拳台。

en: &1496 Do you know anything about your opponent? Simon Inman?
zh: &1496 你了解你的对手吗？西蒙·英曼？

en: &54 Just that he needs all the help he can get.
zh: &54 就知道能帮他的都得帮一把。

en: &252 What sort of help?
&1497 I'm not sure I follow.
&55 Just what I said. He'll need all the help he can get.
zh: &55 就是这意思，能帮他的都得帮一把。

en: &1498 I don't think you should fight tonight.
zh: &1498 我觉得你今晚不该比赛。

en: &56 Hah. Nope. Ida would kill me.
&1499 No. Something is going to happen.
&1500 I am unsure what, but it will lead to something tragic.
zh: &1500 我不确定是什么，但会导致悲剧。

en: &57 Pff. We've all been through something tragic.
&58 Everything around us is a tragedy.
zh: &58 我们周围的一切都是悲剧。

en: &59 Just a tragedy. That's all this is.
Sorry not sorry.
&6193 I don't understand.
&60 I'm getting in the ring tonight. Whether I want to or not.
zh: &60 我今晚要上拳台。不管我想不想。

en: &1501 You don't want to fight?
&61 Who said that?
&1502 You did. You said you had to fight "whether I want to or not."
zh: &1502 你说的。你说你必须打，“不管我想不想。”

en: &62 Doesn't mean I don't want to.
&63 Just that I have to.
&253 That doesn't make much sense.
&1503 That... doesn't make much sense.
&64 YOU don't make much sense.
&603 What?
&6194 What?
&65 Nothing. Look, I'm fighting tonight. End of story.
zh: &65 没什么。听着，我今晚要打比赛。就这样。

en: &1504 Don't you think you've had enough?
zh: &1504 你不觉得你已经喝得够多了吗？

en: &66 Dunno. They don't pay me to think.
zh: &66 不知道，人家给钱又不是让我动脑子的。

en: &67 So I don't.
&1505 I know about the payoff, Brian.
zh: &1505 我知道好处费的事，布赖恩。

en: &68 Don't know what you're talking about.
&1506 The fight tonight.
&1507 Ida told you to lose the match on purpose, didn't she?
zh: &1507 艾达让你故意输掉比赛，是不是？

en: &69 No. No! That's a filthy lie.
&74 Yeah! Brian could never do that.
zh: &74 是啊！布赖恩绝不会做那种事。

en: &1508 That's why you're drinking, isn't it?
&1509 You have no intention of winning.
&70 That's a lie!
&1510 I wish it was. But you know it's not.
zh: &1510 我也希望是。但你知道不是。

en: &71 Don't listen to her, Clara! You know there's no way!
zh: &71 别听她的，克拉拉！你知道绝不可能！

en: &72 She's a goddamn liar!
&75 How dare you.
&76 How dare you come into my bar throwing accusations like that around.
zh: &76 你竟敢闯进我的酒吧，这样乱泼脏水。

en: &77 My Brian would never do something so... so... pathetic.
zh: &77 我的布赖恩绝不会做那么……那么……可悲的事。

en: &2229 I'm sorry, but it's the truth.
&78 Truth? How's this for truth.
zh: &78 事实？那我就让你看看事实。

en: &79 Get the hell out of my tavern!
&2230 All right. I'm leaving.
&6195 Does this ledger mean anything to you?
&73 Um. Should it?
&74 I'll leave the numbers stuff to people smarter than me.
zh: &74 算账的事还是交给比我聪明的人吧。

en: &75 I don't work with gangs.
&6196 I never said you did.
&76 Good. Then we have nothing to talk about.
zh: &76 好。那我们没什么好谈的了。

en: &1511 We're going to leave now, Brian.
zh: &1511 我们现在要走了，布赖恩。

en: &1512 I'm going to leave now, Brian.
&77 I'll see you at the match tonight.
&1536 Not exactly. You told us to leave your property. This place is Ida's.
zh: &1536 不完全是。你让我们离开你的地盘。这地方是艾达的。

en: &144 You know what I meant.
&1537 Perhaps. But this is important.
&1538 You can't get rid of us that easily.
zh: &1538 你可没那么容易甩掉我们。

en: &1539 You can't get rid of me that easily.
zh: &1539 你可没那么容易甩掉我。

en: &145 You think this is funny?
&1540 No. This isn't funny at all. This is important.
zh: &1540 不，这一点都不好笑。这很重要。

en: &1541 We need to talk, Simon.
&146 Even if I wanted to, I'm a little busy right now.
zh: &146 就算我想，我现在也有点忙。

en: &1542 I know, but this is important.
&147 This MATCH is important.
&148 So whatever you're after, it can wait.
zh: &148 所以不管你来找我干什么，都可以等等。

en: &1543 Your uncle is a dangerous man.
&149 Haven't we been over this?
zh: &149 我们不是已经谈过这个了吗？

en: &150 Leave my family alone.
&1544 Your sister is in danger.
&151 Paula can take care of herself.
&1545 Not tonight she can't.
zh: &1545 今晚她可照顾不了自己。

en: &1546 She's in the woods right now. Something is going to happen to her.
zh: &1546 她现在就在树林里，会出事的。

en: &1547 It may have already happened.
&152 Paula's in the woods? Oh no. What a surprise.
zh: &152 葆拉在树林里？哦不。真是意外。

en: &1548 You're not taking this seriously.
&1549 Paula is going to die! In the woods. Tonight!
zh: &1549 葆拉会死的！在树林里。就在今晚！

en: &153 You don't know Paula.
&154 She's been running around those woods since she was two.
zh: &154 她从两岁起就在那片林子里到处跑了。

en: &155 Nobody knows those trees better than her. She loves that place.
zh: &155 没人比她更熟悉那些树。她爱那个地方。

en: &156 And it's all gonna be blown up next week. So if she wants to go out there? Let her.
zh: &156 而且下周那里就要被炸掉了。所以她想出去？随她吧。

en: &157 I won't begrudge her that. And you shouldn't either.
zh: &157 我不会拦着她，你也不该拦。

en: &1550 We need your help to find Paula.
zh: &1550 我们需要你帮忙找到葆拉。

en: &1551 She's in the woods somewhere. I don't know my way around.
zh: &1551 她就在树林里某个地方。我不认识路。

en: &158 I told you. She's FINE.
&255 And we're telling you, she's not.
zh: &255 而我们在告诉你，她有事。

en: &159 Enough.
&160 You two have been trying to get me to skip this match all night.
zh: &160 你们俩一整晚都想让我不去比赛。

en: &161 And that's not going to happen. Understand?
&162 So stop trying.
&1552 I am sorry to be the one to tell you this, but...
zh: &1552 很抱歉要由我来告诉你这件事，但是……

en: &1553 Your uncle has paid off Brian Mason. He's going to let you win.
zh: &1553 你叔叔买通了布赖恩·梅森。他会让你赢的。

en: &164 Saints above. You don't stop, do you?
zh: &164 老天在上。你们还真是没完没了，是吧？

en: &1554 You don't believe me.
&165 No. I don't. My uncle wouldn't do that.
zh: &165 不，我不信。我叔叔不会那么做的。

en: &1555 Rest assured, he would. And has.
zh: &1555 我可以保证，他会，而且已经做了。

en: &166 Just. Stop.
&1556 I have proof. See this ledger?
zh: &1556 我有证据。看到这本账簿了吗？

en: &167 What about it?
&1557 Your uncle gave a sizable amount of money to this arena.
zh: &1557 你叔叔给这个竞技场付了一大笔钱。

en: &168 So? Lots of people give money to this place. They love boxing.
zh: &168 所以呢？很多人都给这里捐钱。他们热爱拳击。

en: &169 And besides, how do you know that book belongs to my uncle?
zh: &169 再说了，你怎么知道那本账簿是我叔叔的？

en: &1558 I am telling you the truth, Simon. Your uncle paid off Brian Mason.
zh: &1558 我说的是实话，西蒙。你叔叔收买了布赖恩·梅森。

en: &170 And like I said, I'm not inclined to believe you.
zh: &170 就像我说的，我不太相信你。

en: &171 So unless I hear it from either of them, I'm just gonna remain unconvinced.
zh: &171 所以除非我亲耳听到他们俩中任何一个人承认，否则我还是不会信。

en: &1559 Do you know if your uncle kept a ledger?
zh: &1559 你知道你叔叔有没有账本吗？

en: &172 I assume he does. Why?
&1560 Do you know where he might keep it?
zh: &1560 你知道他可能放在哪里吗？

en: &173 Of course not! What kind of question is that!
zh: &173 当然不知道！这算什么问题！

en: &174 You want to know his finances so badly, you ask him.
zh: &174 你这么想知道他的财务状况，自己去问他。

en: &1561 I have this ledger.
&175 So you do.
&1562 There are some payments here made out to the owner of this gym. Large ones.
zh: &1562 这里有几笔付给这家健身房老板的款项，数额很大。

en: &176 Payments for what?
&1563 I am not entirely sure yet.
&177 Then why are you bothering me with them?
zh: &177 那你为什么拿这些来烦我？

en: &1564 So do you believe me now?
&178 You think I care?
&1565 Looks like you beat Mason after all. Didn't need the bribe.
zh: &1565 看来你最终还是打败了梅森。根本不需要贿赂。

en: &179 You think that matters anymore?
&1566 You're not staying for the match?
&180 To hell with the match!
&181 Nothing matters anymore. I just gotta get home to Paula.
zh: &181 什么都不重要了。我只想回家找葆拉。

en: &1567 Paula's fine. She's safe now. Don't worry.
zh: &1567 葆拉没事。她现在安全了。别担心。

en: &182 Safe? Why wouldn't she be safe?
zh: &182 安全？她为什么会不安全？

en: &1568 She almost died in the woods.
&183 She... WHAT?
&184 You were telling the truth about that?
&185 Damn this. Damn ALL of this. I can't.
zh: &185 该死的。这一切都该死。我受不了了。

en: &186 I'm done. Just done.
&187 Out of my way. Now.
&1569 All right.
&1570 Good luck, Simon.
&188 Luck has nothing to do with this.
&1571 You're right. Luck has nothing to do with this.
zh: &1571 你说得对。运气跟这事没关系。

en: &1573 So, Nozzo. How's Simon's timeline looking?
zh: &1573 那么，诺佐。西蒙的时间线看起来怎么样？

en: &1574 Did we do it?
&328 Hm. It's fluctuating. Should stabilize in a minute.
zh: &328 嗯。它在波动。应该一分钟内会稳定下来。

en: &1575 Fluctuating? Why?
&329 Simon's emotional. Acting irrational.
zh: &329 西蒙情绪激动。行为不理智。

en: &330 He keeps changing his mind about what he's going to do.
zh: &330 他不断改变主意，拿不定自己接下来要做什么。

en: &1576 But he lives, right?
&1577 Please tell me he lives.
&331 Stabilizing... now.
&1578 What? What happens?
&333 Tomorrow morning, Simon's dead body is found in the woods by his house.
zh: &333 明天早上，西蒙的尸体在他家附近的树林里被发现。

en: &1579 What? How?
&334 Doesn't say.
&1580 Of course it doesn't.
&1581 I'm beginning to think Simon's doomed whatever we do.
zh: &1581 我开始觉得不管我们怎么做，西蒙都难逃一死。

en: &335 You believe in fate suddenly? You're starting to sound like our client.
zh: &335 怎么突然信起命了？你说话都开始像我们的客户了。

en: &1582 Maybe she's right. Maybe fate does exist.
zh: &1582 也许她是对的。也许命运确实存在。

en: &336 If it does, are you going to let it beat us?
zh: &336 如果存在，你打算让它打败我们吗？

en: &3243 Put it that way, I suppose we can give it one more try.
zh: &3243 这么说的话，我想我们可以再试一次。

en: &897 There we go. If it's between us and fate, my money is on us.
zh: &897 这就对了。如果要在我们和命运之间选，我押我们赢。

en: &337 Get up to his house. Before whatever happened, happens.
zh: &337 快去他家，趁那件事还没发生。

en: &3244 Paula nearly died in the woods tonight.
zh: &3244 葆拉今晚差点死在树林里。

en: &189 She's had more close calls out there than I can count.
zh: &189 她在外面遇到的险情多得数不清。

en: &190 But don't worry. She's been running around those woods since she was two.
zh: &190 不过别担心。她从两岁起就在那片树林里跑来跑去了。

en: &3245 That's not what I mean.
&191 She's fine, isn't she?
&3246 She's fine NOW, yes.
&192 Then there's nothing to worry about. Can you leave me alone?
zh: &192 那就没什么好担心的。你能让我一个人待会儿吗？

en: &1583 I have to go, but we'll talk later.
zh: &1583 我得走了，但我们晚点再谈。

en: &193 I can't exactly stop you.
&1584 It's a funny story actually...
&194 Nothing about this is funny.
&1585 I found the ledger in his bedroom.
zh: &1585 我在他卧室里找到了账本。

en: &195 His bedroom? What were you doing there?
zh: &195 他卧室？你去那儿干什么？

en: &196 Are you and him...?
&1586 No! God no.
&197 Then why were you there?
&1587 It's... hard to explain.
&198 Good. Because I don't believe you anyway.
&1588 You are just going to have to trust me on this.
zh: &1588 这件事你只能相信我了。

en: &199 Begging your pardon, but I must decline.
&1589 I am telling the truth.
&200 Well, unless I hear it straight from either of them, I'm just gonna remain unconvinced
zh: &200 好吧，除非我亲耳听到他们俩任何一个人说，否则我还是不信。

en: &201 Now leave me alone. You got me all tense. Need to warm up all over again.
zh: &201 别烦我了，你搞得我浑身紧绷，又得从头热身。

en: &343 I'd love to explain, but we don't have the time.
zh: &343 我很想解释，但我们没时间了。

en: &344 The timeline's in flux right now.
&345 Chloe. I need you to listen to me carefully.
zh: &345 克洛伊。我需要你仔细听我说。

en: &346 Eddie is about to kill the both of you.
zh: &346 埃迪马上就要杀了你们俩。

en: &274 I knew it. The guy is steaming.
zh: &274 我就知道。那家伙气坏了。

en: &275 So is Fia coming to save us or what?
&347 Yes, but she's several minutes away. I need you to stall them until she gets here.
zh: &347 会，但她还要几分钟才能到。我需要你拖住他们，直到她赶到。

en: &348 Talk to them.
&277 And say what?
&278 Hey! Can I say something?
&60 Stay out of this, lady.
&279 Look. Eddie. Can I call you Eddie?
zh: &279 听着。埃迪。我能叫你埃迪吗？

en: &280 Whatever. Look. This is all my fault. Really.
zh: &280 随便吧。听着。这都是我的错。真的。

en: &281 Simon won that fight. He did work for you.
zh: &281 西蒙赢了那场比赛，也给你干了活。

en: &282 Or rather, he will. He's supposed to.
zh: &282 或者说，他将来会的。他本该如此。

en: &213 What?
&283 Er. Let me start that over.
&62 I heard you fine. You think I want this coward by my side? After what he just did?
zh: &62 我听清楚了。他刚才干出那种事，你觉得我还想要这个懦夫留在身边？

en: &284 Whatever. I just think we should all calm down before we do something we regret.
zh: &284 随便吧。我只是觉得我们都该冷静下来，免得做出让自己后悔的事。

en: &63 Regret's got nothing to do with this.
&285 Whatever. This isn't right. You know it.
zh: &285 随你怎么说。这样做不对，你心里清楚。

en: &64 Right and wrong's got nothing to do with this.
&286 Simon? Eddie wants you to be his successor. That's why he rigged the fight.
zh: &286 西蒙，埃迪想让你接班，所以才操纵了那场比赛。

en: &65 Huh. You're well-informed.
&202 I don't understand...
&66 I'm getting old, Simon. Need someone to take my place in a few years.
zh: &66 我老了，西蒙。过几年得有人接我的班。

en: &67 I wanted it to be you. But that replacement can't be a loser.
zh: &67 我本来想让你来。但接班人不能是个输家。

en: &287 This is getting real ugly real fast. Where's Fia?
zh: &287 这事恶化得也太快了。菲娅在哪儿？

en: &350 Almost there. Promise.
&351 Try telling him...
&68 It's about respect. And this kid's LACK of it.
zh: &68 我要的是尊重，可这小子压根不把我放在眼里。

en: &69 Here's what's gonna happen, Simon.
&70 We're gonna get on my horse and ride like blazes. You can still make the match.
zh: &70 我们骑上我的马，拼命赶过去。你还能赶上比赛。

en: &204 I'm not going anywhere with you.
&205 Paula almost DIED tonight because I wasn't here.
zh: &205 葆拉今晚差点死了，因为我没在这儿。

en: &71 She seems fine now. So let's go.
zh: &71 她现在看起来没事了。我们走吧。

en: &72 Simon. Do what I say.
&288 Neither of them are budging. Where is Fia? She can swoop in to save the day any second now.
zh: &288 他们俩谁也不让步。菲娅在哪儿？她也该冲过来救场了吧。

en: &352 She's running as fast as she can!
&289 Can you blame him, really?
&290 You're the one who's showing disrespect, here.
zh: &290 不把别人当回事的可是你。

en: &291 This is more your fault than his.
zh: &291 这事怪你更多，别光怪他。

en: &292 I'd be angry as hell if I was in his shoes.
zh: &292 我要是他，也会气得要命。

en: &207 Angry? I'm beyond angry.
&208 Why ruin me like this, Uncle?
zh: &208 为什么要这样毁了我，叔叔？

en: &73 Ruin you? I was SAVING you.
&74 You needed to be a champion. You needed that head start.
zh: &74 你得当上冠军，起步就得领先别人。

en: &209 Head start?
&75 For when you replace me.
&210 What?
&66 I'm getting old, Simon. Need someone to take my place in a few years.
zh: &66 我老了，西蒙。过几年需要有人接我的班。

en: &76 And that replacement can't be a loser.
zh: &76 接班人可不能是个输家。

en: &353 Almost there.
&354 Tell him...
&293 Hey! You know how many times I lost in the ring? More than I can count!
zh: &293 嘿！你知道我在拳台上输过多少次吗？数都数不清！

en: &294 It just makes you want to train harder and come back even stronger.
zh: &294 输了才更想苦练，下次上台就更强。

en: &77 You don't know my nephew like I do.
zh: &77 你不像我那么了解我侄子。

en: &295 YOU are the loser, Eddie.
&296 Respect is about trust. And you couldn't trust your own nephew.
zh: &296 尊重别人就该相信别人，可你连自己的侄子都不信。

en: &78 Trust goes both ways.
&297 Simon isn't a loser. He's trying to provide for himself and his sister as best he can.
zh: &297 西蒙不是输家，他已经拼命在养活自己和妹妹了。

en: &79 That best ain't good enough.
zh: &79 拼命也没用，他就是不够格。

en: &355 Tell him he'd make a good gang leader.
zh: &355 告诉他，他会是个好帮派头目。

en: &298 Tell him WHAT?
&356 Please. Trust me.
&299 Okaay...
&300 Simon? I think you'd make a great successor.
zh: &300 西蒙？我觉得你会是个很好的接班人。

en: &301 Your uncle doesn't know what he's talking about.
zh: &301 你叔叔不知道自己在说什么。

en: &212 I'd make a great what?
&302 A gang leader. Of the Breakdown Boys.
&213 You're kidding. I can't do that!
&80 For once, we agree.
zh: &80 就这一次，我们意见一致。

en: &81 You think this weakling could lead the Boys?
zh: &81 你觉得这个软蛋能带领那帮小子？

en: &82 I seen him grow up. He doesn't have it in him.
zh: &82 我看着他长大。他没那个种。

en: &214 That's why you did it?
&215 So you wouldn't have a loser for a nephew?
zh: &215 就为了不让自己有个废物侄子？

en: &83 It was bad enough having a loser for a brother.
zh: &83 有个废物兄弟已经够糟了。

en: &216 My father was worth ten of you!
&84 He was a weak man, and he had a weak son.
zh: &84 他是个软弱的男人，生了个软弱的儿子。

en: &85 I see that now.
&217 So you're gonna kill me. Your own nephew.
zh: &217 所以你要杀了我。你的亲侄子。

en: &86 Gotta cut out the rot before it spreads.
zh: &86 烂肉得趁早剜掉，免得扩散。

en: &87 I never liked guns. Always thought they were a coward's weapon.
zh: &87 我从来不喜欢枪。总觉得那是懦夫的武器。

en: &88 But for you? Seems right.
&1606 Right! You! Stop!
&89 Eh? Who the hell?
&1607 Take THIS!
&2248 Hang on. That's never happened before...
&15 Blast it.
&90 Saints above, I'm surrounded by idiots.
zh: &90 老天在上，我周围全是白痴。

en: &79 Activating ERP.
&1608 Why is Eddie Inman ranked "medium", anyway?
zh: &1608 话说回来，埃迪·英曼为什么被评为“中等”？

en: &1609 Is he really that important?
&357 Good question. Let me bring up his ranking report...
zh: &357 问得好。让我调出他的评级报告……

en: &358 Blast it. It's so hard to read these things. It's all done by algorithms. No human touch at all.
zh: &358 该死，这报告太难看懂了。全是算法生成的，根本没人整理过。

en: &1610 Can you read it or not?
&359 Eventually. I'd need several hours to analyze this fully, but it appears his ranking is linked directly to the Breakdown Boys gang.
zh: &359 花点时间能。完整分析得要几个小时，不过看起来，他的评级跟“破坏男孩”帮直接挂钩。

en: &1611 So the GANG is important, which makes Eddie important?
zh: &1611 所以是帮派重要，才让埃迪重要？

en: &360 They are one and the same, as far as the ranking is concerned.
zh: &360 就评级而言，他们是一体的。

en: &361 Eddie leads the gang. The gang needs to exist. Therefore, Eddie needs to exist in order to lead the gang.
zh: &361 埃迪领导帮派。帮派必须存在。因此，埃迪必须存在才能领导帮派。

en: &1612 What if, hypothetically, the gang had a different leader?
zh: &1612 假设帮派换了个头目呢？

en: &362 What, hypothetically, are you suggesting?
zh: &362 那你这是在“假设”什么呢？

en: &1613 Nothing. Yet.
&1614 Why are the Breakdown Boys so important?
zh: &1614 为什么“破坏男孩”这么重要？

en: &363 Like I said, I'll need several hours to analyze the ranking report, but best guess?
zh: &363 我说了，分析评级报告得花几个小时，不过要我猜的话……

en: &364 In the 1870s, the local gangs had a lot of political pull. Most of them worked hand in hand with city hall.
zh: &364 在1870年代，本地帮派有很大的政治影响力。他们大多与市政厅勾结。

en: &365 Removing one gang could potentially change the political landscape of that era.
zh: &365 除掉一个帮派可能会改变那个时代的政治格局。

en: &1615 Can you override the protocol in an emergency like this?
zh: &1615 遇到这种紧急情况，就不能破例吗？

en: &366 I don't think the brass would consider this an emergency.
zh: &366 我觉得公司高层不会认为这是紧急情况。

en: &1616 Of course they wouldn't.
&1617 "The rankings must take precedence!" blah blah blah
zh: &1617 “评级必须优先！”翻来覆去就那几句。

en: &367 You remember the training manual.
&1618 Considering how often my brains have been blown out today, I'm surprised I remember anything at all.
zh: &1618 今天脑袋都被打爆这么多次了，我居然还能记住东西，真够难得的。

en: &2249 Do you have to bring me back this far?
zh: &2249 每次都非得把我回溯到这么早吗？

en: &567 Sorry. It's locked in until you break the loop.
zh: &567 抱歉，回溯点锁定了，得打破循环才能改。

en: &568 I... panicked when I saw the client was killed. So I rewound you as far the system allows.
zh: &568 我……看到客户被杀时慌了。所以我把你回溯到了系统允许的最远点。

en: &2250 No. No. You did the right thing.
&2251 At least my exhaustion levels reset along with the rest of me.
zh: &2251 至少身体一重置，也就不累了。

en: &2252 Can you check if there are any taxis nearby?
zh: &2252 你能查查附近有没有出租车吗？

en: &569 The Hansom Cab Company was only set up a few years ago. There aren't many of them around yet.
zh: &569 汉瑟姆出租车公司几年前才成立。现在还没多少车。

en: &570 You could try to find one, but you could miss your window.
zh: &570 可以试着找一辆，可这么一来，兴许就赶不上了。

en: &2253 My window to get shot again, you mean.
zh: &2253 赶不上再挨一枪，你是说这个吧。

en: &571 Your window to save the client, yes.
zh: &571 我说的是赶去救客户，没错。

en: &1619 Can you check Eddie's ranking again?
