zh: &1619 你能再查一下埃迪的评级吗？

en: &368 Still medium. Sorry.
&1620 I'm going to run back to the Inman house. We'll figure this out.
zh: &1620 我跑回英曼家。我们会弄清楚的。

en: &2254 And here I go again.
&303 Do I think it? I know it.
zh: &303 哪还用猜，我知道就是这样。

en: &218 That's crazy talk!
&304 It's worth a try, right?
&219 But that's crazy!
&305 He isn't a weakling.
&91 You don't know him like I do.
&306 Shut up, Eddie.
&307 Simon? You don't know me, but I know you.
zh: &307 西蒙？你不认识我，但我认识你。

en: &308 Or a version of you, at least. What you could be.
zh: &308 至少，我认识某一条时间线上的你。你将来有可能成为的那个人。

en: &220 You're not making any sense.
zh: &220 你说话让人摸不着头脑。

en: &309 No. No I guess I'm not.
&310 But I know why you fight. You fight for your sister. The ones you love.
zh: &310 但我知道你为什么而战。你为你的妹妹而战。为你所爱的人而战。

en: &311 Without that? You're lost.
&312 But your uncle? He doesn't fight for anyone.
zh: &312 但你叔叔？他不为任何人而战。

en: &313 So yes. You'd be a better gang leader than him. You'd be a better leader PERIOD.
zh: &313 所以没错，你会比他更适合当帮派头目。不管带领谁，你都比他强。

en: &221 But... a leader of criminals? Those are bad people!
zh: &221 但是……犯罪分子的头目？那些是坏人！

en: &314 Think about it, Simon. Do you have any other prospects right now?
zh: &314 想想看，西蒙。你现在还有别的出路吗？

en: &222 There's the oyster stand...
&315 Come on, Simon. That's not a future. Not for you. Not for Paula.
zh: &315 西蒙，靠那个，你和葆拉哪来的出路？

en: &316 If not this, then what?
zh: &316 不走这条路，你还能怎么办？

en: &223 I... never thought of it that way.
&92 You don't think at all! That's always been the problem!
zh: &92 你根本不动脑子！这一直是你的问题！

en: &317 Tell me this. Do you want to prove your uncle right?
zh: &317 告诉我，你想证明你叔叔是对的吗？

en: &224 To hell with my uncle and what he thinks.
zh: &224 让他见鬼去吧，谁管他怎么想。

en: &93 To hell with me? To hell with YOU!
zh: &93 让我见鬼去？你才给我见鬼去！

en: &318 Gangs can be a force for good.
&225 They can?
&319 I've seen it. They can do things for the community that the police won't.
zh: &319 我见过。他们能为社区做警察不愿做的事。

en: &94 You want us to go SOFT? Paint a target on our backs?
zh: &94 你想让我们心慈手软？等着别人来打我们？

en: &320 So how about it, Simon? You're being given an opportunity, here.
zh: &320 怎么样，西蒙？你现在有个机会。

en: &321 Be a shame to waste it.
&95 I don't know who you are, lady, but you're wasting your breath.
zh: &95 我不知道你是谁，女士，但你在白费口舌。

en: &226 Why didn't you just ASK me, Uncle Eddie? Why do all this?
zh: &226 你为什么不直接问我，埃迪叔叔？为什么要搞这些？

en: &96 Cuz I knew you'd say no.
&227 So you went behind my back? To FORCE me?
&228 If I do this? If I join you? It needs to be my decision.
zh: &228 我要是加入你，接手这事，那也得是我自己做的决定。

en: &229 I'll do it because I choose to. And it will be on my own terms.
zh: &229 我愿意才会做，而且得按我的意思来。

en: &97 You'll do it because I TELL YOU TO!
&230 No I won't. Not that way.
zh: &230 不，我不做。我不接受这种方式。

en: &98 Weak. Always knew it.
&1621 Right! You! Stop! Again!
&1622 Nozzo? Did his ranking change?
&370 Gimme a sec. Have to refresh...
&1623 No time!
&371 And Eddie's ranking is "Low"! We did it, Fia!
zh: &371 埃迪的评级是“低”！我们做到了，菲娅！

en: &1624 Yeah. Figured that.
&231 What the...?
&232 Did you...?
&1625 He's alive. More than he deserves.
zh: &1625 他还活着，已经便宜他了。

en: &1626 Kick him a few times, if you want. I know I would.
zh: &1626 想踢就踢他几脚。换我肯定踢。

en: &233 No. That's not the kind of leader I'm going to be.
zh: &233 不，我可不会当那种头目。

en: &234 I'll... tie him up, maybe? Until I know he won't kill me.
zh: &234 我……也许把他绑起来？直到我确定他不会杀我。

en: &235 Yeah. That's what I should do.
&236 Where did...?
&1627 He's gone. That's all that matters.
&237 Gone? So... I'm on my own?
&1628 No. You've got Paula.
&239 That's right. She'll get me through this. If anyone can teach me to be a good leader, it's her.
zh: &239 没错。她会帮我挺过去。要说谁能教我做个好领袖，就是她。

en: &322 So you're doing it? Taking over the gang?
zh: &322 所以你打算干？接管帮派？

en: &240 I... I'm not sure. Maybe?
&241 It's not something I'd ever considered before, but...
&242 It's my choice to do it. And that's all that matters.
zh: &242 这是我的选择。这才是最重要的。

en: &1629 Good. *gasp*. All is well then.
&243 Er. Are you okay?
&1630 Ran all the way here. Several times in a row.
zh: &1630 一路跑过来的。连续跑了好几趟。

en: &1631 Thirty-three years until the first subway. Can't come soon enough.
zh: &1631 离第一条地铁建成还有三十三年。真等不及了。

en: &1632 Nothing. Forget it. Timelines under the bridge.
zh: &1632 没什么，忘了吧。就当那些时间线都随流水去了。

en: &1634 You should check on your sister, Simon. She needs you.
zh: &1634 你该去看看你妹妹，西蒙。她需要你。

en: &245 Yeah. Paula. She's gonna be okay. Isn't she?
zh: &245 是啊。葆拉。她会没事的。对吧？

en: &1635 We can't see the future, but... I assume so.
zh: &1635 我们看不到未来，不过……我想会的。

en: &246 Thank you both. I'm not totally clear what you did, but... thank you.
zh: &246 谢谢你们。我不太清楚你们做了什么，但……谢谢。

en: &2685 Yes. Or rather, your reputation precedes you.
zh: &2685 是的。或者说，你名声在外。

en: &2686 Not yet. Your reputation precedes you, I suppose.
zh: &2686 还没有。我想，你名声在外。

en: &2687 No, but your reputation precedes you.
&90 What's that supposed to mean?
&2688 Nothing bad, I promise.
&2689 No need to reach for that shotgun behind the counter.
zh: &2689 没必要去拿柜台后面那把猎枪。

en: &91 Heh. Glad to see someone in this town shows some proper respect.
zh: &91 嘿，这镇上总算还有懂得尊重人的。

en: &92 I like you gals.
&93 So you want a drink or not?
zh: &93 那你们到底要不要喝一杯？

en: &2690 Not right now. Just dropped by to soak in the pre-fight atmosphere.
zh: &2690 现在不了。只是顺路来感受一下赛前气氛。

en: &94 Well when you decide to soak in something more liquid-y, you just let me know, alright?
zh: &94 等你们想喝点更带劲的，就告诉我，好吗？

en: &2691 Will do.
&3327 So. Do you know Simon Inman?
zh: &3327 那么，你认识西蒙·英曼吗？

en: &95 Only that tonight, Brian's gonna knock him into next week.
zh: &95 只知道今晚布赖恩会把他揍到下个星期。

en: &3328 Really? I'm not sure that's...
&3329 Oh! Sorry. You're being rhetorical. My mistake.
zh: &3329 哦，抱歉，你是在打比方，是我会错意了。

en: &96 You're definitely not from around here.
&3330 Can you tell me anything about a gang called "The Breakdown Boys?"
zh: &3330 你能告诉我一个叫“破坏男孩”的帮派吗？

en: &97 You ARE new around here.
&98 I make my payments, on time, every month, without fail.
zh: &98 我每个月都按时交钱，从不拖欠。

en: &124 Clara...
&99 I KNOW you don't like it, Brian. But I know how the world works.
zh: &99 我知道你不喜欢，布赖恩。但我知道这世界是怎么运转的。

en: &125 Yeah, I know. But maybe it shouldn't.
zh: &125 是啊，我知道。但也许不该这样。

en: &100 Oh, that sweet optimism. Don't ever lose it.
zh: &100 你这份天真真可爱，可别丢了。

en: &2692 See you 'round, Clara.
&101 Bye now.
&54 Sweet Toronto, it's dark.
&55 Do you have any idea where we're going?
zh: &55 你知道我们要去哪儿吗？

en: The forest maze.
&56 And here we are again.
&57 You sure you know what you're doing?
zh: &57 你确定你知道自己在做什么吗？

en: &6222 Let's retrace our footsteps...
&6116 This job is reminding me I haven't been to the gym in awhile.
zh: &6116 做这趟任务我才发现，好久没去健身房了。

en: &1185 Bit of advice? Make sure the place is chronolocked first.
zh: &1185 一点建议？先确保那个地方已经时空锁定。

en: &6117 Speaking from experience?
&1186 The armcurl machine chrono-shifted into a leg press in the middle of my second set.
zh: &1186 我第二组刚做一半，弯举机就被时间线改写成了腿举机。

en: &1302 Needed a cast for a week.
&6118 Noted. Avoid the gym.
&1303 Thus endeth the lesson.
&5143 Chloe doing all right on her own?
zh: &5143 克洛伊一个人没问题吧？

en: &1790 She's fine. She hasn't taken her eyes of the kid once.
zh: &1790 她没事。她眼睛一刻也没离开过那孩子。

en: &5246 Just make sure she doesn't pull another Joe Anderson.
zh: &5246 只要确保她别再干出乔·安德森那种事就行。

en: &1791 Don't worry. If she does, I'm ready.
zh: &1791 别担心。如果她真那么做，我准备好了。

en: &5274 You're... ready? Just how are you ready?
zh: &5274 你……准备好了？你究竟怎么个准备法？

en: &1792 She's out in the countryside with no other people around for miles in any direction.
zh: &1792 她在乡下，方圆几英里内都没有其他人。

en: &1793 If she runs off, I can pull her through a tunnel whenever I want.
zh: &1793 如果她跑掉，我随时可以把她拉进隧道。

en: &5275 You've thought this through.
&1794 It's my job.
Access denied.
&2256 Is there another way in? A window or a back door?
zh: &2256 还有别的路进去吗？窗户或者后门？

en: &1 Um.
&2 You want to get arrested on your first day?
zh: &2 你想第一天上班就被逮捕吗？

en: &3 Is it that important you get in?
&4 Well, sorry. I don't know what to tell you.
zh: &4 好吧，抱歉。我不知道该怎么跟你说。

en: &5 The problem is obviously on their end. I'm sure they'll understand.
zh: &5 问题显然出在他们那边。我相信他们会理解的。

en: &2257 What's wrong with your card?
&6 Oh. I'm getting a... let's see.
zh: &6 哦。我收到一个……让我看看。

en: &7 A "Duplicate ID error".
&2258 And what's that mean?
&8 That someone else used a card with the same ID as this one, but hasn't signed out yet. The system doesn't like that.
zh: &8 就是有人用相同ID的卡进去了，却还没签退。系统不允许这样。

en: &9 Fraud thing, you know? Can't be too careful. Especially with these corporate types.
zh: &9 为了防欺诈嘛，懂吧？谨慎点总没坏处，尤其是这种大公司的地方。

en: &2259 There's no failsafe for duplicate cards?
zh: &2259 卡片重复就没有备用处理办法吗？

en: &10 Well technically there aren't supposed to BE duplicate cards.
zh: &10 嗯，严格来说，本来就不应该有重复卡。

en: &11 But it happens more often than you think. Human error thing, you know?
zh: &11 但这种情况比你想象的更常见。人为失误，你懂吧？

en: &12 It's happened to me once or twice.
&2260 You said you were a temp?
&13 Yep. You know how it is. Need those work study credits, you know?
zh: &13 对，得攒工读学分嘛，你懂的。

en: &14 They give me an entry level job, I get a certificate showing that I learned something.
zh: &14 他们给我派一份基础工作，做完我拿证书，证明学到了东西。

en: &15 Course with this faulty card they gave me, that might not happen.
zh: &15 当然，他们给我的这张卡有问题，那可能就实现不了了。

en: &2261 Can we call anyone?
&16 Didn't bring my phone. They were very clear about that.
zh: &16 我没带手机。他们对此说得很清楚。

en: &17 "No phones or recording devices inside the building."
zh: &17 “大楼内禁止携带手机或录音设备。”

en: &18 Annoying, but I get it. Corporations and their secrets, you know?
zh: &18 很烦人，但我理解。公司和他们那些秘密，你懂的？

en: &19 Unless... did you bring a phone?
&7051 Ah. No. Sorry.
&20 There we go. This is what we get for following directions!
zh: &20 这下好了。这就是我们遵守指示的下场！

en: &2262 Who are the "they" that gave you the card?
zh: &2262 你说给你卡的“他们”，指的是谁？

en: &21 The temp agency.
&22 They are usually much more on top of this stuff.
zh: &22 他们通常对这些事情上心得多。

en: &23 It's not like them to give me a faulty card.
zh: &23 给我一张有问题的卡，不像他们的作风。

en: &2263 Yes. I do.
&24 Oh good. My card isn't working. Can you scan me in with yours?
zh: &24 哦，太好了。我的卡用不了。你能用你的卡帮我刷进去吗？

en: &2264 Ah. Er. I'm afraid I don't have a card.
&25 Oh! So you're new. Like me?
zh: &25 哦！所以你是新来的。跟我一样？

en: &7049 Something like that.
&2265 No. Just visiting.
&26 Oh. Were you given an access card, by any chance?
zh: &26 哦，那他们有没有给你门禁卡？

en: &27 Mine's not working.
&2266 Ah. No. I'm afraid not.
&28 Well, c'est la vie. I guess we're both stuck until they notice we're out here.
zh: &28 好吧，这就是人生。我想我们俩都得困在这儿，直到他们注意到我们在外面。

en: &29 Serves us right for getting here early!
zh: &29 谁叫我们来得这么早，活该！

en: &2267 I'm Fia, by the way.
&30 Sam Deane. Nice to meet you.
zh: &30 萨姆·迪恩。很高兴认识你。

en: Sam
&2268 What do you do here?
&31 Nothing, yet. I'm just a temp, you know? But my background is in admin and engineering.
zh: &31 暂时还没开始。我只是临时工，懂吧？不过行政和工程方面的事我都学过。

en: &32 What about yourself?
&2269 Oh. Well...
&33 Right. None of my business. Totes get it.
zh: &33 好吧。不关我的事。完全理解。

en: &2270 So this temp agency you work for...
zh: &2270 那么你工作的这家临时工中介……

en: &34 Sterling? Been around for... gosh, thirty years at least.
zh: &34 斯特林？这中介开了……天哪，至少三十年了。

en: &2271 Good, are they?
&35 They give you more credits than anybody. No other agency does that.
zh: &35 他们给的学分比谁都多。没有其他中介会那样做。

en: &36 But they make you earn it. When I'm done with a gig, I have to write a paper showing what I learned. They don't mess around.
zh: &36 不过学分可不好拿。每干完一份活，都得写篇论文，讲讲学到了什么。他们认真得很。

en: &2272 So, I heard some troubling news about your temp agency...
zh: &2272 你那家中介……我听说了些不太好的消息。

en: &37 You did?
&2273 They are stealing money and secrets from the firms they send workers to.
zh: &2273 他们把员工派到公司里，偷取那些公司的钱和机密。

en: &38 Huh? What do you mean?
&2274 Just that. You need to be careful.
zh: &2274 就这个意思。你得小心点。

en: &39 I mean, this is all a bit out of the blue, you know?
zh: &39 我是说，这一切都有点突然，你知道吗？

en: &40 Where's your proof?
&2275 Well. I don't have PROOF per se.
zh: &2275 嗯，严格来说我没有证据。

en: &2276 But consider your temp agency for a moment.
zh: &2276 但你先想想你的那家临时工中介。

en: &41 Okay. What about them?
&2277 I mean it. Your agency is going to get you into trouble.
zh: &2277 我是认真的。你的中介会给你惹上麻烦。

en: &42 So you said, but I'm not hearing any proof, you know?
zh: &42 你是这么说的，但我没听到任何证据，你知道吗？

en: &2278 There is no proof, but consider this temp agency for a moment.
zh: &2278 没有证据，但你先想想这家临时工中介。

en: &43 Okay, what about them?
&2279 Still no luck?
&44 No. Not yet.
&45 They've gotta notice us here at some point.
zh: &45 他们总会发现咱们在这儿的吧。

en: &2280 Sam. I know what you are here to do.
zh: &2280 萨姆，我知道你来这里要做什么。

en: &2281 Stealing company secrets, Sam. You are going to get caught.
zh: &2281 窃取公司机密，萨姆。你会被抓的。

en: &46 What?
&47 I'm just here because STP sent me! I'm not going to STEAL anything.
zh: &47 我只是因为STP派我来的！我不会偷任何东西。

en: &48 Sterling Temp Placements. The temp agency.
zh: &48 斯特林临时工派遣公司。就是那家中介。

en: &49 You have your wires crossed, lady. Whoever you're looking for, it's not me.
zh: &49 你搞错了，女士。不管你在找谁，都不是我。

en: &574 He sounds like he's telling the truth, Fia. You'd better leave him alone.
zh: &574 菲娅，他听起来说的是实话。你最好别烦他了。

en: &2283 Right. Apologies. I must have you confused with someone else.
zh: &2283 好吧。抱歉。我一定是把你和别人搞混了。

en: &50 Sure. It happens.
&51 Welp. I won't be needing this!
zh: &51 好吧。那我就不需要这个了！

en: &52 It's a nice day at least. Gonna salvage it by taking an early lunch. Wanna join?
zh: &52 至少天气不错。我打算早点去吃午饭，也不算白来一趟。要一起吗？

en: &7053 No. I have business here, but thank you.
zh: &7053 不了。我在这里有事，不过谢谢你。

en: &53 Thank YOU. I think I may have just dodged a bullet.
zh: &53 谢谢你。我想我可能刚躲过一劫。

en: &54 Bye!
&2285 Should I go find Mr. Pasamon?
zh: &2285 我应该去找帕萨蒙先生吗？

en: &6 If you think it'll do any good.
zh: &6 如果你觉得会有用的话。

en: &7 That man was only on time once in his life, and that was only because his mother drove him.
zh: &7 那个人这辈子只准时过一次，那还是因为他妈妈开车送他。

en: &2286 I found Mr. Pasamon, but he won't come back inside.
zh: &2286 我找到帕萨蒙先生了，但他不肯回来。

en: &8 Oh. This is my surprised face.
&9 What distracted him this time? A pretty smile or a pretty engine?
zh: &9 这次是什么让他分心了？漂亮的笑容还是漂亮的引擎？

en: &2287 Well he's talking to this man...
zh: &2287 嗯，他在跟一个男人说话……

en: &10 I knew it. Good for him.
&11 In that case, just leave him.
&2288 Really?
&12 Yeah. Getting some action will be good for him.
zh: &12 是啊。让他风流一下对他有好处。

en: &13 I can muddle through on my own.
&2289 D'you think you should practice a bit more? Just in case?
zh: &2289 你觉得是不是该再练练？以防万一？

en: &15 Hmm. You may be right. Let's get to it, shall we?
zh: &15 嗯。也许你说得对。我们开始吧，好吗？

en: &16 Music ON!
&2290 You should take a break, Ms. Bates.
zh: &2290 你应该休息一下，贝茨女士。

en: &17 A break...?
&18 You know what, maybe you're right.
zh: &18 你知道吗，也许你说得对。

en: &19 Gotta rest the vocal cords.
&20 System! Deactivate drone program.
&3247 Cassie mentioned you had an incident with a virus created by Mr. Pasamon?
zh: &3247 卡西提到你遇到过帕萨蒙先生制造的病毒？

en: &21 Nope.
&3248 Are you sure-
&22 I said NOPE.
&3249 Right. Sorry. Never mind.
&2291 I'd love to go over your presentation with you.
zh: &2291 我很乐意陪你过一遍演示。

en: &2292 Maybe we should go over your presentation again? Just in case?
zh: &2292 也许我们应该再过一遍你的演示？以防万一？

en: &23 Hm. Couldn't hurt!
&24 OK. This word here, at the beginning...
&25 Can you think of good word for "cold"? I'm currently using the word "frigid" but that has a lot of baggage tied to it, especially among women.
zh: &25 有没有什么合适的词来形容“冷”？我现在用的是“严寒”，frigid，可这词还有别的意思，尤其形容女性时，会让人想到性冷淡。

en: &26 I'm still not sure of the word "frigid". What other word can imply cold?
zh: &26 “严寒”，frigid，我还是拿不准。还有什么词能表示冷？

en: &27 The word "freezing" works, and does the job fine, but I'm thinking it can be punchier. Any ideas?
zh: &27 “冰冷”这个词可以，也能胜任，但我觉得可以更有冲击力。有什么想法吗？

en: &28 The word "cold" is simple, and I like that, but is it TOO simple?
zh: &28 “寒冷”这个词很简单，我喜欢，但会不会太简单了？

en: &29 What do you think?
&30 I'm wondering if the word "intense" is a bit too strong? I want to imply COLD, not a blizzard.
zh: &30 “强烈”，intense，会不会用力过猛了？我想表达的是冷，不是暴风雪。

en: &2293 Is there anything I can help you with?
&31 Hm. I'm looking through my presentation here. I've gone over it dozens of times, but something STILL isn't gelling.
zh: &31 嗯，我在看演讲稿。过了几十遍，还是有些地方不太顺。

en: &32 I'm sure that with just the right tweaks, it'll be a winner.
zh: &32 我相信只要改对几个地方，就能打动投资人。

en: &33 Mind if I run some of it by you? Second opinion and all?
zh: &33 能听我讲几段吗？想听听你的意见。

en: &34 THANK you.
&35 Now where was I...
&2294 Excuse me?
&2 Hey! Fia, this is Sam!
&55 We've met.
&56 She's the one I told you about.
zh: &56 她就是我跟你说过的那个人。

en: &3 Oh. So Cassie hired two temps from two different agencies?
zh: &3 哦。所以卡西从两个不同的中介雇了两个临时工？

en: &4 Eh, whatever. You did good, Fia.
zh: &4 呃，无所谓。你做得不错，菲娅。

en: &2295 I did?
&5 Yeah. I got to have lunch with this fella, instead of being his boss.
zh: &5 是啊，能跟这位一起吃午饭，用不着当他的上司了。

en: &2296 And that's better?
&6 Power dynamics, you know? Get in the way.
zh: &6 有上下级这层关系，很多事就不好办了，懂吧？

en: &57 Oh they get in the way, do they? Of what?
&7 Oh. Er.
&8 You know. Things?
&58 Things. Right.
&9 Uh. Hi.
&2297 You two seem to be getting on well.
zh: &2297 你们俩似乎相处得不错。

en: &10 Er. You think?
&11 I mean yes. Yes we are.
zh: &11 我是说，是的。我们相处得很好。

en: &2298 You should get back to the office, Mr. Pasamon.
zh: &2298 你该回办公室了，帕萨蒙先生。

en: &12 Already? I haven't even had my full hour yet.
zh: &12 已经到时间了？我连整整一小时都还没待满。

en: &2299 You don't want to miss the presentation, do you?
&13 You mean the presentation we've given 30 times this month?
zh: &13 你是说我们这个月已经做了30次的演示？

en: &14 Nobody important has been interested yet. Why would things be different now?
zh: &14 到现在也没哪个大人物有兴趣，这次凭什么不一样？

en: &15 And besides, Madison's better at the talky stuff. She can handle it. Just this once.
zh: &15 再说，麦迪逊更会说话，这回就让她一个人应付吧。

en: &16 I build it. She sells it. That's how it works.
zh: &16 我负责制造，她负责销售。就是这样。

en: &2300 There's been an accident. Madison is unable to do the presentation.
zh: &2300 出了点意外。麦迪逊没法做演示了。

en: &17 Really? What happened? Is she okay?
zh: &17 真的吗？发生了什么？她没事吧？

en: &2301 She's fine. She's just, um, covered in orange salad dressing.
zh: &2301 她没事。她只是，呃，浑身都是橙色的沙拉酱。

en: &2302 Somehow.
&2303 Anyhow, you need to take her place.
&20 *Sigh*
&21 Right. Once again, it's up to me to save the day.
zh: &21 好吧，又得靠我来救场了。

en: &22 Sorry, Sam. Duty calls.
zh: &22 抱歉，萨姆，得回去干活了。

en: &24 You wanna come up with me? You can be my good luck charm.
zh: &24 你想跟我一起上去吗？你可以当我的幸运符。

en: &59 Really? I'd like that. Sounds like fun.
zh: &59 真的吗？我很乐意。听起来很有趣。

en: &25 Great. It's a date.
&26 I mean, let's go.
&27 *cough*
&2304 Hm. That went well.
&2305 So. How'd everything shake out, Noz?
&575 Just waiting for the ripples to stabilize.
zh: &575 只是在等涟漪稳定下来。

en: &576 Right. Checking...
&577 Looks like you did it!
&578 "BatesTech" no longer exists. "Leaves" went on to be rebranded as Pasamon Industries.
zh: &578 “贝茨科技”已经不存在了。“叶子”后来更名为帕萨蒙工业。

en: &579 And a Mr. Benjamin Pasamon is listed as CEO.
zh: &579 CEO一栏写的是本杰明·帕萨蒙。

en: &2306 Does he stay together with Sam?
&580 Unknown. No cluster-mates are listed.
zh: &580 未知。没有列出伴侣组成员。

en: &2307 Ah well. So much for that ship.
&2308 Ready to jump home.
&7066 Nozzo?
&582 The new protocols, Fia.
&7067 Right. Of course. Ahem.
&2309 Chrono-suit is engaged. Confirm?
zh: &2309 时空防护服已启动。确认？

en: &583 Confirmed. Stand by.
&2310 Trust me, if you don't go back, you'll regret it.
zh: &2310 相信我，如果你不回去，你会后悔的。

en: &28 I'm happy here, thank you.
&29 I'll go back when I'm ready.
&2311 Roy Rockcamp is going to be watching the stream today.
zh: &2311 罗伊·罗克坎普今天会看直播。

en: &2312 If you're not there, he'll put Madison in charge.
zh: &2312 如果你不在，他会让麦迪逊负责。

en: &30 That's a big IF.
&31 A guy like that isn't interested in us.
zh: &31 那样的人对我们不感兴趣。

en: &2313 Nobody has been interested yet? Why?
zh: &2313 到现在还没人感兴趣？为什么？

en: &32 Why do you think? It's frigging SALADS.
&33 I told Madison it was a boring idea, but she thinks with enough bells and whistles we can sell a big whale investor on the pitch.
zh: &33 我都跟麦迪逊说了，这主意太无聊。她却觉得，包装得够花哨，就能让个大投资人看上。

en: &3250 And you disagree?
&34 I don't wanna yuck her yum, but yeah.
zh: &34 我不想扫她的兴，但没错。

en: &35 She'll realize I was right soon enough, and then she'll agree to show off my prototype instead.
zh: &35 她很快就会明白我说得对，到时候就肯展示我的原型了。

en: &36 Nothing like a few explosions to raise someone's interest, am I right?
zh: &36 没有什么比几场爆炸更能引起别人兴趣的了，对吧？

en: &60 It gets you noticed, for sure.
&37 Er. Yeah.
&400 *cough*
&3251 What is "PasaGel?"
&38 You... you really want to know?
&39 It's a nanotech gel, see? It's got these audio receptors on 'em. My own design.
zh: &39 是种纳米凝胶，里面有我设计的声音接收器。

en: &40 You can program them to activate when they hear three unique phrases.
zh: &40 可以编程设定，让它们听到三个特定短语后启动。

en: &41 So you spray the gel on any surface you want, then speak the phrases, and they turn on!
zh: &41 所以你把凝胶喷在任何表面上，然后说出短语，它们就会启动！

en: &61 And do what?
&42 They explode!
&62 That's... one practical application.
&43 Right?
&2314 Right. Enjoy your lunch.
&44 We will!
&45 Anyway, what was I saying? Oh. Right.
zh: &45 总之，我刚才说到哪了？哦。对。

en: &46 Anyway. You were saying?
&2315 The bin is unmoved.
&2317 *Sigh* No change.
&2318 Right. How would Chloe Sadar do this?
zh: &2318 好吧。克洛伊·萨达尔会怎么做？

en: &2319 Ow. Hurt her hand, most likely.
zh: &2319 哎哟。很可能会伤到她的手。

en: &2320 Heeyah!
&2321 The bin is unhurt, although I can't say the same for my foot.
zh: &2321 垃圾桶毫发无伤，我的脚可就惨了。

en: &2322 The bin won't budge.
&2323 Come on!
&2324 What's with this thing?
&2326 Doesn't move an inch.
&2327 Come ON!
&2328 Nothing.
&2329 UUURGGGG!
&3163 Right. Now you're gonna get it.
&2330 Still won't budge.
&2331 That metal arm holds this rubbish bin solidly in place.
zh: &2331 那根金属臂把这个垃圾桶牢牢固定住了。

en: &3253 Can you tell me about this place?
zh: &3253 你能给我介绍一下这个地方吗？

en: &7 Elevator pitch? We are a bespoke salad growth and delivery company.
zh: &7 要我简单介绍一下？我们是一家提供定制沙拉种植和配送服务的公司。

en: &8 Lots of moving parts! Don't worry. You'll get the hang of it.
zh: &8 有很多环节！别担心，你会慢慢熟悉的。

en: &3254 Any idea what I should be doing around here?
zh: &3254 你知道我在这里应该做些什么吗？

en: &9 Whatever Mr. Pasamon and Ms. Bates tell you.
zh: &9 帕萨蒙先生和贝茨女士让你做什么就做什么。

en: &10 You HAVE spoken to them, right?
zh: &10 你已经和他们谈过了，对吧？

en: &11 They're upstairs.
&3255 So what do you do around here?
&12 You open up THAT can of worms, you won't have time to do your job.
zh: &12 真要说起来，你可就没时间干活了。

en: &13 So I'll just say "everything" and leave it at that.
zh: &13 就说“什么都干”吧，不多聊了。

en: &3256 Anything I should know about Madison?
zh: &3256 关于麦迪逊，有什么我需要了解的吗？

en: &14 Uh, so Madison is kind of our marketing person. Branding, PR, things like that.
zh: &14 呃，麦迪逊算是我们的营销人员。品牌推广、公关之类的。

en: &15 We all do a little bit of everything around here.
zh: &15 我们这儿每个人都什么事都做一点。

en: &16 She's been pitching to investors for almost a month with no results, so she's a little stressed.
zh: &16 她向投资者推销了快一个月，毫无结果，所以压力有点大。

en: &17 Well, I mean she's always stressed. But that's start-ups, right?
zh: &17 嗯，我是说她总是压力很大。但初创公司不都这样吗？

en: &18 The key thing you need to know is - don't distract her. Not today.
zh: &18 你需要知道的关键一点是——别打扰她。今天不行。

en: &3257 Anything else I should know about Madison?
zh: &3257 关于麦迪逊，还有什么我需要了解的吗？

en: &19 Oh, you're a curious one.
&3258 She wouldn't take the printouts you made for her. Did I do something wrong?
zh: &3258 她不肯收你为她做的打印件。我做错什么了吗？

en: &20 Oh. Yeah. I should've warned you. Madison is wearing vintage Margiela Tabi, so please don't get anything on that.
zh: &20 哦。对。我该提醒你的。麦迪逊穿的是复古马吉拉分趾鞋，请别把东西弄到上面。

en: Ha ha.
&22 She loves that suit and it's a whole thing to get it cleaned... which of course is my job.
zh: &22 她很喜欢那套衣服，清洗起来可费事了……当然，这是我的活儿。

en: &3259 So Madison likes to have things just so?
zh: &3259 麦迪逊对这些讲究这么多？

en: &23 She says it brings her luck. And we certainly need it today.
zh: &23 她说那能给她带来好运。我们今天确实需要好运。

en: &3260 So I shouldn't get anything on Madison's suit?
zh: &3260 所以我不该把任何东西弄到麦迪逊的衣服上？

en: &24 I don't know why you need reminding, but yeah.
zh: &24 我不知道为什么还需要提醒你，不过是的。

en: &3261 What's special about today?
&25 Oh. Um. Just a special guest who is attending today's pitch stream. Nobody you need to worry about.
zh: &25 哦。呃。只是有位特别嘉宾会出席今天的推介直播。你不必担心。

en: &3262 This guest. It wouldn't be Roy Rockcamp, would it?
zh: &3262 这位嘉宾。不会是罗伊·罗克坎普吧？

en: &27 Jesus. Keep it down!
&28 If Madison found out, she'd be a nervous wreck. More so than usual.
zh: &28 要是让麦迪逊知道了，她会紧张得不行。比平时更糟。

en: &29 Better if she doesn't know.
&3263 What do you know about... uh...
&7064 (roy rockcamp?)
&30 Only that I have called in favors from every admin, secretary and executive assistant in this city to get him here.
zh: &30 我只知道，为了请他来，我把城里行政人员、秘书和高管助理的人情都用上了。

en: &31  He is our best hope of taking Leaves stratospheric.
zh: &31  他是我们把“叶子”推向巅峰的最大希望。

en: &3264  Benjamin Pasamon. Anything you can tell me about him?
zh: &3264  本杰明·帕萨蒙。关于他你能告诉我些什么？

en: &32 Benjamin's our resident inventor, and he does most of the R&D for Leaves.
zh: &32 本杰明是我们公司的发明家，“叶子”大部分研发都是他做的。

en: &33 When he's not getting distracted by his side projects, anyway.
zh: &33 前提是他没被自己的业余项目分走心思。

en: &3265 What kind of side projects?
&34 Let's see. There's the spray gel that makes things blow up.
zh: &34 让我想想。有能让东西爆炸的喷雾凝胶。

en: &35 There's the computer virus that makes things blow up.
zh: &35 有能让东西爆炸的电脑病毒。

en: &36 Honestly? I'm surprised the salad hasn't blown up yet.
zh: &36 说实话？沙拉还没爆炸我都觉得意外。

en: &37 Jesus. I'd better look into that.
&3266 Spray gel that makes things blow up?
zh: &3266 能让东西爆炸的喷雾凝胶？

en: &38 "PasaGel." Don't get me started.
&39 You want to know more? Ask him.
&3267 A virus that makes things blow up?
&40 Nope. We don't talk about "Pulseblast" in this house.
zh: &40 不行，我们这里不提“脉冲爆裂”。

en: &41 Not since the incident.
zh: &41 自从那次事故之后就不谈了。

en: &3268 Incident?
&42 Ask Madison. Or rather, DON'T. She doesn't need the reminder.
zh: &42 去问麦迪逊……不，还是别问，别又让她想起那件事。

en: &3269 Mr. Pasamon is outside having lunch. He won't come back in.
zh: &3269 帕萨蒙先生在外面吃午饭。他不肯回来。

en: &43 Yeah, he does that. Don't worry about it.
&44 The less those two are in each others' hair, the easier my life is.
zh: &44 那两位越少互相碍事，我的日子就越好过。

en: &3270 Doesn't he need to help Ms. Bates with the presentation?
zh: &3270 他不需要帮贝茨女士准备演示吗？

en: &45 He should, yes. But need? No.
&46 They've both flown solo before. Madison can manage.
zh: &46 他们俩以前都独自完成过。麦迪逊能应付。

en: &3271 Mr. Pasamon is chatting with this man...
zh: &3271 帕萨蒙先生正在和这个男人聊天……

en: &47 Oh. OH.
&48 Good for him.
&3272 Good for him?
&49 He's had a hard time. His last business failed spectacularly. His fiance left him last year. He can't seem to get back on the horse. Uh, so to speak.
zh: &49 他这阵子不容易，上个生意赔得很惨，未婚夫去年也离开了他。他一直振作不起来，嗯，感情方面也是。

en: &50 He's a romantic at heart. Maybe this will be good for him.
zh: &50 他骨子里是个浪漫的人。也许这对他有好处。

en: &3273 Are you alright?
&51 Me? I'm FINE. Just a bit wired. We're ALL a bit wired.
zh: &51 我？我很好。只是有点紧张。我们都有些紧张。

en: &52 In case nobody has said it yet, we're REALLY glad you're here.
zh: &52 如果还没人说过，我们真的很高兴你来了。

en: &53 We lost our janitor last week, so things aren't running quite as well as they should.
zh: &53 上周清洁工走了，这里运转得也没那么顺了。

en: &3274 You need a temp... to be a janitor?
zh: &3274 你们需要临时工……来当清洁工？

en: &54 We're all on the same team, right? You're OK pitching in with whatever, right?
zh: &54 大家都是一个团队的嘛，需要帮忙的事，你都愿意搭把手吧？

en: &3275 "Whatever" is my middle name.
zh: &3275 论“什么都干”，我可在行了。

en: &55 I know that's not true, but I love the enthusiasm.
zh: &55 我知道你是在说笑，不过这股热情我喜欢。

en: &56 Keep a low profile, do whatever needs doing, try not to annoy Benjamin and Madison.
zh: &56 保持低调，做需要做的事，尽量别惹本杰明和麦迪逊。

en: &57 That's the key to survival here!
zh: &57 这是在这里生存的关键！

en: &3276 What happened to your janitor?
&58 Sweet guy. Keen worker. Loved to talk about his grandkids.
zh: &58 人很好。工作勤快。喜欢聊他的孙子孙女。

en: &59 But... he was a bit of a phytophile. LOVED plants. That's why we hired him.
zh: &59 不过……他有点植物癖，特别喜欢植物，所以我们才雇他。

en: &60 Little did we know...
&3277 Your former janitor loved plants? I'd think that would be beneficial in a place like this.
zh: &3277 你们的前清洁工喜欢植物？我以为在这种地方这是好事。

en: &61 You'd think so, right?
&62 It was cute at first. After his first week, he asked us to call him "Plant Master".
zh: &62 起初还挺可爱。第一周后，他让我们叫他“植物大师”。

en: &3278 And you obliged?
&63 It was no less weird than what Benji and Madison ask me to do on a regular basis.
zh: &63 本吉和麦迪逊平时让我干的事，也没正常到哪儿去。

en: &64 But then one night I had to come back late to collect some paperwork...
zh: &64 但有一天晚上我不得不回来取文件……

en: &65 And I found him inside the Vertical Farm. Completely naked. Covered in soil. Screaming "I AM THE PLANT MASTER!"
zh: &65 我发现他在垂直农场里。一丝不挂。浑身是土。大喊“我是植物大师！”

en: &66 Hah!
&67 I laugh about it now, but I fired him on the spot. What else could I do?
zh: &67 现在想想是好笑，可当时我立刻就把他开除了。我还能怎么办？

en: &68 He just left. Didn't even get his clothes out of his locker.
zh: &68 他就那么走了。甚至没从储物柜里拿衣服。

en: &69 I can only hope he's okay and got the help he needs.
zh: &69 我只能希望他没事，并得到了需要的帮助。

en: &3279 Your janitor really wanted to be called "Plant Master".
zh: &3279 你们的清洁工真想被叫做“植物大师”。

en: &70 Like I said, I shouldn't have humored him. That'll teach me.
zh: &70 我说了，不该那么顺着他，这下长记性了。

en: &71 His clothes are still in his locker. Need to do something about that.
zh: &71 他的衣服还在储物柜里。得处理一下。

en: &72 Just one more item on my list.
&3280 Will Madison be... alright?
&73 She'll be fine. It's the presentation I'm worried about.
zh: &73 她会没事的。我担心的是演示。

en: &74 Ideally, they'd give it together. Show off the best of both worlds.
zh: &74 理想情况下，他们应该一起做。把两人的长处都展现出来。

en: &75 But Benji can handle it on his own. He can be charming when he wants to be.
zh: &75 不过本吉一个人也能应付。他愿意的话，还是挺有魅力的。

en: &3281 Madison is meditating in the vertical farm...
zh: &3281 麦迪逊正在垂直农场里冥想……

en: &76 Yeah. She does that. It's how she calms herself down.
zh: &76 是啊。她就这样。这是她让自己冷静下来的方式。

en: &77 But don't be fooled. She's more alert than she looks.
zh: &77 可别被她的样子骗了，她清醒着呢。

en: &78 She'll know when it's time to give the next presentation.
zh: &78 她知道什么时候该做下一场演示。

en: &79 Her meditation ritual is calculated to the micro-second. She'll be fresh and ready to go in plenty of time.
zh: &79 她把冥想时间算得精确到微秒，肯定能提前醒来，精神饱满地上场。

en: &80 Better than a nap. At least for her.
zh: &80 比小睡还好。至少对她来说。

en: &3282 Madison's meditation is better than a nap?
zh: &3282 麦迪逊的冥想比小睡还好？

en: &81 You HAVE met Madison, right? She runs on pure, raw tension.
zh: &81 你已经见过麦迪逊了吧？她平时全靠一根绷紧的弦撑着。

en: &82 If she lets herself relax too long, she's asleep.
zh: &82 如果她让自己放松太久，就会睡着。

en: &83 And once that happens? Good luck waking her up.
zh: &83 一旦那样？想叫醒她就难了。

en: &84 We went to a Haskins tribute concert last month, and she was snoring by the second number.
zh: &84 上个月我们去了一场哈斯金斯致敬音乐会，第二首曲子时她就开始打鼾了。

en: &3283 Madison really fell asleep during a concert?
zh: &3283 麦迪逊真的在音乐会上睡着了？

en: &85 At a Haskins tribute concert, of all things. I had to fireman carry her out of there.
zh: &85 偏偏还是哈斯金斯致敬音乐会！我只能把她扛在肩上带出去。

en: &86 I just wish I took pictures.
&87 Right. You have any questions, just holler.
&88 Sorry to keep you waiting. Where was I? Right.
zh: &88 抱歉让你久等了。我说到哪儿了？对。

en: &2332 I'd rather stay, if that's all right.
zh: &2332 如果可以的话，我宁愿留下。

en: &36 No, it's not all right!
&2333 I will in a minute. Maybe two.
zh: &2333 我一会儿就走。也许两分钟。

en: &2334 How far is the front door from the stairs?
&37 What are you talking about?
&2335 I was here first.
&38 Excuse me?
&39 I think you vastly misunderstand how things work here.
zh: &39 我想你完全误解了这里的规矩。

en: &40 Leave!
&2336 I... can't. Not yet. I'm sorry.
&41 Really. Tell me why?
&2337 If you must know, I'm hiding from myself.
zh: &2337 如果你非要知道，我在躲我自己。

en: &43 That makes two of us.
&2338 You look like you could use some help?
&2339 That is why I'm here after all.
zh: &2339 毕竟这就是我来这里的原因。

en: &44 Huh. The agency didn't say you were this tenacious.
zh: &44 呵。中介可没说你这么执着。

en: &2340 I... like it in here?
&45 You do?
&2341 Yes. It's peaceful.
&46 I feel the exact same way.
&47 Look. Fia, was it?
&48 I'm sorry I snapped. That was wrong of me.
zh: &48 抱歉我刚才发火了。是我不对。

en: &49 A job like this is hectic. You have to be able to roll with the punches.
zh: &49 这种工作很忙乱。你得能随机应变。

en: &50 And do what you're told.
&51 If you can't do that, then maybe this isn't the place for you?
zh: &51 如果你做不到，那也许这里不适合你？

en: &52 If there's a problem, you need to show some INITIATIVE.
zh: &52 有问题就得自己主动想办法。

en: &53 The solution isn't just going to drop down from the sky.
zh: &53 解决办法不会从天上掉下来。

en: &54 Look. Fia. We'll talk about this later. Right now I need to center myself.
zh: &54 听着，菲娅。我们晚点再谈这个。现在我需要让自己平静下来。

en: &55 The door is that way.
&3284 Did she... did she just go to sleep?
&1315 She's meditating. She's not asleep.
&3285 For how long?
&1316 She doesn't miss the presentation, if that's what you're asking.
zh: &1316 她不会错过演示的，如果你问的是这个。

en: &3286 Hm. Shame.
&2342 Maybe go back to the word "frigid?" You chose it for a reason.
zh: &2342 要不还是用“严寒”，frigid？你当初选它总有理由。

en: &56 Gut feeling, huh? You're probably right.
&2343 How about "freezing?"
&57 Hm. Kinda basic, but maybe that's called for.
zh: &57 嗯，有点普通，但也许正合适。

en: &2344 Why not just go with "cold?"
&58 Hm. Plain. Simple. Clear. Yeah. That works.
zh: &58 嗯，朴素、简单、清晰。对，这个可以。

en: &59 Should've thought of it myself.
&2345 How about... "intense."
&60 Hm. I see where you're coming from, but it doesn't mean COLD does it?
zh: &60 嗯，我明白你的意思，但它不表示“冷”，对吧？

en: &61 But I did get a chill down my spine when you said it, so maybe it'll work.
zh: &61 不过你说的时候我确实打了个寒颤，所以也许能行。

en: &2346 I think what you've got already works fine.
zh: &2346 我觉得你现在的用词已经不错了。

en: &62 Hm. Don't fix what isn't broken?
&63 Okay. Let's go with that. Moving on...
Madison set primer word
&64 Now this bit in the middle. I'm trying to describe the aroma of fresh basil.
zh: &64 现在看中间这段。我想描述新鲜罗勒的香气。

en: &65 I'm using the descriptor "fragrant", but that can imply a BAD smell as well as a nice one.
zh: &65 我用了“芬芳”，fragrant，可英文里这词不一定都指好闻，也可能用来说难闻。

en: &66 Any thoughts on what I could use instead?
zh: &66 你觉得我可以用什么词代替？

en: &67 I'm still torn on the word "fragrant." Am I being too precious?
zh: &67 “芬芳”，fragrant，我还是拿不准。我是不是太挑剔了？

en: &68 Is the word "savory" appropriate here? I usually associate that word with taste, not smell.
zh: &68 这里用“咸香”合适吗？我通常把这个词和味道联系起来，而不是气味。

en: &69 You don't think the word "aromatic" is a bit too fancy? I don't want to look like we're putting on airs.
zh: &69 你不觉得“芳香”这个词有点太花哨了吗？我不想显得我们装腔作势。

en: &70 The word "delicious." When I hear that word, I think of eating. Not smelling.
zh: &70 “美味”这个词。我听到它时想到的是吃，不是闻。

en: &71 Any ideas?
&2347 How about... "delicious?"
&72 Delicious. Hm. That is definitely what we are trying to get across.
zh: &72 美味。嗯，这确实是我们想表达的意思。

en: &2348 Maybe "savory" would work better?
&73 Savory... yeah. It just rolls off the tongue, doesn't it?
&2349 Let's get fancy. How about "aromatic."
zh: &2349 我们花哨一点，用“芳香”怎么样？

en: &74 Oooh. Breaking out the thesaurus.
&2350 I think you had the right idea with "fragrant."
zh: &2350 我觉得你原来用“芬芳”是对的。

en: &75 Yeah, I think it works too. Just instinct I guess.
zh: &75 对，我也觉得可以。大概是直觉吧。

en: &2351 I think it's perfect the way it is.
zh: &2351 我觉得现在这样已经很完美了。

en: &76 Flattery, huh?
&77 I like it. Moving on...
Madison set boom word
&78 Now towards the end here, I am describing how fast the demand is rising for products like ours.
zh: &78 现在接近尾声，我在描述对我们这类产品的需求增长有多快。

en: &79 The obvious choice would be to say "it's fast approaching", but the word "fast" can mean to not eat anything at all.
zh: &79 最直接的说法是“需求正快速增长”，可英文里的fast除了“快速”，还有“禁食”的意思。

en: &80 Any thoughts?
&81 The word "fast" can often mean to not eat anything at all, which is the opposite of what we want to imply.
zh: &81 英文里的fast也常表示“禁食”，跟我们想传达的意思正好相反。

en: &82 The word "speedily" is a bit of a tongue twister. I don't want to take any chances tripping over my words. Any ideas?
zh: &82 “迅速”，speedily，读起来有点拗口，我不想讲的时候打磕巴。有什么建议？

en: &83 The word "swiftly" doesn't roll off the tongue as much as I'd like. You have any other ideas?
zh: &83 “飞速”，swiftly，读起来没我想的那么顺口。还有别的建议吗？

en: &84 "Rapidly" is a good descriptor, but those hard consonants make me come across harsher than I'd like. Any other ideas?
zh: &84 “急速”，rapidly，用在这里不错，可几个辅音发音太硬，听起来有点凶。还有别的建议吗？

en: &2352 The word "fast" works for me. You should go back to that.
zh: &2352 我觉得“快速”挺好。你该用回这个词。

en: &85 Hm. Yeah. I'm overthinking it. Story of my life!
zh: &85 嗯，对，是我想太多了。我老这样！

en: &2353 How about "speedily?"
&86 "The demand is SPEEDILY approaching..."
&2354 How about "swiftly?"
&87 "The demand is SWIFTLY approaching..."
&2355 How about "rapidly?"
&88 "The demand is RAPIDLY approaching..."
&2356 It's fine the way it is.
&89 You mean keep it?
&90 Yeah. That works. I think.
&91 Thanks. Cassie was right to hire you.
zh: &91 谢谢。卡西雇你真是雇对了。

en: &2357 Yes it is.
&47 Right. Okay. Step into my office, then.
zh: &47 好的。那么，请进我的办公室。

en: &223 Music off!
&48 Hang tight a minute, okay, Sam?
&63 Sure.
&49 If it's not important, than it can wait.
&50 Hit me up after this presentation is done, okay?
zh: &50 等这个演示结束后再找我，好吗？

en: &3287 Is... everything going all right with Sam?
&51 All right? Sure sure.
&52 Oh who am I fooling, it's a tote disaster!
zh: &52 哦，我在骗谁呢，简直是一团糟！

en: &53 What was I thinking, bringing him in here?
zh: &53 我怎么想的，居然把他带进这里？

en: &3288 So why don't you take Sam out somewhere? A coffee or something?
zh: &3288 那你为什么不带萨姆出去走走？喝杯咖啡什么的？

en: &54 I would, but I have to give the presentation soon.
zh: &54 我想，但我很快就要做演示了。

en: &55 SOMEONE has to do it. I'm the only one who can.
zh: &55 总得有人来做。我是唯一能做的人。

en: &2360 Why don't you let Madison do the presentation instead?
zh: &2360 你为什么不改让麦迪逊做演示？

en: &56 I thought you said she was "indisposed?"
zh: &56 你不是说她“不方便来”吗？

en: &2361 Did I say that?
&57 Yeah.
&2362 Well, she's fine now. You should let her take care of it.
zh: &2362 好了，她现在没事了。你应该让她来处理。

en: &58 And let her think I can't hack it? No. I'm here. I'll do the job.
zh: &58 然后让她觉得我搞不定？不。我来了。我会完成工作。

en: &2363 Maybe Cassie can take care of the presentation for you?
zh: &2363 也许卡西可以帮你做演示？

en: &59 Cassie...?
&60 Ha. No. She's smart, and does a lot around here, but I don't think so.
zh: &60 哈。不。她很聪明，在这里做了很多事，但我觉得不行。

en: &61 I built all this. I can handle it.
zh: &61 这一切都是我建立的。我能应付。

en: &2364 When does the presentation start?
&62 Hm. Good question.
&63 Less than an hour. Yep. Not enough time.
zh: &63 不到一个小时。对。时间不够。

en: &64 Anyway is that all?
&2365 Yes, that's all.
&65 Right. Back to the grind.
&2366 I'm almost positive you have time to take Sam out for coffee.
zh: &2366 我几乎可以肯定你有时间带萨姆出去喝杯咖啡。

en: &66 I told you. There isn't enough time.
&67 I'll even check again.
&68 Wait, WHAT?
&69 I'm losing it. I really am.
&2367 Is everything all right?
&70 You bet it is. I have PLENTY of time!
&71 I'm just gonna, um, pop out for a bit.
&2368 Sure. Have fun.
&72 Oh I WILL!
&3289 But things were going so well. Weren't they?
zh: &3289 但事情一直很顺利。不是吗？

en: &75 Yeah. OUTSIDE. Not in the workplace. We were on equal footing.
zh: &75 是啊，那是在外面，又不是在公司。我们当时是平等的。

en: &76 Talking to him in here? It throws off the whole dynamic.
zh: &76 在这里跟他说话？整个氛围都不对了。

en: &77 Every time I try to make a move I feel like a total creep.
zh: &77 我一想主动接近他，就觉得自己像个十足的变态。

en: &3290 That's very attentive of you, but I don't think he'll mind if you ask him out now.
zh: &3290 你想得很周到，但我觉得你现在约他出去，他不会介意的。

en: &78 Come ON. Asking for a date in the workplace? Complete glitchgoblin move.
zh: &78 拜托，在公司里约人？那不是个故障小丑吗。

en: &3291 But he doesn't work here.
&79 Doesn't matter. I just seize up.
zh: &79 那也没用，我就是开不了口。

en: &80 Anyway, this isn't anyone's problem but mine.
zh: &80 总之，这只是我自己的问题。

en: &3292 That's all. Thanks for meeting with me.
&2372 They gave you a faulty card, didn't they?
zh: &2372 他们给了你一张有问题的卡，对吧？

en: &64 Well, yeah. But mistakes happen.
&2373 You said they were one of the best agencies in the city.
zh: &2373 你说过他们是城里最好的中介之一。

en: &65 Well, "best" is subjective, but I've never worked with one better.
zh: &65 嗯，“最好”是主观的，但我没合作过更好的。

en: &2374 They've been around a long time. 30 years or more, you said?
zh: &2374 他们开了很久了。你说三十多年？

en: &66 Yeah. Since the 2010s at least.
zh: &66 是啊。至少从2010年代就开始了。

en: &2375 When you're done here, you're going to write a paper about what you did?
zh: &2375 这份工作结束后，你要写篇论文，讲讲自己都做了什么？

en: &67 Sure. It's how they make sure we learned something from our time here.
zh: &67 对，这样他们才知道我在这里学到了东西。

en: &2376 They give out more work credits than anyone, you said?
zh: &2376 你说他们给的工读学分比谁都多？

en: &68 Yeah they do. It's why they are so selective about who they pick.
zh: &68 对，所以他们挑人也特别严格。

en: &2377 Actually, never mind.
&69 Yeah. The idea is silly.
&70 But how is that proof they sent me here to steal secrets?
zh: &70 但这怎么能证明他们派我来是为了窃取机密？

en: &2378 Well, think about where they sent you.
zh: &2378 你想想他们把你派到了哪儿。

en: &71 You mean Leaves? What about them?
zh: &71 你是说“叶子”？他们怎么了？

en: &2379 Their card scanner doesn't work.
&72 Yeah, I noticed.
&2380 They are about to get a big investment from Roy Rockcamp.
zh: &2380 他们马上要从罗伊·罗克坎普那里拿到一大笔投资。

en: &73 Really. You have insider info, huh? No wonder they need extra help.
zh: &73 真的？你有内幕消息啊？难怪他们需要额外人手。

en: &2381 Their security is quite tight. They won't even let you bring in a phone.
zh: &2381 他们的安保相当严密，连手机都不让你带进去。

en: &74 Yeah. I had to leave mine at home. Very annoying.
zh: &74 是啊，我只好把手机留在家里。烦死了。

en: &2382 They are hiring temps.
&75 I mean, obviously.
&2383 Their office building is extremely nice, wouldn't you say?
zh: &2383 他们的办公楼特别气派，你不觉得吗？

en: &76 It is, yeah.
&77 But I don't see what that has to do with STP giving me a faulty card.
zh: &77 但我不明白这跟 STP 给我一张坏卡有什么关系。

en: &78 But I don't see what that has to do with STP being one of the best agencies.
zh: &78 但我不明白这跟 STP 是最好的中介之一有什么关系。

en: &79 But I don't see what that has to do with STP being around for over 30 years.
zh: &79 但我不明白这跟 STP 已经干了三十多年有什么关系。

en: &80 But I don't see what that has to do with me writing a paper for my work credit.
zh: &80 但我不明白这跟我为了工读学分写报告有什么关系。

en: &81 But I don't see what that has to do with STP giving out more work credits than the competition.
zh: &81 但我不明白这跟 STP 给的工读学分比竞争对手多有什么关系。

en: &2384 Hm. Let me think about this for a minute...
&82 You do that.
&83 Wait a minute. I see what you're getting at.
zh: &83 等等。我明白你的意思了。

en: &84 You're saying STP takes our papers and uses them to steal company secrets?
zh: &84 你是说 STP 拿走我们的报告，用来窃取公司机密？

en: &2385 It's quite likely.
&85 But it's not like I'm writing about anything IMPORTANT.
zh: &85 但我写的又不是什么重要内容。

en: &86 And STP would get permission from their clients first, surely? They KNOW I'm doing it. They must.
zh: &86 可STP总会先问过客户吧？客户肯定知道我要写报告，对吧？

en: &2386 Are you sure about that?
&87 I'm... pretty sure?
&88 Freaking dang it. You're right. It makes no sense.
zh: &88 见鬼。你说得对。这根本说不通。

en: &7052 I'm sorry.
&89 Don't be. Jesus. I knew it was too good to be true.
zh: &89 别道歉。天哪。我就知道天下没有这种好事。

en: &97 *Sigh*.
&2387 Nothing. Never mind.
&91 Yeah. Agreed.
&2388 Since I'm going to be working here, what can you tell me about this place?
zh: &2388 既然我要在这里工作，你能给我介绍一下这地方吗？

en: &81 We're making anything and everything!
&92 Yes, anything and everything.
&93 PLUS a revolutionary salad packing and distribution system.
zh: &93 外加一套革命性的沙拉包装与配送系统。

en: &82 Which is what will earn us the funding to make anything and everything.
zh: &82 靠它才能拿到资金，以后就能想做什么做什么。

en: &2389 Do you need me to do anything?
&2390 That's why I'm here, after all.
zh: &2390 毕竟我在这儿就是为了这个。

en: &2391 Because I'm a temp.
&83 Hm. The agency said you have a background in engineering, yeah?
zh: &83 嗯。中介说你学过工程，对吧？

en: &2392 That is... what the agency said. Yes.
&84 See if you can fix this drone.
zh: &84 看看你能不能修好这架无人机。

en: &94 Benj, that's YOUR job.
&85 She's gotta earn those work credits somehow, right?
zh: &85 她总得想办法挣点工读学分，对吧？

en: &86 Go on. Have a look-see.
&2393 So about this presentation you're giving...
zh: &2393 关于你要做的这个演示……

en: &95 You're well informed.
&96 We're streaming our product demonstration to potential investors.
zh: &96 我们要把产品演示直播给潜在投资人。

en: &87 Again.
&88 Every day we show off the tech. And every day we are rewarded with silence.
zh: &88 每天展示技术，每天都是没人搭理。

en: &97 This is a marathon, Benji. Not a sprint.
zh: &97 这是马拉松，本吉。不是短跑。

en: &89 Still don't see why we can't just pre-record it.
zh: &89 还是不明白为什么不能直接录播。

en: &98 A recording can't answer questions or sign a contract, Benj.
zh: &98 录像没法回答问题，也没法签合同，本吉。

&92 Not since that one time in college.

&94 Not really.

en: &300 Thanks.

zh: &119 还是别管她了。就算我能把她叫醒，她也会闹一个小时脾气。那种状态根本没法做演示。

en: &4200 You should give the presentation yourself.
&121 Me? No. I couldn't possibly.

en: &128 No. No, I wasn't. If they knew about Rockcamp it would be non-stop meltdowns.
zh: &128 不。不，我没有。如果他们知道罗克坎普的事，就会不停地崩溃。

en: &129 I did the right thing.
&4203 There's only one thing for it. Give the presentation yourself.
zh: &4203 只有一个办法。你自己来做演示。

en: &130 Me? I mean, I hate going over their heads...
zh: &130 我？可是，我不想越过他们擅自做主……

en: &4204 Like it or not, you're the one in charge now.
zh: &4204 不管你喜不喜欢，现在你是负责人。

en: &131 Me... in charge? I guess I am.
&4205 So. You have a choice. Are you going to work for your future? Or just let it pass you by?
zh: &4205 那你自己选。是争一争自己的未来，还是眼看着机会溜走？

en: &132 Jesus. What a way to put it.
&133 I guess there's only one choice to make.
&134 Okay. Okay. I can do this.
&135 Wish me luck.
&4206 Well, Nozzo?
&1361 Waiting for the ripples to level out...
&77 Okay. Here we go.

zh: &1362 根据档案，卡西做了演示，从罗克坎普那里获得了资金，并成为了新的CEO。

en: &1363 She re-branded as "CassaNetics". Still a Fortune 500 company to this day.
zh: &1363 她将公司更名为“卡萨奈蒂克斯”。至今仍是财富500强企业。

en: &4207 So we did it.
&1364 Yeah. We did it.
&4208 Thank you, Nozzo. For indulging me.
zh: &4208 谢谢你，诺佐，肯由着我这么做。

en: &1365 It's... all right.
&1366 But let's not make a habit of this, okay? Get back to the landing point.
zh: &1366 但别养成习惯，好吗？回跃迁落点去。

en: &4628 No. I can't leave.
&4629 No. I'm stuck here.
&4630 No. I wish I could.
&136 Huh? Oh. Right.

en: &4631 Yes. Sure. That's it.
&138 Well, here's some good news.
&139 We secured our funding!
&4633 What a surprise.
&4634 Total shock.
&140 I know! I thought I'd fall apart when the stream went live, but when the moment came...
zh: &140 我知道！直播开始的时候我还以为我会崩溃，但那一刻到来时……

en: &141 Something just clicked! And here we are.
zh: &141 到那个节骨眼上，我突然就会了！这不，就成了。

en: &142 I'm meeting Roy Rockcamp at Vantini's right now to go over the paperwork.
zh: &142 我现在正要去万蒂尼餐厅见罗伊·罗克坎普，处理文件的事。

en: &143 There's gonna be a lot of changes around here.
&4635 Right. Changes.
&144 Anyway, looks like you have run of the place.
zh: &144 这下这里只有你一个人了，随你吧。

en: &145 Lock up when you clock out. And don't wake Madison up unless you want your head bitten off.
zh: &145 下班时锁好门。还有，除非你想被骂得狗血淋头，否则别叫醒麦迪逊。

en: &146 First thing tomorrow I'll call the agency and talk to them about bumping you to full time.
zh: &146 明天一早，我就给中介打电话，谈谈把你转成全职的事。

en: &4636 Full time?
&147 Sure. We need to scale up. Quickly!
zh: &147 当然。我们需要扩大规模。要快！

zh: &148 说到快，我得走了。要做的事太多了！

en: &149 Bye, Fia!

&4638 That can't blasting happen. I need to get home.
&5258 So why salads?
&1811 Proof of work. They wanted to show what they were capable of.
zh: &1811 为了证明他们能做出成果，让投资人看到他们的本事。

en: &1812 Once they secured their funding, they parleyed their technology and know-how into a whole range of products.
zh: &1812 拿到资金后，他们利用自己的技术和专业知识，推出了一系列产品。

en: &5142 Can you print me an access card to this place?

zh: &5146 别担心。我会想办法的。不管怎样。

zh: &5257 所以我现在是个办公室临时工了。

en: &1823 It can't handle that. So it melts down.
zh: &1823 它处理不了，所以会熔毁。

&1824 This is why they should normally be avoided.

&8070 I know.

&5251 Okay, Fia. I believe in you.

en: &5242 I'm not a loose cannon.

&5256 So are you doing all right?
&5253 Right. Stupid question.

&202 Maybe.

&8003 Everything's fine.

&3818 Who's there?!

&208 Er. What's going on?

&3821 I know that's you, Hanna. Let's just talk about this.

&507 Huh? What are-

&8006 Cover your ears?
&550 Cover my wha-

&510 I... okay. Okay. Staying put.
&8009 We make a run for it.

zh: &511 好。跑吧。好主意。往哪儿跑？

en: &8010 We split up. Maybe that will confuse her?
zh: &8010 我们分开跑。也许能迷惑她？

en: &512 So one of us still gets shot?
zh: &512 那不还是有一个人要挨枪子？

en: &8011 Do you trust me or what?
&513 Okay. This is crazy, but whatever.
zh: &513 好吧。这太疯狂了，不过随便吧。

en: &514 Who goes where?
&8012 Let me think a moment. There's got to be some way out of this.
zh: &8012 让我想想。肯定有办法脱身。

en: &515 Sure. Sure. I'm... not going anywhere.

&8023 Any ideas, Noz?
&1042 Still running predictive models, but...

zh: &1044 所以我的建议？继续往左跑。

zh: &3822 我不能把伊曼妮留在这儿等死！

zh: &1047 现在你只需要担心，嗯，你自己。

zh: &1048 再在周围找找。肯定有什么东西。

en: &1049 Running in the same direction is not the best strategy.
zh: &1049 往同一个方向跑不是最好的策略。

zh: &1050 你得迷惑她。也许分开跑？

zh: &1051 躲在长椅后面是个糟糕的主意。你们在那儿就是活靶子。

en: &1052 So my suggestion? Move!

zh: &4 这是什么黑客帝国见鬼的……

zh: &1053 还在疯狂飙升。越接近历史事件只会越糟。

zh: &1054 没法知道是汉娜死，还是伊曼妮，还是伊冯娜，或者三个都死。

&6023 I'll be here.

&8015 Doesn't matter. Just move!
&517 Okay. Here I go.

zh: &8016 你躲到那棵树后面。我跑进那条巷子。

en: &518 But what about you?
&8017 I'll be fine. Just move!
&3826 Blast it, NO!
&8018 Never mind. I'll think of another idea.
&8019 There's an alley down that way. With a lowered fire escape.
zh: &8019 那边有条小巷。有放下来的消防梯。

en: &8020 If we can make it there, we'll be safe.
zh: &8020 只要能到那里，我们就安全了。

en: &519 Okay. Okay. Let's do this.
&3826 Blast it. No!
&8021 We'll take cover behind that tree.
&8022 Never mind. I'll think of something else.
&3828 Stop right there.
&3829 You're too late.
&8 Huh?
&9 I told you not to follow me.
&10 Now I have to...
&11 Why did you have to follow me?
&3830 I came to stop you.
&12 Damn it. Everyone wants to be a hero.
&13 News flash. There's no such thing.
zh: &13 告诉你，根本就没有英雄。

en: &3831 You don't want to do this.
&14 Course I don't WANT to do this.
&15 But we don't always get what we want.
&3832 I need to save my friend.
&16 Sorry, but it's too late for her.
zh: &16 抱歉，对她来说已经太迟了。

en: &17 Nothing either of us can do about it.
&18 Look. I don't want anyone else involved in this. I still don't.
zh: &18 听着。我不想把别人卷进来。现在也是。

en: &2 You don't know me. I don't know you.
zh: &2 你不认识我。我也不认识你。

en: &3 So... last chance. Just walk away.
&3833 This won't work. You'll never catch her.
zh: &3833 这行不通的。你永远抓不到她。

en: &19 Her days are numbered. It's just a matter of time.
zh: &19 她日子不多了。只是时间问题。

en: &20 And speaking of time, I'm on the clock.
&21 You're in my way. Sorry. I did warn you.
zh: &21 你挡我道了。抱歉。我警告过你的。

en: &3834 She's got too much of a head start. She's long gone by now.
zh: &3834 她早就跑远了，你追不上。

en: &22 I'll find her. I am very good at my job.
zh: &22 我会找到她的。我很擅长我的工作。

en: &3835 THIS is part of your job?
zh: &3835 这也是你工作的一部分？

en: &23 It's not in the job description, but yeah. It is.
zh: &23 岗位职责里没写，可也是我的工作。

en: &24 And you're preventing me from doing it. Sorry.
&3836 You don't have to do this, Hanna. You can still walk away.
zh: &3836 你不必这么做，汉娜。你还可以走开。

en: &25 Not an option.
&26 Wait.
&27 You said my name.
&28 How the hell do you know my name?
zh: &28 你到底怎么知道我名字的？

en: &3837 I know more than that.
&29 Oh yeah? Like what.
&30 WHAT?
&3839 You trigger happy IDIOT.
&31 What did you call me?
&3840 You heard.
&32 You think I want to do this?
&3841 Does it matter? You're not exactly stopping.
&33 And neither are you!
&34 Damn it, I warned you!
&3842 Okay. I'm walking away.
&3843 No need for anymore bloodshed.
&35 God, you really are DUMB.
&36 What the...
&4016 You call yourself Hanna Tanner, but that's not your real name.
zh: &4016 你自称汉娜·坦纳，但那不是你的真名。

en: &37 Jesus. You really do know too much.
zh: &37 老天。你知道的确实太多了。

en: &38 I... can't take any chances.
&39 I'm sorry.
&4017 You're a police officer.
&40 And let me guess. You think cops aren't supposed to do this kind of thing.
zh: &40 让我猜猜。你觉得警察不该干这种事。

en: &4018 Unfortunately, my experience shows otherwise.
zh: &4018 可惜，我遇到过的警察并不是这样。

en: &41 Then you should know better.
&4019 You are planning to murder two people.
&42 You're wrong about that.
&4020 I am? There's another target?
&43 There is NOW.
&4021 You are planning to murder your best friend.
zh: &4021 你正打算杀你最好的朋友。

en: &44 I... don't know what you're talking about.
&4022 Yvonne Lozzotti. Your former roommate. Currently a journalist for the Village Eye.
zh: &4022 伊冯娜·洛佐蒂。你以前的室友。现在是《村眼》的记者。

en: &4023 She got too close to the truth and now she's a target.
zh: &4023 她太接近真相了，所以现在成了目标。

en: &46 ...it's not my fault. She pissed off the wrong people.
zh: &46 ……这不是我的错。她惹了不该惹的人。

en: &47 If it wasn't me doing this, it would be someone else.
zh: &47 就算我不做，也会有别人来做。

en: &48 It sucks that it's me. It's not fair.
zh: &48 偏偏要我动手，太混账了。这不公平。

en: &49 But it is what it is.
&4024 This is going to haunt you forever.
zh: &4024 你一辈子都忘不了这件事。

en: &4025 Whether you kill her or someone else, it's going to define your whole life.
zh: &4025 不管是你杀了她，还是别人动手，你这辈子都摆脱不了。

en: &4026 You don't want that, do you?
&50 I don't want a lot of things.
&4027 She's your best friend.
&51 You think that matters?
&52 What happens if I walk away? She'd still be dead. And I'd be dead too.
zh: &52 如果我走开会怎样？她还是会死。而我也一样会死。

en: &4028 Just wait a day.
&4029 Wait a day. Tomorrow, it won't matter. Winera will be gone.
zh: &4029 等一天就好。明天维内拉就没了，这件事也就没必要了。

en: &53 Wouldn't that be nice.
&4030 It's the truth.
&54 It's a fairy-tale.
&55 You can't fight the system. Might as well fight the whole world.
zh: &55 跟这套体制作对，就等于跟全世界作对。

en: &56 And when it's you against the world? The world always wins.
zh: &56 当你一个人对抗全世界时？赢的总是世界。

en: &57 Now. Last warning. Out of my way.
zh: &57 现在。最后警告。别挡我的路。

en: &4031 You don't want this.
&4032 Please, Hanna. See reason.
&58 You don't get it. I am not going to change my mind.
zh: &58 你不明白。我是不会改变主意的。

en: &357 She's not lying.
&358 She's never going to change her mind.
&7144 Hanna?
&359 Hey. Glad you're alive.
&360 But... it doesn't seem to have made a difference.
&361 No good deed goes unpunished and all. Should know that by now.
zh: &361 好心没好报嘛，早该懂了。

en: &362 But I'm holding on. It hurts like hell, but I'm holding on.
zh: &362 我还撑得住，疼得要命，可我还在撑。

en: &4034 Nozzo, what's happening?
&1072 She's paradoxing and her PFE is failing.
zh: &1072 她正在发生悖论，她的PFE快失效了。

en: &1073 We can stabilize her here at HQ. Make sure she keeps her memory, at the very least.
zh: &1073 我们可以在总部稳定她的状况。至少确保她保留记忆。

en: &1074 Get her to the landing point. Now.
&60 Who... what...
&363 Shut up. Just... shut up.
&364 I thought stopping the first would fix it. Wipe the slate clean.
zh: &364 我以为阻止第一次，就能把一切改回来，把过去一笔勾销。

en: &365 But you just can't stop yourself, can you?
zh: &365 可你就是控制不住自己，对吧？

en: &4035 We need to go. Now.
&366 Go back to THAT life? No.
&4036 Aren't you supposed to be in jail?
&367 Heh. No. Not yet. Maybe in ten years.
zh: &367 呵。不。还没有。也许十年后吧。

en: &4037 Leave her alone. I stopped her. Stopped you.
zh: &4037 离她远点。我阻止了她。也阻止了你。

en: &368 That's just it. She doesn't stop.
zh: &368 问题就在这。她不会停手。

en: &4038 You aren't making any sense.
&4039 How did you get out of prison?
zh: &4039 你是怎么从监狱出来的？

en: &369 Look at me!
&371 I'm a ghost! Or close enough it makes no difference.
zh: &371 我是个幽灵！或者说，跟幽灵也差不多了。

en: &372 Nobody at the Tombs could see me. They couldn't even HEAR me.
zh: &372 在坟墓监狱里没人能看见我。他们甚至听不到我。

en: &373 So I just walked out.
zh: &373 所以我就直接走了出来。

en: &374 And now... my memory's changing. I'm becoming HER.
zh: &374 而现在……我的记忆在改变。我正在变成她。

en: &375 Sixty years of HER.
&376 But not yet. I still have time.
zh: &376 但还没到时候。我还有时间。

en: &4040 I had this under control.
&377 You didn't. You really didn't.
&4041 What exactly are you DOING?
&378 What does it look like?
&4042 Your memory is changing?
&379 Fading. SHE'S taking over.
zh: &379 我的记忆在消退，她的记忆正把它取代。

en: &380 My memories are all jumbled up, but I can still remember one thing clear as a bell.
zh: &380 我的记忆全都乱成一团，但有一件事我记得清清楚楚。

en: &381 Doesn't matter what you say. She kills you. Just shoots and walks away.
zh: &381 你说什么都没用，她会杀了你。开枪，然后就走。

en: &382 Leaves you for dead in this alley. Never looks back.
zh: &382 把你扔在这条巷子里等死，连头都不回。

en: &383 After that, it... just gets easier.
zh: &383 从那以后，下手就……越来越容易了。

en: &61 What... are... you... talking... about?
&384 Murder. Extortion. Blackmail.
&385 She doesn't stop. I never stop.
zh: &385 她不会停手。我也不会停手。

en: &386 I... SHE... just does whatever they ask.
zh: &386 我……她……只是照他们说的做。

en: &4043 Nozzo, is this all true?
&1075 Checking... yes. A RICO investigation in 2010 uncovered it all. Massive corruption scandal.
zh: &1075 正在查……是的。2010年的一项RICO调查把一切都查出来了。大规模腐败丑闻。

en: &1076 Hanna Tanaka was arrested, along with a handful of other co-conspirators.
zh: &1076 汉娜·田中和其他几名同谋一起被捕。

en: &387 A handful. There were DOZENS of us. In every precinct.
zh: &387 几名？我们有几十个人，每个分局都有。

en: &388 They made me... HER...  take the fall.
zh: &388 他们让我……让她……背了黑锅。

en: &389 Thirty years in prison. And after that...
&390 ...there was nothing.
&4044 Why do you... why does SHE... do this?
zh: &4044 你为什么……她为什么……要这么做？

en: &391 Because they paid her?
&392 Because she wanted to fit in?
zh: &392 因为她想跟大家打成一片？

en: &393 Because everyone else was doing it?
&4045 You told me that was because of the bribes. This is murder.
zh: &4045 你告诉我是因为贿赂。这可是谋杀。

en: &394 It was easier than saying no. Each time, it got easier.
zh: &394 比说“不”容易多了，做一次，下次就更容易。

en: &395 I thought by stopping her here, the first time she did it, before she got a taste for it...
zh: &395 我以为在这里阻止她，在她第一次这么做的时候，在她尝到甜头之前……

en: &396 But no. Nothing's changed. I can remember it all.
zh: &396 但没用。什么都没变。我全都记得。

en: &4046 So this is your answer. You're going to shoot yourself.
zh: &4046 所以你想的办法，就是开枪杀了过去的自己？

en: &397 That woman is NOT ME.
&398 Not yet.
&399 And it's never going to be.
&4047 You'll destroy your whole life. Everything you are. Is that what you want?
zh: &4047 你会毁掉自己的一生。你的一切。这就是你想要的吗？

en: &400 Everything I am is gone!
&401 Do you know what my... her life is like now?
zh: &401 你知道我的……她的生活现在是什么样吗？

en: &402 No friends. No family. None who'll speak to us, anyway.
zh: &402 没有朋友。没有家人。至少没有愿意和我们说话的人。

en: &403 Living in a basement. Working at a grocery store check-out lane.
zh: &403 住在地下室。在杂货店收银台工作。

en: &404 Just a sad, miserable old lady and a legacy of shame.
zh: &404 只剩一个可悲又痛苦的老太婆，留下的全是耻辱。

en: &405 You know the worst part? She doesn't even regret doing it. Just that she got caught.
zh: &405 最糟的是什么，你知道吗？她压根不后悔做过那些事，只后悔被人抓到了。

en: &406 I can't become that. I won't.
zh: &406 我不能变成那样。我绝不会。

en: &407 I'd rather be nothing at all.
&4048 What about the good you've done?
zh: &4048 那你做过的那些好事呢？

en: &4049 You said it yourself. You "put a lot of bad guys away".
zh: &4049 你自己说过，你“把很多坏人送进了监狱”。

en: &4050 If you do this, you'll never get it back.
zh: &4050 如果你这么做，就再也回不去了。

en: &408 That's the irony of it all.
&409 I checked the archive. When I felt my memory changing.
zh: &409 我感觉到记忆在变，就查了档案。

en: &410 All those bad guys I caught? Still caught. Put away by somebody else.
zh: &410 我抓的那些坏人，还是进了监狱，只不过是别人抓的。

en: &411 I thought I was so damn irreplaceable. Turns out I made no difference.
zh: &411 我还以为自己多他妈不可替代呢，原来有我没我都一样。

en: &4051 What about your friend Yvonne?
&4052 Or Imani?
&4053 With Winera gone, they're no longer a target. Right?
zh: &4053 维内拉不在了，她们就不再是目标了。对吧？

en: &412 I... she... doesn't kill them. Either of them.
zh: &412 我……她……没有杀她们。她们两个都没有。

en: &413 Yvonne lives. For whatever that's worth.
zh: &413 伊冯娜活下来了。可这又有什么用。

en: &4054 ChronoZen will compensate you. Don't worry.
zh: &4054 ChronoZen 会补偿你的。别担心。

en: &1077 Er, about that.
&7145 What?
&1078 Ms. Tanaka lied to us on her application, remember? The brass is already planning to sue for fraud.
zh: &1078 田中女士申请时对我们撒了谎，记得吧？高层已经准备以欺诈为由起诉她了。

en: &4055 So they're just going to leave her like this?
zh: &4055 所以他们就这样把她扔下不管了？

en: &1079 She can countersue and probably win, but...
zh: &1079 她可以反诉，而且很可能会赢，但是……

en: &415 It'll take years and astronomical legal fees. I know how this works.
zh: &415 那要花上好几年，还有天文数字的律师费。我知道这套把戏。

en: &4056 Don't make me stun you, Hanna.
&416 Please. I read your rulebook.
zh: &416 拜托。我读过你的规则手册。

en: &417 You and I both know that weapon won't work against me.
zh: &417 你我都清楚，那武器对我没用。

en: &1080 In most circumstances, yes.
&1081 But you've triggered the Grandfather Paradox Protocol. Supersedes everything else.
zh: &1081 但你已经触发了祖父悖论协议。它凌驾于一切之上。

en: &1082 The weapon knows that. It will fire just fine.
zh: &1082 武器系统能识别这一点，所以正常开火没问题。

en: &4057 We can still change things. You don't have to do this.
zh: &4057 我们还能改变现状。你不必这么做。

en: &418 I am open to ideas. As long as they're quick.
zh: &418 我愿意听你的想法。只要够快。

en: &420 ...fading fast.
&4058 I thought you'd be happier that Yvonne survived.
zh: &4058 我还以为伊冯娜活下来你会更高兴。

en: &421 At the cost of so many other lives.
zh: &421 以这么多其他人的生命为代价。

en: &422 When it was just my life? Sure. Fine. Fair trade. Whatever.
zh: &422 如果只是我自己的命？行。没问题。公平交易。随便。

en: &423 But to be disgraced like this? Ruined beyond redemption?
zh: &423 可要我这样身败名裂，彻底毁掉，再也没有回头路？

en: &424 No. Not fair at all.
&425 Better to have died tonight. Before it all went wrong.
zh: &425 还不如今晚就死了。在一切变糟之前。

en: &426 I need to do this. Please let me do this.
zh: &426 我必须这么做。请让我这么做。

en: &427 I'm begging you. Don't let me become... that.
zh: &427 我求你了。别让我变成……那样。

en: &4059 Blast it, Hanna.
&62 Huh? What's going on?
&63 Who's... this... old lady?
&4060 With luck, maybe you'll find out.
zh: &4060 运气好的话，也许你会知道的。

en: &1083 Fia. The ripples are starting to stabilize. Someone's about to report the gunfire.
zh: &1083 菲娅，涟漪开始稳定了。马上就会有人报告枪声。

en: &1084 The police will get there in about 15 minutes.
&4061 And they'll take care of young Hanna, here?
zh: &4061 那这儿年轻的汉娜就交给他们了？

en: &1085 Yes. She'll be fine. They have an EMT with them.
zh: &1085 会的。她会没事的。他们带了一名急救员。

en: &4062 Any other changes?
&1086 She still goes to prison in ten years, if that's what you mean.
zh: &1086 她十年后还是会进监狱，如果你指的是这个。

en: &64 Come... on. Help... me...
&4063 Help is on its way.
&65 Help?
&4064 Yes. And... I'm sorry, but you're going to need lots of it.
zh: &4064 是的，而且……很抱歉，以后你还有很多地方需要人帮。

en: &428 ARGH!
&429 It's done. It's over.
&430 I thought for sure you'd stop me.
zh: &430 我原以为你肯定会阻止我。

en: &4065 I tried to. I missed.
&431 You missed.
&4066 I'm a terrible shot.
&432 Huh. Maybe you should practice more.
&433 The range over on Essex is a good place for beginners.
zh: &433 埃塞克斯街上的射击场很适合初学者。

en: &434 They know me there. Just tell 'em I...
zh: &434 那儿的人认识我。就跟他们说我……

en: &435 Oh. Right.
&4067 We walk away. Just leave her.
zh: &4067 我们走吧。就让她留在这儿。

en: &4068 She's in no shape to kill anyone tonight.
zh: &4068 她今晚这状态杀不了任何人。

en: &436 That seems obvious, doesn't it? That was my plan.
zh: &436 这不是很明显吗？那就是我的计划。

en: &437 I have memories of doing just that, but it doesn't work.
zh: &437 我有这么做的记忆，但没用。

en: &438 Getting shot on the job just proves my loyalty. Winera might be gone, but there's plenty more just like 'em.
zh: &438 执行任务时挨了枪子，反倒证明了我的忠心。维内拉是没了，可跟他们一样的还有的是。

en: &439 I get a call. She says yes. The calls keep coming. I keep saying yes.
zh: &439 我接到一个电话。她答应了。电话不断打来。我一直答应。

en: &440 I mean, SHE keeps saying yes.
&441 Damn it. I can't hold on much longer.
&4069 Can't we change her mind? Right here and now?
zh: &4069 我们不能改变她的想法吗？就在此时此地？

en: &442 She can hear every word we're saying!
zh: &442 她能听见我们说的每一个字！

en: &443 How about it? You gonna change your ways? Walk the straight and narrow?
zh: &443 怎么样？你打算改过自新吗？走正道？

en: &444 Yeah. Didn't think so.
&445 I'm starting to remember this moment. From her side.
zh: &445 这一刻也开始变成我的记忆了，是从她那边看到的。

en: &446 She thinks this is just a dream. I'm barely gonna remember any of this.
zh: &446 她以为这只是一场梦。我几乎不会记得这些。

en: &447 I mean, SHE'S barely gonna remember. Damn it.
zh: &447 我是说，她几乎不会记得。该死。

en: &448 Nothing we say is gonna make a difference.
zh: &448 我们说什么都不会有用了。

en: &4070 We go home right now. Get you stabilized. Keep your memory intact.
zh: &4070 我们现在就回家。让你稳定下来。保住你的记忆。

en: &4071 Then we come back and find a proper way to fix this.
zh: &4071 然后我们再回来，找个合适的办法解决这件事。

en: &449 I told you. In my new life, I'm barely scraping by.
zh: &449 我告诉过你。在我的新生活里，我勉强糊口。

en: &450 I can't afford another trip.
&4072 Please. I can fix this. Just give me time.
zh: &4072 求你了。我能解决。给我点时间。

en: &451 No. This is my bed. I'll damn well lie in it.
zh: &451 不，这是我自己闯的祸，后果我自己担。

en: &452 I want to hate you. You had a second chance. You pissed it away. Made things so much worse.
zh: &452 我真想恨你。你有了重新来过的机会，却白白糟蹋了，害一切变得更糟。

en: &453 You're rotten to the core. But... you're me. I can't deny that.
zh: &453 你烂到骨子里了。但……你就是我。我无法否认。

en: &454 That rot was there all along.
zh: &454 原来我骨子里早就烂了。

en: &455 And now? There's only one way to get rid of it.
zh: &455 而现在？只有一种办法能摆脱它。

en: &3298 We're looking for your wife. Yvonne?
zh: &3298 我们在找你的妻子。伊冯娜？

en: &3299 We are friends of your wife, Yvonne.
zh: &3299 我们是你妻子伊冯娜的朋友。

en: &3300 We have reason to believe your wife is in... trouble.
zh: &3300 我们有理由相信你的妻子遇到了……麻烦。

en: &2 Oh.
&3 Well, Yvonne's not my problem anymore.
zh: &3 伊冯娜的事，已经不归我管了。

en: &4 So can you leave me alone, please?
zh: &4 所以请你们别来烦我，好吗？

en: &5 You're in my light.
&6 You don't get it. She's in serious danger.
zh: &6 你不明白。她处境非常危险。

en: &7 We need to find her. As soon as possible.
zh: &7 我们必须找到她。越快越好。

en: &6 *Sigh*
&7 Nope. Nope. I'm done.
&8 Whatever mess she's gotten into, she can clean it up herself.
zh: &8 她惹下的烂摊子，让她自己收拾。

en: &6207 Quite.
&2565 You don't seem concerned.
&9 Because I'm not.
&2566 I'm serious.
&10 Sure you are.
&2567 You don't believe us, do you?
&11 I didn't say that.
&12 It's just like I said. She's not my problem anymore.
zh: &12 我说过，她的事已经不归我管了。

en: &13 I've spent way too long being angry. I just want to focus on THIS.
zh: &13 我生气太久了。我只想专注于这个。

en: &14 Can I do that? Please?
zh: &14 能让我专心画画吗？拜托了。

en: &8 Wait. Are you and Yvonne having... problems?
zh: &8 等等。你和伊冯娜是不是……出了问题？

en: &15 Not that it's any of your business, but yeah.
zh: &15 虽然不关你的事，但没错。

en: &9 I had no idea. She never said.
zh: &9 我完全不知道。她从没说过。

en: &16 ...do we know you?
&10 Er, well-
&17 No. Forget it. I don't care.
&18 If you don't know, I'm not gonna tell you.
zh: &18 如果你不知道，那我也不会告诉你。

en: &2576 What are you painting?
&19 The arch. I've been obsessed with it since I was a kid.
zh: &19 拱门。我从小就对它着迷。

en: &20 Been sketching it for weeks. Figured it was time to dive in.
zh: &20 已经画了好几周草图。觉得是时候正式动笔了。

en: &21 So here I am.
&2577 What is it about the arch that obsesses you?
zh: &2577 拱门有什么让你这么着迷？

en: &22 The lines, the curves, the park beyond.
zh: &22 那些线条、曲线，还有后面的公园。

en: &23 The way it perfectly frames the Twin Towers.
zh: &23 还有从拱门里望过去，双子塔恰好框在里面的景象。

en: &24 I want to capture it all.
zh: &24 我想把这一切都画下来。

en: &25 I'm not quite there yet, but I'll get it one day.
zh: &25 我现在还差得远，但总有一天会画成的。

en: &2578 Yes. I'm... sure you will.
&26 Practice. That's all it takes.
&27 Yvonne used to make fun of me for liking it so much.
zh: &27 伊冯娜以前总笑话我这么喜欢它。

en: &28 But she can't make me feel bad about it anymore.
zh: &28 但她再也别想让我为此难受了。

en: &29 So I'm painting it.
&2579 Why are you so upset with Yvonne?
zh: &2579 你为什么对伊冯娜这么生气？

en: &30 Like I said. If you don't know, I'm not saying.
zh: &30 我说过了。如果你不知道，那我也不会说。

en: &2580 Your wife had an affair, didn't she?
&3301 With a woman named Em?
&31 That was one of them.
&3904 There was more than one?
&32 She didn't do much to hide it. It's like she wanted to get caught.
zh: &32 她几乎毫不掩饰。就像故意想被抓到一样。

en: &33 And now you know too. Great.
zh: &33 现在你也知道了。好极了。

en: &2582 What do you know about Ima... I mean, Em?
zh: &2582 你对伊……我是说，埃姆，了解多少？

en: &34 Only that she's some corporate type working in the World Trade Center.
zh: &34 只知道她是个在世贸中心上班的公司白领。

en: &35 How am I supposed to compete with that?
&37 Look. I come here to try and NOT think about it, okay?
zh: &37 听着。我来这儿就是为了不去想这些，行吗？

en: &2583 You're not thinking about your wife's mistress... by painting the World Trade Center where she works?
zh: &2583 你画她工作的世贸中心，还说没在想你妻子的情人？

en: &38 Okay. Fair point.
&39 Maybe I don't have to draw the Towers. Just the arch...
zh: &39 也许我不该画双子塔。只画拱门……

en: &40 No, screw that. I'm not letting her take this from me. I'm painting it all.
zh: &40 不，去他的。我不会让她把这也夺走。我要把一切都画下来。

en: &3302 I'm sorry about Yvonne.
&42 Hey, there are plenty of fish in the sea, right?
zh: &42 嘿，天涯何处无芳草，对吧？

en: &43 Sometimes I think I never should've left home.
zh: &43 有时候我觉得自己当初就不该离开家。

en: &44 Twobrook may have been in the middle of nowhere, but...
&45 Threebrook may have been in the middle of nowhere, but...
&46 Fourbrook may have been in the middle of nowhere, but...
&47 Fivebrook have been in the middle of nowhere, but...
&48 No. She won't drive me back there. I won't give her the pleasure.
zh: &48 不。我不会让她把我逼回那儿。我不会让她得意。

en: &3303 Are you familiar with Hanna Tanaka?
&49 Yvonne's cop friend? Not a lot.
zh: &49 伊冯娜的警察朋友？不太熟。

en: &50 I know they had a fling back in college. Before she met me.
zh: &50 我知道她们大学时有过一段。在她遇见我之前。

en: &3304 Oh. They did, did they?
&51 You didn't know that?
&3305 No I did not.
&12 Yeah. Well. You know. College.
&52 Look, if there's any drama here, I want no part of it. I just want to paint.
zh: &52 听着，如果这里有什么纠葛，我不想掺和。我只想画画。

en: &3306 What brook?
&54 Twobrook.
&55 Threebrook.
&56 Fourbrook.
&57 Fivebrook.
&58 Place I grew up. Little place on Long Island. More trees than people.
zh: &58 我长大的地方。长岛上的一个小地方。树比人多。

en: &59 And, as you can guess, more than one brook.
zh: &59 而且，你可以猜到，不止一条溪。

en: &60 That's the type of sizzling creativity I left behind.
zh: &60 瞧，我离开的老家，取名就是这么“有创意”。

en: &61 Never thought I'd miss it, but...
&62 No. I'm staying. Not giving her the pleasure.
zh: &62 不。我要留下。不让她得意。

en: &3307 We're going to go now, Dion.
&3308 I'm sorry about... everything.
&63 Nothing to be sorry about. I'm done with all of it.
zh: &63 没什么可抱歉的。这一切我都受够了。

en: &2595 Are you okay?
&13 Like I said. I'm always fine.
zh: &13 我说过了。我一直都很好。

en: &2596 Shall we go?
&14 Yeah. Yeah.
&15 I thought I'd feel something.
zh: &15 我还以为能感觉到点什么。

en: &2597 Something? Like what?
&16 I don't know. A tension in the air?
zh: &16 不知道，比如……气氛有点紧张？

en: &17 This whole city - the whole WORLD - is about to completely change.
zh: &17 这整座城市——整个世界——即将彻底改变。

en: &18 But it's just a normal day.
&2598 Every day is like any other, as far as time travel is concerned.
zh: &2598 就时间旅行而言，每一天都和其他日子一样。

en: &19 Hm. Just another case. Like police work I guess.
zh: &19 嗯。只是又一个案子。我猜就像警察的工作。

en: &2599 Tomorrow is the day that everything changes. Not today.
zh: &2599 明天才是改变一切的日子。不是今天。

en: &20 Yeah. One day at a time. Just like police work.
zh: &20 是啊。一天一天来。就像警察的工作。

en: &2600 Are you absolutely sure you're all right?
&2601 I've known other clients who react... strongly to seeing those towers.
zh: &2601 有些客户一看到双子塔，反应就……很强烈。

en: &21 I told you, I'm fine. Police work trains you for this kind of thing.
zh: &21 说了我没事，警察受过训练，知道怎么应对这种情况。

en: &22 Gotta stay dispassionate. Keep that distance. That's how you get through it.
zh: &22 得保持冷静，别投入感情，才能撑过去。

en: &3309 No distractions, you mean?
&23 Yeah. That's how it's supposed to work.
&2602 And does it?
&24 Would I be here if it did?
zh: &24 如果真管用，我还会在这里吗？

en: &25 Anyway. I'm ready when you are.
zh: &25 总之。我准备好了，就等你。

en: Hanna impatiently waits for you.
&2603 You want to find a place to sit? Get a coffee somewhere?
zh: &2603 你想找个地方坐坐吗？去喝杯咖啡？

en: &26 I'm FINE. Jesus. I'm not some delicate flower.
zh: &26 我没事，天哪，又不是个娇滴滴的人。

en: &27 Although, I definitely was back then.
&2604 That must've been terrible.
&28 I wanna say I wasn't ready, but how could anyone be ready for that?
zh: &28 我想说我没准备好，但面对那种事，谁能准备好呢？

en: &2605 It wasn't inconsequential to you.
zh: &2605 那件事对你并不是无关紧要。

en: &29 I was just a dumb socket back then. Practically a kid.
zh: &29 那时候我只是个傻乎乎的菜鸟。几乎还是个孩子。

en: &30 I was naive as hell. Not every case gets priority. I get that.
zh: &30 我天真得要命。不是每个案子都能优先处理。我明白。

en: &31 But this one? It didn't even have a chance.
zh: &31 可这个案子呢？连被查一查的机会都没有。

en: &32 "Never forget," they said.
&33 Well, I didn't.
&34 And here I am.
Alley
&2606 So I suppose we wait here?
zh: &2606 所以我想我们就在这里等？

en: &2607 It's where the murder was committed. And we know roughly when it happened. So my assumption was that we'd just... wait?
zh: &2607 凶案就发生在这里，时间我们也大致清楚。所以我想，只要……等着？

en: &36 Wait, huh?
&37 I suppose that's... one option.
&38 But come on. I'm an old lady. You're untrained. A hundred things could go wrong.
zh: &38 可我都这把年纪了，你又没受过训练，会出错的地方可多了。

en: &3310 I've held my own in worse situations.
zh: &3310 我在更糟的情况下也能应付。

en: &39 While holding that fancy weapon of yours, no doubt.
zh: &39 那肯定是有你那把厉害的武器在手吧。

en: &40 Pew.
&3311 Not... every time.
&41 We only get one shot at this. So we hit him where he lives.
zh: &41 我们只有一次机会。所以我们要直捣他的老巢。

en: &904 His archive data has been redacted. We don't know where he lived.
zh: &904 他的档案被隐去了，我们查不到他的住址。

en: &42 Please. You forget who you're talking to.
zh: &42 拜托。你忘了你在跟谁说话。

en: &43 Collect enough favors, and nothing stays redacted for long.
zh: &43 攒够人情，没有什么能长期保密。

en: &44 He lives in a cheap room in some dinky brownstone called the Essex House. It's not far.
zh: &44 他住在一栋叫埃塞克斯公寓的破旧褐石楼里的廉价房间。离这儿不远。

en: New location:[Nick Chord[Essex House
zh: 新地点：[尼克·科德[埃塞克斯公寓

en: &3312 You said you discovered the body. What were you doing here?
zh: &3312 你说你发现了尸体。你当时在这里做什么？

en: &45 This block was part of my regular rounds.
zh: &45 我平常就负责巡逻这一带。

en: &46 Yvonne lived in the neighborhood, too. She said it was just a coincidence, but I think she just wanted to be near me.
zh: &46 伊冯娜也住在那附近。她说这只是巧合，但我觉得她只是想离我近一点。

en: &47 At least, that's what I'd like to believe.
&2610 Can you tell me about Yvonne?
zh: &2610 你能跟我说说伊冯娜吗？

en: &48 We roomed together in college. Hofstra.
zh: &48 我们大学时是室友。霍夫斯特拉大学。

en: &49 I wasn't happy there, but she was nice. We got along.
zh: &49 我在那儿过得不开心，但她人很好。我们相处得不错。

en: &50 Even when I dropped out the first year and enrolled in the academy, she kept in touch.
zh: &50 即使我第一年就退学，进了警校，她也一直和我保持联系。

en: &51 Emailed me every week. Making sure I was okay.
zh: &51 每周都给我发邮件，确认我一切都好。

en: &52 Annoying as hell, but... anyway.
&3313 I know that the murder wasn't investigated, but surely you looked into it yourself?
zh: &3313 我知道那起谋杀案没有立案调查，但你自己肯定查过吧？

en: &53 I was a fresh-faced beat cop. You think I had the clout to go off on my own?
zh: &53 那时候我就是个刚入行的巡警，哪有权力自己去查？

en: &54 By the time I rose through the ranks, the case was too cold. And the world had... changed.
zh: &54 等我升上去，案子早就成了冷案，世界也已经……变了。

en: &55 *Sigh*
&2612 Do you have any theories about why Yvonne was killed?
zh: &2612 关于伊冯娜被杀的原因，你有什么推测吗？

en: &56 So many you have no idea. There's no evidence for any of them.
zh: &56 太多了，你都想不到。但没有一个能找到证据。

en: &57 But the "why" doesn't matter anymore.
zh: &57 不过“为什么”已经不重要了。

en: &58 I just care about IF.
zh: &58 我只在乎她能不能活下来。

en: &2613 What was this alley like when you found it?
zh: &2613 你当时赶到这条巷子，是什么情况？

en: &2614 What was the alley like when you found it?
zh: &2614 你当时赶到这条巷子，是什么情况？

en: &59 About the same. Aside from Yvonne's body. And the... smell.
zh: &59 差不多还是那样。除了伊冯娜的尸体。还有那股……气味。

en: &60 Yvonne had her wallet. About 80 bucks in it. A few credit cards.
zh: &60 伊冯娜的钱包还在。里面大约有80美元，还有几张信用卡。

en: &61 She was wearing a silver necklace. And her wedding ring.
zh: &61 她戴着一条银项链，还有结婚戒指。

en: &2616 So Nick Chord's motive wasn't robbery.
zh: &2616 所以尼克·科德的动机不是抢劫。

en: &62 Sure. We know that NOW, thanks to his confession. We didn't know it then. Not for certain.
zh: &62 当然。我们现在知道了，多亏了他的供词。但当时我们不知道，没法确定。

en: &2617 How did you get inside the house the first time?
zh: &2617 你第一次是怎么进到房子里的？

en: &2618 The door was locked. Did you break in that time as well?
zh: &2618 门是锁着的。那次你也是破门而入的吗？

en: &64 Oh. Honestly? I don't remember.
&65 I think the door was unlocked?
&2619 It was?
&66 Yeah that must've been it. And it makes sense, doesn't it?
zh: &66 对，肯定是这样。而且这也说得通，不是吗？

en: &67 Afer all, we unlocked it ourselves.
zh: &67 毕竟，是我们自己开的锁。

en: &2620 It doesn't quite work like that, but it's probably not important.
zh: &2620 事情不是这么运作的，不过那可能也不重要。

en: &3314 Why did Yvonne feel the need to check in on you?
zh: &3314 伊冯娜为什么觉得需要关心你的情况？

en: &68 Because I was a New York cop in the 90s, that's why.
zh: &68 因为我是90年代的纽约警察，这就是原因。

en: &69 And not just any cop. Back then you could count the officers who looked like me on one hand.
zh: &69 而且不是一般的警察。那时候，像我这样的警官一只手就数得过来。

en: &70 Yvonne worried that the pressure would get to me.
zh: &70 伊冯娜担心压力会把我压垮。

en: &3315 And did it?
&71 I've made it to retirement age, so I'm gonna say no.
zh: &71 我都活到退休年龄了，那就算没有吧。

en: &3316 What about Yvonne's husband? Dion, you said?
zh: &3316 那伊冯娜的丈夫呢？你说他叫迪翁？

en: &72 I know what you're thinking. That's a dead end. Dion's a good dude.
zh: &72 我知道你在想什么，可查他没用，迪翁是个好人。

en: &73 Or... maybe he WAS? I have no idea if he's still alive.
zh: &73 或者该说，他曾经是好人？我都不知道他现在还活着没有。

en: &74 Anyway, I talked to him. Unofficially. At Yvonne's funeral and stuff. He was clean.
zh: &74 我私下找他聊过，在伊冯娜葬礼上之类的场合。他没问题。

en: &75 But it's not like I've been right about anything so far.
zh: &75 但到目前为止，我还没对过任何事。

en: &76 Damn it. They always say you shouldn't work cases you're personally involved in. This is why.
zh: &76 该死，都说查案别牵扯私人感情，这就是原因。

en: &3317 What did Nick Chord's confession actually say?
zh: &3317 尼克·科德的供词到底说了什么？

en: &77 Here. I have a copy handy. You should probably read it.
zh: &77 给。我手边有份副本。你最好读一下。

en: &3318 Nick Chord was a killer for hire?
&3319 What did your friend get mixed up in?
zh: &3319 你的朋友卷进了什么事？

en: &78 Don't know. Doesn't matter.
&79 We stop Nick, Yvonne doesn't die.
zh: &79 我们阻止尼克，伊冯娜就不会死。

en: &3320 Can you tell me anything else about Yvonne?
zh: &3320 关于伊冯娜，你还能告诉我什么吗？

en: &80 She moved here to the city when she graduated. We met for drinks every Friday.
zh: &80 她毕业后搬到了这座城市。我们每周五都见面喝酒。

en: &81 Even after she got married to Dion, she always made the time.
zh: &81 即使她嫁给迪翁之后，也总是抽出时间。

en: &82 She was... good to me. More than I deserved, probably.
zh: &82 她……对我很好。可能比我应得的还要好。

en: &83 She didn't deserve what happened to her.
&3321 So. You and Yvonne. In college.
zh: &3321 那么。你和伊冯娜。在大学里。

en: &84 What about it?
&3322 You didn't think to volunteer that information?
zh: &3322 这件事，你没想过主动告诉我？

en: &85 It's personal. And not relevant.
&86 Look, it was a one time thing. We were both high as hell. I barely remember it.
zh: &86 就那一次，我们都嗨过头了，我也记不太清。

en: &87 I never mentioned it again, and neither did she.
zh: &87 我再也没提过，她也没有。

en: &88 I can't believe she told DION.
zh: &88 真不敢相信她告诉了迪翁。

en: &3323 So. Thoughts on Dion?
zh: &3323 那么。对迪翁有什么看法？

en: &89 I... don't know if I trust my thoughts anymore.
zh: &89 我……不知道还能不能相信自己的想法。

en: &90 I didn't even know they were having problems. If I'd known, maybe I would've...
zh: &90 我甚至不知道他们之间有问题。如果我知道，也许我会……

en: &91 I dunno. Talked to her or something. Been a better friend.
zh: &91 我不知道。跟她谈谈什么的。做个更好的朋友。

en: &3324 You are trying to save her life. I call that being a good friend.
zh: &3324 你都在想办法救她的命了，这还不算好朋友吗？

en: &92 Yeah. Maybe.
&93 Yeah yeah. No sense woolgathering.
zh: &93 是啊是啊。胡思乱想没意义。

en: &2621 Yes. Amazing.
&4 I am aware.
&5 But the question is...
&6 Am I amazing enough for you to buy me a drink?
zh: &6 那我够不够棒，能让你请我喝一杯？

en: &7 Am I amazing enough for me to buy you a drink?
zh: &7 那我够不够棒，能请你喝一杯？

en: &8 Am I amazing enough for us to share a drink?
zh: &8 那我够不够棒，能跟你喝一杯？

en: &2622 I am not entirely sure what just happened.
zh: &2622 我不太确定刚才发生了什么。

en: &9 How about you buy me a drink and we can find out?
zh: &9 要不请我喝一杯，咱们慢慢聊？

en: &10 How about I buy you a drink and we can find out?
zh: &10 要不我请你喝一杯，咱们慢慢聊？

en: &11 How about we  share a drink and we can find out?
zh: &11 要不一起喝一杯，咱们慢慢聊？

en: &2623 Are you... are you all right?
&12 I'm fine.
&13 You want to know HOW fine, you can buy me a drink.
zh: &13 想知道我到底有多好，就请我喝一杯吧。

en: &14 You want to know HOW fine, you'll let me buy you a drink.
zh: &14 想知道我到底有多好，就让我请你喝一杯吧。

en: &15 You want to know HOW fine, you'll share a drink with me.
zh: &15 想知道我到底有多好，就陪我喝一杯吧。

en: &16 Too strong?
&2624 I've been worse, believe me.
zh: &2624 相信我，我经历过更糟的。

en: &17 Well then. To being worse!
&2625 You... caught me by surprise, is all.
&18 And yet you're still talking to me.
&19 To being caught by surprise.
&2626 A bit, perhaps.
&20 To you still talking to me!
zh: &20 为你还在跟我说话干杯！
