en: &113 Windows on the World? I haven't been there since...
zh: &113 “世界之窗餐厅”？我自从……就再没去过。

en: &114 Ohhh. I remember now.
&3755 My name is Fia. Remember?
&115 But they said your name was...
&116 Oh wait. FIA. I remember now.
zh: &116 哦，等等。菲娅。我现在想起来了。

en: &117 Took your sweet time to visit, huh?
zh: &117 你可真够磨蹭的，现在才来看我，嗯？

en: &118 Since you had to steal a pass and identity to get in here, I guess you're not here to tell the world my story?
zh: &118 既然你得偷通行证、冒用身份才能进来，我猜你不是来向世界讲述我的故事的吧？

en: &3756 Not exactly. But I do want to learn what happened.
zh: &3756 不完全是。但我确实想弄清楚发生了什么。

en: &119 Just like before.
&120 Fine. I'm a literal captive audience. Ask me whatever you want.
zh: &120 行吧。我反正是个跑不掉的听众。你想问什么就问吧。

en: &3757 Could I ask about your arrest?
zh: &3757 我能问问你被捕的事吗？

en: &121 You didn't hear. I killed a cop.
zh: &121 你没听说吗？我杀了个警察。

en: &3758 And... why did you do that?
&122 Because she was trying to kill ME?
&3759 About your arrest...
&123 Ask away.
&3760 Could we talk about that night we met?
zh: &3760 我们能聊聊我们见面的那晚吗？

en: &124 You mean when you asked me a bunch of personal questions and then left me high and dry at cocktail hour.
zh: &124 就是你问了我一堆私事，喝酒喝到一半就把我晾在那儿的那晚？

en: &3761 "High and dry?"
&125 You BAILED.
&126 You came over to me, acted all interested, then you just dipped.
zh: &126 你凑到我面前，装得挺感兴趣，然后人就没了。

en: &3762 Could we talk more about that night we met?
zh: &3762 我们能再聊聊我们见面的那晚吗？

en: &127 Sure. Why not?
&3763 Have you heard from Yvonne since that night?
zh: &3763 那晚之后，伊冯娜联系过你吗？

en: &128 No. I tried reaching out. With her being a reporter and all, I thought she could help.
zh: &128 没有。我试着联系过她。她是个记者，我以为她能帮忙。

en: &129 But she won't even talk to me.
zh: &129 可她连话都不肯跟我说。

en: &3764 Do you know Hanna Tanaka? Or Hanna Tanner?
zh: &3764 你认识汉娜·田中吗？或者汉娜·坦纳？

en: &130 Not before that night, no. Never heard of her.
zh: &130 那晚之前不认识，从没听说过她。

en: &3765 What can you tell me about the company you worked for?
zh: &3765 关于你工作过的公司，你能告诉我些什么？

en: &131 You mean Winera?  The office is gone now.
zh: &131 你是说维内拉？办公室现在已经没了。

en: &132 Even if I wasn't stuck here, I couldn't go back.
zh: &132 就算我没被困在这里，我也回不去了。

en: &3766 Just tell me what you can. It may help.
zh: &3766 把你能说的都告诉我吧。也许会有帮助。

en: &133 Well, it was pretty boring. I just processed invoices when they came in.
zh: &133 嗯，挺无聊的。我就是处理收到的发票。

en: &134 Paid whoever needed paying. Chased after people who needed to pay us.
zh: &134 该付的付掉，该收的催一催。

en: &135 Easy work, but a lot of it. Good money, too. And the view... wow.
zh: &135 活儿轻松，但量很大。钱也不少。还有那景色……哇。

en: &136 Jesus. Hard to believe it's all gone.
zh: &136 天哪。真不敢相信全没了。

en: &3767 Did you know Winera was a money laundering operation?
zh: &3767 你知道维内拉是个洗钱组织吗？

en: &137 A what now?
&3768 Surely you must have noticed? You handled the accounts.
zh: &3768 你肯定注意到了吧？账目都是你经手的。

en: &138 Not really. I just cut checks to whoever they told me to pay.
zh: &138 其实没有。我只是按他们说的开支票付钱。

en: &3769 And you never once suspected?
&139 I mean, some of our clients were on the sketchy side but...
zh: &139 有些客户看着是有点可疑，可是……

en: &140 *Sigh* I guess you could be right. I never thought to ask.
zh: &140 *叹气* 我想你可能是对的。我从没想过要问。

en: &141 Huh. Good thing I didn't put my own signature on those checks.
zh: &141 哈。幸好我没在那些支票上签自己的名字。

en: &142 I might've been arrested or something.
zh: &142 不然我可能已经被抓了什么的。

en: &3770 I should go, Imani. Sorry. I mean Em.
zh: &3770 我得走了，伊曼妮。抱歉。我是说，埃姆。

en: &143 Sure. See you around.
&3771 Do you know why she was trying to kill you?
zh: &3771 你知道她为什么想杀你吗？

en: &144 No idea!
&3772 Can you tell me what happened?
zh: &3772 能告诉我发生了什么吗？

en: &145 I've gone over this a hundred times, but okay.
zh: &145 我已经说过一百遍了，不过好吧。

en: &146 It was just before midnight. I was in my office. Catching up on a few late invoices.
zh: &146 快到午夜了，我还在办公室，赶着处理几张迟来的发票。

en: &147 Then this woman walks in. She didn't say a word. Just... stared.
zh: &147 然后这个女人走了进来。她一句话没说，只是……盯着。

en: &3773 Stared?
&148 Yeah. Hard eyes. Blank, but FOCUSED.
zh: &148 对，眼神冷冰冰的，没什么表情，却一直盯着我。

en: &149 Like she had a job to do and wasn't gonna get distracted.
zh: &149 就像她有任务在身，不会分心。

en: &3774 And you didn't know her?
&150 Never seen her before in my life.
&151 I still have no idea what she wanted with me.
zh: &151 我到现在都不知道她找我干什么。

en: &155 Anyway, I asked who she was, what she was doing there, nothing.
zh: &155 总之，我问她是谁、来干什么，她都不回答。

en: &156 She kept walking toward me. Didn't say a word, but her eyes said it all.
zh: &156 她一直朝我走过来。一句话不说，但她的眼神说明了一切。

en: &157 Then I saw her reaching for the gun in her pocket.
zh: &157 然后我看见她伸手去掏口袋里的枪。

en: &158 So I did what I needed to do.
&3777 Which was?
&159 Grabbed the gun from her hand and fired at her till the bullets ran out.
zh: &159 从她手里夺过枪，朝她开枪，直到子弹打光。

en: &3778 You managed to grab the gun from a trained police officer? Impressive.
zh: &3778 你能从一个训练有素的警察手里夺枪？了不起。

en: &160 I didn't take twenty years of ballet for nothing.
zh: &160 我二十年的芭蕾可不是白练的。

en: &161 I'm more agile than I look.
&3779 Surely that was self-defense?
&162 That's what I kept telling everyone! Nobody believed me.
zh: &162 我一直跟所有人这么说！没人相信我。

en: &163 Apparently "self-defense" doesn't count when you're facing a cop who is trying to kill you.
zh: &163 反正碰上要杀你的警察，“正当防卫”就不算数了。

en: &3780 You didn't realize she was a police officer at the time?
zh: &3780 你当时没意识到她是警察？

en: &164 No! Not that it would've mattered. What was I going to do? Let her kill me?
zh: &164 没有！不过就算知道也没用。我能怎么办？让她杀了我？

en: &3781 No. No you couldn't have.
&3782 What were you doing in the office so late?
zh: &3782 你那么晚还在办公室做什么？

en: &165 I dunno. Maybe because I didn't want to go home?
zh: &165 不知道。也许因为我不想回家？

en: &166 Maybe because I had been bailed on twice in one evening and was feeling sorry for myself?
zh: &166 也许是因为一晚上被放了两回鸽子，心里不好受吧。

en: &167 I figured I might as well be useful for SOMEONE.
zh: &167 我想我至少还能对某个人有点用。

en: &168 Never make that mistake again.
zh: &168 以后再也不干这种傻事了。

en: &3783 So you're saying... you went back to the office because of me?
zh: &3783 所以你是说……你是因为我才回到办公室的？

en: &3784 You wouldn't have gone there otherwise?
&169 Maybe. Dunno. I was a bit drunk and sad. Definitely wasn't thinking too clearly.
zh: &169 也许吧。不知道。我当时有点醉，又难过。肯定没想清楚。

en: &170 I don't blame YOU for what happened, if that's what you're worried about.
zh: &170 我不怪你，如果你担心的是这个的话。

en: &171 If you think about it, the whole thing saved my life, didn't it?
zh: &171 你想想，整件事救了我的命，不是吗？

en: &3785 This whole thing saved your life?
&172 Think about it. I was arrested, so I wasn't at work when...
zh: &172 你想，我被捕了，所以那件事发生时，我就没在公司。

en: &173 You know. When the planes hit?
zh: &173 就是飞机撞上去的时候？

en: &3786 Ah. I see. That's... one way you could think of it.
zh: &3786 啊。我明白了。这……倒是一种看法。

en: &174 I've spent the last two months thinking of nothing BUT.
zh: &174 过去两个月我满脑子想的都是这个。

en: &175 You showed up to ruin my night, then...
zh: &175 你出现毁了我的夜晚，然后……

en: &176 Poof. I am alive.
&177 Stuck in jail for a crime I didn't really commit, but alive.
zh: &177 被扣了个不该有的罪名，关在牢里，可还活着。

en: &178 Is that extremely good luck, or extremely bad luck? Haven't decided yet.
zh: &178 到底是走了大运，还是倒了大霉，我还没想明白。

en: &3787 So this officer who attacked you. You have no idea who she is?
zh: &3787 那么袭击你的那个警官。你完全不知道她是谁？

en: &179 No. None.
&180 Like I said, she didn't say a darn word. Just went for her gun.
zh: &180 就像我说的，她一个字都没说。直接去掏枪。

en: &181 But... slowly. Like she wasn't sure if she wanted to.
zh: &181 但是……动作很慢。好像她不确定要不要那么做。

en: &3788 But you shot her anyway?
&182 I've answered this question a hundred times. YES.
zh: &182 这个问题我已经回答一百遍了。是的。

en: &183 What was I supposed to do? Give her time to make up her mind?
zh: &183 我还能怎么办？给她时间让她下定决心？

en: &7128 I suppose not.
&3789 Let's talk about something else.
&184 Please.
&3790 Did I misunderstand you that night?
zh: &3790 那天晚上我是不是误会你了？

en: &3791 You didn't seem all that interested.
zh: &3791 你看起来没那么感兴趣。

en: &3792 I totally embarrassed myself.
zh: &3792 我把自己搞得太丢人了。

en: &3793 I assumed you wanted me to, er, dip.
zh: &3793 我以为你想让我，呃，走人。

en: &185 Why'd you think that?
&3794 Well, I made rather a mess of it, didn't I?
&186 Heh. Can't deny that. Bringing up my ex wasn't the smoothest line.
zh: &186 呵。这我无法否认。提起我的前任可不是什么高明的搭讪。

en: &187 But did I tell you to leave? No, you chose to do that all by yourself.
zh: &187 但我叫你走了吗？没有，是你自己选择离开的。

en: &3795 You could've been more clear about it.
zh: &3795 你当时可以把话说清楚一点。

en: &188 I don't see how I could've been any more clear than I was?
zh: &188 我怎么才能说得更清楚啊？

en: &189 Oh well. Woulda coulda shoulda.
zh: &189 算了，哪来那么多“早知道”。

en: &3796 You really wanted me to stay?
&190 I was hoping you would.
zh: &190 我当时是希望你留下的。

en: &191 Too late now though.
&192 Fun to imagine though, isn't it? Sliding doors and all.
zh: &192 不过想想也挺有意思的，不是吗？平行人生什么的。

en: &3797 You seemed quite angry with me.
zh: &3797 你当时好像很生我的气。

en: &193 Course I was angry. I was waiting for you to say the right thing.
zh: &193 我当然生气。我一直在等你说出该说的话。

en: &194 You never did, by the way.
zh: &194 顺便说一句，你始终没说。

en: &3798 What "right thing" were you hoping I would say?
zh: &3798 你希望我说出什么“该说的话”？

en: &195 No idea. All I knew was that you seemed to know a lot about me and I didn't know a thing about you. Still don't.
zh: &195 不知道。我只知道你好像很了解我，而我却对你一无所知。现在也还是。

en: &3799 And that bothered you?
&196 It was weird, yeah, but I figured you would tell me why. Or how.
zh: &196 是挺奇怪的，没错，但我以为你会告诉我原因。或者是怎么知道的。

en: &197 But you never even tried.
If only real life flirting worked this way.
zh: 要是现实中的调情也能这样就好了。

en: &3800 Let's... change the subject.
&198 Yes, please.
&5267 Tying up and threatening a famous assassin. That's another off the bucket list.
zh: &5267 绑住一个著名杀手，再威胁他。人生清单又划掉一项。

en: &1795 Technically, it's the client who did both.
zh: &1795 严格来说，绑人和威胁的都是客户。

en: &5255 Semantics.
&5250 Not one member of the brass noticed anything odd about Hanna's profile?
zh: &5250 公司高层就没有一个人发现汉娜的档案有什么不对劲吗？

en: &1796 No, but that isn't surprising. Police corruption isn't something that goes on your service record.
zh: &1796 没有，不过也不奇怪，警察收黑钱又不会写进履历。

en: &7170 Right.
&3675 Yvonne is alive.
&991 Yeah. I noticed. Good work.
&3676 But I didn't DO anything.
&992 I won't tell the brass if you won't.
zh: &992 你不说，我就不告诉高层。

en: &3677 At least Hanna's friend is alive. She should be happy about that, at least.
zh: &3677 至少汉娜的朋友还活着。她至少该为这个高兴。

en: &993 I'm sure it'll be a great consolation when the brass sues her for fraudulent misrepresentation.
zh: &993 等高层告她虚假陈述、欺诈的时候，这可真是个天大的安慰。

en: &994 Assuming she doesn't get paradoxed out of history.
zh: &994 前提是她没被悖论从历史中抹掉。

en: &3678 Not that I'm complaining, but what could have caused Yvonne to survive?
zh: &3678 她活着我当然高兴，可到底是什么救了她？

en: &995 Like I said, it's a historically charged point. It's hard to predict anything.
zh: &995 我说过了，这是个历史敏感的时点。什么都很难预测。

en: &3679 So. We saved Yvonne. Objective complete?
zh: &3679 所以。我们救了伊冯娜。目标完成？

en: &996 I guess. Technically.
&3680 I can come home, then? Drinks at Jay V's to celebrate?
zh: &3680 那我可以回家了？去杰伊V喝一杯庆祝？

en: &7122 I know. I know.
&3682 Isn't the PFE supposed to prevent her from paradoxing?
zh: &3682 PFE不是应该保护她免受悖论影响吗？

en: &3683 Her younger self might be dead but her older self should be physically fine. Right?
zh: &3683 她年轻时的自己可能死了，但年长的自己身体应该没事。对吧？

en: &998 According to the specs, yes. That's exactly what should happen.
zh: &998 按技术说明，是的，本来就该这样。

en: &999 But when it involves a historically charged event like this one? The specs are... vague.
zh: &999 不过，碰上这种历史敏感事件，技术说明里就……说得很模糊了。

en: &3684 So this is our fault.
&1000 You did nothing outside of protocol, Fia. I'll testify to that.
zh: &1000 菲娅，你没有做任何超出协议的事。我可以作证。

en: &1001 And we didn't force Hanna to punch that officer. Everything was fine until she did that.
zh: &1001 而且我们也没逼汉娜打那个警察。在她动手之前一切都很顺利。

en: &1002 I'll testify to that too.
&3685 I know we're not supposed to intentionally stop any deaths on that day, but...
zh: &3685 我知道，那天发生的任何死亡，我们都不该主动阻止，可是……

en: &1003 I think the case can be made that we unintentionally caused one. We're just redressing the balance.
zh: &1003 我想，我们有理由认为，是我们无意中害死了她，现在只是在把这事补回来。

en: &1004 As long as we stay focused on that, we're covered.
zh: &1004 只要咱们做的事不超出这个范围，就不算违背规定。

en: &3686 Nozzo? How the hell did this happen?
zh: &3686 诺佐？这到底是怎么发生的？

en: &1005 I don't know, Fia.
&1006 Ripple effects can be... unpredictable at the best of times, but usually you can trace an effect back to an inciting cause.
zh: &1006 平时涟漪效应也……很难预测，可通常还能从结果追查到起因。

en: &1007 This one? I'm drawing a blank.
&7168 So what do we do?
&1008 Right. The tunnel to September 10th. It's still active.
zh: &1008 对了，通往9月10日的隧道还开着。

en: &1009 On that day, Young Hanna is still alive, presumably.
zh: &1009 那一天，年轻的汉娜应该还活着。

en: &1010 Prevent her from dying, and the paradox is resolved.
zh: &1010 阻止她死亡，悖论就解决了。

en: &1011 Old Hanna doesn't die. She serves out her time. We collect her as planned.
zh: &1011 老年的汉娜不会死。她服完刑期。我们按计划接她。

en: &3687 You make it sound so simple.
&1012 Blast it Fia, don't say that.
&3688 I still want to know how this happened, Nozzo.
zh: &3688 我还是想知道这是怎么发生的，诺佐。

en: &1013 I know. But all we can do now is treat the symptoms.
zh: &1013 我知道。但我们现在能做的只有治标。

en: &1014 The rest is above our pay grade.
zh: &1014 剩下的超出我们的职权范围。

en: &3689 You sound remarkably calm, Nozzo.
zh: &3689 你听起来异常冷静，诺佐。

en: &1015 Do I? Good. I've been practicing.
zh: &1015 是吗？很好。我一直在练习。

en: &1016 Head back to the landing point, Fia. We'll figure this out.
zh: &1016 回到跃迁落点，菲娅。我们会弄清楚的。

en: &1017 Then we open a tab at Jay V's and drink the place dry.
zh: &1017 然后我们在杰伊V酒吧开个账，把那里喝个精光。

en: &3911 January...
&3912 February...
&3918 August...
&3919 September...
&3920 October...
&3921 November...
&3922 December...
&3923 the first...
&3924 the third...
&3925 the fifth...
&3926 the eighth...
&3927 the tenth...
&3928 the twelfth...
&3929 the fourteenth...
&3930 the seventeenth...
&3931 the twentieth...
&3932 the twenty-second...
&3933 the twenty-fifth...
&3934 the twenty-eighth...
&8035 the thirty-first...
&3847 Isn't there supposed to be a book signing event today?
zh: &3847 今天不是应该有签售会吗？

en: &4 Today? On the Fourth of July?
&5 Of course not.
&3848 Really. Because I thought...
&8028 Never mind.
&3849 Why are you here if the shop is closed?
zh: &3849 店都关了，你怎么还在这儿？

en: &6 Because I live here? I got a living area in the back.
zh: &6 因为我住这儿啊？后面有我的住处。

en: &7 What's with the personal questions?
zh: &7 问这些私人问题干什么？

en: &8 I just came out to watch the fireworks.
&3850 Do you know anyone named Adam Cole?
zh: &3850 你认识一个叫亚当·科尔的人吗？

en: &9 Nope. Never heard that name.
zh: &9 不认识。从没听过这名字。

en: &3851 Do you know the Knox family?
&10 What makes you say that?
&3852 I saw you in a photograph. With Marla Knox.
zh: &3852 我在一张照片里见过你。和玛拉·诺克斯一起。

en: &11 Yeah?
&3853 Do you still claim you don't know them?
&12 Never claimed anything one way or the other.
&3854 You're Liam, correct? Marla Knox's brother.
zh: &3854 你是利亚姆，对吧？玛拉·诺克斯的哥哥。

en: &13 Yeah. Uh. That's me.
&14 Is she okay?
&4297 Oh yes. She's fine. I'm just... checking in on the family.
zh: &4297 哦，她很好。我只是……来看看这家人。

en: &4298 On behalf of Nathan.
&15 Oh! Well, any friend of Nathan's is a friend of mine.
zh: &15 哦！内森的朋友就是我的朋友。

en: &16 Love that kid like a son.
zh: &16 那孩子我当亲儿子一样疼。

en: &3856 What is your relationship to the Knox's?
zh: &3856 你和诺克斯家是什么关系？

en: &17 I don't see how that's your business.
&4299 So you're close with Otis Knox and his family?
zh: &4299 所以你和奥蒂斯·诺克斯一家很熟？

en: &4300 Because earlier you said that you didn't know him.
zh: &4300 你先前明明说不认识他。

en: &18 What was I supposed to say?
&19 I hate lying, but they like their privacy.
zh: &19 我不喜欢撒谎，但他们喜欢清静。

en: &20 So do I. The last thing I need are his fans swarming this place.
zh: &20 我也是。我最怕他的粉丝涌到这儿来。

en: &3859 Do you know anything about Otis Knox?
zh: &3859 你对奥蒂斯·诺克斯有什么了解吗？

en: &21 Only through his books. I'm a fan, but who isn't?
zh: &21 只看过他的书。我是他的书迷，谁不是呢？

en: &22 His books fly off the shelves faster than I can put them on.
zh: &22 他的书卖得飞快，我刚摆上架就没了。

en: &3860 You don't know anything else?
&23 What a question. His personal life is none of my business.
zh: &23 这问题问的。他的私生活不关我的事。

en: &3861 Otis proved himself? Why did he have to do that?
zh: &3861 奥蒂斯证明了自己？他为什么要那么做？

en: &24 Er, yeah. Maybe I shouldn't have said that.
zh: &24 呃，是啊。也许我不该说那些。

en: &25 Let's just say he didn't make the best first impression.
zh: &25 这么说吧，他给人的第一印象不太好。

en: &26 But he's good now.
&3862 Because he's famous?
&27 Er. No. Not exactly.
&28 Never mind. Forget it.
&3863 Otis is "good now".
&3864 Implying he wasn't good before?
&29 I said never mind, okay?
&30 I let it go ages back. So should you.
zh: &30 我早就放下了。你也该放下。

en: &3865 So I heard some stories. About Otis. About how different he was back in the day.
zh: &3865 我听到过一些传闻。关于奥蒂斯。关于他以前有多不一样。

en: &31 "Different". Yeah. That's one way of putting it.
&32 He drank like a fish. Said it was part of his "process".
zh: &32 他以前喝酒没个节制，还说那是“创作过程”的一部分。

en: &33 I'm just glad he fixed things before it was too late.
zh: &33 我只是庆幸他及时改好了。

en: &3866 She didn't leave him after all? Why the change of heart?
zh: &3866 她最后没离开他？为什么回心转意？

en: &34 Beats the hell out of me. I thought she was out of her mind.
zh: &34 我完全搞不懂。我以为她疯了。

en: &35 She swore up and down that he was a changed man. I might've laughed in her face.
zh: &35 她信誓旦旦地说，他变了个人。我记得还当面笑过她。

en: &36 But the kicker? She was right. He hasn't touched a drop since.
zh: &36 但最绝的是？她说对了。他从此滴酒不沾。

en: &37 And you've met them, right? Tell me you've never seen two people more in love.
zh: &37 你也见过他们吧？还有谁能像他俩这么恩爱？

en: &38 Something must've put the fear of God into him. Made him realize all he stood to lose.
zh: &38 肯定是出了什么事，让他彻底怕了，明白自己有多少东西会失去。

en: &39 Lots of time has passed since then. Took awhile for him to earn my trust, but earn it he did.
zh: &39 那之后过了很久。他花了很长时间才赢得我的信任，但他确实做到了。

en: &40 I'm proud to call him my brother-in-law.
zh: &40 我很自豪能叫他一声妹夫。

en: &4301 You said a "long time has passed" since Otis had his epiphany.
zh: &4301 你说奥蒂斯“顿悟”之后“过了很久”。

en: &4302 Do you know how much time?
&41 Twenty-some odd years ago? Time flies.
zh: &41 二十多年前吧？时光飞逝。

en: &5266 Twenty years exactly?
&42 Something like that. Maybe more. Maybe less.
zh: &42 差不多吧。可能多点儿，可能少点儿。

en: &43 Like I said, I think it was twenty-some odd years ago? Time flies.
zh: &43 就像我说的，我记得是二十多年前吧？时光飞逝。

en: &44 I know I had just bought this place. Was working around the clock, fixing it up.
zh: &44 我记得我刚买下这地方。没日没夜地装修。

en: &45 My only bed was an old sofa. That's why I got Marla the room at the Commonwealth.
zh: &45 我那时候只能睡张旧沙发，所以给玛拉在联邦酒店订了间房。

en: &46 Probably for the best. If Otis came looking for her here, I might've punched his face in.
zh: &46 这样也好。奥蒂斯要是来这里找她，我可能一拳就打在他脸上了。

en: &3869 Do you remember which hotel you booked Marla into?
zh: &3869 你记得给玛拉订的是哪家酒店吗？

en: &47 The Commonwealth. Downtown somewhere.
zh: &47 联邦酒店，在曼哈顿下城那边。

en: &48 They tore it down about five years back.
&3870 Are you Otis Knox?
&49 Huh? Me?
&50 Heh. I wish.
&3871 I'm looking for Otis Knox. Do you know where he is?
zh: &3871 我在找奥蒂斯·诺克斯。你知道他在哪里吗？

en: &51 Otis Knox? Why would I know that?
zh: &51 奥蒂斯·诺克斯？我怎么会知道？

en: &3872 Could I have your autograph?
&52 My autograph? Why?
&3873 Aren't you Otis Knox?
zh: &3873 你不是奥蒂斯·诺克斯吗？

en: &53 Heh. I WISH.
&54 I just sell his books. I don't write 'em.
zh: &54 我只是卖他的书，又不是写书的。

en: &3874 Oh. I see. You own this bookshop?
zh: &3874 哦，明白了。这家书店是你开的？

en: &55 That I do.
&56 But we're closed.
&3875 You're... closed.
&57 Yeah. Because it's the Fourth of July?
zh: &57 是啊。因为今天是七月四号国庆日？

en: &58 I'm sure some of the major chains are open, but not me.
zh: &58 那些大连锁店可能还开着，但我这儿不开。

en: &59 Sorry.
&3876 This photo. Do you recognize this shop?
zh: &3876 这张照片。你认得这家店吗？

en: &60 Hmmm.
&61 It looks like mine. Why?
zh: &61 看起来像我的店。怎么了？

en: &3877 Could it be another shop, perhaps? One that just looks like yours?
zh: &3877 会不会是另一家店？只是看起来像你的店？

en: &62 Nope. definitely mine. That clock on the wall? Belonged to my uncle. Had it for years.
zh: &62 不，绝对是我的店。墙上那个钟？是我叔叔的，用了好多年了。

en: &63 When was this taken, anyway?
zh: &63 这张照片是什么时候拍的？

en: &3878 There is... some confusion about that.
&64 All right. Shouldn't have asked. I just want to watch the fireworks.
zh: &64 好吧，我不该问的。我只想看烟花。

en: &4304 Wouldn't fans swarming this place be a good thing?
zh: &4304 粉丝蜂拥到这儿来不是好事吗？

en: &65 Heh. You'd think that, but no. I like things simple.
zh: &65 呵，你可能会这么想，但不是。我喜欢简单点。

en: &4317 Simple. On the Coney Island boardwalk?
zh: &4317 简单？在康尼岛木板路上？

en: &66 Selling books is simple.
&67 Dealing with Otis's fans bugging me for his address is not.
zh: &67 应付那些缠着我要奥蒂斯地址的粉丝可不简单。

en: &68 So please don't blab.
&4318 Lips are sealed.
&4320 I'm curious. If you are so close to Marla and Otis, why are you here alone?
zh: &4320 我很好奇。你跟玛拉和奥蒂斯那么亲近，怎么一个人在这儿？

en: &69 Alone?
&3857 They are watching the fireworks about halfway down the boardwalk.
zh: &3857 他们在木板路中段看烟花。

en: &3858 Why you are here instead of with your sister.
zh: &3858 你怎么没跟妹妹待在一起，反而在这里？

en: &70 Oh. They wanted to be by themselves tonight. I'm OK with that.
zh: &70 哦，他们今晚想单独待着。我没意见。

en: &71 Otis has more than proven himself. I trust him now.
zh: &71 奥蒂斯已经证明了自己。我现在信任他。

en: &4321 Marla tried to run away, didn't she?
&73 No "try" about it. It was all arranged.
zh: &73 不是“想”，是已经安排好了。

en: &74 She just learned she was pregnant. She told me everything. Asked me to help her get away.
zh: &74 她刚得知自己怀孕了。她把一切都告诉了我，求我帮她离开。

en: &75 So I booked her a room at the Hotel Commonwealth. Got her a train ticket for the next morning. To our cousin's place in Georgia.
zh: &75 于是我在联邦酒店给她订了房间，买了第二天早上的火车票，去佐治亚州我们表亲家。

en: &76 But then... it all got better. They came around the next day, hand-in-hand. Like nothing happened.
zh: &76 但后来……一切都好起来了。第二天他们手牵手来了，像什么都没发生过一样。

en: &5144 Did you get that, Nozzo? The Commonwealth Hotel?
zh: &5144 你听到了吗，诺佐？联邦酒店？

en: &6108 I got it. The address is close to your position, but it was torn down by your when.
zh: &6108 听到了。地址离你的位置很近，但在你的年代已经被拆了。

en: &5148 Give me the address anyway. You never know.
zh: &5148 还是把地址给我吧。说不定呢。

en: New location:[The Commonwealth Hotel
An in-depth look at the design process.
&3879 Sorry. I'll leave you alone.
&77 Thanks. We'll be open tomorrow, if you want anything.
zh: &77 谢谢。我们明天还开门，如果你需要什么的话。

en: You bring up a copy of the photograph that's going to be published tomorrow. Through clever deduction and AMAZING gameplay, you can tell it's been digitally altered.
zh: 你调出了那张明天将要刊登的照片的副本。通过巧妙的推理和惊人的游戏操作，你发现它被数字修改过了。

en: You bring up the photos again. I'll make a UI for this eventually. You don't need to do anything with them.
zh: 你再次调出这些照片。我最终会为此做一个界面。你不需要对它们做任何操作。

en: A prompt asks you to answer three questions, all of which require future knowledge of the history of time travel to answer. If you answer all three correctly...
zh: 一个提示要求你回答三个问题，所有问题都需要未来关于时间旅行历史的知识才能回答。如果你三个都答对……

en: &521 What is it?
&4561 The answers on this quiz. It's based on history. OUR history.
zh: &4561 这个测验的答案。它基于历史。我们的历史。

en: A new icon appears that says "Open Panel"
zh: 出现一个新图标，写着“打开面板”

en: Ka-chunk. A panel in the wall opens.
zh: 咔嗒。墙上的一块面板打开了。

en: &3880 That's a lovely garden.
&5 Maybe not yet, but I'm working on it.
zh: &5 现在还算不上，我还在慢慢打理。

en: &3881 Are those lupines?
&6 Common mistake. Delphiniums.
zh: &6 经常有人认错，是飞燕草。

en: &7 Not easy to grow near the water, but I have my... ways.
zh: &7 在水边不容易种，但我有我的……办法。

en: &3882 You have... ways, do you?
&8 Ways I'm not sharing. I can tell you, but I'll have to kill you.
zh: &8 这办法可不外传。告诉你了，就得杀你灭口。

en: &3883 Oh. Is that all?
&9 Huh?
&3884 Sorry. Nevermind.
&3885 Does Otis Knox live here?
zh: &3885 奥蒂斯·诺克斯住在这里吗？

en: &10 You obviously know that already, or you wouldn't be here.
zh: &10 你显然已经知道了，否则你不会在这里。

en: &11 Just to warn you, he keeps his address unlisted for a reason.
zh: &11 只是提醒你，他不公开地址是有原因的。

en: &3886 Oh it's not like that.
&12 Hey, you're on his property. Not mine.
zh: &12 嘿，你是在他的地盘上。不是我的。

en: &13 If he can't keep his fans in check, then that's on him.
zh: &13 如果他管不住他的粉丝，那是他的问题。

en: &3887 I'm not a fan.
&14 That's what they all say.
&3888 I'm here on behalf of Nathan.
&15 Nathan? Isn't he abroad for the summer?
zh: &15 内森？他夏天不是出国了吗？

en: &16 Spain or something?
&3889 Yes. He sent me. To check on his father.
zh: &3889 是的。他派我来的。来看看他父亲。

en: &1326 Skirting the edge of truth there, Fia. Well done.
zh: &1326 半真半假啊，菲娅，干得漂亮。

en: &3890 Shhh.
&17 Hm. Good kid.
&3891 So... is Mr. Knox all right?
zh: &3891 那么……诺克斯先生没事吧？

en: &18 As far as I know, Otis and Marla are doing fine.
zh: &18 据我所知，奥蒂斯和玛拉都很好。

en: &19 I assume they're out finding a spot to watch the fireworks.
zh: &19 我猜他们出去找地方看烟花了。

en: &3892 Do you know where that spot might be?
zh: &3892 你知道那个地方可能在哪儿吗？

en: &20 I assume out on the boardwalk. Or maybe the beach?
zh: &20 我猜是在木板路上。或者海滩上？

en: &3893 That's over three miles long.
&21 Yeah. I know. Not much help, huh?
zh: &21 是啊。我知道。没什么帮助，对吧？

en: &22 Sorry. I'm sure they're fine.
&23 Come back tomorrow if you really want to be sure.
zh: &23 如果你真的想确认，明天再来吧。

en: &3894 That's... sure. Tomorrow.
&3895 Do you know an Adam Cole?
zh: &3895 你认识一个叫亚当·科尔的人吗？

en: &24 Doesn't ring a bell. Should it?
&8029 No. Nevermind.
&4565 You wouldn't happen to have a spare key to their house, would you?
zh: &4565 你不会碰巧有他们家的备用钥匙吧？

en: &25 Why do you ask?
&4566 As I said, Nathan asked me to check in.
zh: &4566 我说过，内森让我来看看。

en: &26 You don't have a key of your own?
&4567 Unfortunately, not.
&27 Well, I wish I could help, but I don't have a key either. Sorry.
zh: &27 嗯，我希望我能帮忙，但我也没有钥匙。抱歉。

en: &3896 Did you know the Knox family before Otis became famous?
zh: &3896 你在奥蒂斯成名之前就认识诺克斯一家吗？

en: &28 They moved in just after me, so yeah.
zh: &28 他们就在我之后搬进来的，所以是的。

en: &4568 What was Otis like?
zh: &4568 奥蒂斯是个什么样的人？

en: &29 Why? What've you heard?
zh: &29 为什么问这个？你听说了什么？

en: &4569 Just curious. I imagine becoming a celebrity changes people.
zh: &4569 只是好奇。我想成名会改变一个人。

en: &30 For the worse, usually.
&31 But not Otis. Fame suits him.
zh: &31 可奥蒂斯不一样，出了名倒让他变好了。

en: &32 The year he released his first book, it all stopped.
zh: &32 出第一本书的那年，那些事就都停了。

en: &4570 You said "it all stopped" when Otis wrote his first book. What stopped?
zh: &4570 你说他写第一本书时，那些事都停了。什么事？

en: &33 The drinking. The ear-splitting fights. God those two could go at it.
zh: &33 酗酒。震耳欲聋的争吵。天哪，那两个人真能吵。

en: &34 Almost called the police once, but figured it was none of my business.
zh: &34 有一次差点报警，但又觉得不关我的事。

en: &35 I know better now. It all worked out, thank heaven. But if things went the other way...
zh: &35 现在想想，不能这么想。最后倒是都好了，谢天谢地，可要是出了别的事……

en: &36 Well. Like I said. It all worked out.
zh: &36 嗯。就像我说的。一切都好起来了。

en: &3898 You're not watching the fireworks yourself?
&37 No. Not really my thing.
&38 I'm happy here. And these flowers won't unpot themselves.
zh: &38 我在这儿挺开心，这些花还等着我从盆里移出来呢。

en: &4571 It this a photo of Otis Knox and his family?
zh: &4571 这是奥蒂斯·诺克斯和他家人的照片吗？

en: &39 That's them, sure enough. But why did you scribble out Marla like that?
zh: &39 没错，就是他们。但你为什么把玛拉涂成那样？

en: &4572 Oh. It wasn't me. But you're sure that's Marla?
zh: &4572 哦。不是我。但你确定那是玛拉？

en: &40 I'd recognize that necklace anywhere. But who did that to her picture? They oughta be ashamed.
zh: &40 那条项链我一眼就认得出。可谁把她的照片弄成这样？真不像话。

en: &8030 I have no idea.
&41 Can't imagine why anyone would do such a thing to her. She's the light of the neighborhood.
zh: &41 真想不到为什么会有人对她做这种事。她可是这一带的开心果。

en: &4573 Did you say Marla was the "light of the neighborhood?"
zh: &4573 你刚才说玛拉是“这一带的开心果”？

en: &42 Heh. That's what OTIS calls her, anyway. Guess it caught on.
zh: &42 呵。反正奥蒂斯是这么叫她的。大家也就跟着叫了。

en: &43 Like I said, that's what Otis calls her. Guess it caught on.
zh: &43 就像我说的，奥蒂斯这么叫她。大家也就跟着叫了。

en: &44 But I can't deny it's true. Always smiling, waving, helping everyone who needs helping.
zh: &44 但我也不能否认，她确实总是笑眯眯的，见人就打招呼，谁需要帮忙她都帮。

en: &45 You'd think she'd be more private, being married to someone so famous.
zh: &45 嫁给那么有名的人，你可能会以为她会更低调些。

en: &46 I'm more private than she is.
&4574 The drinking?
&47 That man could put it away. The bottles I'd see stacked up on trash day...
zh: &47 那家伙可真能喝。收垃圾那天，我总能看见堆成山的酒瓶……

en: &48 Well. No point in thinking about the bad old days. Like I said, it all worked out.
zh: &48 唉。过去的糟心事就别想了。就像我说的，最后都好了。

en: &4575 There were fights?
&49 If you lived here back then, you wouldn't be asking that question.
zh: &49 你要是当年住这儿，就不会问这种问题了。

en: &50 The screaming from those two!
&51 She ran away once. Told me she was going to stay with her brother. Begged me not to tell her husband.
zh: &51 她离家出走过一次。跟我说要去她哥哥那儿住。还求我别告诉她丈夫。

en: &52 But she was back home the next day like nothing happened.
zh: &52 可第二天她就回家了，跟没事人一样。

en: &53 I almost called the police, but figured it wasn't my business.
zh: &53 我差点就报警了，但想想也不关我的事。

en: &54 It all worked out in the end, but if it didn't...
zh: &54 最后总算都好了，可要是没好……

en: &55 Well. No point in thinking about that.
&4577 What do you mean, it all worked out?
zh: &4577 你说“最后都好了”是什么意思？

en: &4576 Could you tell me again what you meant by it all "worked out"?
zh: &4576 你能再说一遍，你说的“都好了”是什么意思吗？

en: &56 Like I said, it all stopped! The fights, the drinking, everything.
zh: &56 就像我说的，全都消停了！吵架、酗酒，全都没了。

en: &57 Otis sold his first book, and within the year he was completely transformed!
zh: &57 奥蒂斯卖出了第一本书，不到一年，整个人脱胎换骨！

en: &4578 You really think one has to do with the other?
zh: &4578 你真觉得这两件事有关系？

en: &58 I don't know what else it could be.
zh: &58 我想不出还能有什么别的原因。

en: &4579 You wouldn't happen to have any buformin?
zh: &4579 你这里会不会碰巧有丁双胍？

en: &59 What's that??
&4580 I... am not sure. But I need some.
zh: &4580 我……不太确定。但我需要一些。

en: &60 If you don't know what it is, then I can't help you.
zh: &60 你连那是什么都不知道，那我可帮不了你。

en: &4581 Diabetes medication. I need some. Quite urgently.
zh: &4581 糖尿病药。我需要一些。很急。

en: &61 I wish I could help, but you need a doctor. Not a retired gardener.
zh: &61 我也想帮忙，可你需要的是医生，不是个退休园丁。

en: &62 Sorry.
&4582 Do you know where I could get some sodium nitrate?
zh: &4582 你知道哪里能弄到硝酸钠吗？

en: &500 Why do you ask?
&4583 I really need some. It's really important.
zh: &4583 我真的需要一些。真的很重要。

en: &63 You don't even know what it is, do you?
zh: &63 你连那是什么都不知道，对吧？

en: &4584 Ah. Maybe?
&64 Sorry. Can't help you.
&4585 I hear it's a good fertilizer. And since you're a gardener...
zh: &4585 我听说那是很好的肥料。既然你是个园丁……

en: &65 Oh. A fellow green thumb.
&4586 Sure. Love plants, me.
&4587 Do you know where I can get some?
zh: &4587 你知道我在哪儿能弄到一些吗？

en: &66 I buy my blend from a shop in Greenpoint. They always have the pure stuff.
zh: &66 我的混合肥在格林波因特的一家店买，那儿一直有纯硝酸钠。

en: &67 You want the address?
&4588 That's over an hour away. Do you happen to have any close at hand?
zh: &4588 那要一个多小时的路程。你手头正好有吗？

en: &68 You're really eager, aren't you?
&4589 You have no idea.
&70 Well, I wish I could help. But I've only got one bag left, and it's mine.
zh: &70 我也想帮你，可只剩一袋了，我自己还要用。

en: &4590 Could you lend me some of your sodium nitrate?
zh: &4590 你能借我点你的硝酸钠吗？

en: &4591 Preferably within the next few minutes?
zh: &4591 最好这几分钟就能借到。

en: &71 Nobody needs to garden THAT fast.
zh: &71 种个花草可用不着这么急。

en: &4592 Please. I only need a dash of it.
&4593 It's a matter of life and death.
&4594 My death, to be precise.
&72 I barely know you.
&73 The answer is no.
&3899 I'll leave you alone, now.
&74 See you around.
&3 Yes?
&4595 Sorry to bother you, but are you Mr. and Mrs. Knox?
zh: &4595 抱歉打扰了，请问你们是诺克斯先生和夫人吗？

en: &4 That's a good question.
&5 What would you say, my love?
&6 Are we Mr. and Mrs. Knox?
zh: &6 我们是诺克斯先生和夫人吗？

en: &3 Not tonight we're not.
&4 We're just two people enjoying the fireworks.
zh: &4 我们只是两个看烟花的人。

en: &5 Which should've started by now? Come on. I'm not getting any younger.
zh: &5 都该放烟花了吧？快点啊，我可越等越老了。

en: &4596 Sorry to bother you again, but...
&7 What?
&8 Please leave us alone, crazy fan.
zh: &8 拜托别来烦我们了，你这狂热书迷。

en: &4597 Are either of you familiar with a man named "Adam Cole"?
zh: &4597 你们有谁认识一个叫“亚当·科尔”的人吗？

en: &6 Can't say I am. Marls?
&9 Not me. Sorry. Why?
zh: &9 我也不认识。抱歉。怎么了？

en: &4598 Do you know Boardwalk Books? A shop about a mile down the strip.
zh: &4598 你们知道木板路书店吗？沿着这条木板路走，大概一英里。

en: &7 Sure. Who doesn't?
&10 Why do you ask?
&4599 I know the truth, Otis.
&8 Truth? Of what?
&4600 That you're not really Otis Knox.
zh: &4600 你根本不是奥蒂斯·诺克斯。

en: &4601 Otis Knox was murdered fifteen years ago.
zh: &4601 奥蒂斯·诺克斯十五年前就被谋杀了。

en: &10 Um. I don't think he was?
&11 Okay that's ENOUGH.
&12 We've been nice. We've been patient.
zh: &12 我们一直很客气。一直很有耐心。

en: &13 We humored you because we didn't want to cause a scene in public.
zh: &13 我们一直迁就你，就是不想大庭广众下闹起来。

en: Otis Knox holds his hand out, waiting expectantly for you to take it.
zh: 奥蒂斯·诺克斯伸出手，期待地等着你握住。

en: &14 But there's a line, and you've crossed it.
zh: &14 但凡事都有底线，你已经越界了。

en: &4602 I'm sorry. But I'm telling the truth. His body was found in a hotel room.
zh: &4602 抱歉。但我说的是实话。他的尸体是在酒店房间里被发现的。

en: &15 Oh? Oh? I-is that right?
&16 Found by who, exactly?
&4603 This Adam Cole, whoever he is, seems to have an unhealthy obsession with you.
zh: &4603 这个亚当·科尔，不管他是谁，似乎对你有一种病态的痴迷。

en: &11 An obsessive fan? Oh no. Never had one of those before.
zh: &11 狂热书迷？哦，天哪，可真是头一回见。

en: &4604 Not of you. Of your cluster-mate.
zh: &4604 不是对你。是对你的伴侣。

en: &12 Marla's got a fan?
&17 Huh. Well, it's about time. Why should you have all the fun?
zh: &17 哈，也该轮到我了吧？凭什么只有你出风头？

en: &13 Yeah. Enjoy that "fun". It gets old fast.
zh: &13 是啊。享受这种“风头”吧。很快就会腻的。

en: &4605 Look. This is serious. Adam Cole seems to be stalking you.
zh: &4605 听着。这事很严重。亚当·科尔似乎在跟踪你。

en: &14 I hate to say it, but the only one bothering us tonight is you.
zh: &14 我不想这么说，但今晚唯一来烦我们的就是你。

en: &18 We just want to enjoy our evening alone. We... don't have many of those.
zh: &18 我们只想单独待着，好好过个晚上。这样的机会……不多。

en: &19 I'm sure you understand.
&4606 Nathan sent me.
&15 He did?
&4607 Yes. He is... worried. Asked me to check up on you.
zh: &4607 是的。他……很担心。让我来看看你们。

en: &20 Well, you can tell him we're fine. Nothing to worry about.
zh: &20 那你可以告诉他，我们很好。没什么可担心的。

en: &16 Odd that he didn't reach out himself. He writes to us every week.
zh: &16 奇怪，他怎么不自己联系我们。他每周都给我们写信。

en: &17 You're not telling the entire truth, are you?
zh: &17 你没有完全说实话，对吧？

en: &8033 Pardon?
&18 I can tell. Always been good at that.
zh: &18 我看得出来。这方面我一直很擅长。

en: &19 But it doesn't matter. We just want to enjoy our Fourth of July in peace.
zh: &19 但这不重要。我们只想安安静静地过我们的独立日。

en: &20 So if you don't mind...?
zh: &20 所以，如果你不介意的话……？

en: &4608 Were you scheduled to have a book signing there? At Boardwalk Books.
zh: &4608 你有没有安排过，在木板路书店办一场签售会？

en: &21 Yeah. Around December last year, I think.
zh: &21 是啊。大概是去年十二月吧，我想。

en: &4609 No. I mean tonight.
&22 Tonight? Why the hell would I do a book signing tonight?
zh: &22 今晚？我为什么要在今晚办签售会？

en: &23 Tonight is all about Marla and me.
&24 I'm sure you get the hint.
zh: &24 我相信你明白我的意思。

en: &4610 Marla, you're friendly with the shop owner. Aren't you?
zh: &4610 玛拉，你和书店老板关系不错，对吧？

en: &21 Jesus. What are you implying?
&4611 Oh. Nothing like THAT, I just mean...
zh: &4611 哦。不是那种意思，我只是说……

en: &22 He's my BROTHER, if you must know.
zh: &22 如果你非要知道的话，他是我哥哥。

en: &25 Marla...
&23 Sorry, Otis. But that kind of gossip we DON'T need.
zh: &23 抱歉，奥蒂斯，可这种闲话我们受不起。

en: &24 Just... leave Liam alone, please?
zh: &24 就……别去打扰利亚姆，好吗？

en: &25 He likes his life simple, and we try to keep it that way.
zh: &25 他喜欢过清静日子，我们也尽量别打扰他。

en: &26 And speaking of keeping away...
&4612 Right. Right.
&5157 I was told you were a very different person, before you were famous.
zh: &5157 我听说你成名之前，是个很不一样的人。

en: &27 It's no secret. I used to drink a lot.
zh: &27 这不是什么秘密。我以前喝得很凶。

en: &4614 Used to?
&28 Yeah. Completely dry these days.
&4615 I see.
&4616 And that cooler of beer next to you?
&26 That's for me.
&4617 Really.
&27 Yes.
&4618 That's... a lot of beer for one person.
zh: &4618 一个人喝的话……这些啤酒可真不少。

en: &28 My parents came from Germany.
&29 It's also none of her business, Marls.
zh: &29 而且这不关她的事，玛拉。

en: &29 Right. It's none of your business.
&4619 Of course. Sorry.
&4620 Never mind who.
&30 In other words, nobody.
&4621 I can't reveal my sources.
zh: &4621 我不能透露我的消息来源。

en: &31 In other words, you don't have any.
&4622 By me.
&32 Sorry if I don't believe you.
&33 You're... you're making this up!
&4623 I promise. I'm not.
&30 *Sigh*
&31 Marls, let it go. She knows.
&32 I told you this could happen eventually.
zh: &32 我告诉过你，这种事迟早会发生。

en: &34 But Otis. You can't. Not now.
zh: &34 可是奥蒂斯。你不能。现在不行。

en: &35 We were so close.
&33 I know. But it's time.
&4624 Time for what? What's this about?
&34 I'll tell you everything, but first...
zh: &34 我会把一切都告诉你，但首先……

en: &35 Help an old guy up, will you?
&8034 I'll leave you alone, now.
&36 THANK you.
&4625 You wonder what, exactly?
&1327 Otis Knox's timeline ranking is the highest there is. If anyone changed it, we'd know.
zh: &1327 奥蒂斯·诺克斯的时间线影响评级是最高级别，只要有人改动，我们就会知道。

en: &1328 But his family? They were fair game.
zh: &1328 可他的家人就没这层保护了。

en: &1329 If there was minimal archived information about his family to start with, then someone could change things without tripping any alarms.
zh: &1329 如果档案里本就没多少他家人的资料，那有人改了他们的历史，也可能不触发警报。

en: &1330 It would have to be subtle, but it could be done.
zh: &1330 得做得足够隐蔽，可并非做不到。

en: &4626 It sounds like he changed into a different person overnight.
zh: &4626 听起来他一夜之间变成了另一个人。

en: &4627 Could that be relevant?
&1331 We all go through things that change us. That's nothing special.
zh: &1331 我们都会经历一些改变我们的事。这没什么特别的。

en: &1332 But with everything we found in that secret basement...
zh: &1332 但结合我们在那个秘密地下室里发现的一切……

en: &1333 I don't know. I can't rule anything out.
zh: &1333 我不知道。我无法排除任何可能性。

en: &3906 Any word from Nathan Knox?
&1060 Just a boilerplate letter from his lawyer.
zh: &1060 就他律师来了一封满是套话的信。

en: &3907 I've passed it along to the brass.
zh: &3907 我已经转给公司高层了。

en: &3908 I'd like to see this so-called "change of heart" for myself.
zh: &3908 我想亲眼看看，他到底怎么“改过自新”的。

en: &3909 Can we do that?
&1062 Sure, if we can pinpoint what that day actually WAS.
zh: &1062 当然，如果我们能确定那天到底是什么时候。

en: &1063 Any ideas what that could be?
zh: &1063 你觉得可能是什么时候？

en: &3910 I think I may know when Otis's "change of heart" might have been.
zh: &3910 我想，我可能知道奥蒂斯是在哪一天“改过自新”的了。

en: &1064 You do? Okay. Tell me.
&5248 No answer.
&3947 I've searched it enough. I don't need a second pill.
zh: &3947 我已经搜够了。不需要第二颗药。

en: &5151 He was carrying a small bottle of diabetes pills with him.
zh: &5151 他随身带着一小瓶糖尿病药片。

en: &3949 I don't need much. I'll just take one.
zh: &3949 我不需要太多。只拿一颗。

en: Another cut scene.
&5239 I'll just... take this again. Sorry, Otis.
zh: &5239 我就……再拿一次。抱歉，奥蒂斯。

en: &3950 Nozzo. I know there's a whole "impact ranking" thing, but under the circumstances... should I search the body?
zh: &3950 诺佐，我知道有时间线影响评级的限制，可眼下这种情况……能搜一下尸体吗？

en: &1067 Okay. But don't take anything.
&3951 Wallet. Keys. Assorted odds and ends. Nothing that explains how he got here, or why.
zh: &3951 钱包。钥匙。各种零碎。没什么能解释他是怎么到这里来的，或者为什么。

en: &7173 HmMMMmmMMmMmm.
&7174 HMMmmmmMMM.
&7175 HmmmmMMMmmm.
&27 *sigh*
&4176 Adam Cole?
&1352 Yeah. Adam Cole.
&4177 Does that name mean something to you?
zh: &4177 这个名字对你来说有什么意义吗？

en: &1353 Oh yes.
&4178 Is he important?
&1354 Not in the high timeline impact rating sense, but...
zh: &1354 不是时间线影响评级高的那种重要，但……

en: &1355 A year after Otis Knox went missing, his wife took another cluster-mate. I mean, husband.
zh: &1355 奥蒂斯·诺克斯失踪一年后，他妻子又找了位伴侣组成员……我是说，丈夫。

en: &1356 The man's name was Adam Cole.
&4179 That can hardly be a coincidence, can it?
&1357 No, it most definitely can not.
&4639 You're a time traveler.
&36 Used to be. I haven't been for a long time.
zh: &36 曾经是。我已经很久没做了。

en: &37 Come on. You're so close.
zh: &37 拜托。你差一点就猜到了。

en: &4640 You're Adam Cole.
&38 I plan to be. But not yet.
zh: &38 我打算成为他。但还不是时候。

en: &39 Come on. You've almost got it.
&4641 I never told you my name.
zh: &4641 我从没告诉过你我的名字。

en: &40 Depends on your point of view, doesn't it?
zh: &40 这取决于你怎么看，不是吗？

en: &41 Always a gnarly subject where time travel is concerned.
zh: &41 涉及时间旅行，这总是个棘手的话题。

en: &1367 No. It can't be...
&42 Blast it, Fia.
&43 You really haven't figured this out?
&44 Did I teach you nothing or what?
&4643 Duffy?
&4644 Duffy.
&4645 Duffy?!
&45 Hi Fia.
&46 You haven't aged a day.
Did Abe give the twist away?
zh: 亚伯把转折点透露出来了吗？

en: &1368 I don't understand it. HOW?
&47 And hi Nozzo. I assume you're listening.
zh: &47 还有，嗨，诺佐。我猜你在听。

en: &48 Let me guess. He's sputtering and frantically grabbing for the protocol guide.
zh: &48 让我猜猜。他正语无伦次，手忙脚乱地翻着协议指南。

en: &1369 No I'm n- shut up!
&49 Heh. I wish I could hear him.
Having Your Dinner.
&4646 Talk, Duffy. Now.
&50 For a time traveler, you're blasting impatient.
zh: &50 作为一个时间旅行者，你真是急得要命。

en: &4647 We thought you were dead.
&51 I know. That was the idea.
&4648 It's good to see you again.
&52 Same, Fia. For whatever that's worth.
zh: &52 我也是，菲娅。虽然这话可能没什么用了。

en: &53 How long has it been? For you?
&4649 Only a few weeks.
&54 Fifteen some-odd years for me, but you already know that.
zh: &54 我这里已经过了十五年多，不过你早就知道了。

en: &4650 So you didn't... kill yourself?
&55 Kill myself? Is that what you thought?
&56 I was sure I made it look like an accident.
zh: &56 我还以为做得挺像意外的。

en: &4651 No. We figured you were too smart to forget something as important as that.
zh: &4651 不。我们觉得你不会笨到忘记那么重要的事。

en: &57 Oh. Thanks. I guess.
&4652 Why do this, Duffy? Why put us through this?
zh: &4652 为什么这么做，达菲？为什么要让我们经历这些？

en: &58 Do you really need to ask that?
&59 My reason is right behind you.
&37 Oh please.
&60 It's the TRUTH.
&61 I don't need any better reason than that.
zh: &61 我不需要比这更好的理由。

en: &4653 Duffy. You look so much...
&62 Older?
&63 It's amazing what happens when you don't have access to Anderson injections anymore.
zh: &63 不再打安德森针剂，就会变成这样，神奇吧。

en: &64 Took about ten years for biology to catch up. Just as well. Dyeing my hair gray every month was a pain.
zh: &64 身体花了大概十年，才跟上年纪。这样也好，省得每个月把头发染灰，太麻烦了。

en: &4654 You killed Otis Knox.
&65 I AM Otis Knox.
&4655 You know blasting well what I mean. You murdered a man.
zh: &4655 你很清楚我的意思。你谋杀了一个人。

en: &4656 You sent his body back in your place. Made us think you were dead.
zh: &4656 你把他的尸体送回去冒充你。让我们以为你死了。

en: &4657 And you've been living as him ever since.
zh: &4657 从那时起你就一直以他的身份活着。

en: &66 You're not wrong, but I meant what I said. As far as history is concerned, I AM him.
zh: &66 你没说错，不过我说的就是字面意思。在历史里，我就是他。

en: &67 I suggest you really think about what that means.
zh: &67 我建议你好好想想这意味着什么。

en: &4658 Nozzo? What do we do?
&4659 There must be some protocol for this.
zh: &4659 肯定有某种协议来处理这种情况。

en: &1370 There is, but...
&68 None of them apply to me.
&69 You know the rules. "The rankings must be preserved"?
zh: &69 你知道规矩，“评级必须维持”，对吧？

en: &70 And what's my ranking again?
zh: &70 那我的评级是多少来着？

en: &4660 High.
&71 Yeah. High.
&72 Which means you can't touch me.
zh: &72 这意味着你们不能动我。

en: &4661 We may not be able to touch you yet.
zh: &4661 我们现在也许还不能动你。

en: &4662 But Otis Knox disappeared after the fireworks, according to the historical record.
zh: &4662 但根据历史记录，奥蒂斯·诺克斯在烟花表演后失踪了。

en: &4663 Which means after that, you're fair game.
zh: &4663 到那时，我们就可以动你了。

en: &73 Yeah. But until then, we're on my time.
zh: &73 是啊。但在那之前，我们得按我的时间来。

en: &74 Time which I intend to use.
zh: &74 我打算好好利用这段时间。

en: &75 Marla? This is it. Not the way I expected it to be, but...
zh: &75 玛拉？就是现在。虽然和我想象的不一样，但……

en: &38 It's not fair. It's just not fair.
&76 I know. But it's been worth it. Every last second.
zh: &76 我知道。但这一切都值得。每一秒都值得。

en: &77 Damn it. It's starting.
&39 I thought we'd have more time. Just a little more time.
zh: &39 我以为我们会有更多时间。哪怕再多一点点。

en: &78 I know. We always think there's more time. Until there isn't.
zh: &78 是啊，总觉得还有时间，可转眼就没了。

en: &40 I love you. You saved my life, in every sense of the word.
zh: &40 我爱你，你不只救了我的命，也救了我的人生。

en: &79 I love you. You and Nathan gave my life meaning. More than I ever imagined possible.
zh: &79 我爱你。你和内森让我的人生有了意义，是我从没敢想过的那种意义。

en: &80 I'll see you again. I promise you that.
zh: &80 我会再见到你的。我向你保证。

en: &41 You... you'd better.
&81 Fia? Let's take a walk.
&4664 A walk?
&82 History says the last two people to see Otis Knox were a shop owner on the strip and one of my neighbors.
zh: &82 历史记着，最后见过奥蒂斯·诺克斯的人，是木板路上的一个店主，还有我的一个邻居。

en: &83 Can't upset the rankings, can we?
&84 The brass will accuse me of many things, but not that.
zh: &84 高层会指责我很多事情，但不会指责这个。

en: &85 So let's go.
&4665 You realize that I've had to pull double-duty to cover all your clients?
zh: &4665 为了接下你的客户，我都得干双份活了，你知道吗？

en: &86 Oh. Er. Right. I didn't think of that.
&87 Sorry.
&4666 Do you have ANY idea what you put us both through?
zh: &4666 你知道你让我们俩经历了什么吗？

en: &88 I know. And I'm sorry. If there was any other way...
zh: &88 我知道。我很抱歉。如果有别的办法……

en: &4667 This is all crazy, Duff. Beyond crazy.
zh: &4667 这一切太疯狂了，达菲。疯狂至极。

en: &89 If you really believe that, then I'm sorry.
zh: &89 如果你真这么想，那我只能说抱歉。

en: &4668 Well. At least you're sorry.
&4669 I saw your dead body. You have no idea what that was like.
zh: &4669 我看到了你的尸体。你不知道那是什么感受。

en: &90 It wasn't mine. It was Otis Knox.
zh: &90 那不是我的。是奥蒂斯·诺克斯的。

en: &2850 Blast it, Duff.
&4670 You KILLED a man and took over his identity. For fifteen years.
zh: &4670 你杀了一个人，还顶替了他的身份。整整十五年。

en: &4671 You still haven't told me why.
&91 It's complicated.
&4672 We have time.
&92 No. We really don't.
&93 Hey. Liam!
&4673 So that was you.
&4674 You altered that photograph.
&94 Yeah. That was me.
&4675 We did wonder why that photograph was faked.
zh: &4675 我们确实纳闷过那张照片为什么是伪造的。

en: &4676 That was a risk, Duffy. Why do it?
zh: &4676 那太冒险了，达菲。为什么这么做？

en: &95 For Liam's sake. And mine.
zh: &95 为了利亚姆，也为了我自己。

en: &96 I figured that the only real risk was if someone came back in time to check.
zh: &96 我琢磨着唯一的风险就是有人穿越回来查证。

en: &97 And if they did that, the jig was up anyway.
zh: &97 而如果他们真那么做了，那本来也就瞒不住了。

en: &98 I always wondered if Liam could tell the difference, you know? Between me and the original.
zh: &98 我一直在想，利亚姆能不能看出区别，你知道吗？我和原版之间。

en: &99 Looking back, he must've known. But he never said anything. Not once.
zh: &99 回想起来，他肯定知道。但他从没说过。一次都没有。

en: &100 The original Otis and Liam never got along. Maybe he felt I was an improvement.
zh: &100 原来的奥蒂斯和利亚姆从来就合不来。也许他觉得我是个改进版。

en: &4677 Improvement or not, you can't go around history killing people.
zh: &4677 改进不改进的，你也不能在历史里到处杀人。

en: &101 How many people have YOU killed on the job?
zh: &101 你执行任务时又杀过多少人？

en: &4678 That's not the same thing. And you know it.
&102 Why? Just because you had permission and I didn't?
zh: &102 为什么？就因为你有许可，我没有？

en: &4679 Less than you, Duffy.
&103 The number doesn't matter. You still killed people. Same as me.
zh: &103 数字不重要。你还是杀了人。跟我一样。

en: &4680 It was FOR the job.
&104 So just because we had permission, that made it okay?
zh: &104 所以就因为咱们有许可，那就没问题了？

en: &4681 You're just making excuses for yourself. Trying to justify what you did.
zh: &4681 你只是在给自己找借口。想为你做过的事开脱。

en: &105 I don't need to justify it.
&106 Otis Knox deserved to die.
&107 I'd do it again in a heartbeat.
zh: &107 再让我选一次，我还会毫不犹豫地杀了他。

en: &108 Anyway, here's our next stop.
zh: &108 总之，这就是我们的下一站。

en: &4682 It wasn't your book, Duff. Not really.
zh: &4682 那本书其实不是你的，达菲。

en: &109 You know what I mean. But yeah, you're right.
zh: &109 你知道我的意思。不过，你说得对。

en: &4683 How did you re-write all those books, anyway?
zh: &4683 话说回来，你是怎么重写那些书的？

en: &4684 Did you write them all from memory?
&110 God no.
&4685 Must've been hard. Living as someone so rich and famous.
zh: &4685 一定很难吧。要活成一个那么有钱有名的人。

en: &111 You joke, but it was EXHAUSTING. At least at first.
zh: &111 你开玩笑，但那真是累死人了。至少一开始是。

en: &112 Would you believe I had to jury-rig a Quansonic generator just to pull copies of Otis Knox's books from the previous timeline?
zh: &112 你信吗？我不得不临时拼凑出一台量声粒子发生器，就为了从上一条时间线里把奥蒂斯·诺克斯的书拷贝出来。

en: &113 I thought about changing a few words here and there. Putting my own spin on them. It was so tempting, you have no idea.
zh: &113 我动过念头，想在这儿那儿改几个词，加上我自己的风格。那诱惑太大了，你根本想象不到。

en: &114 But I didn't. Not once.
&115 Old habits die hard I guess.
zh: &115 我猜，老习惯就是改不掉。

en: &117 Say something, Fia. For God's sake.
zh: &117 说点什么吧，菲娅。看在老天的份上。

en: &4686 There's nothing to say, Duff.
&118 No. I suppose there isn't.
&4687 I wish I could understand.
&119 You will. Maybe. One day.
zh: &119 你会的。也许吧。总有一天。

en: &4688 Was it worth it?
&120 Yes. A million times over.
&121 Right.
&122 The fireworks will be over soon.
&4689 You know what happens after?
zh: &4689 你知道之后会发生什么吗？

en: &123 Yes. I know the protocol.
&124 You'll take me to a landing point. Then Nozzo will beam over a fresh chrono-suit for me. Then you'll bring me back.
zh: &124 你带我去跃迁落点，诺佐再送来一套新的时空防护服，然后你就带我回总部。

en: &4690 And if you refuse?
&125 You shoot me. With no consequences whatsoever.
zh: &125 你就开枪。而且完全不用承担后果。

en: &4691 Will that be necessary?
&126 No. No it won't.
&127 Come on. There's a great spot to watch the fireworks. Just over here.
zh: &127 来吧。有个看烟花的好地方。就在这边。

en: &4692 It's... quite breathtaking.
&128 Heh. We're still on the same wavelength, even after all this time.
zh: &128 呵。过了这么久，我们还是这么有默契。

en: &4693 I prefer the view from the DeBlasio Overpass myself, but this is nice enough.
zh: &4693 我更喜欢德布拉西奥天桥上的景色，不过这里也不错。

en: &129 That view is half holograms, Fia. This is REAL.
zh: &129 那景色一半是全息投影，菲娅。这才是真实的。

en: &4694 Let's get this over with.
&130 Wow, Fia. You're colder than I remember.
zh: &130 哇，菲娅。你比我印象中更冷漠了。

en: &131 The future may be home, but it seems like such a sterile place now.
zh: &131 未来也许是家，但现在看来却像个毫无生气的地方。

en: &132 Home is where the love is, and there is no love there.
zh: &132 有爱才是家，可那里已经没有爱了。

en: &133 Or maybe I'm just literally stuck in the past.
zh: &133 又或者，我只是真的被困在了过去。

en: &134 See this boat? It's mine. My plan was to disappear. Just like history says I did.
zh: &134 看到这艘船了吗？这是我的。我的计划是消失。就像历史上记载的那样。

en: &135 Then I would slip into a new identity and work my way back. Be with Marla again.
zh: &135 然后我就换个新身份，再想办法回来，重新跟玛拉在一起。

en: &4695 As Adam Cole.
&137 I'm... sorry, Fia.
&138 I'm so so sorry.
&4696 Don't apologize to ME, Duffy.
&4697 It's the brass you're going to have to explain this to.
zh: &4697 你要解释的对象是公司高层。

en: &4698 I'm sorry too, Duffy.
&4699 This is the last thing I want to do.
&4700 At least you were careful.
&4701 It could've been much worse.
&139 Oh. No. You misunderstand.
&140 I'm not sorry for what I did fifteen years ago. Not ever.
zh: &140 我不是为十五年前的事道歉。永远不会。

en: &141 I'm sorry for that.
&8040 What the...
&4703 Duffy? What did you...
&142 See you soon, Fia.
&6077 Fia? Fia!
&1371 Blast it. Duffy. What did you do to her?
zh: &1371 该死。达菲。你对她做了什么？

en: &143 You there, Noz?
&144 I'm sorry it came to this.
zh: &144 很抱歉事情到了这一步。

en: &145 Better hit that rewind button. For all the good it'll do.
zh: &145 最好按下那个回溯按钮。尽管也起不了什么作用。

en: &6078 A-Activating ERP.
zh: &6078 正-正在启动紧急回溯协议。

en: &8041 Nozzo? What happened?
&1372 I don't know. Your readings just spiked and-
zh: &1372 我不知道。你的读数突然飙升，然后——

en: &146 Don't bother asking Nozzo.
&4705 What the hell happened?
&147 Ah. Got it. So this is the first time.
zh: &147 啊。明白了。所以这是第一次。

en: &4706 What "look", Duffy?
&148 Don't play coy. I know "rewind face" from the inside out.
zh: &148 别装了，刚被回溯过的人是什么表情，我再清楚不过。

en: &149 When you took my hand to help me out of that chair? I dosed you with MorphaBite. Absorbed through the skin.
zh: &149 你握着我的手，扶我从椅子上站起来的时候，我就给你下了吗啡噬。它能通过皮肤吸收。

en: &4707 MorphaBite?
&150 It hardens stomach acid. Takes about twenty or thirty minutes for the effects to take hold.
zh: &150 它会让胃酸凝固，过二十到三十分钟就发作。

en: &151 It's not pleasant, but you seem to already know that.
zh: &151 过程不太舒服，但你似乎已经知道了。

en: &4708 You poisoned me?
&152 Don't worry. The cure is easy enough to obtain. In about... oh, sixty-two years.
zh: &152 别担心。解药很容易弄到。大约……哦，六十二年后。

en: &8042 What?
&1373 Quanmexlin, Fia. It's the only cure.
zh: &1373 是宽美克斯林，菲娅。唯一的解药。

en: &1374 We have a few vials in the first aid kit. You need to get back here!
zh: &1374 急救箱里有几瓶。你得回来！

en: &1 Run back home to ChronoZen, Fia. You have just enough time.
zh: &1 快赶回ChronoZen吧，菲娅，时间刚够。

en: &2 It's too bad I'll be long gone by the time you get back.
zh: &2 可惜，你再回来时，我早就走了。

en: &4709 We're friends, Duffy. How could you do this?
zh: &4709 我们是朋友，达菲。你怎么能这样？

en: &153 Of course we're friends, Fia. That's never going to change.
zh: &153 我们当然是朋友，菲娅。这一点永远不会变。

en: &154 But this is my family. Nobody's going to take that away from me.
zh: &154 但这是我的家人。没人能夺走他们。

en: &155 Not you. Not Nozzo. And not anyone at ChronoZen.
zh: &155 你不行。诺佐不行。ChronoZen 的任何人也都不行。

en: &156 Nobody.
Beach
&4710 You killed Otis Knox, and now me?
zh: &4710 你杀了奥蒂斯·诺克斯，现在还要杀我？

en: &157 I'm not killing you, Fia. Not really.
zh: &157 我可没要你的命，菲娅，至少不算真的要你的命。

en: &158 And as for Otis, he had it coming.
&4711 ChronoZen will send someone else.
&159 I know how to live off the radar, Fia.
zh: &159 我知道怎么隐姓埋名，菲娅。

en: &160 I've eluded ChronoZen for fifteen years while living as a blasting CELEBRITY.
zh: &160 我躲了 ChronoZen 十五年，还一直是个大明星。

en: &161 You think I can't do the same while living as a nobody?
zh: &161 你觉得我当个无名小卒就做不到吗？

en: &162 Adam Cole isn't the only identity I created. You'll never find me.
zh: &162 亚当·科尔不是我唯一的身份。你永远找不到我。

en: &4712 How the hell did you make MorphaBite in 1993?
zh: &4712 你他妈在1993年是怎么搞出吗啡噬的？

en: &163 Wasn't easy, but I had the time. And the know-how.
zh: &163 不容易，但我有时间。也有技术。

en: &164 Only could make the one dose, but it's all I needed.
zh: &164 就做出一剂，可也够用了。

en: &165 We both know that won't work on me. Not yet.
zh: &165 我们都清楚那对我没用。至少现在还没用。

en: &166 Can't fault you for trying.
&4713 I'll figure this out, Duffy. One way or another.
zh: &4713 我会想出办法的，达菲。无论如何。

en: &168 Well, good luck with that. I've had fifteen years to plan this.
zh: &168 那祝你好运。我计划这件事已经十五年了。

en: &4714 YES, it bloody worked.
&171 I knew it would. I timed it perfectly.
zh: &171 我就知道。时间算得刚刚好。

en: &4715 No... idea... what you're talking about.
zh: &4715 完全……不知道……你在说什么。

en: &172 Somehow, I don't believe you.
&4716 You need to stop this, Duffy.
zh: &4716 你必须停止这一切，达菲。

en: &173 It's already done.
&4717 Are you enjoying this?
&174 I'm not. Believe me. I wish it didn't have to come to this.
zh: &174 我没有。相信我。我希望事情不必走到这一步。

en: &4718 TOO MANY.
&175 You always were stubborn.
&4719 We're not giving up.
&4720 No matter how many times it takes.
&30 *sigh*
&176 It won't work.
&4721 Run back home to ChronoZen, Fia.
zh: &4721 跑回 ChronoZen 去吧，菲娅。

en: &179 Well. I suppose I don't have to tell you the rest.
zh: &179 好吧。我想我不必告诉你剩下的了。

en: &4722 I already found out.
&45 Oh. Right. Time loops.
&46 Then you already know that this is pointless.
zh: &46 那你已经知道这是徒劳的。

en: &47 Just go. Leave me alone.
&4723 You're really okay with all this?
zh: &4723 这些事，你真的都能接受？

en: &48 You mean getting rid of you so you'll leave us alone? Of course I am.
zh: &48 你是说把你赶走，好让你别再来烦我们？当然能。

en: &4724 I mean murdering your husband. Poisoning me.
zh: &4724 我是说，杀了你的丈夫，还给我下毒。

en: &49 My husband is the man who just left.
zh: &49 我的丈夫是刚刚离开的那个男人。

en: &50 And as for the poison? The cure is 70 years thataway.
zh: &50 至于毒药？解药在七十年后。

en: &51 Clock's ticking.
&4725 How much do you actually know?
&52 I know everything, Fia Quinn.
zh: &52 我什么都知道，菲娅·奎因。

en: &53 Or should I say, Fia Quinn and Frank Nozzarelli?
zh: &53 或者我该说，菲娅·奎因和弗兰克·诺扎雷利？

en: &4726 We call him Nozzo.
&54 I know.
&4727 What exactly happened fifteen years ago?
zh: &4727 十五年前到底发生了什么？

en: &55 Should you really be wasting your time like this?
zh: &55 你真的应该这样浪费时间吗？

en: &4728 It's my time to waste.
zh: &4728 这是我的时间，怎么用我自己说了算。

en: &56 Well. Like Bobby Brown says, that's your perogative
zh: &56 行，就像鲍比·布朗唱的，这是你的权利。

en: &57 Ask whatever. I'm not the one who's dying.
zh: &57 随便问。快死的又不是我。

en: &4729 Otis was diabetic, wasn't he?
&58 Not that it's any of your business, but yeah.
zh: &58 虽然不关你的事，但没错。

en: &59 He carried those pills around wherever he went.
zh: &59 他走到哪儿都带着那些药片。

en: &60 Probably died with them, too.
&4730 How did you and Duffy meet?
zh: &4730 你和达菲是怎么认识的？

en: &62 I picked him up at a concert.
zh: &62 我在一场演唱会上把他带回家的。

en: &4731 You what?
&63 I thought I was saying goodbye to my abusive husband and this city for good.
zh: &63 我以为，我终于能永远离开那个打我的丈夫，还有这座城。

en: &64 So when I met him, I thought... why not? Why not have a little fun before I leave?
zh: &64 所以当我遇见他时，我想……为什么不呢？为什么不在离开前找点乐子？

en: &4732 So you brought him back to your room at the Commonwealth Hotel?
zh: &4732 所以你把他带回了你在联邦酒店的房间里？

en: &65 Yeah. But Otis was waiting for me when we got there.
zh: &65 是的。但我们到的时候，奥蒂斯已经在等我了。

en: &66 He had the devil in his eyes, let me tell you.
zh: &66 我跟你说，他眼里那股凶狠劲，跟魔鬼一样。

en: &67 If Duffy wasn't with me, I'm sure he would've killed me. And Nathan.
zh: &67 如果达菲不在我身边，我敢肯定他会杀了我。还有内森。

en: &4733 Nathan?
&68 I'd just learned I was pregnant. That's why I was leaving.
zh: &68 我刚得知自己怀孕了。所以我才要离开。

en: &69 Duffy saved us. And gave up everything to do it.
zh: &69 达菲救了我们。为此他放弃了一切。

en: &70 So don't you dare tell me he did wrong.
zh: &70 所以你别跟我说他做错了。

en: &1375 That can't be right. If Marla or Nathan died in the original history, Otis Knox's history would have changed too. And it didn't.
zh: &1375 那不可能。如果玛拉或内森在原本的历史中死了，奥蒂斯·诺克斯的历史也会改变。但它没有。

en: &1376 This doesn't add up.
&4734 There's more to this than you're telling me, Marla. I know it.
zh: &4734 玛拉，你还有事瞒着我。我知道。

en: &71 I don't care what you know.
&72 Now hurry home before your stomach turns to gravel.
zh: &72 现在快回家吧，趁你的胃还没变成砂砾。

en: &73 I don't want to watch.
&4735 I'd better, um, go.
&74 Yeah. You, um, better.
&4736 I feel fine, Duffy.
&4737 I'm tougher than I look, Duffy.
zh: &4737 我比看起来要坚强，达菲。

en: &4738 I found a cure. It worked wonders.
zh: &4738 我找到了解药。效果奇佳。

en: &4739 In fact, I've never felt better.
zh: &4739 事实上，我感觉从未这么好过。

en: &180 Well.
&181 You've always been resourceful.
&4740 You taught me well.
&182 Yeah. I guess I did.
&4741 Nozzo? How long till the fireworks are finished?
zh: &4741 诺佐？烟花还要多久结束？

en: &1377 Any second now. After that, do-
&8044 Nozzo?
&183 Don't bother. I've desynced you.
zh: &183 别费劲了，我把你的同步断开了。

en: &4742 Desynced?
&184 A small invention of mine. I made it back in 2062. Still works fifteen years later.
zh: &184 我的一个小发明。2062年做的。十五年后仍然有效。

en: &185 It desyncs you from the monitoring station at ChronoZen.
zh: &185 它能断开你和ChronoZen监控站的同步。

en: &186 When I turn it off, Nozzo won't even notice time has passed.
zh: &186 等我关掉装置，诺佐甚至不会发现中间过了这么久。

en: &187 So we can talk freely.
zh: &187 所以我们可以自由交谈。

en: &4743 Re-sync me, Duffy. Now.
zh: &4743 恢复我的同步，达菲，立刻。

en: &188 Come on. Don't tell me you never wanted to explore the past without him watching you?
zh: &188 拜托。别告诉我你从未想过在没有他监视的情况下探索过去？

en: &189 Doesn't it feel nice? Just a little?
&190 Don't answer. I know how bad you are at lying.
zh: &190 别回答。我知道你多不擅长撒谎。

en: &4744 Did you use that desync device in the field? It can't be legal.
zh: &4744 你出任务时也用过这断同步的装置？肯定不合规吧。

en: &191 It's not. And I didn't use it often. Maybe a few times. Just to try it out.
zh: &191 不合法。而且我不常用。也许几次。只是为了试试。

en: &192 Then I met Marla, and...
zh: &192 然后我遇见了玛拉，接着……

en: &193 Well. Things got out of hand.
&4745 Got out of hand? You killed a man, Duffy!
&194 He was going to kill Marla. Nathan too.
zh: &194 他当时要杀玛拉。还有内森。

en: &4746 We both know that isn't true. If Otis's history changed that drastically, we would know.
zh: &4746 你我都知道那不是真的。如果奥蒂斯的历史变化那么大，我们会知道的。

en: &195 Fine. You got me. She wouldn't have been killed.
zh: &195 好吧，被你说中了，她不会被杀。

en: &196 She would've been beaten within an inch of her life. And never fully recovered.
zh: &196 她会被打得半死。而且永远无法完全康复。

en: &197 And Nathan? Born with severe brain damage. Grew up despising his father.
zh: &197 内森呢？生下来就有严重脑损伤。长大后恨自己的父亲。

en: &300 It was Nathan who killed him, you know. The original Otis. Buried him at sea on the Fourth of July. Then killed himself a few months later.
zh: &300 是内森杀了他，真正的奥蒂斯。七月四日把尸体沉进海里，几个月后又自杀了。

en: &198 Tell me, Fia. Should I have just stood by and let all of that happen?
zh: &198 告诉我，菲娅。我是不是应该袖手旁观，让这一切发生？

en: &4747 We've let worse things happen, Duffy.
zh: &4747 我们让更糟的事情发生过，达菲。

en: &199 This was different.
&200 I saw an opportunity to make things better. And I took it.
zh: &200 我看到了让事情变好的机会。我抓住了。

en: &201 You mean "Focus on the job"?
&202 I found something more important than the job.
zh: &202 我找到了比任务更重要的东西。

en: &203 And... so have you. Haven't you?
&204 Yeah. You have. I know the look.
zh: &204 是的。你也是。我看得出来。

en: &205 You know how I feel. Whether you admit it or not.
zh: &205 你知道我的感受。不管你承不承认。

en: &4748 You know nothing about how I feel.
zh: &4748 你根本不知道我的感受。

en: &206 I know what it's like to live like you. To avoid caring about anything because it might disappear.
zh: &206 我知道你那种日子是什么感觉。什么都不敢在乎，因为说不定哪天就没了。

en: &207 Look at Nozzo. He lost his whole family. Now his life revolves around ChronoZen.
zh: &207 看看诺佐。他失去了整个家庭。现在他的生活围着 ChronoZen 转。

en: &208 He knows that if he cared about anything else, he could lose it.
zh: &208 他知道如果他在乎别的什么，就可能失去它。

en: &209 Is that the future you want for yourself?
&5126 What makes YOU the exception, then?
&3827 Why do you get to have everything you want, when the rest of us...
zh: &3827 为什么你能得到你想要的一切，而我们其他人……

en: &301 That's just it. I found something I wanted. More than anything.
zh: &301 就是这个，我找到了自己想要的东西，比什么都重要。

en: &302 So I took the risk. Wouldn't you, Fia?
zh: &302 所以我冒了险。你不会吗，菲娅？

en: &303 I think you would. I really think you would.
zh: &303 我觉得你会的。我真的觉得你会的。

en: &4749 Fireworks have stopped.
&210 Yeah.
&4750 So tell me. How is this going to go?
zh: &4750 那么告诉我。接下来会怎样？

en: &211 Fia? A long time ago, I asked you a question.
zh: &211 菲娅？很久以前，我问过你一个问题。

en: &212 I asked why there were so few of us who could do this job.
zh: &212 我问为什么能做这份工作的人这么少。

en: &213 Do you remember what you said?
zh: &213 你还记得你怎么说的吗？

en: &4751 That we were just special.
&4752 Something about our psych profile.
zh: &4752 跟我们的心理档案有关。

en: &4753 That it didn't matter. I was just glad to be chosen.
zh: &4753 那不重要。我只是很高兴被选中。

en: &4754 What does that have to do with anything?
&214 Come on, Fia. I'm at your mercy. Can't you humor me? Just a little?
zh: &214 拜托，菲娅。我任你摆布。就不能迁就我一下吗？就一下？

en: &215 What did you say?
&216 Yeah. I probably made some offhand joke, didn't I?
zh: &216 是啊。我大概随口开了个玩笑，对吧？

en: &217 I've thought about that it a lot over the years. And I've realized something.
zh: &217 这些年我一直在想这件事，后来想明白了一点。

en: &218 Life is about change. The world is about change. Change is a necessary part of life.
zh: &218 生活就是变化。世界就是变化。变化是生活中必不可少的一部分。

en: &219 Staying aloof and above it all while the world alters and shifts around you? Nobody should live like that. Nobody CAN live like that.
zh: &219 世界在你身边不断变化，你却得置身事外，什么都不在乎？没人该过这种日子，也没人过得下去。

en: &220 No wonder ChronoZen finds so few candidates. I'm amazed they can find anyone at all.
zh: &220 难怪 ChronoZen 找不到多少候选人。我很惊讶他们居然能找到人。

en: &221 They told us that we could see "all the paths not taken". Like it was so magical. So blasting special. But they left out one important thing.
zh: &221 他们说，我们能看到“所有没走过的路”，多神奇，多他妈特别。可他们没说最重要的一点。

en: &222 All those paths? None of them include US.
&223 So I escaped all that.
&224 I've walked a path of my own. It was full of highs, full of lows, and full of everything in between.
zh: &224 我走了自己选的路，有高峰，有低谷，也有平凡日子。

en: &225 But above all? It was FULL.
zh: &225 可最重要的是，那是一段充实的人生。

en: &226 Can you say the same?
&227 I'm not going back, Fia. So kill me. Or let me go. I'm ready either way.
zh: &227 我不会回去的，菲娅。杀了我，或者放我走，我都准备好了。

en: &228 Well?
&229 What's it going to be?
&4800 But he's alive in the future..
&8037 Are you sure?
&1409 I'm sure.
&4801 Scan him again.
&1410 I already did.
&1411 The scan compared him to every public photo of him from 1977.
zh: &1411 扫描把他和 1977 年所有公开照片做了比对。

en: &1412 It's him.
&4802 That should be a five alarm situation back home, right?
zh: &4802 那总部不该早就警报大作了吗？

en: &1413 It should.
&4803 Then how...
&1414 Occam's razor.
&1415 If Otis Knox is dead in 1977, then that man you saw on the beach? In 1993?
zh: &1415 如果奥蒂斯·诺克斯 1977 年就死了，那你在海滩上看到的那个人？1993 年？

en: &1416 That's not Otis Knox.
&1417 Get back there. Confront him. Use whatever means necessary.
zh: &1417 回去找他对质，能用的办法都用上。

en: &1418 Find out who the hell he is.
&4804 And what about Marla?
&1419 This was her hotel room. She's involved. Somehow.
zh: &1419 这是玛拉的酒店房间，她肯定也以某种方式牵涉其中。

en: &1420 Do whatever you need to do.
&4805 So he's getting away.
&1421 That doesn't matter, Fia.
&4806 Of course it blasting matters!
&1422 You're dying. Focus on that.
zh: &1422 你现在快死了，先顾着自己的命。

en: &4807 I'm not dying, Noz. Not really.
&1423 The acid in your stomach is changing its molecular composition as we speak.
zh: &1423 你胃里的酸正在改变分子构成。

en: &4808 Not YET it hasn't.
&1424 It will if you don't move!
&4809 I hate giving up. He can't get away with this.
zh: &4809 我讨厌放弃。他不能就这样逍遥法外。

en: &1425 I hate it too, Fia. But there's nothing we can do.
zh: &1425 我也讨厌，菲娅。但我们无能为力。

en: &1426 He beat us. He knows our procedure too well.
zh: &1426 他打败了我们。他对我们的程序太熟悉了。

en: &1427 He even gave you a poison that could only be cured by what I've got here in the office.
zh: &1427 他甚至给你下了一种毒，只有我办公室里的东西才能解。

en: &4810 Yes. How blasting magnanimous of him.
zh: &4810 是啊。他可真是宽宏大量。

en: &4811 Can you send me back after you cured me?
zh: &4811 你治好我之后能送我回去吗？

en: &1428 It won't work.
&8043 Why not?
&4812 Just send me back to the exact second I left from.
zh: &4812 就把我送回我离开的那个确切时刻。

en: &1429 We've been through this before, remember? We can't risk another Chrovergence.
zh: &1429 我们以前经历过这个，记得吗？我们不能再冒一次时空汇聚的风险。

en: &4813 So? I've managed once before.
zh: &4813 那又怎样？我以前成功过一次。

en: &1430 In your weakened state, it would kill you. For real. The rewinds won't be enough.
zh: &1430 你现在这么虚弱，会真的死掉，连回溯都救不了你。

en: &1431 So, no. I'm not doing it.
zh: &1431 所以，不行。我不会这么做。

en: &4814 What'll happen next?
&1432 We've done all we can.
&1433 The brass will assign someone to look for Duffy, but...
zh: &1433 高层会派人去找达菲，但是……

en: &4815 They won't find him?
&1434 I ran a scan for him. Fifty years worth of data from your current when.
zh: &1434 我找过他，从你那边的时间起，往后五十年的数据都扫过了。

en: &1435 Every camera feed. Every publicly available photo. Absolutely nothing.
zh: &1435 每一个摄像头画面。每一张公开照片。什么都没有。

en: &1436 He's gone.
&4816 There is absolutely no cure for MorphaBite in 1993?
zh: &4816 1993年就真的没办法解吗啡噬的毒吗？

en: &1437 None. I'm reading about it now. The antidote takes years to make. You don't have that kind of time. Even with time travel.
zh: &1437 没有。我正在查。解药需要好几年才能制成。你没有那么多时间。即使有时间旅行也不行。

en: &1438 Plus you'd need access to Quansonic particles. And in 1993, that's impossible.
zh: &1438 还得有量声粒子，1993年根本弄不到。

en: &4817 Nozzo. I DO have access to Quansonic particles in 1993.
zh: &4817 诺佐，我在1993年还真能弄到量声粒子。

en: &1439 You do?
&4818 The machine in the secret basement, remember?
zh: &4818 秘密地下室里的那台机器，记得吗？

en: &1440 Fia, you're not suggesting...
zh: &1440 菲娅，你该不会是在建议……

en: &1441 That rusty heap of spare parts and circuit boards?
zh: &1441 那堆生锈的破零件和电路板？

en: &4819 The very same.
&1442 That's crazy!
&4820 What's the worst that could happen?
&1443 I'd give you a list, but we don't have the time.
zh: &1443 我可以给你列个单子，但我们没时间了。

en: &1444 Even if that machine worked, the particles are only PART of the cure. There are several other steps, and...
zh: &1444 就算那台机器能用，粒子也只是解药的一部分。还有好几个步骤，而且……

en: &4821 Do you want to catch Duffy or what?
&1445 Not at the cost of your life.
&4822 You have your finger over the rewind button?
zh: &4822 你的手指放在回溯按钮上了吗？

en: &1446 Always.
&4823 Then you won't let that happen.
zh: &4823 那你就不会让那种事发生。

en: &4824 Send me all the data you have on this cure. Quanmexlin, was it?
zh: &4824 把你手头关于解药的资料都发给我，是叫宽美克斯林吧？

en: &1447 It's... it's in the archive.
&4825 We're gonna do this Nozzo. And I am going to die trying.
zh: &4825 诺佐，这事我们一定要做，我就是死也要试下去。

en: &4826 As many times as it takes.
&1448 I don't like this, Fia. But I'm with you.
zh: &1448 我不赞成，菲娅，可我会陪着你。

en: &1449 If you want to come back, just say the word.
zh: &1449 如果你想回来，说一声就行。

en: &4827 There has to be another way.
&1450 I know you don't like leaving a job unfinished.
zh: &1450 我知道你不喜欢半途而废。

en: &1451 But YOU'LL be the one who's finished if you don't get back here.
zh: &1451 但如果你不回来，完蛋的会是你。

en: &4828 I... suppose that's it then.
&4829 Heading to the landing point.
&1452 I'll activate your jump as soon as you're clear.
zh: &1452 等你到了安全的位置，我就启动跃迁。

en: &1453 And... I'm sorry.
&4831 I need to find a blood sample. Blood that's been infected with MorphaBite.
zh: &4831 得找份血液样本，血里要有吗啡噬。

en: &1454 Um. You don't have to look far.
&1455 All you need is a syringe to extract your blood.
zh: &1455 你只需要一支注射器来抽自己的血。

en: &4832 Buformin. Do you know what that is?
zh: &4832 丁双胍。你知道那是什么吗？

en: &6003 Checking...
&4833 Can you remind me what buformin is?
zh: &4833 你能提醒我一下丁双胍是什么吗？

en: &1456 Checking again...
&1457 It's an oral drug of the biguanide class, chemically related to metformin and phenformin...
zh: &1457 它是一种双胍类口服药，化学上与二甲双胍和苯乙双胍相关……

en: &1458 It used to be taken as diabetic medication.
zh: &1458 以前被用作糖尿病药物。

en: &4834 Used to be?
&1459 It was discontinued in 1978.
&4835 Good thing I'm in 1977.
&4836 Sodium nitrate. That's basically salt, isn't it?
zh: &4836 硝酸钠。那基本上就是盐，对吧？

en: &1460 You're thinking of Sodium chloride.
&1461 Sodium nitrate is typically used as a preservative. Or as a fertilizer.
zh: &1461 硝酸钠通常用作防腐剂。或者肥料。

en: &4837 You said sodium nitrate is used as a preservative?
zh: &4837 你说硝酸钠用作防腐剂？

en: &1462 Or as a fertilizer. Among other things.
zh: &1462 或者肥料。还有其他用途。

en: &4838 What is this... phytofusion?
&4839 What is this phytofusion again?
zh: &4839 植物融合到底是什么来着？

en: &1463 Basically it's when a chemical mixture is injected into a young plant, and the chemical's composition changes as the plant matures.
zh: &1463 基本上就是把一种化学混合物注射到幼株里，随着植物成熟，化学成分会发生变化。

en: &4840 So it has to be a plant?
&1464 Plant. Tree. Flower. Any type of young flora.
zh: &1464 树也好，花也好，什么植物都行，只要还没长成。

en: &1465 It just needs to live long enough to complete the modification process.
zh: &1465 它只需要活得够久，完成整个改造过程。

en: &4841 Making this cure is a lot more complex than I assumed.
zh: &4841 制作这种解药比我以为的要复杂得多。

en: &1466 I told you it would be.
&4842 Are you going to help me or not?
&1467 Okay. Okay. I'm here. What do you need help with?
zh: &1467 好吧。好吧。我来了。你需要什么帮助？

en: &4843 Where's the nearest drug store? I'll get some buformin there.
zh: &4843 最近的药店在哪儿？我去那儿买点丁双胍。

en: &1468 Like I said, it was discontinued in 1978.
&1469 But in 1977, the closest drug store that sells it is...
zh: &1469 但在1977年，离你最近的、有卖它的药店是……

en: &1470 Let's see. The closest drug store that sells it is...
zh: &1470 让我看看。离你最近的、有卖它的药店是……

en: &1471 Forty minutes from your location. Driving distance.
zh: &1471 离你所在位置四十分钟车程。

en: &4844 Blast it. Not enough time.
&6079 I'm sorry.
&5150 Have you read any of Otis Knox's books?
zh: &5150 你读过奥蒂斯·诺克斯的书吗？

en: &1798 Yes. All of them.
&5259 So you're a fan?
&1799 Not especially.
&1800 But thanks to Otis's high ranking, his books are guaranteed not to chrono-shift while I'm reading them.
zh: &1800 不过他的时间线影响评级高，看他的书，就不用担心读到一半被时间线改写。

en: &3138 Ah. That's a good a reason as any.
&5263 The F train runs through here, doesn't it? Even in this when?
zh: &5263 F线地铁经过这里，不是吗？即使在这个年代？

en: &1801 Why do you ask?
&8075 No reason.
&1802 The F train goes to the NYU area, doesn't it?
zh: &1802 F线地铁到纽约大学附近，不是吗？

en: &5145 Does it?
&1803 You want to go to the Nash family storage unit, don't you?
zh: &1803 你想去纳什家的储物间，对吧？

en: &1804 You want to go to the Quentin family storage unit, don't you?
zh: &1804 你想去昆廷家的储物间，对吧？

en: &1805 You want to go to the Finley family storage unit, don't you?
zh: &1805 你想去芬利家的储物间，对吧？

en: &5155 I never said that. You did.
zh: &5155 我从来没说过。是你说的。

en: &1806 The fire doesn't happen for thirty years. What would you even do when you got there?
zh: &1806 那场火灾要三十年后才发生。你到了那儿又能做什么？

en: &5156 I was just wondering. I'm not going to do it, Noz. Don't worry.
zh: &5156 我只是好奇。我不会去的，诺佐。别担心。

en: &5241 I'm focusing on the job. Like always.
zh: &5241 我在专心工作。一如既往。

en: &1807 Good. Then I'll say nothing more about it.
&5273 Your monitors didn't detect Duffy's PFE?
zh: &5273 你的监控器没检测到达菲的PFE？

en: &1808 No they didn't. He must have removed it long ago. He has the knowhow.
zh: &1808 没有。他肯定早就把它取掉了。他有这个本事。

en: &5141 Can we bring him home without it?
zh: &5141 没有它，我们能带他回家吗？

en: &1809 He was wearing it for over a decade. There should be enough residual energy in his system to lock onto.
zh: &1809 他戴了十多年。他体内应该还有足够的残余能量可以锁定。

en: &1810 Assuming you can catch him after the fireworks. And assuming he's, you know. Willing.
zh: &1810 前提是你能在烟花之后抓住他。而且前提是他，你知道，愿意。

en: &5240 I'll worry about that when the time comes.
&8076 I never knew Duffy was that good of an actor.
zh: &8076 我从不知道达菲演技这么好。

en: &6080 How do you mean?
&8077 He fooled everyone. His neighbors. His family. How come nobody saw it?
zh: &8077 他骗过了所有人。他的邻居。他的家人。怎么没人看出来？

en: &6081 He must've used holographic feature alteration. Lowered the strength slowly over time until Otis's face became his own.
zh: &6081 肯定用了全息面容伪装，再慢慢降低强度，让外表一点点从奥蒂斯变成他自己。

en: &8078 Was that technology available in 1977?
&6082 No, but Duffy had the know-how to build a crude one.
zh: &6082 没有，但达菲有本事造一个简陋的。

en: &6083 He's lucky nobody caught him doing it.
&4845 That's all for now, Noz.
&6086 I'll leave you to it.
&4846 No entry.
&4847 I don't know his last name, so I can't look him up.
zh: &4847 我不知道他姓什么，所以没法查。

en: &4848 I don't know her last name, so I can't look her up.
zh: &4848 我不知道她姓什么，所以没法查。

en: &4849 Aha! She does have a telephone number listed.
zh: &4849 啊哈！她确实登记了电话号码。

en: &4850 I'll make a note of it.
&1378 Come on, Fia. Let's get you out of here.
zh: &1378 来吧，菲娅。我们带你离开这里。

en: &4755 I won't make it, Noz.
&4756 We tried so many times.
&1379 Why did you do this, Fia?
zh: &1379 你为什么要这么做，菲娅？

en: &4757 Because Duffy was...
&8053 *cough*
&4758 ...too good a teacher.
&1380 Duffy?
&4759 I wanted to do one thing. Just one thing. For myself.
zh: &4759 我想做一件事。就一件。为我自己。

en: &8054 *cough*
&4760 No. Not for myself.
&4761 For someone else.
&1381 I'll get an ambulance.
&1382 There are already several on their way.
zh: &1382 已经有好几辆在路上了。

en: &1383 I'll just flag one of them down.
&4762 Tried that. Doesn't work.
&4763 Sorry, Noz.
&1384 I don't get it, Fia. Why is she so important?
zh: &1384 我不明白，菲娅。她为什么这么重要？

en: &1385 You barely know her.
&4764 I WANTED to know her.
&4765 To give us both the chance.
&4766 She deserves that. We deserve that.
zh: &4766 她该有这个机会，我们都该有。

en: &1386 Was she worth losing your life over?
&4767 I didn't plan on dying when coming here.
zh: &4767 我来这里的时候没打算死。

en: &4768 It just kinda... *cough*.
&4769 Happened.
&1387 I... I don't know what to do here, Fia.
zh: &1387 我……我不知道该怎么办，菲娅。

en: &4770 Turn off my PFE.
&1388 What? But the rewinds...
&4771 Will stop. I know.
&4772 But it's okay.
&4773 I checked the archive. Imani lives.
zh: &4773 我查过档案了。伊曼妮活着。

en: &4774 Knowing that? It's okay. It's all okay.
zh: &4774 知道她能活下来，就够了。这样就够了。

en: &1389 If the rewinds stop, you die.
zh: &1389 如果回溯停止，你就会死。

en: &4775 I'll die anyway.
&1390 So we'll try again.
&4776 We've tried everything.
&1391 I won't do this. You can't ask me to do this.
zh: &1391 我不会这么做。你不能要求我这么做。

en: &4778 You're the only one who CAN do this.
&8055 Please.
&1392 We'll find another way. There's always another way.
zh: &1392 我们会找到别的办法。总会有别的办法。

en: &4779 We've tried them all.
&4780 Nothing works.
&4781 Trust me.
&1393 I can't, Fia.
&1394 I can't watch you die.
zh: &1394 我不能眼睁睁看着你死。

en: &4782 Then don't watch.
&8056 Please.
&1396 I'll go back and stop you.
&4783 You do and I'll never forgive you.
zh: &4783 你敢这么做，我永远不会原谅你。

en: &1397 I can live with that.
&4784 I'll come back and try again the first chance I get.
zh: &4784 只要有机会，我还是会回来再试。

en: &4785 You know I will.
&1398 You can't know for sure if Imani will live.
zh: &1398 你无法确定伊曼妮会不会活下来。

en: &4786 Don't tell me you...
&8057 *cough*
&4787 ...are doubting the archive?
&1399 No! But another chrono-shift can take her away again.
zh: &1399 没有！但再来一次时空改写，她可能又会消失。

en: &4789 I know! This could all be for nothing!
zh: &4789 我知道！这一切可能都白费了！

en: &4788 Isn't that amazing?
&4790 Think of all the people we met. All through history.
zh: &4790 想想我们在各个时代遇见的那些人。

en: &4791 All following their dreams. Following their hearts.
zh: &4791 他们都在追逐梦想，听从自己的心。

en: &4792 None of them knew if it would work out. None of THEM knew the future.
zh: &4792 谁也不知道能不能成功。谁也不知道未来会怎样。

en: &4793 But it didn't stop them from trying anyway.
&4794 What makes us...
&8058 *cough*
&4795 ...so special?
&1401 Okay. OKAY.
&4796 Thank you, Nozzo.
&4797 It's been... incredible.
&6102 Yeah.
&4798 And for what it's worth?
&8052 *cough*
That's a wrap! Sally's final thoughts.
&6104 Nothing.
&237 Really.
&6105 Yeah.
&238 These paintings have a colorful history.
zh: &238 这些画作的历史可谓丰富多彩。

en: &239 We still don't know the name of the brave woman who sacrificed her life to rescue them. Her reasons will always remain a mystery.
zh: &239 那位勇敢的女子为了救出这些画，献出了生命。我们至今不知道她的名字，也永远无从得知她为什么这么做。

en: &240 All we can do now is appreciate what she saved. And try to imagine what she saw.
zh: &240 如今，我们能做的就是欣赏她救下的画，试着想象她眼中的世界。

en: &241 Do you really feel nothing?
zh: &241 你真的什么感觉都没有吗？

en: &1403 Was she happy?
&242 Sorry?
&1404 Fia. Was she happy?
&244 So you know.
&1405 That she faked her death? Yeah.
&1406 Fia always was a terrible liar.
zh: &1406 菲娅从来都不擅长撒谎。

en: &245 Hah! Isn't that the truth?
&246 It was her biggest regret, lying to you.
zh: &246 她最大的遗憾，就是对你撒了谎。

en: &247 If she realized that you knew all along...
zh: &247 要是她知道，你其实早就看出来了……

en: &248 Well, no point in dwelling.
&1407 So was she happy?
&249 Yes. We both were.
&250 As much as anyone can be.
zh: &250 就像别人一样，有自己的幸福。

en: &1408 Thanks. That's all I wanted to know.
zh: &1408 谢谢。我想知道的就这些。

"Ringcraft Review" interview transcript[April 23, 1921[-----------
Franklin Harrow: What would you say was the biggest highlight for you?
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：对您来说，最难忘的高光时刻是什么？

en: Brian Mason: Jeeze, kid. EVERY time I stepped into that ring was a highlight to me. The cheers, the adrenaline... the rush of victory. Once you got a taste of that, you spend the rest of your life chasing it.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：哎，孩子。每次走上拳击台，对我来说都是高光时刻。那些欢呼，热血上涌的感觉……还有赢下比赛的痛快。一旦尝过这种滋味，往后一辈子都会想再尝一次。

en: Franklin Harrow: Indeed, your first year was marked by victory after victory. You even made it to the championship match.
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：的确，您出道第一年连战连胜，甚至打进了冠军赛。

en: Brian Mason: That was 50 years ago. Couldn't quite seal the deal. But that's okay.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：那是50年前的事了。最后没能拿下冠军，不过也没什么。

en: Franklin Harrow: Do you agree with the critics who said you were too predictable?
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：有人批评您的打法太容易看穿，您同意这种说法吗？

en: Brian Mason: Maybe a little, but who cares? I boxed MY way, with all my heart and soul. Could I have switched things up? Sure. But in the heat of the match, I stuck to what I knew best. Didn't make me a winner, but it made me happy.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：可能有那么一点。可谁在乎呢？我按自己的方式打拳，一心一意地打。我能不能换个打法？当然能。但比赛一激烈起来，我还是会用最熟悉的那套。虽然没赢，却打得开心。

en: Franklin Harrow: That's a wonderful perspective. Thank you for sharing your story with us, Mr. Mason.
zh: 富兰克林·哈罗：您这番话很有感触。梅森先生，谢谢您分享自己的故事。

en: Brian Mason: Thank you for keeping our history alive, son. Remember, it's not always about how many fights you win, but how you fight them that counts.
zh: 布赖恩·梅森：孩子，谢谢你让人们还记得我们的故事。记住，有时候，重要的是你怎么打，而不是赢了多少场。
