zh: 过场：麦迪逊在农场里，感到烦躁，试图擦掉酱汁。外套出现在视野中。她感到困惑，但还是接过外套穿上。她明显松了一口气。

en: Confirmation that you were successful. Madison and Benji deliver the presentation together.
zh: 确认你成功了。麦迪逊和本吉一起完成了演示。

en: The conveyor goes in reverse for a while. Then you stop it.
zh: 传送带倒转了一会儿，然后你停了下来。

en: &197 Really? Incredible.
&198 I'll be sure to tell the agency what a great job you're doing.
zh: &198 我一定会告诉中介，你干得有多好。

en: &199 Get this thing working and I'll tell them you're worth your weight in gold.
zh: &199 把这东西修好，我会告诉他们你价值千金。

en: Puts the coat on the conveyor.
*BEEP*
&220 You might have seen vertical farms before, and you might have seen drone delivery before, BUT...
zh: &220 你可能见过垂直农场，也可能见过无人机送货，但是……

en: &221 ...we've positioned ourselves at the vanguard of the zeitgeist by... combining them!
zh: &221 ……我们通过将它们结合起来，让自己站在了时代潮流的最前沿！

en: &222 Within moments, your bespoke salad order is picked, packed and off into the wide blue yonder.
zh: &222 只需片刻，你定制的沙拉就能完成采摘、打包，再飞上蓝天送到你手里。

en: &224 Madison acts like this is so hard. This is easy.
zh: &224 麦迪逊还说有多难，这不是挺简单的吗。

en: &225 Oh. I'm sorry. Is this boring?
&102 No, but you seem busy. Maybe I should go?
zh: &102 不，但你看起来很忙。也许我该走了？

en: &226 No! Er, I mean. You don't have to do that...
zh: &226 不！呃，我是说，你不必这样……

en: &227 Damn it, Madison. This is so much more impressive with both drones...
zh: &227 该死，麦迪逊。有两架无人机的话，这演示会震撼得多……

en: &103 I'm more free later on. And there's a new chicken place around the corner.
zh: &103 我晚点就有空了。拐角那儿还新开了家炸鸡店。

en: &228 Oh. There, um, is?
&104 Yeah. Maybe there's... something you could ask me about it?
zh: &104 对啊。你是不是……可以问我点什么？

en: &105 Anything at all?
&229 Yeah. Sure. Um... maybe you...
&106 Yeah?
&230 Can... let me know... what it's like?
zh: &230 能……告诉我……那家店怎么样吗？

en: &231 I like sushi! Do you like sushi?
zh: &231 我喜欢寿司！你喜欢寿司吗？

en: &107 Love it.
&232 Grreat. Um. Sushi is... good?
&233 IIII need to go through this one more time!
zh: &233 我我我我需要再排练一遍！

en: &234 Gosh, Benjamin. Keep it together..
&235 MUSIC ON!
&200 Imagine this!
&201 It's a FRIGID winter's day in January, and there's a knock on your door.
zh: &201 那是一月里一个严寒（frigid）的冬日，有人敲响了你的门。

en: &202 It's a FREEZING winter's day in January, and there's a knock on your door.
zh: &202 那是一月里一个冰冷（freezing）的冬日，有人敲响了你的门。

en: &203 It's a COLD winter's day in January, and there's a knock on your door.
zh: &203 那是一月里一个冷（cold）的冬日，有人敲响了你的门。

en: &204 It's an INTENSE winter's day in January, and there's a knock on your door.
zh: &204 那是一月里一个强烈（intense）的冬日，有人敲响了你的门。

en: &205 Outside is a LeafDrone, and it's dropping off a box!
zh: &205 外面有一架 LeafDrone，它正在放下一个箱子！

en: &206 Inside is freshly harvested lettuce...
&207 ...FRAGRANT basil...
&208 ...DELICIOUS basil...
&209 ...SAVORY basil...
&210 ...AROMATIC basil...
&211 ...juicy sweet strawberries...
&212 ...and ripe red tomatoes!
&213 All of which were harvested at our local farm less than half an hour before it arrived.
zh: &213 所有食材都来自我们的本地农场，从采摘到送达，连半小时都不到。

en: &214 The demand for producing fresh food is approaching FAST!
zh: &214 新鲜食品的生产需求正快速增长！

en: &215 The demand for producing fresh food is approaching RAPIDLY!
zh: &215 新鲜食品的生产需求正急速增长！

en: &216 The demand for producing fresh food is approaching SWIFTLY!
zh: &216 新鲜食品的生产需求正飞速增长！

en: &217 The demand for producing fresh food is approaching SPEEDILY!
zh: &217 新鲜食品的生产需求正迅速增长！

en: &218 And we are rising to the occasion. Will you join us?
zh: &218 我们正在迎难而上。你愿意加入我们吗？

en: &219 Needs to be punchier.
&220 Mouth got a little dry. Have to remember to hydrate.
zh: &220 嘴巴有点干。得记得补水。

en: &221 Am I gesturing too much? Or not enough?
zh: &221 我手势是不是太多了？还是不够？

en: &222 You're talking too fast. SLOW DOWN.
&223 Okay. From the top.
*BEEEEEEEEEP*
&224 Augh!
&225 Music off! Music OFF!
&226 I can't give the presentation like this. Benji's going to have to do it. Find him. I... argh!
zh: &226 我这样没法做演示。得让本吉来做。找到他。我……啊！

en: &3139 Better not do that while it's moving.
zh: &3139 最好别在它移动的时候这么做。

en: &3140 I can't reach it.
&4993 I'd better get back to the landing point.
&4412 Madison is still on the bench. For someone in deep meditation, I can feel her coiled-up tension from here.
zh: &4412 麦迪逊还坐在长椅上。说是在深度冥想，可隔着这么远，我都能感觉到她紧绷着。

en: &4413 Madison is still on the bench. Deeply asleep. If Nozzo's correct, she should sleep long enough to miss the presentation.
zh: &4413 麦迪逊还在长椅上。睡得很沉。如果诺佐说得没错，她应该会睡到错过演示。

en: &4414 Madison is still sleeping on the bench. I hope she's in a good mood when she wakes up. If I can't go home, I may need to keep this job.
zh: &4414 麦迪逊还在长椅上睡觉。希望她醒来时心情不错。如果我回不了家，可能还得保住这份工作。

en: &2725 I shouldn't tinker with their things. At least, not while they are watching.
zh: &2725 我不该乱动他们的东西。至少，不该在他们看着的时候。

en: &227 Well? Wow us.
zh: &227 怎么样？让我们惊艳一下吧。

en: &2726 Nozzo? Any idea what to do here?
zh: &2726 诺佐？知道这里该怎么办吗？

en: &668 There should be a panel on the back.
&2727 I see it.
&669 Just push it slightly. That should open it.
zh: &669 轻轻推一下。应该就能打开。

en: &3132 It looks like there's a burnt-out wire. Just here.
zh: &3132 看起来有根烧断的电线。就在这儿。

en: &236 Well-spotted!
&237 Hey, she's earning her credits already.
zh: &237 瞧，她已经开始挣工资了。

en: &228 Wonderful. Now fix it.
&238 Our new temp can handle that.
zh: &238 我们的新临时工能搞定。

en: &239 There's some spare wire in my workshop.
zh: &239 我的工作间里有些备用线。

en: &3133 Workshop?
&240 Through the door just behind you.
&241 You can find whatever you need in there.
zh: &241 你需要的东西都能在里面找到。

en: &4415 I've already looked. There's a burnt-out wire that needs replacing.
zh: &4415 我已经看过了。有一根烧坏的线需要更换。

en: &3134 Right. That should do it.
&229 It's working?
&3135 It should do. It was just a loose wire.
zh: &3135 应该可以。只是根松了的线。

en: &230 "Just" a loose wire, she says. She's just like you, Benj. Acting like it's so easy.
zh: &230 “只是”根线松了。她跟你一样，本吉，都说得轻轻松松的。

en: &242 I've never been a good actor. You remember when we were in "The River Wall" back in 11th grade?
zh: &242 我从来不是个好演员。你还记得我们十一年级演《河墙》的时候吗？

en: &231 I try not to.
&232 Anyway, shall we do a test run?
&243 By all means.
&233 System! Begin drone salad production program!
zh: &233 系统！开始无人机沙拉制作程序！

en: &234 And all systems go! Well done, Fia.
zh: &234 系统一切正常！干得好，菲娅。

en: &244 Well, she obviously has this covered. I'm gonna take an early lunch.
zh: &244 好吧，她显然能搞定。我要提前去吃午饭了。

en: &235 An early WHAT?
&236 The presentation starts in less than an hour!
zh: &236 演示不到一小时就要开始了！

en: &245 Plenty of time. I'll just be on the bench outside.
zh: &245 时间多着呢。我就在外面的长椅上。

en: &246 You want me to be on camera hungry?
zh: &246 你想让我饿着肚子上镜？

en: &237 What if something else breaks again?
zh: &237 万一又有东西坏了怎么办？

en: &247 Our new supertemp's got it covered, right?
zh: &247 我们新来的超级临时工能搞定，对吧？

en: Eject
Socket
Loose wire
This wire appears to have shorted out.
&3142 Here's the problem. This wire's shorted out.
zh: &3142 问题就在这。这根线短路了。

en: &3143 Not yet. I need to suss out the problem, first.
&3145 Should be fixed now.
Trophy
Pedestal
List
Top of Pedestal
Shoes
Spray bottle
Wire
Nozzo-ing herself.
Law of the Protagonist.
Could I be overthinking this?
A small spray bottle. A label reads "PasaGel: Jump Cup Buddo."
zh: 一个小喷瓶，标签上写着“帕萨凝胶：Jump Cup Buddo”。

en: A circular indentation is recessed on top of this machine. The words "Insert PasaGel Container!" are engraved inside.
zh: 机器顶部有个圆形凹槽，里面刻着“请插入帕萨凝胶容器！”

en: A bright touch screen graces the front of this device. A circular indentation is recessed on top.
zh: 设备正面有一块明亮的触摸屏。顶部有一个圆形凹槽。

en: A touchscreen is attached to the far wall.
zh: 远处墙上装着一块触摸屏。

en: A piece of paper is taped to the wall.
The door back to the conference room.
These shoes look brand new.
zh: 这双鞋看起来是全新的。

en: &248 *phew*
&249 My god. This is hard.
&7086 Sorry?
&250 NOTHING!
&251 Everything's fine!
&252 So what's up?
&253 Okay. So what's up?
&254 So many nights, tinkering away...
zh: &254 那么多个晚上，都在埋头折腾这些东西……

en: &110 Sounds like it can get lonely.
&255 Oh. Um. Maybe?
&113 By the way. Looks like we've got company.
zh: &113 顺便说一下。看来我们有伴了。

en: &256 Um. Hey. You're doing a GREAT job, Fia. Really.
zh: &256 呃。嘿。你干得真棒，菲娅。真的。

en: &257 Just... dip out for awhile, okay? I'll holler if I need you.
zh: &257 就……先出去一会儿，好吗？我需要你会喊你。

en: &258 They can self-repair and adapt its form to environmental changes, revolutionizing materials science and engineering. THAT'S my plan.
zh: &258 它们能自我修复，并根据环境变化调整形态，这将彻底改变材料科学和工程学。这就是我的计划。

en: &112 Fascinating.
&114 I really enjoyed talking with you.
&260 Me too. With you.
&115 I know.
&261 It... it was nice?
&116 Maybe... we could... do it again?
&262 ...yeah. That's. Me... too?
&264 Oh. Fia.
&265 Yeah, you really have no reason to come in here right now. Okay?
zh: &265 嗯，你现在用不着进来，好吗？

en: &266 I will holler. If I need you.
Leaves workshop
Select audio phrase key:
Jump
Paper
Zoiper
&3146 Hm. It looks like Benji forgot to exit out of this screen when he last used it.
zh: &3146 嗯。看起来本吉上次用完忘了退出这个界面。

en: &5197 Things may be dire, but not dire enough for me to wear those.
zh: &5197 情况再糟，也还没糟到要穿这双鞋。

en: &5198 But in looking at them... them look very familiar. Where else have I seen them?
zh: &5198 可这鞋……看着真眼熟。我在哪儿见过来着？

en: &3147 I don't need another pair of shoes. Especially ones as garish as that.
zh: &3147 我不需要另一双鞋。尤其是那么花哨的。

en: &3148 Besides, Nozzo can print me any pair I might need.
zh: &3148 再说，诺佐可以给我打印任何我需要的鞋。

en: Melon Cup Buddo
Bolt
Lockers
Bin
Magnet
A group of old lockers. Only one appears to be in use.
zh: 一组旧储物柜。只有一个似乎还在使用。

en: The door back to reception.
A friendly-looking touchscreen is blinking on the wall near the trash bin.
zh: 垃圾桶旁的墙上，有块界面亲切的触摸屏在闪烁。

en: A metal hatch has been built into the floor. There's no knob or handle.
zh: 地板上嵌着一个金属舱口。没有旋钮或把手。

en: A small electro-magnet has been left here on the table, just where Benji said it would be.
zh: 桌上放着一个小电磁铁，就在本吉说的地方。

en: A stylish coat that smells slightly of potting-soil.
zh: 一件时髦的外套，闻起来有点盆栽土的味道。

en: Things coming together.
Blast me sideways!
Now yer for it!
More blast its.
This panel is flush with the wall. A metal tube runs from this panel to the trash bin.
zh: 这个面板与墙壁齐平。一根金属管从这个面板通向垃圾桶。

en: This panel is now warped slightly. Several of the screws are slightly loose.
zh: 这个面板现在有点变形了。几颗螺丝有点松。

en: The tube is now disconnected from the wall.
zh: 管子现在与墙壁断开了。

en: A solid-looking metal trashbin. Its lid is closed.
zh: 一个看起来很结实的金属垃圾桶。盖子关着。

en: You showed that trash bin a thing or two.
zh: 你让那个垃圾桶尝到了厉害。

en: A metal tube attaches the trash bin to the wall.
zh: 一根金属管把垃圾桶连到墙上。

en: The tube is back to being good as new.
A solid-looking metal trashbin. It's lid is slightly open.
zh: 一个看起来很结实的金属垃圾桶。盖子微微开着。

en: You want to avoid looking at that bin as much as possible.
zh: 你尽量不去看那个垃圾桶。

en: The automatic door leading out of this room.
zh: 通往这个房间外的自动门。

en: This wasn't here before. Or, rather, later. This must be what Benji wanted you to bring him.
zh: 之前这里还没有这东西——该说，在之后才对。看来这就是本吉要你帮他拿的东西。

en: after leaves melt!
&3150 That one was beyond terrible.
&3151 Nozzo! What the hell is going on?
&797 It's a Chrovergence.
&3152 Chrovergence...? You mean my jumps are overlapping?
zh: &3152 时空汇聚……？你是说我的跃迁重叠了？

en: &798 It's my fault. I'm sorry.
&799 You were supposed to land 15 minutes after you left, but setting jump points so close together is tricky and...
zh: &799 你本该在离开后15分钟落地，但把跃迁点设得这么近很棘手，而且……

en: &3153 You sent me 15 minutes before I arrived.
zh: &3153 你把我送到了上一次抵达的十五分钟前。

en: &6013 Yeah.
&3154 So I met myself, and I melted.
zh: &3154 所以我撞见了自己，然后融化了。

en: &6014 Yeah.
&3155 And... other me?
&800 She won't feel well, but she won't remember a thing.
zh: &800 她会不舒服，但什么都不会记得。

en: &3156 Ah. Well that explains my incident in the bushes.
zh: &3156 啊，难怪刚才我会在灌木丛里吐成那样。

en: &801 I'm so sorry.
&3157 So what's the plan now?
&802 We're scrubbing the mission. Head back to the landing point. I'll pull you home.
zh: &802 我们取消任务。回到跃迁落点。我拉你回家。

en: &3158 Ah. Slight problem with that.
&3159 My other self is just outside the front door.
&803 Well. This just gets better and better.
zh: &803 好吧。真是越来越精彩了。

en: &804 First Duffy and now this.
&3160 This is NOT the same thing.
zh: &3160 这跟那完全不是一回事。

en: &3161 Stand by. We'll figure this out.
zh: &3161 等着。我们会想出办法的。

en: &6015 Okay.
&14 Right. Trash duty.
&15 Why not?
&7080 Oh blast it.
&3162 I need to get out of sight. Quick.
Some time later.
&3164 I am beginning to hate myself.
&3165 Let's get this thing open.
&3166 What the...
&12 Er. Hello.
&3167 Oof. My head is spinning.
&3168 At least I'm not melted.
&833 You're welcome, by the way.
&7081 Urrrgh.
&4417 That. Is. The. WORST.
&3169 Urf. The lid won't open.
&3170 That is exactly where I DON'T want to go!
zh: &3170 那正是我不想待的地方！

en: &3171 Can't remove it by hand.
&5199 That is beyond a multi-tool's help.
zh: &5199 这可不是多功能工具能解决的。

en: &3174 Urf. The bolt is locked in tight. The multitool can't budge it.
zh: &3174 呃。螺栓卡得死死的。多功能工具也拧不动。

en: &3175 I shouldn't mess with it any more than I already am going to.
zh: &3175 我已经打算动它了，不该再多折腾。

en: &3176 I need to get rid of this trash before doing anything else. Blech.
zh: &3176 我得先把这垃圾处理掉，再干别的。呕。

en: &4994 I don't have time to mess about with that. I need to hide.
zh: &4994 我没时间瞎折腾那个。我得躲起来。

en: &3177 I don't see the point in putting anything on TOP of the bin.
zh: &3177 我觉得把东西放在垃圾桶上面没有任何意义。

en: &3178 There doesn't seem to be a way to open it with my bare hands.
zh: &3178 光靠双手好像打不开它。

en: &3179 I think I've carried enough trash for one day.
zh: &3179 我觉得今天搬的垃圾已经够多了。

en: Access leaves locker
&3180 I remember these old lockers. They're the voice activated kind, right?
zh: &3180 我记得这些老式储物柜。是声控的那种，对吧？

en: &1263 A voice-activated password, yeah. They weren't on the market very long, for obvious reasons.
zh: &1263 对，用语音口令开锁。为什么没卖多久，你也能猜到。

en: &4418 Right. Well, let's see...
&4419 There's nothing for me in there anymore.
zh: &4419 那里面已经没有我要的东西了。

en: &3181 That's way too small for me to fit inside.
&3182 This must be what Benji wanted.
zh: &3182 这一定就是本吉想要的东西。

en: &3183 The bin is down, but the lid obviously isn't coming off.
zh: &3183 垃圾桶倒是倒下了，可盖子还是纹丝不动。

en: &3184 I should focus on the chute that was underneath.
zh: &3184 得想办法打开底下的垃圾滑槽。

en: &4420 I've seen more of that trash bin than I ever want to.
zh: &4420 那个垃圾桶我已经看够了，再也不想看了。

en: Memo
Drawer
Breathe
&218 Tsumugi! Hey, it's Cassie...
&219 I KNOW! Too long!
&220 Tsk, they're working you too hard.
zh: &220 啧，他们也太能使唤你了。

en: &221 Oh wow, so did you get a raise?
&222 OK, well you're exactly who I want to talk to then!
zh: &222 好，那你正是我想找的人！

en: &223 I'm at a start-up! I know, I know. Such a throwback.
zh: &223 我在一家初创公司！我知道，我知道。太复古了。

en: &224 They're great, I am *thriving*.
&225 Anyway, we have something I think Ms Bushiko would really love...
zh: &225 总之，我们有个东西，我觉得布什科女士一定会喜欢……

en: &226 Believe it or not it's food delivery. Yeah!
zh: &226 信不信由你，是送餐服务。没错！

en: &227 I know it's a big ask, but would you maybe be able to talk to her...
zh: &227 我知道这个请求有点过分，但你能不能跟她谈谈……

en: &228 Oh OK. Then how about after her Anderson injection? Say, Wednesday?
zh: &228 哦，好吧。那等她打完安德森针之后怎么样？比如，周三？

en: &229 You're such a good friend, Tsumugi. I mean it.
zh: &229 你真是个好朋友，紬。我是认真的。

en: &230 And you won't regret it. Seriously, she's gonna love the drones.
zh: &230 你不会后悔的。说真的，她一定会喜欢那些无人机的。

en: &231 Oh yeah, the drones are freaking adorable!
zh: &231 哦对，那些无人机可爱得要命！

en: &232 I'll send it all over, you can see for yourself. Come along!
zh: &232 我这就把资料全发过去，你自己看看。一定要来啊！

en: &233 Seriously, you haven't lived till you've tasted our Salad Beaumont.
zh: &233 说真的，没尝过我们的博蒙特沙拉，你就算白活了。

en: &234 Oh, it's kind of... it's like salty-sweet... you know?
zh: &234 哦，它有点……又咸又甜……你懂吧？

en: &235 I know you're busy. I'm not gonna bore you with salad.
zh: &235 我知道你很忙。我不会拿沙拉来烦你。

en: &236 Let's meet up for drinks! Soon.
zh: &236 我们改天约出来喝一杯吧！尽快啊。

en: &237 You too! Yeah, looking forward to it,
&239 OK, that's Wednesday sorted. Who's next?
zh: &239 好，周三搞定了。下一个是谁？

en: &240 Noah?
&241 Cassie!
&242 Hahah! Yeah, I tracked you down.
&243 Oh no, it's fine, we're all moving around so much. I'm at a new place, too.
zh: &243 没事没事，现在谁不是换来换去的。我也换地方了。

en: &244 Yeah! Start-up... got shares.
&245 Well, get you, too! Is it true you get complimentary suites at The Mark?
zh: &245 哇，你也混得不错！听说你在马克酒店有免费套房？

en: &246 You better not trash *that* one.
zh: &246 你最好别把*那间*也搞砸了。

en: &247 I remember your parties Noah.
&248 I *miss* your parties!
&249 Listen- I have something I'd love you to slide across your new boss's desk.
zh: &249 听着——我有个东西想让你递给你新老板。

en: &250 I've done my research, he's going to want to visit us.
zh: &250 我做过调研了，他会想来我们这儿看看的。

en: &251 Uh huh. It's disruptive. You know he loves that.
zh: &251 嗯哼。这玩意儿很有颠覆性。你知道他就喜欢这个。

en: &252 Don't laugh: salad.
&253 Bespoke salad. I'm telling you, it is the future and he'll want to get on it before...
zh: &253 定制沙拉。我告诉你，这就是未来，他会想赶在……之前入局的。

en: &254 I should say.
&255 We're all under NDA, I shouldn't.
zh: &255 我们都签了保密协议，我不该说的。

en: &256 Ohhhhhh fine.
&257 Roy... Rockcamp.
&258 Noah I would never lie to you. He's coming in today. Time is money, babe.
zh: &258 诺亚，我绝不会骗你。他今天就来。时间就是金钱，宝贝。

en: &259 Is your boss able to move fast?
zh: &259 你老板能尽快拿定主意吗？

en: &260 Thought so. I'm sending it over.
zh: &260 我想也是。我这就发过去。

en: &261 Love you, let's do drinks!
&262 Lots of drinks...
&263 Chowder!
Perfect! Now do it again.
Gets out the bad acting.
What's wrong with my tongue?
You're welcome, Cassie
A piece of paper has been placed on this desk.
A drawer with a proper handle. How quaint.
zh: 抽屉居然装了个实实在在的把手，真够老派的。

en: An automatic door leading back to reception.
zh: 一扇自动门，通往接待处。

en: You don't recognize the painting, but you recognize that it was produced using the "Urdinesque" AI algorithm.
zh: 你不认识这幅画，但你看得出它是用“乌尔丁式”AI算法生成的。

en: You couldn't begin to understand what any of this means. Nor do you need to.
zh: 你完全搞不懂这些是什么意思。你也不需要懂。

en: &264 Oh hey.
&265 Getting too much for you out there?
&3185 Too much of something, I'll say that much.
zh: &3185 有些东西是多得让人吃不消。

en: &266 Tell me about it.
&267 Feel free to use my sanctum if you need a bit of peace.
zh: &267 想清静一会儿，尽管去我的专用休息处。

en: &268 Just don't linger too long, okay?
&269 Anyway, I have to take this.
Perfect. Now do it again!
You're welcome, Cassie.
Foreground Pipes
&239 Waste not want not.
A balancing act.
An overstep for a temp.
zh: 对一个临时工来说，这有点越界了。

en: The things I have to do for this job.
zh: 为了这份工作，我不得不做的事。

en: It's always me!
Can I say jumper?
A maintenance panel. It probably controls the settings for the vertical farm.
zh: 一块维护面板。很可能控制着垂直农场的各项设置。

en: The door leading back to reception.
&240 Show some INITIATIVE.
&267 And here it is! The beating heart of Leaves: our Vertical Farm.
zh: &267 就是这里！“叶子”跳动的心脏：我们的垂直农场。

en: &268 What you're looking at isn't just plants, it's going to revolutionize food production, delivery, everything.
zh: &268 你们看到的不仅仅是植物，它将彻底改变食品生产、配送，所有一切。

en: &269 Anyway. Once we get Leaves funded, we are on the gravy train.
zh: &269 总之，一旦“叶子”拿到资金，我们就发达了。

en: &270 Then who knows what we can achieve here?
zh: &270 到那时，谁知道我们能在这里取得什么成就？

en: &271 Oh. That reminds me. I left my electro-magnet in the break area. Could you get it for me?
zh: &271 哦，这倒提醒我了。我把电磁铁落在休息区了。你能帮我拿一下吗？

en: &272 It's on the table in the middle of the room. You can't miss it.
zh: &272 就在房间中央的桌子上。你肯定能找到。

en: &273 Thanks so much!
&3186 There goes the drone.
&3187 And any moment, Madison Bates will...
&7084 Oh blast it.
&241 How did you get in here?
&242 Oh forget it. I don't care. Get out.
&243 Well? I said get out!
&3188 All clear, Noz?
&805 Both your previous selves are gone. The coast is clear.
zh: &805 你之前的两个自己都走了。安全了。

en: &3189 Well. That's a relief.
&274 Don't touch that!
&275 Sorry. We've got the settings just perfect. We don't want to tamper with perfection.
zh: &275 抱歉。我们把设置调得刚刚好。我们可不想破坏完美。

en: &244 Leave that alone, please?
&3190 Hm. Looks like all the vertical farm's systems can be controlled from here.
zh: &3190 嗯。看起来垂直农场的所有系统都能从这里控制。

en: &4421 I should leave it alone. I don't want to wake her up.
zh: &4421 还是别碰了，免得吵醒她。

en: Lid
Chute panel
This flat piece of metal is all that lies between you and discovery.
zh: 只有这片金属板挡着，你才没被发现。

en: This rag is covered in who-knows-what. No wonder it was discarded.
zh: 这块抹布沾满了不知什么东西。难怪被扔掉了。

en: You shoved the rag into the tube's opening.
zh: 你把抹布塞进了管道口。

en: This panel is held in place by four large screws.
zh: 这块面板由四颗大螺丝固定。

en: Your inability to lift your own body weight is the only thing preventing your discovery.
zh: 你没力气把自己撑起来。也正因为如此，才没有被发现。

en: &3191 That would be a very bad idea.
zh: &3191 那会是个非常糟糕的主意。

en: The lid is held down tight by the high-powered magnet, which is in turn held down tight by you.
zh: 盖子被强力磁铁紧紧吸住，而磁铁又被你紧紧压住。

en: URG. Doesn't move an inch.
Come ON! *Sigh* Nothing.
UUUURG.
The bin is unhurt, although I can't say the same for my foot
zh: 垃圾桶没事，但我的脚可不敢说没事。

en: Urf. The bin won't budge.
What's with this thing!
The bin is unmoved.
&2319 Ow. Hurt her hand most likely.
zh: &2319 哎哟。很可能伤到她的手了。

en: chute panel open!
&1012 INCENDIARY DEVICE DEPLOYED.
&3193 A what device?
&3194 Oh bla-
&3195 I can't open that with my bare hands.
&3196 All I see is an empty tube leading into the wall.
zh: &3196 我只看到一根空管子通进墙里。

en: The panel is now open. You can see the tube inside.
zh: 面板现在打开了。你能看到里面的管道。

en: &3198 The panel is closed tight.
An old rag is now stuffed inside the tube.
zh: 一块旧抹布现在塞在管道里。

en: &3199 It doesn't look like it opens by hand.
&5042 I'd better leave it alone.
Gun
Drawer handle
Memstick
Sally doing a Nozzo impression.
My joy is your terror.
zh: 我的快乐就是你的恐惧。

en: You don't know much about weapons, but this one looks clean and well-cared for.
zh: 你对武器了解不多，但这把看起来干净且保养得很好。

en: This looks like a W.E.G. Smart Gun. An early precursor to the weapon you now carry.
zh: 这看起来像一把W.E.G.智能枪。是你现在所持武器的早期前身。

en: A small label on this memstick reads "PU1S3B14ST virus - BE CAREFUL!"
zh: 这个记忆棒上有个小标签写着“PU1S3B14ST 病毒——小心！”

en: This sheet of paper is blank.
&3200 I already have a weapon. I see no reason to take this one.
zh: &3200 我已经有武器了。没必要拿这把。

en: Room changes: %d
Diner door
ToDorm
Oil puddle
Newspaper
Board
Air conditioner
A sign on the door reads "CLOSED FOR SPRING BREAK."
zh: 门上的牌子写着“春假期间歇业”。

en: A small puddle of lubricant is forming under the A/C unit.
zh: 空调下面正在形成一小滩润滑油。

en: The newspaper box is empty and long-abandoned. One of print media's last gasps.
zh: 报箱空空如也，早就没人用了。纸媒落幕前最后留下的痕迹之一。

en: "Free food. Naked servers. False advertising."
zh: “免费食物。裸体服务员。虚假广告。”

en: A groaning A/C unit drips lubricant onto the sidewalk. Better watch your step.
zh: 空调嗡嗡作响，润滑油一滴滴落在人行道上。小心脚下。

en: The door to the diner is warm and inviting.
zh: 餐厅门透着暖意，让人很想进去。

en: A wrought-iron fence blocks your way into a garbage-strewn alley.
zh: 一道锻铁栅栏挡住了你进入一条垃圾遍地的小巷。

en: The busy street of Broadway leads into East Village neighborhood.
zh: 百老汇繁忙的街道通向东村社区。

en: An empty cardboard box lies abandoned on the street.
zh: 一个空纸箱被遗弃在街上。

en: Ask a British person...
What're you asking me for?
Not a British jewish thing.
What I would do with a time machine.
zh: 我会用时间机器做什么。

en: Naming Nozzo and Fia.
Lip syncing and thank you Daniel Wolf!
zh: 对口型，谢谢丹尼尔·沃尔夫！

en: &158 Um. Where are you going?
&159 The Silver Flare is right here. Are we going in or what?
zh: &159 银焰餐厅就在这儿。我们进去还是怎样？

en: &467 I'm telling you, Fia. He's still in the alley!
zh: &467 我告诉你，菲娅。他还在小巷里！

en: &1861 And I'm telling you, he's not.
&468 Well the data is showing SOMETHING there.
zh: &468 但数据显示那里有东西。

en: &469 Something that doesn't belong in that time period. So find it.
zh: &469 是不属于那个时代的东西。所以找到它。

en: &160 God. There it is. The Silver Flare.
zh: &160 天哪。就是那里。银焰餐厅。

en: &162 Jesus. Sorry.
&163 It's just a RESTAURANT. I didn't expect to...
zh: &163 这只是一家餐厅。我没想到会……

en: &1863 Don't worry. Take your time.
&164 Time, huh?
&1864 We have plenty of it. That is the benefit of time travel.
zh: &1864 我们有的是时间。这就是时间旅行的好处。

en: &165 But I don't, though. Do I?
&298 Sorry?
&166 I... was diagnosed with Skimein syndrome. Did they tell you that?
zh: &166 我……被诊断出斯基曼综合征。他们告诉过你吗？

en: &1865 Oh. I see. I'm sorry.
&1866 How long?
&167 They gave me six months. Maybe eight.
zh: &167 医生说还有六个月，最多八个月。

en: &168 That's why I wanted to see this place. One last time.
zh: &168 所以我想看看这个地方。最后一次。

en: &1867 I understand, Dr. Anderson.
&169 Dr. Anderson?
&170 Please. It's 2024. I'm 19 years old. I'm no doctor.
zh: &170 拜托。现在是2024年。我19岁。我还不是博士。

en: &171 Call me JOE.
&172 Right now? I'm just a sophomore bio-chem student.
zh: &172 现在？我只是个生物化学大二学生。

en: &300 I have my whole life ahead of me.
&173 Not to mention countless late-night study burgers from this diner.
zh: &173 还有无数次熬夜念书，来这儿吃汉堡的日子。

en: &174 Let's go in.
&470 Damn it. I told them our vetting process was outdated. I TOLD them.
zh: &470 该死。我告诉过他们我们的审查流程过时了。我告诉过他们。

en: &471 We should've seen this coming.
&1868 Blast it. No sign of him.
&472 I'm telling you, Fia. His PFE data says he's in the alley.
zh: &472 我告诉你，菲娅。他的PFE数据显示他在小巷里。

en: &1869 Well, your data is wrong.
&473 You know the protocols, Fia. Check anyway.
zh: &473 规定你都知道，菲娅。还是去查一查。

en: East Village
&474 Fia? Please. This is important.
&475 Just get over to the landing point. Okay?
&1870 I shouldn't enter without the client.
zh: &1870 没有客户我不应该进去。

en: &1872 There's no handle or keyhole. It must open from the other side.
zh: &1872 没有把手或钥匙孔。一定是从另一边开的。

en: &1873 I don't see how that would open the gate.
zh: &1873 我看不出那怎么能打开门。

en: New Location:[[20 St. Marks Place
&1875 Not with my bare hands, I'm not.
&1876 Now it's all mucky. Blech.
&1877 Good thing my suit is self-cleaning.
zh: &1877 幸好我的防护服能自洁。

en: &1878 This is already as oily as it's going to get.
zh: &1878 这已经油得不能再油了。

en: &5183 No need to reach all the way up there.
zh: &5183 没必要够到那么高的地方。

en: Fire escape
In a unique position to tell this story.
zh: 处于讲述这个故事的独特位置。

en: She's being sarcastic, right?
Include that in the drinking scene.
zh: 把那段加进喝酒的场景里。

en: You recognize that expression. She hasn't quite accepted where she really is. It will come, in time.
zh: 你认得那副表情。她还没完全接受自己身在何处。会接受的，只是需要时间。

en: This fire escape ladder seems to be the most efficient way off the roof.
zh: 这道消防梯似乎是离开屋顶最有效的途径。

en: The door leading into this building. Most likely locked from the inside.
zh: 通往这栋楼的门。很可能从里面锁上了。

en: For now, the towers dominate the skyline.
zh: 眼下，双子塔仍主宰着天际线。

en: Chelsea[September 10, 2001[7:04 PM
&3201 Wow. Nice choice for a landing spot.
zh: &3201 哇。跃迁落点选得真不错。

en: &835 Thanks. I had a feeling you'd like it.
zh: &835 谢谢。我就觉得你会喜欢。

en: &3202 Hm. Not bad, but it IS raining. Could you...
zh: &3202 嗯。不赖，但确实在下雨。你能不能……

en: &836 Sure. Let me adjust the settings...
&3203 Much better. Thanks.
&3204 Go on. Send her through.
&3205 Welcome to 2001, Ms. Tanaka.
&511 Sure. I'm fine.
&512 I'm always fine.
&513 So we're here?
&3206 Look behind you.
&515 Yeah. Yeah. We're here.
&516 Can't dispute evidence like that.
&517 Urgggh.
&4423 Just stand up. Nice and slow.
&518 What the hell hit me?
&4424 That's not important right now.
&4425 Do you know who I am?
&519 Huh? No. Should I?
&520 Answer my question. What am I doing here?
zh: &520 回答我的问题。我在这儿干什么？

en: &521 What the hell am I wearing?
zh: &521 我穿的到底是什么鬼东西？

en: &522 Where...
&523 Holy shit. Are those the TWIN TOWERS?
&524 I haven't seen them since...
zh: &524 我已经很久没见过它们了……

en: &525 I'm losing my mind.
&4426 It's going to be all right.
&526 All right?
&527 Nothing's been all right for a long time.
zh: &527 我的日子早就没好过了。

en: &4427 Just... brace yourself Hanna.
&4428 It will be over soon.
&4429 Well. That's done.
&4430 She get home all right, Noz?
&1264 Yeah. She's here. She's a bit... confused.
zh: &1264 嗯。她在这儿。她有点……迷糊。

en: &1265 I'm thinking she needs a cup of tea with a sedative.
zh: &1265 我觉得她需要一杯加了镇静剂的茶。

en: &1266 You good to be on your own for a few minutes?
zh: &1266 你一个人待几分钟没问题吧？

en: &4431 I'll be fine. You make sure she's taken care of.
&1267 Be back soon.
&528 So what happens now?
&1268 Well, you have two choices. Neither of them are good.
zh: &1268 你有两个选择。两个都不好。

en: &1269 First choice. We wait. Five minutes. Maybe ten.
zh: &1269 第一个选择。我们等。五分钟。也许十分钟。

en: &1270 Without a working PFE, your past will catch up to you. Or rather, your lack of it. You'll just disappear.
zh: &1270 没有有效的 PFE 保护，过去就会追上你——准确地说，是“你没有过去”这件事。你会就此消失。

en: &529 I figured as much. What's the other option?
zh: &529 我猜到了。另一个选择是什么？

en: &1271 We take you home.
&530 But I don't have a home. Not anymore.
zh: &530 可我没有家。再也没有了。

en: &1272 Technically you do. If you count "prison" as home.
zh: &1272 严格来说你有。如果你把“监狱”也算作家的话。

en: &531 Prison?
&1273 What did you think was going to happen, Hanna?
&1274 It's out of my hands. I'm sorry.
zh: &1274 这已经不由我控制了。对不起。

en: &1275 The Grandfather Paradox Protocol triggered as soon as she killed her younger self.
zh: &1275 她杀死年轻自己的那一刻，祖父悖论协议就触发了。

en: &1276 The authorities were summoned. They're waiting outside. They'll take custody of you right after your Quansonic Lock procedure.
zh: &1276 已经通知警方了，他们就在外面等着。量声锁定程序一结束，他们就会把你带走。

en: &532 My what?
&1277 Basically a PFE infusion. Keeps your existence and your memory intact.
zh: &1277 简单说，就是注入 PFE，保住你的存在和记忆。

en: &533 So I'll remember everything? From both timelines?
zh: &533 所以我会记得一切？两条时间线的？

en: &6024 Yeah.
&534 Everything that happened. It's kept me up at night for decades.
zh: &534 发生的一切。几十年来我一直夜不能寐。

en: &535 I thought it would end. I...
&536 Can I refuse? What if I don't have the procedure?
zh: &536 我能拒绝吗？不接受这个处理会怎么样？

en: &1278 You'll disappear.
&537 Jesus. What a choice.
&7146 I'm sorry, Hanna.
&538 You apologize for nothing. You hear? Nothing at all.
zh: &538 你没什么好道歉的。听到了吗？完全没有。

en: &539 I know what I did. I know why I did it. And I know it was worth it.
zh: &539 我知道我做了什么。我知道我为什么这么做。我也知道这值得。

en: &540 My life. My choice. My consequences.
zh: &540 人生是我的，选择是我的，后果也由我承担。

en: &541 Jesus. Look at those towers. They just dominate the city.
zh: &541 天哪，看看那两座塔，整座城市都在它们脚下。

en: &542 They felt so ETERNAL, you know? Comforting.
zh: &542 那时总觉得，它们会永远在那儿。让人很安心。

en: &918 Like... we fragile mortals could come and go, but they would still be here. Forever.
zh: &918 就像……我们这些脆弱的凡人来了又走，但它们仍会在这里。永远。

en: &543 I'd like to look at them for awhile. Could I do that?
zh: &543 我想看它们一会儿。可以吗？

en: &4433 How long do you need?
&544 Give me five minutes? Maybe ten.
zh: &544 给我五分钟？也许十分钟。

en: &4434 Sure, Hanna.
&1279 Fia? The police are still outside. I need to go deal with that.
zh: &1279 菲娅？警察还在外面。我得去处理一下。

en: &4435 Sure. I'll be fine.
&6025 Okay. Stand by, Fia. I'll be back soon.
zh: &6025 好。待命，菲娅。我很快回来。

en: &3207 I'd better check on the client. Her mind seems a bit... occupied.
zh: &3207 得去看看客户。她好像有点……心事重重。

en: &3208 Do you need help getting down?
&545 I guarantee I've climbed up and down more fire escapes than you.
zh: &545 我保证我爬过的消防梯比你多。

en: &546 Outta my way. Let me go first.
&4436 It's locked from the inside. Just as well. The fire escape is less conspicuous, anyway.
zh: &4436 门从里面锁上了。也好。反正消防梯更不显眼。

en: I wouldn't do that to you, man!
zh: 我不会那样对你的，伙计！

en: Hanna Tanaka stands here, drenched by rain and over sixty years of memories.
zh: 汉娜·田中站在这里，浑身被雨水淋透，也浸透着六十多年的记忆。

en: The door to the Lozzotti's basement flat.
zh: 通往洛佐蒂家地下室公寓的门。

en: A damp Jane Street leads deeper into the Chelsea neighborhood.
zh: 潮湿的简街延伸向切尔西街区深处。

en: &547 Yeah. This is the place.
&548 They had me over every Friday for drinks.
zh: &548 他们每个周五都请我过来喝酒。

en: &3629 They?
&549 Yvonne and her husband. Dion.
&550 Amazing how it all comes flooding back, huh?
zh: &550 一切都涌回来了，真神奇，是吧？

en: &551 I know it's been six decades, but...
zh: &551 我知道已经过去六十年了，但是……

en: &3209 It still feels like yesterday?
&552 That's the thing, isn't it? It's not yesterday. It's TODAY.
zh: &552 问题就在这，不是吗？不是昨天。是今天。

en: &553 Let's see what's what.
Lozzotti house - ext
knock on lozzotti's door
&3210 Nobody's home. You think we're too late?
zh: &3210 没人在家。你觉得我们来晚了吗？

en: &554 You're asking if she's murdered already? I don't think so.
zh: &554 你是在问她是不是已经被杀了？我觉得没有。

en: &555 Autopsy put the time of death at around midnight.
zh: &555 尸检判断，死亡时间在午夜前后。

en: &556 That's five hours away.
&557 There's still time to prevent it.
&3211 Still nobody home.
&3212 So. Any moral objections to using this?
